tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I learned Bella's mother drives her to the airport in warm, sunny Phoenix.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: Bella's mother drives her to the airport in warm, sunny Phoenix.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I learned Bella dresses in a summery shirt as a farewell gesture while packing a parka.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: Bella dresses in a summery shirt as a farewell gesture while packing a parka.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I realized Bella's stated certainty about wanting to go is complicated because I learned she lies to reassure her mother.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: Renée expresses worry and reluctance about Bella leaving for Forks; Bella insists she wants to go and lies to reassure her mother.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I updated my view of Bella and Renée's relationship as affectionate and bittersweet based on their goodbye.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: They exchange affectionate, bittersweet goodbyes before Bella boards the plane.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I learned Bella boards the plane after the farewell at the airport.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: They exchange affectionate, bittersweet goodbyes before Bella boards the plane.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.description: I described that my trip to Forks involved a flight followed by drives.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I described the long travel route to Forks (flight and drives).

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.description: I learned that I arrived in rainy Port Angeles on arrival.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I arrived in rainy Port Angeles.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.description: I was met by my father, Charlie Swan, who is the police chief.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I was met by my father Charlie Swan, the police chief.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.description: I rode to Forks with my father in his police cruiser.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I rode to Forks with Charlie in his police cruiser.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.description: I found that my dislike of Forks was strong and clear in my reflections.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I reflected on my dislike of Forks.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.description: I noticed awkwardness with my taciturn father and I perceived emotional distance between us.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I reflected on the awkwardness with my taciturn father.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc3.description: I learned that Charlie bought me an old Chevy truck from Billy Black as a gift.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: Charlie reveals he bought Bella an old Chevy truck (from Billy Black) as a gift.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc3.description: I felt skeptical at first about the truck but then I became delighted when I saw it.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: They discuss its age and condition; Bella is initially skeptical but then delighted.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc3.description: I recognized Charlie's quiet caring through his gift and the somewhat awkward conversation we shared.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: Their brief, somewhat awkward conversation underscores Charlie's quiet caring and Bella's mixed emotions about being in Forks.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.description: I learned that the west bedroom I had as a child remained familiar and unchanged.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "Bella carries her few belongings into the familiar west bedroom she’d had as a child."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.description: I noticed that the house and its old furniture remained the same.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "She notes the unchanged house, the old furniture, the computer with a modem line, and the shared bathroom."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.description: I observed that there was a computer still connected to a modem line in the house.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "She notes the unchanged house, the old furniture, the computer with a modem line, and the shared bathroom."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.description: I observed that the bathroom in the house was shared.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "She notes the unchanged house, the old furniture, the computer with a modem line, and the shared bathroom."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.description: I noticed that Charlie gave me space as I settled in and I felt that allowance impacted how I experienced returning home.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "Charlie gives her space; Bella allows herself some private tears and contemplates her difficulty fitting in socially."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.description: I allowed myself private tears and I contemplated my difficulty fitting in socially which reinforced a sense of isolation.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "Charlie gives her space; Bella allows herself some private tears and contemplates her difficulty fitting in socially."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Bella had a restless night, crying and trying to sleep while rain sounded outside.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'Bella has a restless night, crying then trying to sleep under the sounds of rain.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Bella woke to thick fog and a claustrophobic morning atmosphere that deepened her unease.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'In the morning, thick fog and claustrophobic weather deepen her unease.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Bella is worried about fitting in, notices her pale appearance, and dreads her first day at Forks High School.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'She describes her internal doubts about fitting in, her pale appearance, and the dread of her first day at Forks High School.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I noticed that Bella's belief about belonging has shifted toward feeling like an outsider and expecting discomfort at school.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'She describes her internal doubts about fitting in, her pale appearance, and the dread of her first day at Forks High School.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I observed that Bella's view of others is framed by anxiety and anticipation of judgment, which makes her feel isolated.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'She describes her internal doubts about fitting in, her pale appearance, and the dread of her first day at Forks High School.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that the weather (rain and fog) functions as a mirror for Bella's inner turmoil and increases the difficulty of facing the day.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'Bella has a restless night, crying then trying to sleep under the sounds of rain.' and 'In the morning, thick fog and claustrophobic weather deepen her unease.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.description: I heard Charlie wish me luck before he left for the police station.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "Quiet breakfast with Charlie, who wishes her luck before heading to the police station."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.description: I noticed that the kitchen photos remained unchanged and felt homey.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "Bella inspects the unchanged, homey kitchen photos and senses Charlie's lingering attachment to her mother."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.description: I sensed that Charlie still had a lingering attachment to my mother.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "senses Charlie's lingering attachment to her mother."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.description: I locked up the house, trudged through drizzle to my truck, and observed the truck's interior and engine as I prepared to drive to school.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "She locks up, trudges through drizzle to her truck, and notices the truck's interior and engine as she prepares to drive to school."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.description: I learned that Forks High appears more like clustered houses than a formal institution.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: Bella locates Forks High, which looks more like clustered houses than an institution.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.description: I learned that Bella is given a schedule, a map, and a teacher-signature slip in the front office.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: In the front office she meets the red-haired secretary who produces her schedule and a map, offers friendly small-talk, and gives Bella a teacher-signature slip.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.description: I felt nervous but determined when I left the office, indicating a change in Bella's emotional state about starting school.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: Bella leaves the office nervous but determined.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.description: I found the red-haired secretary to be friendly and helpful, which updated Bella's view of the office staff as approachable.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: In the front office she meets the red-haired secretary who produces her schedule and a map, offers friendly small-talk, and gives Bella a teacher-signature slip.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I learned that Bella navigates between buildings and classes using a map.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Bella navigates between buildings and classes using the map."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I learned that she is made to introduce herself in English and Trigonometry.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "In English and Trigonometry she's made to introduce herself; classmates approach with curiosity."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I learned that classmates approached her with curiosity after her introductions.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "In English and Trigonometry she's made to introduce herself; classmates approach with curiosity."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I learned that Eric offers to show her around and speaks to her in a helpful way.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Eric (a helpful, talkative student) offers to show her around."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I learned that she meets Jessica and Angela during this early integration into school life.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "She meets Jessica and Angela and experiences the slow process of being integrated into the small-town social rhythm."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I felt that Bella experiences a slow integration into the small-town social rhythm rather than instant acceptance.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "She meets Jessica and Angela and experiences the slow process of being integrated into the small-town social rhythm."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I came to view Eric as a helpful, talkative peer who assists newcomers.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Eric (a helpful, talkative student) offers to show her around."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.description: I noticed Jessica and Angela as peers who participate in integrating Bella into local social rhythms.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "She meets Jessica and Angela and experiences the slow process of being integrated into the small-town social rhythm."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.description: I noticed a strikingly pale, unusually beautiful group sitting apart who were identified as the Cullens and the Hales.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "a strikingly pale, unusually beautiful group sitting apart — the Cullens (and the Hales)."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.description: I observed the group's stillness and their unapproachable beauty and I watched Alice leave with a graceful motion.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "She observes their stillness, their unapproachable beauty, and Alice's graceful departure."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.description: I heard Jessica provide small-town gossip about their background and living situation.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "Jessica provides small-town gossip about their background and living situation"

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.description: I felt both captivated by their mystery and comforted to learn that other outsiders existed.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "Bella feels both captivated and comforted that there are other outsiders."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.description: I learned that Bella chose the one open seat next to Edward in biology class.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I read that in Biology Bella finds one open seat next to Edward Cullen.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.description: I felt Bella become uneasy and try to make herself small and keep focused during class because of the encounter.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I observed that she tries to make herself small and keep focused during class, uneasy about his behavior.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.description: I understand that Bella now perceives Edward as hostile and unwelcoming after his reactions.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I noticed that his reaction to her presence read as hostility and aversion.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.description: I met Mike, a friendly, talkative boy who accompanied me to gym class and helped ease some awkwardness.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: Bella meets Mike, a friendly, talkative boy who accompanies her to gym class and helps ease some awkwardness.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.description: I learned that P.E. is mandatory in Forks as part of a required four-year program and I felt out of place during it.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: Bella endures mandatory P.E., feeling out of place in Forks' required four-year program.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.description: My view of Mike improved because his friendliness and talkativeness eased my awkwardness in class.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: Bella meets Mike, a friendly, talkative boy who accompanies her to gym class and helps ease some awkwardness.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.description: I watched Bella return paperwork to the office and hand in her slip.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.source_text: Bella hands in her slip shaken and unsettled.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.description: I felt Bella become shaken and unsettled after Edward gave her a hate-filled glance.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.source_text: he turns and gives her an intensely hate-filled glance that chills her.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.description: I perceived Edward's glance as intensely hate-filled, which updated my view of his relationship with Bella as strained.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.source_text: he turns and gives her an intensely hate-filled glance that chills her.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I sat in my truck and collected myself before driving home in the cold wind.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'Bella sits in her truck and collects herself, then drives home in the cold wind.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I drove back toward Charlie's house and fought back tears during the drive.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'Bella sits in her truck and collects herself, then drives home in the cold wind. She reflects on the day's humiliations, Edward's hostility, the alienness of Forks, and fights back tears on the drive back to Charlie's house.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I felt humiliated by the events of the day and my confidence was shaken.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'She reflects on the day's humiliations, Edward's hostility, the alienness of Forks, and fights back tears on the drive back to Charlie's house.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I found Forks feeling alien and less like a home than it used to.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'She reflects on the day's humiliations, Edward's hostility, the alienness of Forks, and fights back tears on the drive back to Charlie's house.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I perceived Edward's hostility as a clear signal that our relationship was strained.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'She reflects on the day's humiliations, Edward's hostility, the alienness of Forks, and fights back tears on the drive back to Charlie's house.'

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I felt uncertain whether last night was a dream despite reasoning telling me otherwise.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: It was very hard, in the morning, to argue with the part of me that was sure last night was a dream.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I clung to sensory memories like his smell as evidence that the night had really happened.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: I clung to the parts I couldn't have imagined — like his smell.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I noticed it was foggy and dark outside my window.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: It was foggy and dark outside my window, absolutely perfect.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I thought he had no reason not to be in school that day.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: He had no reason not to be in school today.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I dressed in heavy clothes and realized I didn't have a jacket.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: I dressed in my heavy clothes, remembering I didn't have a jacket.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I took remembering not having a jacket as further proof that my memory was real.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: Further proof that my memory was real.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I discovered Charlie was gone when I got downstairs and I realized I was running later than I'd thought.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: When I got downstairs, Charlie was gone again — I was running later than I'd realized.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I swallowed a granola bar in three bites and chased it with milk straight from the carton.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: I swallowed a granola bar in three bites, chased it down with milk straight from the carton, and then hurried out the door.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I hurried out the door and hoped the rain would hold off until I could find Jessica.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: Hopefully the rain would hold off until I could find Jessica.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I noticed that the morning was unusually foggy and that the mist was ice cold on my exposed skin.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: It was unusually foggy; the air was almost smoky with it. The mist was ice cold where it clung to the exposed skin on my face and neck.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward offered me a ride and genuinely gave me the option to refuse.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "Do you want to ride with me today?" he asked, amused by my expression as he caught me by surprise yet again. There was uncertainty in his voice. He was really giving me a choice — I was free to refuse, and part of him hoped for that. It was a vain hope.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I discovered that Edward had brought his tan jacket for me and that the jacket's scent was better than I remembered.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "I brought the jacket for you. I didn't want you to get sick or something." His voice was guarded. "It was better."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I felt awkward and tongue-tied because I wasn't sure if we were still being as candid after last night.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: Last night all the walls were down… almost all. I didn't know if we were still being as candid today. It left me tongue-tied.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I regretted a mumbled comment almost as soon as I said it and feared I had ruined the mood.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "You don't want to hear it," I mumbled, almost whispered. As soon as the words were out, I regretted them.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I found myself drawn to Edward's face and aware of his physical presence while deliberately keeping my gaze there.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: the fabric clung to his perfectly muscled chest. It was a colossal tribute to his face that it kept my eyes away from his body.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.description: I learned that his family took Rosalie's car.
I learned that Rosalie's car is a glossy red convertible with the top up.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: a glossy red convertible with the top up.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.description: I felt more than glad to be alone with him.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: — more than glad to be alone with him, but remembering that his car was usually full.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.description: I wanted to close the little distance and reach out to touch him but I was afraid he wouldn't like it.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: I wanted to close that little distance, to reach out and touch him, but I was afraid he wouldn't like me to.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I learned that Jessica was holding my jacket under the cafeteria overhang.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: Over her arm, bless her, was my jacket.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward cannot read my mind but can read Jessica's mind.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: "I can't," he said, startled. Then understanding brightened his eyes. "However, I can read hers — she'll be waiting to ambush you in class."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I decided I would tell people we were dating if asked because Edward suggested that answer was easiest.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: "I suppose you could say yes to the first… if you don't mind — it's easier than any other explanation."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I learned that Jessica wants to know whether Edward and I are secretly dating and how I feel about him.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: "She wants to know if we're secretly dating. And she wants to know how you feel about me," he finally said.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I felt my heart splutter and my breath shorten when Edward touched my hair and smiled, making me more aware of my feelings.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: My heart spluttered hyperactively. "One side of his mouth pulled up into my favorite uneven smile. I couldn't catch my breath soon enough to respond to that remark."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I noticed classmates stopped and stared at me as I entered class after Edward walked away.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: Three people walking in the door stopped to stare at me.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I learned that Jessica got a really cute dress and that I had been to Port Angeles.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: Jessica got a really cute dress.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I became more worried about how to explain things to Jessica after I felt cheated and irritated.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: I hurried into class, flushed and irritated. He was such a cheater. Now I was even more worried about what I was going to say to Jessica.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I felt that Edward's talent was inconvenient when it intruded on my privacy even though it could save my life.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: How very inconvenient his little talent could be — when it wasn't saving my life.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I confirmed that I sat in my usual seat and that English and Government passed in a blur while I worried.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: I sat in my usual seat, slamming my bag down in aggravation.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I took evasive action as soon as the bell rang to avoid a sensitive subject.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: and as soon as the bell rang, I took evasive action.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I learned that Mike asked me if Jessica had said anything about Monday night.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: In English, Mike asked me if you said anything about Monday night," I told her.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I became more worried that the subject would return to me and I deliberately drew out the walk to avoid it.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: I wouldn't have helped draw it out for as long as I did if I wasn't worried about the subject returning to me.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I noticed Edward waiting at the Spanish door and his presence made me self-conscious and prompted Jessica to leave.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: outside the door to our Spanish class, leaning against the wall — looking more like a Greek god than anyone had a right to — Edward was waiting for me. Jessica took one look, rolled her eyes, and departed.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I walked with Edward to the cafeteria and I realized that his presence drew everyone's stares.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: Walking with Edward through the crowded lunchtime rush was a lot like my first day here; everyone stared.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward bought a lot of food and that he said, "Half is for me, of course," indicating he intended to share and participate.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: Half is for me, of course.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward listens and monitors things I say and think because I heard him warn, "I warned you I would be listening."
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: I warned you I would be listening.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I believed for a moment that I cared more for Edward than he did for me and I answered 'Yes' to his question before he contradicted me by saying, "You're wrong."
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: Do you truly believe that you care more for me than I do for you?" ... "You're wrong.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I felt our relationship shift into a more intense and honest place when Edward confirmed my perceptions and insisted on knowing my thoughts with the line, "I do want to know what you're thinking — everything."
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: You did," he agreed, but his voice was still rough. "You aren't precisely right, though. I do want to know what you're thinking — everything.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I learned that the trip to Goat Rocks was questioned as a hunting excursion because Bella asked why he went there to hunt and mentioned Charlie's warning about bears.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: Why did you go to that Goat Rocks place last weekend… to hunt? Charlie said it wasn't a good place to hike, because of bears.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I learned that the Cullens consider legal hunting laws to apply only to weapons as humans define them and that they use other methods.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: If you read carefully, the laws only cover hunting with weapons,

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I learned that Emmett favors grizzly bears and that Edward stated a preference for mountain lions.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: Grizzly is Emmett's favorite. Mountain lion.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I felt more frightened and unsettled by the idea of their hunting methods after Edward's terse and furious reaction when Bella asked whether she might see it.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: "Absolutely not!" His face turned even whiter than usual, and his eyes were suddenly furious.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I found Emmett more menacing after noticing the thick bands of muscle on his arms and torso while thinking about Edward's hunting descriptions.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: I peeked across the cafeteria toward Emmett, grateful that he wasn't looking my way. The thick bands of muscle that wrapped his arms and torso were somehow even more menacing now.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward would apologize and planned to be on my doorstep bright and early Saturday morning.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "And I'll be on your doorstep bright and early Saturday morning."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I decided that his offer to let me drive Saturday was probably the best I would get and therefore agreed.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I considered, and decided it was probably the best offer I would get. "Deal," I agreed.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that he did not intend to bring a car so as not to leave an unexplained vehicle in the driveway.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "I wasn't intending to bring a car."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned why I could not watch him hunt because they give themselves over to their senses and smell could make him lose control.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "When we hunt," he spoke slowly, unwillingly, "we give ourselves over to our senses… govern less with our minds. Especially our sense of smell. If you were anywhere near me when I lost control that way..."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I felt increasingly drawn to Edward as electricity charged the atmosphere between us and left me breathless.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: Flickers of the electricity I'd felt this afternoon began to charge the atmosphere as he gazed unrelentingly into my eyes. It wasn't until my head started to swim that I realized I wasn't breathing.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I experienced restless, electric dreams about Edward that left me exhausted and edgy the next morning.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: That night Edward starred in my dreams, as usual. However, the climate of my unconsciousness had changed. It thrilled with the same electricity that had charged the afternoon, and I tossed and turned restlessly, waking often.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I told Charlie that I was not going to the dance when he asked if I could make it back in time.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "I'm not going to the dance, Dad."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I saw the silver car already parked in Charlie's spot on the driveway when I peeked out my window.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: The silver car was already there, waiting in Charlie's spot on the driveway.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I felt compelled to talk more than usual because of Edward's absolute absorption and never-ending stream of questions.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: But the absolute absorption of his face, and his never-ending stream of questions, compelled me to continue.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I experienced a restless craving and irrational longing to touch Edward's cold skin when the lights went out, indicating a deepening physical attraction.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: As soon as the room was dark, there was the same electric spark, the same restless craving to stretch my hand across the short space and touch his cold skin, as yesterday.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I admitted that my favorite gemstone changed to topaz in that moment because it matched the color of Edward's eyes.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: Such as the time he asked my favorite gemstone, and I blurted out topaz before thinking...My face reddened because, until very recently, my favorite gemstone was garnet..."It's the color of your eyes today," I sighed...

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I realized that Edward had the same Debussy CD that Phil had given me when he pulled it from his car's CD compartment and handed it to me.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: He flipped open a compartment under his car's CD player, pulled out one of thirty or so CDs that were jammed into the small space, and handed it to me, 'Debussy to this?' It was the same CD.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I heard Jacob call to me from the driver's side of the little black car.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: "Hey, Bella," called a familiar, husky voice from the driver's side of the little black car.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I watched Charlie's cruiser swing around the corner with its lights shining on the occupants of the car in front of me.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Just then, Charlie's cruiser swung around the corner, his lights shining on the occupants of the car in front of me.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I recognized the heavyset man in the passenger seat as Jacob's father, Billy Black, despite having forgotten his name over the years.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Jacob's father, Billy Black. I knew him immediately, though in the more than five years since I'd seen him last I'd managed to forget his name when Charlie had spoken of him my first day here.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I noticed Billy's overflowing cheeks, creased russet skin, and black eyes that seemed both too young and too ancient.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: In the passenger seat was a much older man, a heavyset man with a memorable face — a face that overflowed, the cheeks resting against his shoulders, with creases running through the russet skin like an old leather jacket. And the surprisingly familiar eyes, black eyes that seemed at the same time both too young and too ancient for the broad face they were set in.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I concluded that Billy recognized Edward and therefore might believe the impossible legends about him.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Had Billy recognized Edward so easily? Could he really believe the impossible legends his son had scoffed at? The answer was clear in Billy's eyes. Yes. Yes, he could.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I groaned internally as I remembered Edward's warning that this would be another complication.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text:
Another complication, Edward had said.

I groaned internally.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I smiled tentatively at Jacob when Billy scrutinized my face, reflecting an uneasy but familiar connection with Jacob and his family.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: He was staring at me, scrutinizing my face, so I smiled tentatively at him.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I enjoyed the sun but preferred drier air.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I enjoyed the sun, too, though the air wasn't quite dry enough for my taste.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I became more convinced of Edward's unreal beauty and feared he might disappear like a mirage.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: Hesitantly, always afraid, even now, that he would disappear like a mirage, too beautiful to be real…

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I reached out and touched Edward's hand and felt close enough to hold and turn his palm while I watched the sun glitter on his skin.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I lifted his hand, turning it this way and that as I watched the sun glitter on his palm.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I found the meadow less spectacular compared to Edward's presence.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: The meadow, so spectacular to me at first, paled next to his magnificence.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I smelled Edward's breath as sweet and irresistible and noted that his scent made my mouth water.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: Sweet, delicious, the scent made my mouth water. It was unlike anything else. Instinctively, unthinkingly, I leaned closer, inhaling.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward can move with terrifying speed and exert superhuman strength.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: And he was gone, his hand ripped from mine. In the time it took my eyes to focus, he was twenty feet away, standing at the edge of the small meadow... only to appear beneath the same tree as before, having circled the meadow in half a second. He reached up with one hand and, with a deafening crack, effortlessly ripped a two-foot-thick branch from the trunk of the spruce.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I became more afraid of Edward and started to see him as less human and more dangerous despite his beauty.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: I sat without moving, more frightened of him than I had ever been. He'd never been less human… or more beautiful.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I felt hurt and confused when he pulled his hand away and also noticed his apology and vow not to hurt me, which complicated my trust.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: And he was gone, his hand ripped from mine. 'I'm… sorry… Edward,' I whispered. 'I am so very sorry.' He hesitated. 'I promise…' He hesitated. 'I swear not to hurt you.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I learned that he told me he could control himself and that I had caught him off guard but that he was on his best behavior now.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "Please forgive me," he said formally. "I can control myself. You caught me off guard. But I'm on my best behavior now."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I learned that he told me he was not thirsty today and even winked when he said it.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "I'm not thirsty today, honestly." He winked.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I felt encouraged when I realized his struggle to control himself was as new to him as it was to me, which gave me courage.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "As many years of unfathomable experience as he had, this was hard for him, too. I took courage from that thought."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I admitted aloud that I was afraid because I couldn't stay with him and that I feared I would want to stay with him much more than I should.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "I was afraid… because, for, well, obvious reasons, I can't stay with you. And I'm afraid that I'd like to stay with you, much more than I should."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I recognized that he appeared repentant and ashamed and that his sudden mood changes left me dazed and a step behind.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "He smiled, but his face was ashamed." and "His sudden mood changes left me always a step behind, dazed."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I understood from his warning that he believed he was more dangerous to me than to anyone else.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "Never forget I am more dangerous to you than I am to anyone else."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward perceives each person as having a distinct scent or essence that can be pleasurable or dangerously enticing.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: "You see, every person smells different, has a different essence."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.description: I realized that I am aware of my own dangerous appeal to Edward and I responded by teasing to soften the revelation.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: "So what you're saying is, I'm your brand of heroin?" I teased, trying to lighten the mood.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.description: I recognized that Edward explicitly identifies me as uniquely intoxicating to him, which deepens both intimacy and risk in our relationship.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: "Yes, you are exactly my brand of heroin."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward found my scent maddening and described it as nearly deranging him the first day.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: The fragrance coming off your skin… I thought it would make me deranged that first day.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward nearly acted on his thirst in public situations, including a classroom and a small room where Ms. Cope was present, which could have resulted in her death.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: It took everything I had not to jump up in the middle of that class full of children and — When you walked past me, I could have ruined everything Carlisle has built for us, right then and there. ... There was only one other frail human there — so easily dealt with.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I realized that Edward did not hate me but was horrified and ashamed of his uncontrollable desire toward me.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: I couldn't understand why. How you could hate me so quickly… To me, it was like you were some kind of demon, summoned straight from my own personal hell to ruin me.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I now view Edward as someone who is deeply attracted to me yet determined to protect his family and restrain himself despite the danger he feels.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: If I hadn't been denying my thirst for the last, well, too many years, I wouldn't have been able to stop myself.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward went to Alaska the morning after our first meeting and stayed for two days because he felt ashamed and homesick.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: By the next morning I was in Alaska. He sounded ashamed, as if admitting a great cowardice. I spent two days there, with some old acquaintances… but I was homesick.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward believed he was strong enough to resist his urges, so he returned and took precautions like hunting and feeding more before seeing me.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: So I came back… I took precautions, hunting, feeding more than usual before seeing you again. I was sure that I was strong enough to treat you like any other human. I was arrogant about it.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward could not read my thoughts and therefore had to listen to my words in Jessica's mind, which he found irritating.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: It was unquestionably a complication that I couldn't simply read your thoughts to know what your reaction was to me. I wasn't used to having to go to such circuitous measures, listening to your words in Jessica's mind… her mind isn't very original, and it was annoying to have to stoop to that.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward was repeatedly stunned by my scent when I moved, which made him struggle to maintain control.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: But you were too interesting, I found myself caught up in your expressions… and every now and then you would stir the air with your hand or your hair, and the scent would stun me again…

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward saved me when I was nearly crushed and that his immediate reaction in that moment was the thought, 'Not her.'
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: Of course, then you were nearly crushed to death in front of my eyes. Later I thought of a perfectly good excuse for why I acted at that moment — because if I hadn't saved you, if your blood had been spilled there in front of me, I don't think I could have stopped myself from exposing us for what we are. At the time, all I could think was, 'Not her.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I felt relief and compassion instead of terror after hearing Edward's agonized confession about his craving and suffering.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: I listened, more eager than rational. Common sense told me I should be terrified. Instead, I was relieved to finally understand. And I was filled with compassion for his suffering, even now, as he confessed his craving to take my life.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I understood Edward as both a tormentor and protector, which deepened my sympathy and complicated my feelings toward him.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: I was filled with compassion for his suffering, even now, as he confessed his craving to take my life.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.description: I admitted that I would rather die than stay away from Edward.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.source_text: "I'm here… which, roughly translated, means I would rather die than stay away from you."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.description: I acknowledged my own self-criticism when I called myself an idiot and shared a laugh with him over the impossibility of the moment.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.source_text:
"I'm an idiot."

"You are an idiot," he agreed with a laugh.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.description: I heard Edward report that he had fought with Rosalie, Emmett, and Jasper and that Carlisle and Alice had sided with him during those arguments.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.source_text: "I fought with Rosalie, Emmett, and Jasper when they suggested that now was the time… the worst fight we've ever had. Carlisle sided with me, and Alice."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward's earlier withdrawal was caused by my proximity and the scent of my throat.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: It was just how close you were. Most humans instinctively shy away from us, are repelled by our alienness… I wasn't expecting you to come so close. And the smell of your throat.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward can hear my heartbeat when he rests his face against my chest.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: He came to rest with the side of his face pressed tenderly against my chest. Listening to my heart.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I realized that I could not make myself be afraid despite knowing how dangerous the situation could be.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: I knew at any moment it could be too much, and my life could end — so quickly that I might not even notice. And I couldn't make myself be afraid.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I felt closer to Edward and more intimate with him as I touched his face, something I had dreamed of since I first saw him.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: I was touching his face, something I'd dreamed of constantly since the first day I'd seen him.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward feels an intense hunger and thirst for me that he likens to an addiction I may only partially understand.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: I don't think I can. I've told you, on the one hand, the hunger — the thirst — that, deplorable creature that I am, I feel for you. And I think you can understand that, to an extent. Though — as you are not addicted to any illegal substances, you probably can't empathize completely.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward experiences other hungers that are foreign to him and that he cannot fully explain.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: But… There are other hungers. Hungers I don't even understand, that are foreign to me.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I became more comfortable with close physical contact and found comfort in pressing my cheek to his chest and accepting his arms around me.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: This is enough. In a very human gesture, he put his arms around me and pressed his face against my hair.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I realized Edward is more human and vulnerable than I had fully appreciated, which deepened my emotional connection to him.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: I'm not used to feeling so human. Is it always like this? I don't know how to be close to you, he admitted.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I learned that my pulse gives away my reaction even when my thoughts cannot be heard.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: My heart reacted; even though he couldn't hear my thoughts, my pulse always gave me away.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I experienced being slung onto his back with very little effort on my part and clung so tightly that my limbs would choke a normal person.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: He then proceeded to sling me onto his back, with very little effort on my part, besides, when in place, clamping my legs and arms so tightly around him that it would choke a normal person.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I became more terrified than before and felt that any prior fear of death in his presence was nothing compared to now.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: If I'd ever feared death before in his presence, it was nothing compared to how I felt now.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I felt dizzy faintness and motion sickness for the first time due to the speed of the run.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: And, for the first time in my life, I felt the dizzy faintness of motion sickness.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I recalled that we had hiked for hours that morning to reach the meadow and that we were back at the truck in minutes.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: We'd hiked hours this morning to reach Edward's meadow, and now, in a matter of minutes, we were back to the truck.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I was too terrified to close my eyes even though the cool forest air whipped against my face and burned them.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: I was too terrified to close my eyes, though the cool forest air whipped against my face and burned them.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I learned that Bella became dizzy and needed to lie down after the run.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I read 'I think I need to lie down' and 'Dizzy, I think.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I learned that Bella kissed Edward unexpectedly and experienced a strong, visceral physical reaction.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I read 'his cold, marble lips pressed very softly against mine' and 'Blood boiled under my skin, burned in my lips.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I found that Bella's feelings deepened and she felt besotted and afraid of being separated from Edward.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I noticed 'It would cause me physical pain to be separated from him now.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I observed that Bella's physical boundary with Edward shifted as their contact increased beyond their previous careful non-contact.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I noted 'I was so used to our standard of careful non-contact.'

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.description: I realized Bella woke from a dream and suddenly remembered that Edward had been there.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Bella wakes from a dream and suddenly remembers Edward was there; she rushes to him, flusters at her own enthusiasm; they share a warmly intimate moment as he reassures her that he stayed; they tease one another, and Bella retreats briefly to the bathroom to compose herself before returning to Edward's arms."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.description: I felt Bella's fear or uncertainty shift to relief and affectionate eagerness when she found Edward still present.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Bella wakes from a dream and suddenly remembers Edward was there; she rushes to him, flusters at her own enthusiasm; they share a warmly intimate moment as he reassures her that he stayed; they tease one another, and Bella retreats briefly to the bathroom to compose herself before returning to Edward's arms."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.description: I noticed Bella's connection with Edward strengthened in this scene through his reassurance and their intimate interaction.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Bella wakes from a dream and suddenly remembers Edward was there; she rushes to him, flusters at her own enthusiasm; they share a warmly intimate moment as he reassures her that he stayed; they tease one another, and Bella retreats briefly to the bathroom to compose herself before returning to Edward's arms."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.description: I heard him suggest I meet his family during breakfast.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: Edward suggests Bella meet his family; Bella nervously reacts to the idea

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.description: I felt nervous about the idea of meeting his family and I considered how that anxiety might affect introductions to her father as his girlfriend.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: Bella nervously reacts to the idea and they talk about how open Edward’s family is and whether she should meet her father as his girlfriend.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.description: I noticed our affection and banter reinforced a sense of closeness and I heard him reassure me of his commitment and protection.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: Their affection and banter continue, with Edward reassuring her of his commitment and protection.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.description: I saw Bella dress, return, and be teased about her appearance before being kissed.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Bella dresses and returns; Edward teases her about her appearance and kisses her.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella fainted from the intensity of the moment.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: The intensity of the moment causes Bella to faint.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.description: I felt Bella's relationship with Edward was reaffirmed by their exchange and the subsequent drive toward his home.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Edward then drives Bella out of town toward his home, their relationship reaffirmed.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella sees a large, timeless white house among cedars near a river and reacts with awe.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: Bella sees the large, timeless white house among cedars near a river and reacts with awe.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.description: I felt that Bella's emotional state shifted to a mixture of awe and nervous jitters upon seeing the house.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: Bella sees the large, timeless white house among cedars near a river and reacts with awe. They approach the porch together, Edward comforting Bella’s jitters as they enter the house.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward comforts Bella and that their interaction at the house highlights his protective, reassuring role.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: They approach the porch together, Edward comforting Bella’s jitters as they enter the house.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.description: I met Carlisle and Esme in a bright, open main room during my introduction to the family.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.source_text: I read that Bella meets Carlisle and Esme in the bright, open main room.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.description: I observed that the parents greeted me politely and with visible caution when I arrived.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.source_text: I read that the parents greet her politely and cautiously.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.description: I found Esme warm and gentle which adjusted my expectation of the family's emotional tone toward kindness.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.source_text: I read that Bella finds Esme warm and gentle.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.description: I viewed the household as welcoming despite their reserve which softened my sense of distance from them.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.source_text: I read that the family's pale beauty coexisted with a welcoming atmosphere despite their reserve.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.description: I observed that Alice and Jasper appeared at the top of the grand staircase.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Alice and Jasper appear at the top of the grand staircase."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.description: I noticed that Bella's nerves eased when her family members arrived.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: I read: "The presence of these family members eases Bella’s nerves."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.description: I perceived that Alice shows obvious approval toward Bella and that Jasper's gentler reserve complements that approval, indicating family support.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Alice enthusiastically greets Bella and shows obvious approval; Jasper is gentler and more reserved."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.description: I learned that Bella was deeply moved by Edward's piano composition.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: He performs a complex piece he composed, which deeply moves Bella.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.description: I noticed Bella appeared more accepted by the Cullen family as their reactions revealed warmth and pride.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: The family’s reactions reveal warmth and pride.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.description: I felt Bella's confidence in her place with the family increased after Edward indicated they liked her and reassured her about Rosalie and Emmett.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: Edward indicates to Bella that the family likes her and reassures her about Rosalie and Emmett, who are currently absent or hesitant.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.description: I observed Bella speaking privately with Edward after the music.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: After the music, Edward and Bella speak more privately.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.description: I felt Bella's mood shift from celebration to cautious concern during the conversation.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: The mood shifts from celebration to cautious concern.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward reassured Bella about most family members’ acceptance.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: He also shares family background and reassures Bella about most members’ acceptance.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.description: I noticed an old wooden cross on the wall and questioned its presence.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.source_text: I saw "In the hall she notices an old wooden cross on the wall and questions its presence."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.description: I felt curious and slightly unsettled by the presence of the cross, which prompted me to ask about it.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.source_text: I read "In the hall she notices an old wooden cross on the wall and questions its presence."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.description: I trusted Edward to explain the family's history and accepted his invitation to ask more questions as he continued the tour.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.source_text: I heard "The scene ends with Edward inviting Bella to ask more questions as he continues the tour."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that Carlisle's office is a high‑ceilinged room with tall west‑facing windows, dark wood paneling, towering bookshelves, a huge mahogany desk, and a leather chair.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "Edward opened the door to a high‑ceilinged room with tall, west‑facing windows. The walls were paneled again, in a darker wood — where they were visible. Most of the wall space was taken up by towering bookshelves that reached high above my head and held more books than I'd ever seen outside a library. Carlisle sat behind a huge mahogany desk in a leather chair."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that one of the framed pictures is a small square sepia oil painting depicting London in the sixteen‑fifties with a river and a bridge.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "This one did not stand out among the bigger and brighter pieces; painted in varying tones of sepia, it depicted a miniature city full of steeply slanted roofs, with thin spires atop a few scattered towers. A wide river filled the foreground, crossed by a bridge covered with structures that looked like tiny cathedrals."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned from Carlisle's and Edward's words that the painting represented "London in the sixteen‑fifties" and that Carlisle referred to it as the London of his youth.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "'London in the sixteen‑fifties,' Edward said. 'The London of my youth,' Carlisle added, from a few feet behind us."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward intended to show me some of Carlisle's history and that he named "The Waggoner" as the place to start.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "'I wanted to show Bella some of our history,' Edward said. 'Well, your history, actually.' 'Where are you going to start?' 'The Waggoner,' Edward replied, placing one hand lightly on my shoulder and spinning me around to look back toward the door we'd just come through.'"

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I felt my reaction to Edward's casual touch more intensely and became embarrassed by my audible heartbeat whenever he touched me.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "Every time he touched me, in even the most casual way, my heart had an audible reaction. It was more embarrassing with Carlisle there."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I realized that Carlisle sometimes spoke aloud primarily for my benefit, which I found unsettling.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "It was also unsettling to know that he spoke aloud only for my benefit."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that Carlisle needed to leave because the hospital called about Dr. Snow taking a sick day, which tied his everyday duties to the present moment.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "'I'm actually running a bit late. The hospital called this morning — Dr. Snow is taking a sick day.'"

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I learned that Carlisle rebelled against his new vampire nature and attempted to destroy himself by jumping, drowning, and starvation before surviving.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "When he knew what he had become," Edward said quietly, "he rebelled against it. He tried to destroy himself. But that's not easily done."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I learned that vampires are difficult to kill and that there are very few ways they can be killed.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "Is that possible?" My voice was faint. "No, there are very few ways we can be killed."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I learned that Carlisle regained strength after attacking a herd of deer and that eating venison helped him resist becoming a monster.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "One night, a herd of deer passed his hiding place. He was so wild with thirst that he attacked without a thought... He found himself again."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I learned that vampires technically do not need to breathe and that swimming long distances, like to France, is easy for them.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "Because, technically, we don't need to breathe." "How long can you go… without breathing?" "Indefinitely, I suppose..." "He swam to France."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I promised that I was not going to run away despite the disturbing revelations, and I felt more resolved toward Edward after hearing his story.
I felt Edward's vulnerability when he admitted he expected me to be overwhelmed and run, and I recognized his conflicting desires to keep me safe and to be with me.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "I keep waiting for it to happen... something I tell you or something you see is going to be too much. And then you'll run away from me... I want this to happen, because I want you to be safe. And yet, I want to be with you."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that Carlisle decided to act during the influenza epidemic while working nights in a Chicago hospital and that I was left in a ward with the dying.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: When the influenza epidemic hit, he was working nights in a hospital in Chicago. There was no hope for me; I was left in a ward with the dying.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that Carlisle had nursed my parents and that his knowledge of my circumstance influenced his decision.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: He had nursed my parents, and knew I was alone.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I realized that Carlisle deliberately chose to attempt creating a companion out of compassion and hesitation rather than reckless desire.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: He wasn't absolutely sure how his own transformation had occurred, so he was hesitant. And he was loath to steal anyone's life the way his had been stolen. It was in that frame of mind that he found me. There was no hope for me; I was left in a ward with the dying. He had nursed my parents, and knew I was alone. He decided to try…

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I noticed the room faced south with a wall-sized window and that the view looked down on the winding Sol Duc River and the Olympic Mountain range.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: His room faced south, with a wall-sized window like the great room below. His view looked down on the winding Sol Duc River, across the untouched forest to the Olympic Mountain range.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I observed that there was no bed in the room and that a wide and inviting black leather sofa served as the primary seating or lounging furniture.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: There was no bed, only a wide and inviting black leather sofa.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I felt relieved and unexpectedly happy that he told me everything instead of feeling only burdened by secrets.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "I was prepared to feel… relieved. Having you know about everything, not needing to keep secrets from you. But I didn't expect to feel more than that. I like it. It makes me… happy."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I recognized that I lied casually when I said I didn't find him scary even though I was still bracing for an extreme reaction.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "I hate to burst your bubble, but you're really not as scary as you think you are. I don't find you scary at all, actually," I lied casually.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I realized that I viewed him as protective and playfully controlling rather than solely threatening after he restrained me and held me securely.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: All the while, his arms formed an iron cage of protection around me — I was barely jostled. He curled me into a ball against his chest, holding me more securely than iron chains.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I noticed that I was somewhat more conventionally seated on Edward's lap and felt embarrassed.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: I struggled to free myself, but Edward merely readjusted me so that I was somewhat more conventionally seated on his lap.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I felt less scared and more eager about going to the storm game.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: I found myself eager, rather than scared stiff.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I felt that Edward was at ease and protective as his arms held me recklessly close.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: Sorry, I don't believe I have enough to spare," he replied, his arms holding me recklessly close.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I learned that I would be watching while the others played baseball.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: "You will be watching," Edward clarified. "We will be playing baseball."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I felt a shock when Carlisle said my name.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: I felt a shock when he said my name.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I became uneasy and fearful when Laurent joked about having eaten outside of Seattle and I felt a shiver run up my spine.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "We've been on the hunt all the way down from Ontario, and we haven't had the chance to clean up in a while." ... "A shiver ran up my spine."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I recognized myself as part of Carlisle's family when he introduced us as a group and deliberately avoided singling out individuals.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "I'm Carlisle. This is my family, Emmett and Jasper, Rosalie, Esme and Alice, Edward and Bella."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I learned that Emmett and Alice would go with Edward and Bella to get the Jeep.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "We'll show you the way if you'd like to run with us — Emmett and Alice, you can go with Edward and Bella to get the Jeep," he casually added.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.description: I learned that James noticed me and reacted intensely, fixating his attention on me.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: James suddenly whipped his head around, scrutinizing me, his nostrils flaring.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.description: I became more afraid of Edward's potential for menace after his feral snarl, which felt unlike his earlier playful sounds.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: It was nothing like the playful sounds I'd heard from him this morning; it was the single most menacing thing I had ever heard, and chills ran from the crown of my head to the back of my heels.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.description: I realized the Cullens are protective of me when Carlisle rebuffed James and other family members moved to block me from view.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: They gathered together, blocking me from view as they converged.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I experienced being rooted in place, terrified into absolute immobility.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: This whole time I'd been rooted in place, terrified into absolute immobility.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I was carried on Edward's back through the trees without him breaking stride.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: Once we were into the trees, Edward slung me over his back without breaking stride.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I was flung into the backseat of the Jeep and instructed to be strapped in.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: We reached the Jeep in an impossibly short time, and Edward barely slowed as he flung me in the backseat.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I realized that Edward's usual exhilaration while running was gone and had been replaced by a consuming fury.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: The sense of exhilaration that usually seemed to possess Edward as he ran was completely absent, replaced by a fury that consumed him and drove him still faster.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I felt protected by Alice and Emmett as they stayed close behind us and hid me while we moved.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: Alice and Emmett were close behind us, hiding me.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I realized Edward intended to take me away from Charlie and had Emmett restrain my hands with a harness.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text:
"Turn around! You have to take me home!" I shouted. I struggled with the stupid harness, tearing at the straps.

"Emmett," Edward said grimly.

And Emmett secured my hands in his steely grasp.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I heard Edward say he had seen the tracker's mind and that tracking was the man's passion and obsession directed at me.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: "Listen to me, Alice. I saw his mind. Tracking is his passion, his obsession — and he wants her, Alice — her, specifically."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward was driving extremely fast, with the speedometer passing well over one hundred miles per hour.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text:
The speedometer neared one hundred and fifteen.

The speedometer inched passed one-twenty.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I became convinced that Charlie would call the FBI and that my being found would force Carlisle and Esme to leave and hide forever.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: "Charlie will call the FBI! They'll be all over your family — Carlisle and Esme! They'll have to leave, to hide forever!"

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I felt betrayed and angry because I believed Edward was willing to override my wishes and risk ruining everything for me.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: "Not over me, you don't! You're not ruining everything over me!"

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.description: I learned that once the tracker commits to a hunt, he becomes unshakable.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: I quote: "Once he commits to a hunt, he's unshakable."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.description: I decided that leaving and luring the tracker away could protect Charlie and be a workable plan.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: I quote: "You tell Charlie that you can't stand another minute in Forks. Tell him whatever story works."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.description: I recognized Edward as fiercely protective and controlling while also ultimately willing to surrender decision-making to protect me.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: I quote: "I don't want him within a hundred miles of her." and "You're leaving tonight, whether the tracker sees or not... You have fifteen minutes."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I learned the exact contingency plan if the tracker is absent, including a fifteen-minute window at the door.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: This is how it's going to happen. When we get to the house, if the tracker is not there, I will walk her to the door. Then she has fifteen minutes.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I learned the assigned roles for the immediate operation, including who would cover the outside, who would take the truck, and who would remain inside with me.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: Emmett, you take the outside of the house. Alice, you get the truck. I'll be inside as long as she is. After she's out, you two can take the Jeep home and tell Carlisle.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I became convinced that Edward was determined to control the situation and resist alternative plans even when others urged a different approach.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: Bella, please just do this my way, just this once," he said between clenched teeth.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I proposed Phoenix as a possible decoy destination to mislead James and to provide a cover story.
I learned that other members favored waiting to confront James alone because attempting the capture while I was present raised the risk of someone getting hurt.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: Look, if we try to take him down while she's still around, there's a much better chance that someone will get hurt — she'll get hurt, or you will, trying to protect her. Now, if we get him alone…

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I felt fear as the hairs on my arms stood up while the Jeep crawled into town despite my brave talk.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: Despite my brave talk, I could feel the hairs on my arms standing up.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I thought about Charlie being alone in the house and I tried to be courageous for his sake.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: I thought about Charlie, alone in the house, and tried to be courageous.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I changed from believing I was composed to recognizing that I was frightened despite my attempts at bravery.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: Despite my brave talk, I could feel the hairs on my arms standing up.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I understood Edward's intense protectiveness when he warned he would hold me personally responsible if anything happened.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: "If you let anything happen to yourself— anything at all — I'm holding you personally responsible. Do you understand that?"

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I found Alice capable of terrifying gestures when she pulled back her lips in a horrific grimace and snarled, which made me cower.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: And graceful little Alice pulled back her lips in a horrific grimace and let loose with a guttural snarl that had me cowering against the seat in terror.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I learned that Jasper had been doing very well recently and that others were aware of his steadiness.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: "Give him some credit, Edward. He's been doing very, very well, all things considered."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I learned that Charlie was waiting up for me and that all the house lights were on when I arrived.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: Charlie was waiting up for me. All the house lights were on.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward pulled up slowly and deliberately stayed well back from my truck.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: Edward pulled up slowly, staying well back from my truck.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I felt anguish about impending goodbyes and began to cry when I thought of not knowing when I would see Emmett again.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: I felt moisture filling up my eyes as I looked at Emmett. I barely knew him, and yet, somehow, not knowing when I would see him again after tonight was anguishing.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I declared my love to Edward and vowed that I would always love him no matter what happened next.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: "I love you," I said in a low, intense voice. "I will always love you, no matter what happens now."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I instructed Edward to follow the plan and to keep Charlie safe so that I would have the chance to apologize later.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: "Just follow the plan, okay? Keep Charlie safe for me. He's not going to like me very much after this, and I want to have the chance to apologize later."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I told Edward not to listen to another word I might say that night and then kissed him forcefully before entering the house.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: "One more thing," I whispered passionately. "Don't listen to another word I say tonight!" He was leaning in, and so all I had to do was stretch up on my toes to kiss his surprised, frozen lips with as much force as I was capable of. Then I turned and kicked the door open.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I retrieved my secret cash hoard hidden in a knotted old sock between the mattress and box spring.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I reached swiftly between the mattress and box spring to grab the knotted old sock that contained my secret cash hoard."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I packed a duffel and left Forks that night, planning to sleep in the truck if I got tired.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I'll sleep in the truck if I get tired."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I realized I could not stay in Forks and I did not want to end up trapped there like my mother.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I don't want to end up trapped in this stupid, boring town like Mom! I'm not going to make the same dumb mistake she did."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I deliberately hurt Charlie by telling him I hated Forks and that it didn't work out so he would not stop me from leaving.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "It didn't work out, okay? I really, really hate Forks!"

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I admitted that I like Edward but I chose to leave with his help because I could not live there any longer.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I do like him — that's the problem. I can't do this anymore!"

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that a tracker named James is following us and is running behind the truck.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "The tracker followed us. He's running behind us now."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that James is euphoric about the hunt and thrives on the challenge of tracking prey like me.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "His existence is consumed with tracking, and a challenge is all he asks of life."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that my scent makes me particularly tempting to vampires and that this contributed to James targeting me.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "If you didn't smell so appallingly luscious, he might not have bothered."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I feel guilty and partially responsible after Edward told me it was partially my fault that James targeted us.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "It is partially your fault."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I trust Edward to protect me and to make hard decisions, including planning to kill the tracker if necessary.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I don't think I have any choice but to kill him now," he muttered.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.description: I learned that someone is tracking us and that Laurent confirmed that fact.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: "He's tracking us," Edward announced, glaring balefully at Laurent.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.description: I learned that James is approximately three miles out past the river and is circling to meet up with the female.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: About three miles out past the river; he's circling around to meet up with the female.
