tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: I felt like I was five years old as I laughed after a few minutes of effortless waltzing and I admitted that this wasn't half bad.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward acting protectively and jealously when Jacob entered and I felt the tension affect our interaction.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: I heard Edward snarl very quietly and I watched his face go angry as Jacob crossed the floor toward us.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.description: I felt sympathy for Jacob when I saw his embarrassment and I learned that he still cared enough to come despite awkwardness.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: I watched Jacob cross the floor looking clearly uncomfortable and apologetic and I heard him say he was hoping I would be here.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.description: I admitted I had secretly hoped Edward might change me despite earlier disbelief in that possibility.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: So I was hoping that you might have changed your mind… that you were going to change me, after all.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.description: I expressed that I was very uninterested in living a normal human life and resisted the idea of a typical existence.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: I wished there was some way to explain how very uninterested I was in a normal human life.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob relayed a warning that "We'll be watching."
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: "We'll be watching." He watched warily for my reaction.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.description: I decided that I viewed the transformation as the beginning rather than the end of my life.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote "It's not the end, it's the beginning," I disagreed under my breath.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.description: I confirmed that I was ready to be transformed in that moment when I said yes.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote "Right now?" he whispered, his breath blowing cool on my neck. "Yes," I whispered.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.description: I became certain that my love for Edward outweighed everything else and justified my choice.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote "I love you more than everything else in the world combined."

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.description: I felt intense physical fear while remaining resolute about my decision despite my body's reactions.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote "It didn't matter that my body was rigid as a plank, my hands balled into fists, my breathing erratic…"

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.description: I accepted Edward's pledge to stay with me as sufficient for now and as the basis for a future together.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote "I will stay with you — isn't that enough?"

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that I was having a bad week and that Victoria had reappeared, confirming the ongoing danger.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
IWAS HAVING A BAD WEEK.
I knew that essentially nothing had changed. Okay, so Victoria had not given up, but had I ever dreamed
for one moment that she had?

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that graduation was only a few weeks away and that the timeline increased my anxiety.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
Graduation was only a few weeks away, but I wondered if it wasn’t a little foolish to sit around, weak
and tasty, waiting for the next disaster.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that I worked a morning shift at Newton’s Olympic Outfitters and planned to help Angela with announcements after work.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
So now I had a big empty Saturday with nothing but my morning shift at Newton’s Olympic Outfitters to
distract me.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I felt that being human seemed too dangerous for someone like me and that my vulnerability made me almost beg for trouble.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
It seemed too dangerous to be human — just begging for trouble.
Someone like me shouldn’tbe human.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I recognized that the Cullens were united in protecting me and that their reassurances were intended for my safety and for Charlie’s sake.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
Carlisle had said, “There are seven of us, Bella. And with Alice on our side, I don’t think Victoria’s
going to catch us off guard. I think it’s important, for Charlie’s sake, that we stick with the original plan.”

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I noticed that Alice promised to stay close by while Edward was away and that her presence was meant to guard me.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
“I’m staying close to home to hunt. I’ll only be fifteen minutes away if you need me. I’ll keep an eye out
for trouble.”

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.description: I observed that I had small compulsive rituals, such as arranging magnets on the fridge, to calm myself.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc1.source_text:
Not wanting to be ridiculously early for work, I ate my breakfast slowly, one Cheerio at a time. Then,
when I’d washed the dishes, I arranged the magnets on the fridge into a perfect line.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I snuck out to come back to town.
I learned Edward left me last fall because he didn’t think I should be hanging out with vampires and believed leaving would be healthier for me.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: Edward left me last fall because he didn’t think I should be hanging out with vampires. He thought it would be healthier for me if he left.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I decided there was nothing to forgive Edward.
I know that Jasper tried to kill me, a fact I did not disclose to Jacob.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: I could only imagine what he’d think if he knew Jasper had tried to kill me.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I felt myself reverting to an earlier, younger version of myself when I was with Jacob.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: As we walked, I felt myself settling into another version of myself, the self I had been with Jacob. A little younger, a little less responsible.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I learned that Victoria escaped by heading into the water and that she will likely return for another attempt.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Well, she’ll be back, I guess. We’ll get another shot at her."

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I learned that I should watch Alice for signs that the pattern of events is about to repeat.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I’d have to keep an eye on Alice, to look for the signs that the pattern was about to repeat. . . ."

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I affirmed that I love Edward for his character and not for his looks or wealth, and I expressed frustration at Jacob's inability to understand that.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I love him . Not because he’s beautiful or because he’s rich !"

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I became unsure whether Edward would tell me about future dangerous events after this incident.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Would Edward really tell me next time? I wasn’t sure."

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I learned that I was engaged and was self-conscious about the delicate ring on my left hand.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: the delicate ring on my left hand.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I learned that I had a mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college that was part of town gossip about me.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: my mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I learned that I was driving a glossy black Mercedes that drew attention, specifically prompting someone to ask if it was a Mercedes Guardian.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: is that… are you driving a Mercedes Guardian?

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I learned that I was cutting everyday comforts and going without items like Pop-Tarts and shoelaces to avoid spending time in public.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: I was going without a lot of things these days, like Pop-Tarts and shoelaces, to avoid spending time in public.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I realized that facing death again felt oddly inevitable and that loving the one who was killing me left me no options.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: When you loved the one who was killing you, it left you no options.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I felt self-conscious and imagined my ring pulsing like a neon sign, amplifying the sensation that people were staring at me.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: it felt as if the ring were pulsing like a neon sign: Look at me, look at me.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I remembered that I used to drive an ancient Chevy truck, which contrasted with how this new car behaved and how I drove it.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: the normal way I would have punched it to get my ancient Chevy truck moving.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.description: I recognized that my engagement and new possessions were causing townspeople to stare and gossip about me.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: did it really matter what people were saying about my engagement? About my new car? About my mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college?

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I realized that it was my last night as Isabella Swan and that tomorrow I would be Bella Cullen.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: My last night in my room. My last night as Isabella Swan. Tomorrow night, I would be Bella Cullen.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I felt suddenly calm as Jasper's presence made my qualms seem unimportant.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: I was suddenly very calm, and my qualms all seemed unimportant.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I worried about maneuvering the Cullens' staircase in heels and a wedding dress train because Alice prioritized artistry over practicality.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: First there was the wedding dress’s train. Alice clearly had let her artistic sense overpower practicalities on that one.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I learned that the Denali clan would arrive before the ceremony and that Irina still nursed a vendetta against the werewolves for killing Laurent.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: Tanya’s family, the Denali clan, would be arriving sometime before the ceremony. It would be touchy to have Tanya’s family in the same room with our guests from the Quileute reservation, Jacob’s father and the Clearwaters. The Denalis were no fans of the werewolves. In fact, Tanya’s sister Irina was not coming to the wedding at all. She still nursed a vendetta against the werewolves for killing her friend Laurent (just as he was about to kill me).

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I was reassured by Edward's promise that having the Denalis near the Quileutes would not be dangerous.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: Edward had promised me it wouldn’t be dangerous to have the Denalis near the Quileutes.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I worried that my fragile self-esteem would suffer when I met Tanya because I expected comparisons despite Edward's preference for me.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: I’d never seen Tanya before, but I was sure that meeting her wouldn’t be a pleasant experience for my ego. Once upon a time, before I was born probably, she’d made her play for Edward—not that I blamed her or anyone else for wanting him. Still, she would be beautiful at the very least and magnificent at best. Though Edward clearly—if inconceivably—preferred me, I wouldn’t be able to help making comparisons.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.description: I learned from Carlisle that the paramount rule for immortals was to keep their existence secret.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: Only one rule, actually—one law that broke down into a thousand different facets: Keep the secret.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella intends to undergo the transformation into a vampire in about a week or two.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: I don't know for sure. A week or two, maybe.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella affirms that choosing Edward and proceeding with their plans is what she wants.
I noticed that Bella becomes defensive and asserts her independence when Jacob challenges her decisions.
I observed that Bella's relationship with Jacob has become strained and is no longer as easy as it used to be since Edward returned.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: My relationship with Jacob used to be so easy. Natural as breathing. But since Edward had come back into my life, it was a constant strain.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.description: I learned that the physical encounter with Edward felt wonderful and perfect to me.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.source_text: I didn’t know what to expect—but I definitely did not expect how… how… just wonderful and perfect it was.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.description: I realized that this experience surpassed all of my previous happiest memories with Edward.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.source_text: I’ve never been so happy in all my life—I wasn’t this happy when you decided that you loved me more than you wanted to kill me, or the first morning I woke up and you were there waiting for me.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.description: I insisted that I am not pretending to make Edward feel better and I demanded that he accept my genuine happiness.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.source_text: I grabbed his chin and leaned forward so that our faces were inches apart.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.description: I learned that Bella Swan made an informed choice and that the pack resolved not to punish the Cullens for her choice.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: Bella Swan made an informed choice, and we are not going to punish our former allies for her choice.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.description: I noticed that some in the pack believed Bella was no longer the same person when they said she was 'not Bella anymore'.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella is dying and that others explicitly describe her state as being killed by whatever is inside her.
I learned that Bella will not allow Carlisle or the family to perform medical intervention despite Carlisle being a doctor.
I noticed that Bella pleaded with me to behave and to come back, showing concern for both me and Edward in the same breath.
I realized that Bella's physical strength is that of a normal human one hundred-and-ten-pound girl in contrast to what some vampires might expect.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: “Did you ever notice that she’s exactly as strong as a normal hundred-and-ten-pound human girl? How stupid are you vamps? Hold her down and knock her out with drugs.”

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella plans to keep her heart beating and hopes Carlisle will perform an emergency vampirization if necessary.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "I will keep my heart beating. I’m strong enough for that."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella cited Esme's cliff jump as an example of someone saved by Carlisle after being near death.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "Did you know Esme jumped off a cliff? When she was human, I mean."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I recognized that Bella genuinely believes that things will work out and that she described her stance as faith.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "It’ll work out, you know," she said after a quiet minute. "I believe that."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I understood that Bella's commitment to Edward is so strong that she is willing to risk dying for their relationship.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "She didn't have to say the words for me to know what she was thinking. She was dying for it."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella is explicitly named as someone the pack considers protecting.
I learned that Bella had visible bruises that appeared in the pack's shared images.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: Bella’s bruises, Edward’s face as he burned.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.description: I began to believe that the pack's obligation to tribal safety could override direct protection of Bella.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: Protecting Bella Swan. We can’t let that influence us. The safety of our families, of everyone here, is more important than one human.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella believes in magic and referenced Edward's explanation of Jacob's imprinting.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: Edward told me once what it was like—your imprinting thing. He said it was like A Midsummer Night’s Dream, like magic. You’ll find who you’re really looking for, Jacob, and maybe then all of this will make sense.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.description: I noticed Bella expressed renewed belief that things will work out despite her fragility.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: It’ll work out, you know," she said after a quiet minute. "I believe that.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.description: I observed Bella seeking comfort from Jacob and showing affection by holding his hands and touching his cheek.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: Thanks, Jake. That feels good. She pulled one of her hands away from mine and pressed it against my cheek.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella is human and that members of the pack consider her and the new creature to be central to the danger under discussion.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: "She’s human, too! Doesn’t our protection apply to her?"

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella has visible injuries that are part of the pack's concerns about the situation.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: "Bella’s bruises, Edward’s face as he burned."

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.description: I realized that the pack's protective stance toward Bella is strained and that some members view her as an unacceptable risk worth tragic sacrifice.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: "She’s dying anyway, Leah thought. We’ll just shorten the process."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella has never chosen me.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "She has never been the one for you, she has never chosen you, but you continue to destroy your life for her!"

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I decided that I would not let the pack destroy itself over Bella and I resisted orders to prevent that outcome.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "Maybe you’re right. But you’re going to destroy the pack over her, Sam. No matter how many of them survive tonight, they will always have murder on their hands."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I understood that Bella was the central reason for the conflict being argued over.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that the pack thinks Bella has become a problem.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "The pack thinks Bella’s become a problem."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that the pack foresees potential danger from what Bella is carrying.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "They foresee potential danger from the… from what she’s carrying."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that the rest of the pack are planning to attack tonight.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "The rest are planning to attack tonight."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I came to believe that Bella is likely to die.
I felt responsible for Bella's safety and aware that my earlier efforts had not convinced her.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Sorry I didn’t do any good today. Told you she wouldn’t listen to me."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I learned that the pack regards the Cullens as people to protect and that Jacob planned to check in with them.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: they’re people to me, and I’m going to protect them, ’cause that’s what we’re supposed to do.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text_alt: I’m going to go check in with the Cullens.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I learned that the pack believes it is open season on vampires right now, which makes the Cullens vulnerable.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: It’s open season on vamps now.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella was hospitalized and physically declining with a very large, swollen belly.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Bella lay flat on the hospital bed, her belly a mountain under the sheet.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.description: I noticed that Bella was making jokes despite appearing to have only hours left and being in pain.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: The girl looked like she only had hours left, and she had to be in pain, but she was making jokes.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.description: I learned that the Cullens planned to ask Bella for her opinion about a medical plan before proceeding.

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella is not present or mentioned in the action of this scene.

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella's condition was much the same as the night before and that she was awake when Jacob arrived.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “She’s… much the same as last night. ... She’s awake.”

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I felt increased urgency to protect Bella after realizing Edward did not want to leave her because he had limited time left.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “Edward didn’t want to lose any time with her, because he didn’t have much time left.”

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I recognized that the Cullens, represented by Carlisle, appreciated Jacob's role in protecting Bella and the family.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “I didn’t get a chance to thank you last night, Jacob. You don’t know how much I appreciate your… compassion. I know your goal was to protect Bella, but I owe you the safety of the rest of my family as well.”

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella is severely weakened and is attempting to drink from a covered cup as part of a medical effort.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I read that Bella reached out and took the cup from Carlisle with a shaking hand while she tried to prop herself up.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.description: I noticed that Bella remained self-conscious and aware even in her frail state as she flickered her eyes around the room.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I observed Bella's eyes flicker around at us, still aware enough to feel self-conscious despite her weakness.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.description: I observed that Bella and Edward communicated through intense, conversational eye contact that felt different from simple romantic gooiness.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I watched Edward and Bella stare into each other's eyes in a way that read more like a conversation than a gooey display.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I learned that the wolf elders decided to delay immediate action and to wait in hopes that Bella would be separated from the problem.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: They’ve decided that immediate action is in no one’s best interest at this point.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I realized that many in the pack are uncomfortable with the idea of killing Bella and prefer to postpone violent measures.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: Killing her is not something any of us feel comfortable with.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I saw Bella on the couch with just one tube still hooked into her and an IV hanging behind the back of the sofa.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: Bella was on the couch like yesterday, with just one tube still hooked into her, and an IV hanging behind the back of the sofa.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I noticed Bella sounded much better and looked stronger while I smelled fresh blood and saw the cup in her hands again.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: It was amazing how much better she sounded, how much stronger she looked. I smelled fresh blood and saw that the cup was in her hands again.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I learned Bella was married to a vampire and was described as hugely pregnant.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: For crying out loud, she was married! Happily married, too—there was no question that she was in love with her vampire past the boundaries of sanity. And hugely pregnant, to top it off.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I felt surprised and unsettled that Bella, despite being married and pregnant, looked genuinely thrilled to see me.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: I couldn't remember the last time she’d looked so excited to see me. For crying out loud, she was married! ... And hugely pregnant, to top it off.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella had a cup of blood wedged between her leg and Edward's while she ate.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: “Omelets,” she said, but her eyes darted down, and I saw that her cup of blood was wedged between her leg and Edward’s.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella's rib was taped up tight and that she said she didn't feel it.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: “Taped up nice and tight. I don’t even feel it.”

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I observed that Bella's color had returned to pale with a rose undertone and that her lips were pink and hair looked shinier.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: Her color was back to the way I remembered it. Pale, but with the rose undertone. Her lips were pink again. Even her hair looked better—shinier.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I believed that Bella appeared 'totally herself again' after she grinned and acted playful.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: She stuck her tongue out at me. Totally herself again.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I learned that I had had more than my fair share of near-death experiences and that it wasn’t something one ever really got used to.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: I’d had more than my fair share of near-death experiences; it wasn’t something you ever really got used to.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I realized that loving the one who was killing me left me with no options and made facing death feel different and inevitable.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: When you loved the one who was killing you, it left you no options. How could you run, how could you fight, when doing so would hurt that beloved one?

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I noticed that I am engaged and that the wedding is just days away.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: I had a feeling this guy would get along well with Edward Cullen, my… my fiancé (there really was no getting around that truth with the wedding just days away).

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I observed that my delicate ring on my left hand draws attention and makes me feel like a spotlight is trained on me.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: I still felt like a spotlight was trained on me, drawing attention to the delicate ring on my left hand.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I admitted that I was avoiding spending time in public and going without small comforts like Pop-Tarts and shoelaces to minimize exposure.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: I was going without a lot of things these days, like Pop-Tarts and shoelaces, to avoid spending time in public.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I reported that I had a shiny black credit card that felt red-hot in my back pocket and that my mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college was a topic of gossip.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: my mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college? About the shiny black credit card that felt red-hot in my back pocket right now?

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I felt overwhelmed and cried when Jacob hugged me in the darkness during the dance.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.source_text: I read: "My hand flew up to my throat, and if Edward hadn’t been holding me I would have collapsed." "Jacob!" I choked as soon as I could breathe.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I realized I’d never done anything good enough to deserve a friend like Jacob.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.source_text: I read: "I’d never done anything good enough to deserve a friend like Jacob."

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I accepted that Jacob intended to be my best friend one last time when he said he was there to be my friend.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.source_text: I read: "I’m just here to be your friend. Your best friend, one last time."

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward purposely left us at the cedars to give me a private moment with Jacob.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Rosalie won’t forgive me if she doesn’t get her official turn on the dance floor," Edward murmured, and I knew he was leaving us, giving me a gift of his own—this moment with Jacob.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.description: I learned that Kaure is part Ticuna Indian and suspects what Edward might be because of her upbringing.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: Kaure’s part Ticuna Indian. She was raised to be more superstitious—or you could call it more aware—than those who live in the modern world. She suspects what I am, or close enough.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward answered Gustavo in flowing Portuguese and that Gustavo then left toward the front door.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: Edward sat up, keeping me cradled against him, and answered Gustavo in flowing Portuguese. Gustavo nodded and walked quietly toward the front door.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.description: I felt flattered by the notion that a legend would single out beautiful women as prey.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: Beautiful women only? Well, that was kind of flattering.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.description: I felt closer and physically intimate with Edward after he leaned down so I could kiss him, tightened his arms around me, lifted me off the floor, and later swept me up and carried me with inhuman speed to the blue room.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: He leaned down so that I could kiss him, and then his arms tightened around me, lifting me off the floor so he didn’t have to bend. he’d already swept me up into his arms, and his lips silenced mine as he carried me with inhuman speed to the blue room.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.description: I experienced a vivid vision of the Volturi advancing, felt panic transform into bloodlust, and then I jolted upright.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: The line of black advanced on me through the shroud-like mist. ... All that really changed was how the picture looked to me. Suddenly, I was hungry for it. I wanted them to charge. ... The panic changed to bloodlust as I crouched forward, a smile on my face, and a growl ripped through my bared teeth. I jolted uprig

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella is pregnant with a dangerous child that is harming her.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc4.source_text: It’s killing her, right? She’s dying.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella refuses medical intervention and will not allow Carlisle to treat her.
I realized that Bella would sacrifice herself for the child despite the obvious danger.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc4.source_text: Of course, die for the monster spawn. It was so Bella.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella is using up the O negative blood storage and that Carlisle expects to need more soon.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: Carlisle thinks they’re going to need more blood for Bella soon. She’s using up all the O negative they stored for her.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella has been running a low-grade fever with sweats and chills and that her immune system may be compromised.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: Bella’s been running a fever off and on today. Just low grade—sweats and then chills. Carlisle’s not sure what to make of it—she might just be sick. Her immune system can’t be in peak form right now.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella recently suffered another cracked rib and that Carlisle taped her up again.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: Broke another of her ribs, he told me somberly. Carlisle taped her up again. Just another crack, he said.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella was talking and laughing with Charlie, which surprised me given her condition and the pack’s concerns.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: She was chatting with Charlie, laughing and all—Charlie! What?! What do you mean, she was talking to Charlie?!

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.description: I began to believe that it would be healthier for Bella to leave with the Cullens to keep her safe.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: Take Bella and run. It seemed like an obvious answer to their problems.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.description: I realized that I do not want Bella to disappear because I would never know whether she made it, and I feel protective toward her.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I didn’t want to have Bella disappear—to never know whether she’d made it or not.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella feels complete when Jacob is present and considers him part of her new family.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: It feels… complete when you’re here, Jacob. Like all my family is together. I mean, I guess that’s what it’s like—I’ve never had a big family before now. It’s nice.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella plans to deceive Charlie by telling him she must go to a special hospital far away and maintaining only limited contact.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: She thinks she can stall. Tell Charlie she has to go to a special hospital on the other side of the world. Keep in contact through phone calls. . . .

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc2.description: I recognized that Bella is very sure she is going to live despite becoming nonhuman.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: She’s very sure she’s going to live.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella was dying and pregnant and that Edward had brought her home.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Some reason for gathering that must have been forgotten when Edward brought his dying pregnant wife home.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc3.description: I learned that the Cullens had returned and that this area was considered their treaty land.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: We’d pulled back the lines when the Cullens returned. This was their treaty land.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc3.description: I realized that Bella's condition influenced the pack's and Cullens' movements and priorities.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Some reason for gathering that must have been forgotten when Edward brought his dying pregnant wife home.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc4.description: I learned that Bella's injury this time was to her pelvis rather than a rib.
I saw Bella gripping her cup of blood in both hands and looking white and in pain.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: She was gripping her cup of blood in both hands, and her face was white.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc4.description: I realized Bella wanted to act like things were normal and avoid a hospital setup.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: She’d want to act like things were normal, avoid the hospital setup.

tw-book4-chapter15_Sc4.description: I noticed Bella whispered 'Jake' and smiled through the pain, showing her connection to me even while hurt.
tw-book4-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: “Jake,” she whispered, and she smiled through the pain.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that I am engaged and wearing a delicate ring on my left hand.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: the delicate ring on my left hand.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that I am driving a glossy black Mercedes that draws public attention.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: This car was glossy black, sleek, and pretty, but it was still just a car to me.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that I have a mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: my mysterious acceptance into an Ivy League college?

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that I carry a shiny black credit card that feels hot in my back pocket.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: the shiny black credit card that felt red-hot in my back pocket right now?

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I learned that my wedding is only days away and that the engagement is imminent.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: my… my fiancé (there really was no getting around that truth with the wedding just days away).

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I realized that surviving near-death experiences left me marked for disaster but that loving the one who might kill me made my options vanish.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text:
I’d had more than my fair share of near-death experiences; it wasn’t something you ever really got used to.
When you loved the one who was killing you, it left you no options.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I felt that the engagement ring seemed to demand attention as if it were pulsing like a neon sign.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: At times like this, sensing the eyes on my back, it felt as if the ring were pulsing like a neon sign: Look at me, look at me.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.description: I noticed that strangers openly stared at me in town and that I could not convincingly lie to myself about it.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: No one is staring at you, I promised myself. No one is staring at you. No one is staring at you.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.description: I heard Edward say Carlisle would get 'that thing' out before it could hurt any part of me.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: "We’re going to get that thing out before it can hurt any part of you. Don’t be scared. I won’t let it hurt you."

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.description: I believed Edward did not care about the baby and might want to hurt him, which changed my trust in him.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: I’d gotten it wrong before. He didn’t care about the baby at all. He wanted to hurt him.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.description: I felt a tentative little nudge in my womb indicating fetal movement.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: There was a tentative little nudge in my womb.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that the visiting woman laid her hand on my stomach and whispered the word 'Morte', implying death for the child.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: She reached slowly forward until she was close enough to lay her small hand on top of mine, over my stomach. "Morte," she sighed quietly.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.description: I felt both protected by Edward's physical comfort and betrayed by his words about removing the baby.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: He pulled me against his chest. "Don’t be afraid. We’ll be home in sixteen hours. You’ll be fine. Carlisle will be ready when we get there." "We’re going to get that thing out before it can hurt any part of you."

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc4.description: I learned that the pack planned to prioritize destroying the creature Bella carries as their first objective and that Bella herself would be targeted.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: Destroying the creature is our first priority.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc4.description: I realized that killing Bella felt like killing me and that thought made me recoil as if it were suicide.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: And it wasn’t just because killing Bella felt like killing me, like suicide.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc4.description: I noted that the Alpha framed Bella’s sacrifice as a heavy price the pack would recognize, which influenced the pack’s emotional stance toward the act.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: Bella’s sacrifice is a heavy price, and we will all recognize that.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc5.description: I learned that Bella was on the couch with a tube still hooked in and an IV nearby while wrapped tightly in quilts.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: Bella was on the couch like yesterday, with just one tube still hooked into her, and an IV hanging behind the back of the sofa. She was wrapped up like a burrito in a couple of thick quilts, so at least they’d listened to me before.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc5.description: I noticed that Bella looked excited and genuinely happy to see me when she glanced up and smiled after Edward did the same.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: Bella didn’t hear me. She only glanced up when he did, and then she smiled, too. With real energy, her whole face lighting up.

tw-book4-chapter16_Sc5.description: I learned that Rosalie was sitting cross-legged on the floor by Bella's head while Bella recovered.
tw-book4-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: Rosalie was cross-legged on the ground by her head.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc1.description: I remained emotionally tied to Bella and I was still hurting over her, which drove my desperate search for distraction.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: As I’d searched my head for any way at all to get away from the pain, what Leah’d said today had popped in there.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc1.description: I noticed Bella's distinctive features reappearing in other girls and I kept comparing them to her while I scanned the crowd.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: As time went on, I started noticing all the wrong things. Bella things. This one’s hair was the same color. That one’s eyes were sort of shaped the same.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc1.description: I believed that imprinting might stop the pain I felt about Bella and I considered losing my choices if it meant relief.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: That would go away, you know, if you imprinted. You wouldn’t have to hurt over her anymore. Seemed like maybe getting your choices taken away from you wasn’t the very worst thing in the world.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella's appetite is consuming the blood supply quickly and that the current supply will be used up in another day.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: Carlisle sent all the blood he was able to acquire, but it wasn’t as much as he was hoping for—Bella will use up this supply in another day the way her appetite has grown.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella is too fragile to delay the delivery because the child has become too big and waiting is madness.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: He’s become too big. It’s madness to wait, when he’s clearly developed beyond what Carlisle had guessed. Bella’s too fragile to delay.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.description: I learned that the child seems to love Bella and is trying to avoid what hurts her as much as possible.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: He seems to have a vague sense of what hurts her now. He’s trying to avoid that, as much as possible. He… loves her. Already.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.description: I began to believe that Bella might survive if the Cullens act quickly to deliver the child.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: If we’re proactive about this, if we act quickly, I see no reason why it should not go well. Bella is going to survive.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella delivered a newborn named Renesmee in a bloody, traumatic birth.
I learned that Bella suffered a catastrophic injury to her spine during the birth.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Her spine," he choked in horror.

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc3.description: I observed that Bella's heart faltered and went silent and that I had to perform CPR and mouth-to-mouth to try to keep her alive.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "With a last dull ga-lump, her heart faltered and went silent."

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc4.description: I recognized several thematic chapter titles (for example BURNING, FIRST HUNT, MEMORIES, THE FUTURE, IRRESISTIBLE) that suggest emotional and plot developments centered on Bella.
tw-book4-chapter17_Sc4.source_text:

tw-book4-chapter17_Sc4.description: I noted that Bella is the focus of the contents listing while no characters are marked as present, which updates my sense that this material frames Bella's arc rather than showing direct interactions.

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella was convulsing violently, streaming with blood, and unconscious while being held by Rosalie.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: I quote: "Bella’s body, streaming with red, started to twitch, jerking around in Rosalie’s arms like she was being electrocuted."

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc1.description: I learned that Bella screamed urgently that the baby could not breathe and demanded that they get him out immediately.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: I quote: "Get him OUT!" she screamed. "He can’t BREATHE! Do it NOW!"

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc1.description: I learned that rescuers feared internal failures including a detached placenta and that Bella later showed signs indicating a shattered spine.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: I quote: "The placenta must have detached!" and "Her spine," he choked in horror.

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc2.description: I noticed Bella’s heart faltered and went silent during the delivery.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: I read: "With a last dull ga-lump, her heart faltered and went silent."

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc2.description: I witnessed that Bella had given birth to a newborn whom Edward named Renesmee.
I observed fresh blood welling from a tiny double-crescent bite mark above Bella’s left breast after the birth.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: I read: "fresh blood welling out of a tiny double-crescent bite mark just over her left breast."

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc2.description: I realized that Bella was truly gone when I no longer felt the pull that bound me to her.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: I read: "I knew it was too late. I knew she was dead. I knew it for sure because the pull was gone."

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella's heart was not beating and that she was dead.
I learned that Bella was brutally killed from the inside out by the newborn creature.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: the screaming, the bleeding, the unbearable crunching and snapping as the newborn monster tore through her from the inside out. . . .

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc3.description: I realized that my purpose of saving Bella was lost and that I felt empty without that mission.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: I felt empty again, now that I’d lost my purpose. Saving Bella had been my fight for so long now.

tw-book4-chapter18_Sc3.description: I learned that the newborn contains some of Bella and may have inherited vulnerability from her.
tw-book4-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: I wondered if the creature could be put back together. I doubted it. It was part Bella, too—so it must have inherited some of her vulnerability.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I learned Bella is leaving for Forks, which implies Edward's relevance to her decision.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: Renée expresses worry and reluctance about Bella leaving for Forks; Bella insists she wants to go and lies to reassure her mother.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.description: I inferred that Bella's departure toward Forks strengthens the impression of a significant connection to Edward even though he is not present in this scene.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: Renée expresses worry and reluctance about Bella leaving for Forks; Bella insists she wants to go and lies to reassure her mother.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward Cullen is not present in this scene and is not mentioned in the immediate action.
I learned that no new behaviors or dialogue from Edward are provided in this scene.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I read 'Characters present: Bella Swan' and 'Bella has a restless night, crying then trying to sleep under the sounds of rain.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.description: I noticed the scene names Edward Cullen as a character to track but provides no presence or actions for him in this scene.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: Characters to track: Bella Swan, Edward Cullen, Jacob Black Characters present: Bella Swan, Office Secretary

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward Cullen was present as part of the pale, unusually beautiful Cullen family sitting apart.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "a strikingly pale, unusually beautiful group sitting apart — the Cullens (and the Hales)."

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.description: I perceived Edward Cullen as part of an unapproachable and still group, which shaped my impression of him as distant.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "their stillness, their unapproachable beauty"

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.description: I learned that Edward reacted immediately and intensely with a hostile look when Bella passed by and later when she sat down.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I saw that he reacts in an immediate, intense, hostile manner when she passes by and later when she sits.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.description: I observed Edward displaying clenched posture and black eyes that signaled strong aversion to Bella's presence.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I noticed his clenched posture, black eyes, and aversion to her presence.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.description: I concluded that Edward's behavior establishes an antagonistic stance toward Bella in this scene.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I felt the scene establishes a strong, unsettling antagonism from Edward toward Bella.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.description: I heard that Edward had been acting oddly according to what Mike mentioned.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: He mentions Edward's odd behavior, confirming that the furious reaction is unusual.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.description: I became more convinced that Edward's furious reaction was unusual after hearing Mike's comment.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: He mentions Edward's odd behavior, confirming that the furious reaction is unusual.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.description: My concern about Edward increased when I learned that others noticed odd behavior and an unusually furious reaction.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: He mentions Edward's odd behavior, confirming that the furious reaction is unusual.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.description: I heard Edward arguing quietly with the receptionist about switching class times.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.source_text: Edward is arguing quietly with the receptionist about switching class times.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.description: I noticed Edward's back stiffen and his intensely hate-filled glance toward Bella, which updated my view of his attitude.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.source_text: As she approaches, his back stiffens; he turns and gives her an intensely hate-filled glance that chills her.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.description: I realized Edward could be polite to the secretary while still acting hostile toward Bella and leaving abruptly.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc12.source_text: He leaves abruptly after politeness to the secretary, and Bella hands in her slip shaken and unsettled.

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I perceived Edward as hostile during interactions earlier in the day.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'She reflects on the day's humiliations, Edward's hostility, the alienness of Forks, and fights back tears on the drive back to Charlie's house.'

tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.description: I felt more distant from Edward after his cold behavior and I questioned how to approach him.
tw-book1-chapter1_Sc13.source_text: I quote: 'She reflects on the day's humiliations, Edward's hostility, the alienness of Forks, and fights back tears on the drive back to Charlie's house.'

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I used the memory of his smell to shift from doubting to believing that our encounter was real.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: I clung to the parts I couldn't have imagined — like his smell.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.description: I believed Edward had no reason to miss school that day.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: He had no reason not to be in school today.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward appeared suddenly and pulled the car door open for me.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: I didn't see where he came from, but suddenly he was there, pulling the door open for me.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward was sitting next to me and had started the car almost immediately after I got in.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: The door closed behind me, and, sooner than should be possible, he was sitting next to me, starting the car.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I heard Edward give the jacket and speak with a guarded voice when he said he didn't want me to get sick.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "I brought the jacket for you. I didn't want you to get sick or something." His voice was guarded.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward was giving me a genuine choice about the ride while secretly hoping I would accept rather than refuse.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: He was really giving me a choice — I was free to refuse, and part of him hoped for that. It was a vain hope.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward was amused and teasing as he smirked and asked about "twenty questions," which mixed playfulness with guardedness.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: He turned to smirk at me. "What, no twenty questions today?"

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.description: I heard him call Rosalie's car ostentatious.
I heard him say that his family took Rosalie's car.
I heard him admit that the cars are an indulgence and that they all like to drive fast.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: An indulgence," he admitted with an impish smile. "We all like to drive fast.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.description: I noticed that he stayed very close to my side as we walked onto campus.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: He met me at the front of the car, staying very close to my side as we walked onto campus.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.description: I heard him say he was breaking all the rules now.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: I'm breaking all the rules now.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward's voice and eyes had a strong, irresistible effect on me.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: It wasn't really his fault that his voice was so irresistible. Or what his eyes were capable of.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward can read Jessica's mind and knew she would ambush me in class.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: "I can't," he said, startled. Then understanding brightened his eyes. "However, I can read hers — she'll be waiting to ambush you in class."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I saw Edward fold my jacket over his arm after I handed it to him.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: He folded it over his arm.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I realized Edward intended to listen for my answer about how I feel about him.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: "And as for her other question… well, I'll be listening to hear the answer to that one myself."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.description: I heard Edward suggest that I could say we were dating as a simple explanation to Jessica.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: "I suppose you could say yes to the first… if you don't mind — it's easier than any other explanation."

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward could potentially listen to what I said through the medium of Jessica's thoughts.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: whether Edward would really be listening to what I said through the medium of Jess's thoughts.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I regarded Edward's mind-reading ability as inconvenient for my privacy even though I acknowledged its life-saving value.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: How very inconvenient his little talent could be — when it wasn't saving my life.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.description: I worried that Edward's possible eavesdropping via Jessica changed how I would interact with both him and Jessica.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc5.source_text: while I worried about how to explain things to Jessica and agonized over whether Edward would really be listening...

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I observed Edward waiting outside the Spanish classroom, leaning against the wall and appearing strikingly attractive.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: outside the door to our Spanish class, leaning against the wall — looking more like a Greek god than anyone had a right to — Edward was waiting for me.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I noticed that his voice sounded amused and irritated and I realized he had been listening to our conversation.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: His voice was amused and irritated at the same time. He had been listening, it was obvious.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.description: I became uncertain that he would remain available and I therefore hesitated to sit with my friends at lunch.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc7.source_text: I couldn't be sure that he wouldn't disappear inconveniently again.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward can perform normal human actions deliberately to demonstrate control when I watched him "deliberately bit off a mouthful, chewed quickly, and then swallowed."
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: He glared at me, holding my eyes as he lifted the slice of pizza off the tray, and deliberately bit off a mouthful, chewed quickly, and then swallowed.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I understood that Edward believes I am extraordinary and he urged me to trust him when he said, "Trust me just this once — you are the opposite of ordinary."
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: Trust me just this once — you are the opposite of ordinary.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.description: I recognized that Edward feels possessive and deeply invested in me because he directly asked whether I thought I cared more for him than he did for me and then contradicted that belief by saying, "You're wrong."
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc8.source_text: Do you truly believe that you care more for me than I do for you?" ... "You're wrong.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward prefers mountain lions when he discussed predator preferences.
I learned that Edward acknowledged having 'weapons' but clarified they were not the kind covered by hunting laws, implying nonconventional methods of hunting.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: Oh, we have weapons. Just not the kind they consider when writing hunting laws.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I realized that Edward can become intensely protective and angry because he reacted with sudden fury and prohibited Bella from witnessing their hunts.
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: "Absolutely not!" His face turned even whiter than usual, and his eyes were suddenly furious.

tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward believes exposing Bella to fear would be beneficial and that he even offered to take her out to provide a 'healthy dose of fear.'
tw-book1-chapter10_Sc9.source_text: "If that were it, I would take you out tonight," he said, his voice cutting. "You need a healthy dose of fear. Nothing could be more beneficial for you."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward apologized and offered to let me drive on Saturday as part of his attempt to make amends.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "Will you forgive me if I apologize?" "How about if I mean it, and I agree to let you drive Saturday?"

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward planned not to bring a car so as to avoid creating questions for my father.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "I wasn't intending to bring a car."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward hunts by surrendering to his senses and that his heightened sense of smell could make him dangerously lose control if I were near.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "When we hunt," he spoke slowly, unwillingly, "we give ourselves over to our senses… govern less with our minds. Especially our sense of smell. If you were anywhere near me when I lost control that way..."

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward's apology was sincere and that his eyes burned with feeling, which made me perceive him as emotionally intense and protective.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: "Then I'm very sorry I upset you." His eyes burned with sincerity for a protracted moment — playing havoc with the rhythm of my heart — and then turned playful.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward questioned me relentlessly about every insignificant detail of my existence, demonstrating intense curiosity about my life.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: It continued like that for the rest of the day. While he walked me to English, when he met me after Spanish, all through the lunch hour, he questioned me relentlessly about every insignificant detail of my existence.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I observed Edward reach over quickly but hesitantly to sweep my hair back and later touch my face wordlessly, stroking from my temple to my jaw.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: He reached over, swiftly, but somehow still hesitantly, to sweep my hair back behind my shoulder...he touched my face wordlessly — this time with the back of his cool hand, stroking once from my temple to my jaw — before he turned and walked away.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward slide his chair slightly farther away when the teacher approached the light switch and saw him looking at me with ambivalent eyes, suggesting restraint and conflicted feelings.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: As the teacher approached the light switch, I noticed Edward slide his chair slightly farther away from mine...he was looking at me, his eyes ambivalent.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.description: I saw Edward flip open a compartment under his car's CD player, pull out one of thirty or so CDs, and hand me the same Debussy CD while asking, 'Debussy to this?'
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: He flipped open a compartment under his car's CD player, pulled out one of thirty or so CDs that were jammed into the small space, and handed it to me, 'Debussy to this?'

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I remembered Edward saying that this would be 'another complication.'
I felt vindicated in trusting Edward's warning when Billy's reaction matched the feared complication.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text:
I groaned internally.

Another complication, Edward had said.

tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.description: I realized that Edward's secrecy might be compromised because Billy's stare made it clear he recognized Edward.
tw-book1-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Had Billy recognized Edward so easily? Could he really believe the impossible legends his son had scoffed at? The answer was clear in Billy's eyes. Yes. Yes, he could.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward's skin literally sparkled like thousands of tiny diamonds.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: His skin, white despite the faint flush from yesterday's hunting trip, literally sparkled, like thousands of tiny diamonds were embedded in the surface.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward did not sleep despite having his pale lavender lids shut.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: His glistening, pale lavender lids were shut, though of course he didn't sleep.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I heard Edward tell me he was singing to himself, though the sound was too low for me to hear.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: But, when I asked, he told me he was singing to himself; it was too low for me to hear.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward's eyes were butterscotch and appeared lighter and warmer after hunting.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: Butterscotch today, lighter, warmer after hunting.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward said it was too easy to be himself with me, indicating comfort and intimacy in our interaction.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: "It's too easy to be myself with you."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I heard Edward refer to himself as the world's best predator and admit that his voice, face, and smell invite me in.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: "I'm the world's best predator, aren't I? Everything about me invites you in — my voice, my face, even my smell. As if I need any of that!"

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward attempt to frame himself as 'only human' as a way of apologizing and explaining his struggle.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: 'I am so very sorry.' He hesitated. 'Would you understand what I meant if I said I was only human?'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward is torn between restraining his predatory instincts and his desire to protect me, and that his promises sometimes seem meant to reassure himself.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: I heard what he couldn't truthfully say, that I didn't need to be afraid, that there was nothing to fear. 'Don't be afraid,' he murmured... 'I promise…' He seemed more concerned with convincing himself than me.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.description: I found myself mesmerized by Edward's beauty and eyes while simultaneously seeing him as a potential threat, which altered how I related to him.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: His golden eyes mesmerized me. I sat like a bird locked in the eyes of a snake.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I learned that he told me my wanting to be with him was not in my best interest and that he acknowledged that as something to be afraid of.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "That is something to be afraid of, indeed. Wanting to be with me. That's really not in your best interest."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I learned that he said he should leave but confessed he might not be able to because he called himself essentially a selfish creature who craves my company.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "I should have left long ago," he sighed. "I should leave now. But I don't know if I can." and "I'm essentially a selfish creature. I crave your company too much to do what I should."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I noticed that he reached out tenderly and placed his marble, smooth, cold hand back in mine and that his smile could be dazzling yet ashamed.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "reaching out slowly, carefully, to place his marble hand back in mine." and "He smiled, but his face was ashamed."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.description: I sensed that he felt repentant and ashamed about his earlier behavior and that he considered himself particularly dangerous to Bella.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: "Please forgive me," he said formally... "He smiled, but his face was ashamed." and "Never forget I am more dangerous to you than I am to anyone else."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.description: I explained that people register as different 'flavors' of scent and that some essences can be compared to addictive substances to illustrate irresistible temptation.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: "You know how everyone enjoys different flavors? ... Now let's say you placed in that room a glass of hundred-year-old brandy, the rarest, finest cognac — and filled the room with its warm aroma — how do you think he would fare then?"

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.description: I decided to choose a gentle approach to avoid frightening Bella, demonstrated by placing my hand back in hers and assembling my words carefully.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: Without seeming to think about it, he placed his hand back in mine; I held it tightly in both of mine.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.description: I admitted that Bella is uniquely irresistible to me by calling her my exact 'brand of heroin', which clarifies my vulnerability and the danger I pose.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: "Yes, you are exactly my brand of heroin."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward discussed his reaction to me with his brothers and that they responded differently to temptation.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: I spoke to my brothers about it. To Jasper, every one of you is much the same.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward claims he has never given in to someone as appealing as I am.
I learned that Edward felt so ashamed of his weakness that he went to Carlisle at the hospital intending to tell him he was leaving.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: I left the others near home — I was too ashamed to tell them how weak I was, they only knew something was very wrong — and then I went straight to Carlisle, at the hospital, to tell him I was leaving.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.description: I recognized that Edward values his family's rules and restraint and that his remorse over possible failure affects his choices and relationships.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc5.source_text: He says twice, for him, once stronger than the other. ... He left the sentence hanging. His eyes burned into mine. "It's different for us. Emmett… these were strangers he happened across. It was a long time ago, and he wasn't as… practiced, as careful, as he is now."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward fled to Alaska because he felt ashamed and homesick after our first encounter.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: By the next morning I was in Alaska. He sounded ashamed, as if admitting a great cowardice. I spent two days there, with some old acquaintances… but I was homesick.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward believed himself strong and even called his restraint arrogant when he returned to see me.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: I convinced myself it was weak to run away. I'd dealt with temptation before, not of this magnitude, not even close, but I was strong. So I came back… I took precautions, hunting, feeding more than usual before seeing you again. I was sure that I was strong enough to treat you like any other human. I was arrogant about it.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward could not read my mind and had to eavesdrop on Jessica's thoughts, which he found bothersome.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: It was unquestionably a complication that I couldn't simply read your thoughts to know what your reaction was to me. I wasn't used to having to go to such circuitous measures, listening to your words in Jessica's mind… her mind isn't very original, and it was annoying to have to stoop to that.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward's immediate motivation to save me in danger included both fear of exposure and a visceral, personal refusal to lose me, summarized by his thought 'Not her.'
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: Later I thought of a perfectly good excuse for why I acted at that moment — because if I hadn't saved you, if your blood had been spilled there in front of me, I don't think I could have stopped myself from exposing us for what we are. But I only thought of that excuse later. At the time, all I could think was, 'Not her.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.description: I perceived Edward as suffering under his craving and self-reproach, which updated my view of him from distant predator to conflicted protector.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: I was filled with compassion for his suffering, even now, as he confessed his craving to take my life.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward admitted to eavesdropping on the minds of everyone I spoke to the day after my hospital choice.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.source_text: "All that next day I eavesdropped on the minds of everyone you spoke to, shocked that you kept your word."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.description: I realized that Edward's attempt to stay away failed because his attraction to me remained as strong as the first day, despite his efforts.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.source_text: "I did my very best to stay as far from you as possible. And every day the perfume of your skin, your breath, your hair… it hit me as hard as the very first day."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.description: I understood Edward declare that I am the most important thing to him now and ever and that he could not live with himself if he ever hurt me.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc7.source_text: "You are the most important thing to me now. The most important thing to me ever." "I couldn't live with myself if I ever hurt you."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward apologized and accepted fault for having run from me earlier.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: You didn't do anything wrong, Bella. It was my fault.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward deliberately tested how I would respond by placing his hand on my neck and instructing me to be still.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: He raised his free hand and placed it gently on the side of my neck. "Be very still," he whispered.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I noted that Edward found the encounter less difficult than he had expected and believed it "won't be so hard again."
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: "It won't be so hard again" and "Not nearly as bad as I imagined it would be."

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.description: I perceived Edward's strong restraint combined with a palpable hunger in his gaze while he allowed me to touch him.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: No one could be still like Edward. He closed his eyes and became as immobile as stone. He opened his eyes, and they were hungry.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward recognizes buried human instincts within himself that sometimes surface despite his nature.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: I have human instincts — they may be buried deep, but they're there.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I noticed Edward admitting uncertainty about intimacy when he confessed he didn't know how to be close to me.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: I don't know how to be close to you, he admitted.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.description: I observed Edward's protectiveness and willingness to guide me when he offered to show how he travels in the forest and invited me to ride on his back.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: Can I show you something? I'll show you how I travel in the forest. Come on, little coward, climb on my back.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I observed that he could carry me easily and exhibit superhuman strength with very little effort.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: He then proceeded to sling me onto his back, with very little effort on my part,

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I noticed that his grip clamped my legs and arms so tightly that it would choke a normal person.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: clamping my legs and arms so tightly around him that it would choke a normal person.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I noticed him grab my hand, press my palm to his face, inhale deeply, and mutter that it was 'Easier all the time,' while appearing unusually high-spirited.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: He startled me, suddenly grabbing my hand, pressing my palm to his face, and inhaling deeply. 'Easier all the time,' he muttered. And then he was running.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.description: I saw him streak through the forest silently at deadly speeds with no sound from his feet and with breathing that never indicated effort.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: He streaked through the dark, thick underbrush of the forest like a bullet, like a ghost. There was no sound, no evidence that his feet touched the earth. His breathing never changed, never indicated any effort. But the trees flew by at deadly speeds, always missing us by inches.

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I observed that Edward cradled Bella, placed her on the springy ferns, and offered calm, practical care.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I read 'cradling me in his arms like a small child' and 'carefully placed me on the springy ferns.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I learned that Edward hesitated before kissing to test his control over his need and to ensure safety.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I read 'Edward hesitated to test himself, to see if this was safe, to make sure he was still in control of his need.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I noticed that Edward was pleased and surprised to discover that he was stronger than he had thought.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I heard 'I'm stronger than I thought. It's nice to know.'

tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.description: I observed Edward acting protectively by preventing Bella from driving when she was woozy and by taking practical responsibility for her safety.
tw-book1-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I heard 'I'm not about to let you behind the wheel of a vehicle when you can't even walk straight.'

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward stayed with Bella and explicitly reassured her that he had remained.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Bella wakes from a dream and suddenly remembers Edward was there; she rushes to him, flusters at her own enthusiasm; they share a warmly intimate moment as he reassures her that he stayed; they tease one another, and Bella retreats briefly to the bathroom to compose herself before returning to Edward's arms."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.description: I sensed Edward's reassurance eased Bella's distress and increased trust between them in that moment.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Bella wakes from a dream and suddenly remembers Edward was there; she rushes to him, flusters at her own enthusiasm; they share a warmly intimate moment as he reassures her that he stayed; they tease one another, and Bella retreats briefly to the bathroom to compose herself before returning to Edward's arms."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.description: I observed Edward's comforting presence and teasing exchange reinforce the intimacy and mutual care in their relationship.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Bella wakes from a dream and suddenly remembers Edward was there; she rushes to him, flusters at her own enthusiasm; they share a warmly intimate moment as he reassures her that he stayed; they tease one another, and Bella retreats briefly to the bathroom to compose herself before returning to Edward's arms."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.description: I heard him suggest she meet his family as part of the day’s plans.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: Edward suggests Bella meet his family; Bella nervously reacts to the idea

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.description: I learned that his family is described as open during their conversation.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: they talk about how open Edward’s family is

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.description: I noticed he actively reassured her of his commitment and protective role and I interpreted that as an affirmation of his devotion.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: Their affection and banter continue, with Edward reassuring her of his commitment and protection.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.description: I observed Edward tease Bella about her appearance and kiss her.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Bella dresses and returns; Edward teases her about her appearance and kisses her.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward caught Bella when she fainted and that they shared a light exchange about her fainting and his effect on her.
