tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Edward catches her; they share a light exchange about her fainting and his effect on her.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward's actions reaffirmed his protective and affectionate role by catching Bella and driving her home.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Edward then drives Bella out of town toward his home, their relationship reaffirmed.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward accompanies Bella to the porch and comforts her jitters as they enter the house.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: They approach the porch together, Edward comforting Bella’s jitters as they enter the house.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.description: I felt more assured about Edward's caring nature after seeing him soothe Bella's nervousness during their arrival.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: They approach the porch together, Edward comforting Bella’s jitters as they enter the house.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.description: I updated my view of Edward as a calming, protective presence in Bella's life based on his behavior at the house.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: They approach the porch together, Edward comforting Bella’s jitters as they enter the house.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward was present during my introduction to Carlisle and Esme which placed him with the family in that scene.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.source_text: I read that Edward was present during Bella's meeting with Carlisle and Esme.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.description: I associated Edward with a reserved but hospitable household which changed my expectations of his family's social demeanor.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc5.source_text: I read that Bella noted the family's welcoming atmosphere and their reserve while meeting Edward there.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.description: I heard a light conversation that referenced Edward's talents.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Light conversation follows about Edward’s talents and the family dynamic."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.description: I sensed that the family discusses and implicitly supports Edward through their conversation about his abilities.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Light conversation follows about Edward’s talents and the family dynamic."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.description: I concluded that Edward is respected within his family based on the approving tone of the exchange.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Alice enthusiastically greets Bella and shows obvious approval; Jasper is gentler and more reserved."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward composed and performed a complex piano piece.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: He performs a complex piece he composed

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.description: I recognized that Edward used his performance to signal to Bella that the family likes her and to comfort her about Rosalie and Emmett.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: Edward indicates to Bella that the family likes her and reassures her about Rosalie and Emmett, who are currently absent or hesitant.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.description: I felt Edward became more demonstratively protective and reassuring toward Bella through his music.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: Edward indicates to Bella that the family likes her and reassures her about Rosalie and Emmett, who are currently absent or hesitant.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.description: I learned that Alice has seen visitors coming and that Edward will be overprotective for a while.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: He explains that Alice has seen visitors coming and that he will be overprotective for a while because those visitors are a different kind of danger.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward adopt a more protective stance toward Bella because of the visitors.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: He explains that Alice has seen visitors coming and that he will be overprotective for a while because those visitors are a different kind of danger.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.description: I heard Edward share family background and reassure Bella that most family members accept her.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: He also shares family background and reassures Bella about most members’ acceptance.

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.description: I learned from Edward that Carlisle originated in 17th-century England and is very old.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.source_text: I heard "Edward tells the story of Carlisle’s past, including his age and origin in 17th-century England"

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.description: I was told a condensed account of Carlisle's transformation and early encounters with vampires.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.source_text: I heard "giving Bella a condensed account of Carlisle’s transformation and early encounters with vampires."

tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.description: I perceived Edward as willing to be open and patient when sharing difficult family history because he invited questions during the tour.
tw-book1-chapter15_Sc9.source_text: I read "The scene ends with Edward inviting Bella to ask more questions as he continues the tour."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward wanted to show Bella some of Carlisle's history and explicitly positioned the visit as partly about Bella's history.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "'I wanted to show Bella some of our history,' Edward said. 'Well, your history, actually.'"

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward indicated 'The Waggoner' as the starting point for the history viewing and physically guided Bella toward the pictures.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "'The Waggoner,' Edward replied, placing one hand lightly on my shoulder and spinning me around to look back toward the door we'd just come through."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I felt more aware of Edward's affectionate and protective behavior after he placed his hand lightly on my shoulder and squeezed my hand.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "Edward pulled me toward the far left side, standing me in front of a small square oil painting... Edward squeezed my hand."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward asked Bella to tell the story of the painting, suggesting he wanted her involvement in recounting Carlisle's past.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc1.source_text: "'Will you tell the story?' Edward asked."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I learned from Edward's narrative that Carlisle studied, traveled, and redefined his existence after accepting that he could survive without becoming a monster.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "He began to make better use of his time. He'd always been intelligent, eager to learn. Now he had unlimited time before him. He studied by night, planned by day. He swam to France and —"

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward and his kind do not technically need to breathe and that lacking smell makes being without breathing uncomfortable.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "No, no, you promised." He laughed, putting his cold finger lightly to my lips. "Do you want to hear the story or not?" "You don't have to breathe?" "No, it's not necessary. Just a habit." "How long can you go… without breathing?" "Indefinitely, I suppose; I don't know. It gets a bit uncomfortable — being without a sense of smell."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward openly feared my reaction to the truth about him and that his fear revealed how much he cares about my safety.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "I keep waiting for it to happen... something I tell you or something you see is going to be too much. And then you'll run away from me, screaming as you go."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.description: I understood that Edward's desire to protect me conflicts with his desire to be with me, and I sensed his willingness to let me go if it meant my safety.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: "I won't stop you. I want this to happen, because I want you to be safe. And yet, I want to be with you. The two desires are impossible to reconcile…"

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that Carlisle spent two centuries struggling to perfect self-control and became almost immune to the scent of human blood.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: it took Carlisle two centuries of torturous effort to perfect his self-control. Now he is all but immune to the scent of human blood, and he is able to do the work he loves without agony.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that Carlisle studied music, science, and medicine in European universities and that he found his calling in saving human lives at hospitals.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: By night he studied music, science, medicine — and found his calling, his penance, in that, in saving human lives.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that Carlisle encountered three ancient vampires in Italy named Aro, Marcus, and Caius who were portrayed as gods by painters.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: Solimena was greatly inspired by Carlisle's friends. He often painted them as gods," Edward chuckled. "Aro, Marcus, Caius,"

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward's reverence and affection when he spoke of Carlisle and his history.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: His expression became awed, almost reverent. And so we've come full circle," he concluded. "a gentle angel's smile lit his expression.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I learned that he organizes his CDs by year and then by personal preference within that frame.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "Ummm, by year, and then by personal preference within that frame," he said absently.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I heard him say he felt prepared to feel relieved about me knowing everything and that sharing made him happy.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "I was prepared to feel… relieved. Having you know about everything, not needing to keep secrets from you. But I didn't expect to feel more than that. I like it. It makes me… happy."

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I observed that he could move with extreme speed, appearing to leap at me so quickly that I only became aware once I was airborne.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: I didn't see him leap at me — it was much too fast. I only found myself suddenly airborne, and then we crashed onto the sofa, knocking it into the wall.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.description: I experienced him as both playful and protective when he growled, grinned, and then held me so securely that I felt barely jostled.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: He growled, a low sound in the back of his throat; his lips curled back over his perfect teeth. All the while, his arms formed an iron cage of protection around me — I was barely jostled.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I observed Edward chuckling quietly as he held me close.
I noticed Edward's eyes light up about the game and then pause in hesitation.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: Edward's eyes lit up, but he hesitated.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I perceived Edward's eagerness to include me when he asked if I wanted to go.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: "Do you want to go?" Edward asked me, excited, his expression vivid.

tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward and the others treat baseball as a kind of ritualized pastime for them.
tw-book1-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: "It's the American pastime," he said with mock solemnity.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I was identified by Carlisle as part of the family standing with him during the encounter.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "I'm Carlisle. This is my family, Emmett and Jasper, Rosalie, Esme and Alice, Edward and Bella."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I became aware that the Cullens' hunting range includes the Olympic Range and occasionally the Coast Ranges, and that another permanent settlement exists near Denali.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "The Olympic Range here, up and down the Coast Ranges on occasion. We keep a permanent residence nearby. There's another permanent settlement like ours up near Denali."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I saw Edward placed in the role of family member who would participate in practical tasks, such as going to fetch the Jeep with Bella, Emmett, and Alice.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "We'll show you the way if you'd like to run with us — Emmett and Alice, you can go with Edward and Bella to get the Jeep," he casually added.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.description: I felt more confident in the Cullens' ability to handle the strangers because I guessed that Jasper was using his gift to control the situation.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: I guessed that Jasper was using his peculiar gift to control the situation.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.description: I saw Edward stiffen and bare his teeth, crouching in defense and snarling ferociously to protect me.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: Edward bared his teeth, crouching in defense, a feral snarl ripping from his throat.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.description: I noted Edward positioned himself like a lion in front of me, reinforcing that he acts as my defender.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: Edward stayed tensed like a lion in front of me.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.description: I observed Edward shift in direct response to James's movements, showing quick defensive coordination.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: James feinted slightly to the side, and Edward shifted in response.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward's impatience as we moved at human speed to the forest edge.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: Edward's impatience was almost tangible as we moved at human speed to the forest edge.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I observed Edward sling Bella over his back and continue running without breaking stride.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: Once we were into the trees, Edward slung me over his back without breaking stride.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I realized that Edward's running was driven by a consuming fury rather than his usual exhilaration.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: The sense of exhilaration that usually seemed to possess Edward as he ran was completely absent, replaced by a fury that consumed him and drove him still faster.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I perceived Edward as protective and commanding when he ordered Emmett to strap Bella in.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: "Strap her in," he ordered Emmett, who slid in beside me.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward drove the Jeep south away from Forks at high speed, with the speedometer reading over one hundred miles per hour.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc3.source_text: And we were headed south, away from Forks. The speedometer read a hundred and five miles an hour.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward claimed he could read or had seen the tracker's mind.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: "Listen to me, Alice. I saw his mind."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I heard Edward assert that the tracker would begin the hunt tonight and that the tracker specifically wanted the girl.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text:
"He's a tracker, Alice, did you see that? He's a tracker!"

"He begins the hunt tonight."

"and he wants her, Alice — her, specifically."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward took a controlling, urgent stance—speaking coldly, ordering Emmett, and insisting there were no options.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc4.source_text:
"I have to, Bella, now please be quiet."

"There are no options," Edward hissed.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.description: I understood that Edward initially believed there was no other option than to confront and potentially kill the tracker.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: I quote: "There — is — no — other — option!" and "We'd have to kill him."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.description: I observed Edward shift from absolute refusal to allowing Bella to leave that night with strict conditions.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: I quote: "You're leaving tonight, whether the tracker sees or not. You tell Charlie that you can't stand another minute in Forks... You have fifteen minutes."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.description: I saw Edward prioritize Bella's safety above all and express a desire to keep dangerous people far from her.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: I quote: "I don't want him within a hundred miles of her."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward had a clear operational plan for approaching the house and a conditional rule to keep driving if the tracker was present.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: This is how it's going to happen. When we get to the house, if the tracker is not there, I will walk her to the door. Then she has fifteen minutes.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward shift from absolute refusal to a more reluctant consideration of alternatives after repeated persuasion from others.
I observed that Edward appeared to accept Alice's competence in this situation and to trust her judgment despite previous reservations.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: Edward seemed to accept that. Whatever his problem with Alice was, he didn't doubt her now.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.description: I heard Edward prioritize the immediate safety of Charlie and the group over other concerns when he emphasized ensuring Charlie would be safe.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: "That's irrelevant. We'll make sure he's safe, and that's all that matters."

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I spoke softly and I issued a clear warning that I would hold Bella personally responsible if anything happened to her.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: "If you let anything happen to yourself— anything at all — I'm holding you personally responsible. Do you understand that?"

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I asked whether Jasper could handle the situation, indicating I was checking on the group's readiness.
I showed a protective attitude combined with a lighter side when I smiled and told Alice to keep her opinions to herself.
tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.source_text: "But keep your opinions to yourself," he muttered suddenly.

tw-book1-chapter18_Sc7.description: I called Bella's name in a very soft voice, which revealed intimacy and concern in my manner.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward announced someone was not there and urged that they leave immediately.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: "He's not here," Edward said tensely. "Let's go."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I observed Edward command Alice and Emmett and saw them move soundlessly into the darkness.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: "Alice, Emmett." Edward's voice was a command. They slithered soundlessly into the darkness, instantly disappearing.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I experienced Edward as protective when he opened my door, took my hand, and drew me into the enclosure of his arm as he guided me to the house.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: Edward opened my door and took my hand, then drew me into the protecting enclosure of his arm. He walked me swiftly toward the house, eyes always roving through the night.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.description: I felt reassured by Edward's fierce assurance that nothing was going to happen to me and by his urgent command to hurry inside.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: "Nothing is going to happen to you, Bella," he said just as fiercely. "Get inside, Bella. We have to hurry."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I watched Edward silently pull out armfuls of clothes, throw them to me, zip my bag, and put the strap over my arm before disappearing through the window.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "Edward was already there, silently yanking out armfuls of random clothes, which he proceeded to throw to me... Edward's capable hands pushed mine away and zipped it smoothly. He put the strap carefully over my arm. 'I'll be in the truck — go!' he whispered, and pushed me toward the door. He vanished out the window."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward remained protective and supportive as he aided my escape despite the emotional turmoil.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "'I'll be in the truck — go!' he whispered, and pushed me toward the door."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.description: I saw Edward positioned as my immediate means of escape by waiting in the truck for me.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I'll be in the truck — go!"

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I know that Edward can read minds and that he got a clear look at the tracker's mind and motivations tonight.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I got a good look at his mind tonight," he began.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward believes the only sure way to stop a vampire like James is to tear him to pieces and burn the remains.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "The only way to be sure is to tear him to shreds, and then burn the pieces."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I see Edward blaming himself for exposing me and feeling hopeless frustration over the consequences.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "It's my fault — I was a fool to expose you like that."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward believes James will not attack the house tonight even though James continues to follow us.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "He won't attack the house, though. Not tonight."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward is determined to confront James and that he planned to hunt James after ensuring I was safe.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: "As soon as Bella is clear, we hunt him."

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward reacted with visible rage to Laurent's presence and that his anger filled the room.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: Edward's enraged roar filled the room; Laurent cringed back.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward deliberately ignored Rosalie's hostility toward me and focused on my safety instead.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: He looked away from Rosalie as if she hadn't spoken, as if she didn't exist.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.description: I observed Edward's calm command to move me upstairs and I believed he prioritized strategy and protection over engaging with Rosalie's anger.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: "Get her upstairs and trade clothes," Edward commanded.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward was part of the hunting party and intended to leave with Carlisle to track the threat.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc5.source_text: "We're taking the Jeep." I realized suddenly, with a stab of fear, that they made up the hunting party.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward was intensely protective in the last moments, catching and kissing me, but then he turned away with a blank expression and left.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc5.source_text: He caught me up in his iron grip, crushing me to him. For the shortest second, his lips were icy and hard against mine. His eyes went blank, curiously dead, as he turned away. And they were gone.

tw-book1-chapter19_Sc5.description: I felt that Edward's brief kiss combined fierce protection with resignation before he departed.
tw-book1-chapter19_Sc5.source_text: For the shortest second, his lips were icy and hard against mine.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward Cullen was not in school that day.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: And it was worse because Edward Cullen wasn't in school at all.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.description: I dreaded lunchtime because I feared Edward's bizarre glares and felt too cowardly to confront him.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: All morning I was dreading lunch, fearing his bizarre glares.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.description: I saw that his four siblings of sorts were sitting together at the same table and that Edward was not with them.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I saw that his four siblings of sorts were sitting together at the same table, and he was not with them.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.description: I began to suspect, against my better judgment, that I might be the reason Edward stayed away from school.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I couldn't get rid of the nagging suspicion that I was the reason he wasn't there.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward Cullen did not come back to school that week.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: Edward Cullen didn't come back to school.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.description: I watched the rest of the Cullens enter the cafeteria without Edward each day, which heightened my anxiety.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: Every day, I watched anxiously until the rest of the Cullens entered the cafeteria without him.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.description: I saw Edward laughing with his family during the snow fight and appearing playful in the cafeteria.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: They were laughing. Edward, Jasper, and Emmett all had their hair entirely saturated with melting snow.

tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.description: I perceived Edward as different in the snow, noting that his skin looked less pale and that something about him had changed.
tw-book1-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: His skin was less pale, I decided — flushed from the snow fight maybe — the circles under his eyes much less noticeable. But there was something more. I pondered, staring, trying to isolate the change.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc1.description: I remembered that we had raced across the black freeways at more than twice the legal speed in a sleek black car with darker-than-limo windows and an almost silent engine.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc1.source_text: I did remember the sleek black car, the glass in the windows darker than that on a limousine. The engine was almost silent, though we'd raced across the black freeways at more than twice the legal speed.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc1.description: I perceived Edward as capable of hostility when I recalled his brutal snarl with teeth bared and I noticed a dead look in his eyes after he kissed me the last time.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc1.source_text: Edward's brutal snarl, teeth bared — the dead look in Edward's eyes after he kissed me the last time…

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward reminded Alice that I have to eat a lot more frequently than they do.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: "Edward reminded me that you have to eat a lot more frequently than we do."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward had called before they left but had not called since then.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: "He called?" "No," she said, and watched as my face fell. "It was before we left."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc3.description: I felt that Edward occupies a caretaking role for me by monitoring my needs and communicating through Alice.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: "Edward reminded me that you have to eat a lot more frequently than we do."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc4.description: I learned from Alice that Edward had been alone for almost a century before finding me.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: "It's been almost a century that Edward's been alone. Now he's found you."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc4.description: I realized that the family would be devastated if Edward lost his connection to me and that they do not want that to happen.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: "Do you think any of us want to look into his eyes for the next hundred years if he loses you?"

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward had apparently given instructions to Alice regarding how she should act while we waited.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc5.source_text: I was beginning to wonder exactly what sort of instructions Edward had given her.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc5.description: I began to see Edward as orchestrating the situation from elsewhere, which made me feel monitored and controlled.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc5.source_text: I was beginning to wonder exactly what sort of instructions Edward had given her.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward did not want Alice to tell Bella about how to become a vampire.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: "Edward doesn't want me to tell you that," she said firmly

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc6.description: I inferred that Edward's desire to control what is shared with Bella creates tension between him and both Alice and Bella.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: "Edward doesn't want me to tell you that," she said firmly, but I sensed she didn't agree. "He'll be extremely angry."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc6.description: I concluded that Edward's protective or controlling stance might conflict with Bella's insistence on autonomy regarding her own fate.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: "That's not fair. I think I have a right to know."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward is one of the vampires who possesses an extra sense.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc7.source_text: The strength, the speed, the acute senses, not to mention those of us like Edward, Jasper, and I, who have extra senses as well.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward had demonstrated the concept of their attractiveness to prey in the meadow for me.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc7.source_text: I was very still, remembering how pointedly Edward had demonstrated the same concept for me in the meadow.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc7.description: I became more convinced that Edward finds it very hard to intentionally bite someone because tasting blood provokes a near-frenzy that is difficult to control.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc7.source_text: "Edward said that it was very hard to do… I don't quite understand," I said. "We're also like sharks in a way. Once we taste the blood, or even smell it for that matter, it becomes very hard to keep from feeding. Sometimes impossible. So you see, to actually bite someone, to taste the blood, it would begin the frenzy."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc8.description: I learned that Alice could not see the tracker's precise location because it was too dark.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc8.source_text: Can you see where he is? "No, it's too dark."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc8.description: I became concerned that ongoing searches may fail because the tracker will elude them.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.description: I heard him say that the pursuer seemed suspicious and kept just far enough away that he could not read his thoughts.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.source_text: "he seems suspicious of us — he's careful to stay just far enough away that I can't hear what he's thinking."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.description: I learned that he reported losing the pursuer and believed the pursuer had gotten on a plane back to Forks.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.source_text: "we lost him... it looks like he got on a plane. We think he's heading back to Forks to start over."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.description: I noticed his voice was hard with urgency as he insisted that I should not worry about anything but myself.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.source_text: "I told you not to worry about anything but yourself."

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.description: I heard him admit that I have taken half his self away and that he still loves me despite everything.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc9.source_text: "It's like you've taken half my self away with you." "I love you,"

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc10.description: I learned that Edward had mentioned a red-haired female connected to Charlie's house and possibly the school records.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc10.source_text: I was thinking about something Edward had said, about the red-haired female at Charlie's house, at the school, where my records would be.

tw-book1-chapter20_Sc10.description: I felt increased concern because Edward's comment about the red-haired female made me worry that someone might be involved with my family's situation.
tw-book1-chapter20_Sc10.source_text: I was thinking about something Edward had said, about the red-haired female at Charlie's house, at the school, where my records would be.

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc1.description: I learned from Jasper's words that someone referred to as 'him' had been brought back to the room with the VCR in Alice's vision and that the room was now light.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc1.source_text: "Yes. Something's brought him back to the room with the VCR, but it's light now."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward is catching the first flight out of Seattle to come get me.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: Yes, he's catching the first flight out of Seattle.

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward had come because of my mother.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: But, my mother… he came here for my mother, Alice!

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc2.description: I began to fear that Edward's actions might lead him to find and hurt someone I love while trying to reach me.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: Don't you see what he's doing? He's not tracking me at all. He'll find someone, he'll hurt someone I love…

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc3.description: I learned from Alice that Edward was on a plane that would land at nine-forty-five.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc3.source_text: "They're just boarding their plane," Alice told me. "They'll land at nine-forty-five."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc3.description: I felt that Edward's imminent arrival was the primary source of hope that I clung to during the crisis.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc3.source_text: Just a few more hours to keep breathing till he was here.

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc4.description: I believed that James might have beaten Edward and that James would be satisfied if he had beaten him.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: I read: 'I could only hope that James would be satisfied with winning the game, that beating Edward would be enough.'

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc4.description: I expected that Edward would eventually find the letter I wrote and that I hoped he would understand my choice.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: I read: 'Eventually he would find it. I only hoped he would understand, and listen to me just this once.'

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc4.description: I asked Edward not to be angry with Alice and Jasper and requested that he forgive them on my behalf.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: I read: 'Don't be angry with Alice and Jasper. If I get away from them it will be a miracle. Tell them thank you for me. Alice especially, please.'

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward's flight from Seattle arrived early, shortening the time I had to escape.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: "The flight from Seattle crept closer to the top of the board." "His plane was ten minutes early."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc6.description: I imagined Edward standing at the edge of the road when he found the end of my trail, which shaped my emotional state during the escape.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: "I couldn't help imagining Edward, where he would stand at the edge of the road when he found the end of my trail."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc6.description: I recognized that my emotional attachment to Edward was powerful and directly conflicted with my desire to run away.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: "That made it very hard. I found myself trying to think of excuses to stay, to see him first and then make my escape."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward was not physically present in this scene while I spent the drive imagining how I would meet him at the airport and escape together.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc7.source_text: I imagined that I had stayed at the airport to meet Edward.

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc7.description: I noticed that I regarded Edward as my sanctuary and ultimate safety, picturing being in his 'marble arms' and feeling that being with him would be heaven.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc7.source_text: I pictured that 'I would be in his marble arms, finally safe.'

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc8.description: I learned that James expected Edward to be unable to resist hunting him after watching the recorded video.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc8.source_text: "I'm sorry, but I just don't think he'll be able to resist hunting me after he watches this."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc8.description: I understood that Bella (I) had asked Edward not to come and that Edward's reply was unknown.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc8.source_text: "I asked him not to." "I don't know."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc8.description: I heard James claim that Edward was too weak to make a difficult choice and that James considered Edward less formidable.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc8.source_text: "The one and only time my prey escaped me... The vampire who was so stupidly fond of this little victim made the choice that your Edward was too weak to make."

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc9.description: I inferred that Edward was not present in the room and that I hoped he would come to find me.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc9.source_text: "Wouldn't you rather have Edward try to find me?" he prompted.

tw-book1-chapter21_Sc9.description: I trusted Edward to be someone who might come for me and I preferred that possibility to the hunter's attention.
tw-book1-chapter21_Sc9.source_text: "Wouldn't you rather have Edward try to find me?" he prompted. "No!" I croaked. "No, Edward, don't—"

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc1.description: I heard an agonized, seemingly perfect voice calling my name and calling for "Carlisle," which conveyed intense distress.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: "Carlisle!" the angel called, agony in his perfect voice. "Bella, Bella, no, oh please, no, no!"

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc1.description: I inferred that someone in my life would respond with raw, tearless sobs and desperate pleading if I were in mortal danger.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: And the angel was sobbing tearless, broken sobs.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc1.description: I became convinced that the person who called me combined an angelic quality with furious protectiveness, suggested by the roar and the begging.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: Where I floated, under the dark water, I heard the happiest sound my mind could conjure up — as beautiful, as uplifting, as it was ghastly. It was another snarl; a deeper, wilder roar that rang with fury.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward was present and spoke urgently to me, trying to keep me conscious.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: "Bella, you're going to be fine. Can you hear me, Bella? I love you."

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc2.description: I realized Edward felt anguish and helplessness when he asked if others could do anything.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: "I know, Bella, I know" — and then, away from me, anguished — "can't you do anything?"

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc2.description: I recognized Edward's protective and loving stance toward me through his words and tone.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: "Bella, you're going to be fine. Can you hear me, Bella? I love you."

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc3.description: I heard that Edward caught his breath in horror when he realized what had happened.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc3.source_text: I heard Edward catch his breath in horror.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward's protective anguish and refusal to let someone try the risky procedure on me.
I learned that Edward's voice was frightened when he called my name.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.description: I heard Edward hesitate and say he did not know if he could perform the task Carlisle requested.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: Carlisle, I…" Edward hesitated. "I don't know if I can do that." There was agony in his beautiful voice again.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.description: I observed Edward's doubt shift into a blazing determination before he acted to help Bella.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: I watched his eyes as the doubt was suddenly replaced with a blazing determination.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward take direct, physical action by holding Bella's hand and using his mouth to remove the venom.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: I felt his cool, strong fingers on my burning hand, locking it in place. Then his head bent over it, and his cold lips pressed against my skin.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.description: I recognized Edward's commitment to Bella when he assured her he would stay with her.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: "He's right here, Bella." "Stay, Edward, stay with me…" "I will." His voice was strained, but somehow triumphant.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc5.description: I heard Edward report that Bella's blood tasted clean and that he could taste morphine.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc5.source_text: "Her blood tastes clean," Edward said quietly. "I can taste the morphine."

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc5.description: I observed Edward express his love for Bella directly and to show visible relief through a weak, quiet laugh.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc5.source_text: "I love you," he answered. I heard my favorite sound in the world: Edward's quiet laugh, weak with relief.

tw-book1-chapter23_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward took on a protective, caregiving role by offering to carry Bella so she could sleep and by soothing her.
tw-book1-chapter23_Sc5.source_text: "You can sleep, sweetheart, I'll carry you," Edward soothed me. "Sleep now, Bella" were the last words I heard.

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward rescued Bella from an attack by James and that others subdued the attacker afterward.
tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: After I pulled him off you, Emmett and Jasper took care of him.

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.description: I sensed that Edward felt tormented and fearful that he had been 'almost too late' to save Bella.
tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: I was almost too late. I could have been too late," he whispered, his voice tormented.

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.description: I perceived Edward's intense love and possessiveness when he admitted, 'I must love you.'
I learned that Edward disliked the transfusions because they temporarily made Bella smell wrong but that he ultimately preferred how she smells.
tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: They gave you a few transfusions. I didn't like it — it made you smell all wrong for a while." "No, I like how you smell.

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward and Alice fabricated a public explanation that Bella fell down stairs and through a window to cover the truth.
tw-book1-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: "You fell down two flights of stairs and through a window."

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc3.description: I watched Edward carry most of my weight and support me through the evening.
tw-book1-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: He was carrying most of my weight, but I still had to shuffle and wobble my feet forward.

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc3.description: I heard Edward mutter that there were more than enough vampires present as he commented on the prom.
tw-book1-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: "there are more than enough vampires present."

tw-book1-chapter24_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward preferred to avoid dancing despite his ability when he said anything to get out of dancing.
I perceived Edward's jealousy toward Jacob through his quiet snarl and rigid composure.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.description: I suspected Edward of lying about his eyes.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: And I was suspicious of him; why should he lie about his eyes?

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.description: I sensed hostility emanating from Edward that frightened me.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: I was still frightened of the hostility I sometimes felt emanating from him,

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.description: I viewed Edward as having a perfect face that left me tongue-tied.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: and I was still tongue-tied whenever I pictured his perfect face.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.description: I knew that I would see Edward Cullen at school.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: I knew I was eager to get to school because I would see Edward Cullen.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.description: I believed that my league and Edward's league were spheres that did not touch.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: I was well aware that my league and his league were spheres that did not touch.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc2.description: I saw Edward Cullen standing four cars down from me staring at me in horror.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: Edward Cullen was standing four cars down from me, staring at me in horror.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward's face standing out from a sea of faces all frozen in the same mask of shock, which I interpreted as his visible alarm at the situation.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: His face stood out from a sea of faces, all frozen in the same mask of shock.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward was standing right next to me and that he asserted he had been next to me the whole time.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: "I was standing right next to you, Bella," he said, his tone serious again.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward used his long white hands to fit into a dent in the van and to grip under the vehicle to pull me out from under it.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.source_text:
Two long, white hands shot out protectively in front of me, and the van shuddered to a stop a foot from my face, the large hands fitting providentially into a deep dent in the side of the van's body.

One was suddenly gripping under the body of the van, and something was dragging me...

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward suppressed laughter even while expressing concern, which changed my sense of his emotional complexity in the moment.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: "That's what I thought." His voice, amazingly, sounded like he was suppressing laughter.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.description: I heard Edward's low, frantic voice clearly above the crowd and felt reassured by his immediate, focused concern for me.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc3.source_text:
But more clearly than all the yelling, I could hear Edward Cullen's low, frantic voice in my ear.

"Bella? Are you all right?"

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.description: I heard Edward insist that he had been standing with me and that he had pulled me out of the way.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: B ella, I was standing with you, and I pulled you out of the way." He unleashed the full, devastating power of his eyes on me, as if trying to communicate something crucial.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.description: I heard Edward deny being by his car when I remembered seeing him there.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: "You were over there," I suddenly remembered, and his chuckle stopped short. "You were by your car." His expression turned hard. "No, I wasn't."

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.description: I watched Edward refuse a stretcher and ride in the front of the ambulance instead of being treated alongside me.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: Edward vehemently refused his, and I tried to do the same, but the traitor told them I'd hit my head and probably had a concussion. I almost died of humiliation when they put on the neck brace. It looked like the entire school was there, watching soberly as they loaded me in the back of the ambulance. Edward got to ride in the front.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward's family watched from a distance with disapproval or fury and showed no visible concern for his safety.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: And then there was his family, looking on from the distance, with expressions that ranged from disapproval to fury but held no hint of concern for their brother's safety.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.description: I felt more mistrustful when Edward pleaded with me to trust him and asked me to promise to let him explain later.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: "Please, Bella." "Trust me," he pleaded, his soft voice overwhelming. "Will you promise to explain everything to me later?" "Fine," he snapped, abruptly exasperated.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward Cullen intervened and pulled me out of harm's way during the accident.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: Umm… Edward pulled me out of the way.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward Cullen was nearby at the scene and was not placed on a stretcher.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: Edward Cullen — he was standing next to me. I think so. He's here somewhere, but they didn't make him use a stretcher.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc5.description: I became convinced that Edward's intervention could not be reconciled with ordinary explanation and that something unexplained had occurred.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: I knew I wasn't crazy. What had happened? There was no way to explain away what I'd seen.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc6.description: I observed Edward lift a hand to stop Tyler from apologizing and control the conversation in the room.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: Edward lifted a hand to stop him.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc6.description: I understood that Edward said "No blood, no foul" and that he told me he had come to spring me.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: "No blood, no foul," he said, flashing his brilliant teeth. "But don't worry, I came to spring you."

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc6.description: I felt increased irritation at Edward's patronizing smile and smug demeanor during the examination.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: I heard a chuckle, and looked over to see Edward's patronizing smile. My eyes narrowed.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward explicitly stated he saved Bella's life and claimed he didn't owe her anything for it.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: "I saved your life — I don't owe you anything."

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc7.description: I perceived Edward as cold, defensive, and dismissive during the private confrontation.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: "What do you want?" he asked, sounding annoyed.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc7.description: I noticed a brief moment of vulnerability in Edward when he whispered that he did not know why he had bothered to intervene.
I learned that Edward expected Bella to accept his actions with little explanation and preferred she simply thank him and move on.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: "Can't you just thank me and get over it?"

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.description: I learned that Dr. Cullen was the person who saw and reassured me in the clinic.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: Dr. Cullen saw me, and he said I was fine and I could go home.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.description: I interpreted Edward's defensive behavior in the hall as confirmation of the strange things I had suspected.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: I was positive that Edward's defensive behavior in the hall was a confirmation of the bizarre things I still could hardly believe I'd witnessed.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.description: I became obsessed with Edward himself and found myself consumed by the mystery he presented.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: I was consumed by the mystery Edward presented. And more than a little obsessed by Edward himself.

tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward displayed defensive behavior in the hallway during the incident at the clinic.
tw-book1-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: I was positive that Edward's defensive behavior in the hall was a confirmation of the bizarre things I still could hardly believe I'd witnessed.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc1.description: I noticed that dim light seemed to be radiating from Edward's skin in my dream.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: In my dream it was very dark, and what dim light there was seemed to be radiating from Edward's skin.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward walked away from me in the dream and that he never turned despite my running and calling.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: No matter how fast I ran, I couldn't catch up to him; no matter how loud I called, he never turned.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc1.description: I began to view Edward as distant and unattainable because he repeatedly appeared only on the periphery of my dreams.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: After that, he was in my dreams nearly every night, but always on the periphery, never within reach.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.description: I observed that people avoided Edward as usual.
I observed Edward sitting next to me in class as far from me as the table would allow and seeming totally unaware of my presence.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: When he sat next to me in class, as far from me as the table would allow, he seemed totally unaware of my presence.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward would suddenly ball up his fists and that his skin looked even whiter over the bones during those moments.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: Only now and then, when his fists would suddenly ball up — skin stretched even whiter over the bones — did I wonder if he wasn't quite as oblivious as he appeared.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.description: I believed that Edward regretted saving me because I could find no other conclusion.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: He wished he hadn't pulled me from the path of Tyler's van — there was no other conclusion I could come to.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.description: I learned that other students claimed not to have seen Edward until after the van was pulled away despite my insistence that he had been the hero.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: No one seemed concerned about Edward, though I explained over and over that he was the hero — how he had pulled me out of the way and had nearly been crushed, too.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward had saved my life, even though I did not know how he had done it.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: But he had in fact saved my life, no matter how he'd done it.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc3.description: I experienced Edward's deliberate coolness when he barely acknowledged me in class, nodding once without meeting my gaze.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: He turned his head a fraction toward me without meeting my gaze, nodded once, and then looked the other way.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc3.description: I watched Edward's golden eyes grow perceptibly darker day by day and felt increased concern and curiosity.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I watched as his golden eyes grew perceptibly darker day by day.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward was sitting close enough to touch while feeling as distant as an invention of my imagination.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: As always, I was electrically aware of Edward sitting close enough to touch, as distant as if he were merely an invention of my imagination.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.description: I observed Edward tilt his head reflexively in my direction from the corner of my eye.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: But I saw, from the corner of my eye, Edward's head tilt reflexively in my direction.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.description: I watched Edward stare at me with probing intensity and a familiar edge of frustration in his black eyes.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: And Edward was staring at me curiously, that same, familiar edge of frustration even more distinct now in his black eyes.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.description: I heard Edward answer Mr. Banner's question with "The Krebs Cycle," appearing reluctant as he turned to look at the teacher.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: "The Krebs Cycle," Edward answered, seeming reluctant as he turned to look at Mr. Banner.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc5.description: I heard him apologize and acknowledge that he was being rude.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc5.source_text: I heard "I'm sorry." and "I'm being very rude, I know. But it's better this way, really."

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc5.description: I observed that he wanted to end our friendship and presented the idea seriously.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc5.source_text: I heard "It's better if we're not friends," he explained.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc5.description: I noticed he became angry and defensive when I accused him of regretting saving my life.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc5.source_text: I heard "You think I regret saving your life?"

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward arrived in the parking lot and positioned his car to cut me off while waiting for his family.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.source_text: Edward was in his car already, two spaces down, sliding out smoothly in front of me, cutting me off. He stopped there — to wait for his family; I could see the four of them walking this way, but still by the cafeteria.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward was with Alice, Rosalie, Emmett, and Jasper when he left in the Volvo.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.source_text: I watched Alice, Rosalie, Emmett, and Jasper all sliding into the Volvo.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.description: I noticed I believed Edward was amused and possibly taunting me because he appeared to be shaking with laughter as he watched.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.source_text: In his rearview mirror, Edward's eyes were on me. He was unquestionably shaking with laughter, as if he'd heard every word Tyler had said.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.description: I felt antagonistic toward Edward in that moment because I considered retaliating against his car for cutting me off.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc6.source_text: I considered taking out the rear of his shiny Volvo, but there were too many witnesses.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc7.description: I heard Edward's remark that it was better if we weren't friends and noted its impact.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc7.source_text: What did he mean, it was better if we weren't friends?

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc7.description: I inferred that Edward wanted distance because he feared leading me on given how absorbed I was by him.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc7.source_text: He must see how absorbed I was by him; he must not want to lead me on… so we couldn't even be friends… because he wasn't interested in me at all.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc7.description: I perceived Edward as interesting, brilliant, mysterious, perfect, beautiful, and possibly physically powerful.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc7.source_text: I wasn't interesting. And he was. Interesting… and brilliant… and mysterious… and perfect… and beautiful… and possibly able to lift full-sized vans with one hand.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward can move with such speed or stealth that he retrieved Bella's key from the puddle before she could.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc8.source_text: As I bent to get it, a white hand flashed out and grabbed it before I could.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward's eyes were light and a deep, golden honey color that day.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc8.source_text: His eyes were light again today, a deep, golden honey color.

tw-book1-chapter4_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward admitted he was tired of trying to stay away from Bella and that he believed it would be more prudent for them not to be friends, despite his feelings.
tw-book1-chapter4_Sc8.source_text: It would be more… prudent for you not to be my friend. But I'm tired of trying to stay away from you, Bella.

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward intentionally skipped class that day.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: I'm not going to class today,

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward's face became severe as if he feared he had said too much.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: His face was abruptly severe, as if he were afraid that he'd accidentally said too much.

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.description: I observed Edward offering to take Bella to the nurse, showing a protective impulse.
I recognized that Edward often masks trouble with a smile while remaining troubled underneath.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: He smiled up at me, but his eyes were still troubled.

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward can be composed and deliberate in small actions, like spinning the bottle lid.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: He turned his attention back to his makeshift top. "I'll see you later, then."

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.description: I heard that Edward spoke softly at the counter and that his voice was described as like melting honey.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: His voice was like melting honey.

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward offered to excuse me from class and to take me home because he thought I wasn't well.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: "Bella has Gym next hour, and I don't think she feels well enough. Actually, I was thinking I should take her home now. Do you think you could excuse her from class?"

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward combined politeness with mockery and possessiveness when he held the door, smiled politely, and later gripped my jacket.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: He held the door for me, his smile polite but his eyes mocking. / He was gripping a fistful of my jacket in one hand.

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.description: I realized that Edward drove very fast yet smoothly and that he played Clair de Lune in the car.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: "Clair de Lune?" I asked, surprised. / I began to realize we were driving very fast;

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward remembered personal details such as the name Phil when he asked about my mother.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: "So why did your mother marry Phil?"

tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.description: I felt that Edward enjoyed teasing and being gently provocative when he suggested we not push Mike and when his eyes danced at the idea of my invitation.
tw-book1-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: "Let's you and I not push poor Mike any further this week. We don't want him to snap." His eyes danced; he was enjoying the idea more than he should.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward typically sat only with his family rather than others.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: "You know, I've never seen him sit with anyone but his family before."

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward had come up in conversation about lunch and that he never really got to the point when he spoke.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: "So what did Edward Cullen want yesterday?" Jessica asked in Trig. "I don't know," I answered truthfully. "He never really got to the point."

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc1.description: I felt drawn to Edward and I experienced gloom when I realized I did not know how long it would be before I saw him again.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: And I couldn't stop the gloom that engulfed me as I realized I didn't know how long I would have to wait before I saw him again.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc2.description: I considered riding to Seattle with Edward Cullen and I wondered if my dad would approve.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: I wondered if he would approve of my plan to ride to Seattle with Edward Cullen. Not that I was going to tell him.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc3.description: I wished that a miracle would occur and that Edward would appear while we were waiting.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: But also wishing that a miracle would occur, and Edward would appear.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward had requested that I not fall into the ocean.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc5.source_text: It reminded me of Edward's request — that I not fall into the ocean.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc5.description: I wondered what Edward was doing and imagined what he would be saying if he were there, showing that I missed him and valued his opinion.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc5.source_text: I was completely absorbed, except for one small part of my mind that wondered what Edward was doing now, and trying to imagine what he would be saying if he were here with me.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc6.description: I learned that the Cullens do not come to First Beach and I took the remark as a sign that the Cullen family was not present or was not allowed there.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc6.source_text: I quote 'The Cullens don't come here' as said by a local in the scene.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc8.description: I noticed that others asked if Bella's boyfriend was present, implying attention on her romantic situation even though Edward was not there.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc8.source_text: "Is that your boyfriend?" Jacob asked, alerted by the jealous edge in Mike's voice.

tw-book1-chapter6_Sc8.description: I inferred from the group's questions and Mike's tone that Bella's boyfriend holds social significance for the local teens.
tw-book1-chapter6_Sc8.source_text: "Is that your boyfriend?" Jacob asked, alerted by the jealous edge in Mike's voice.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc1.description: I inferred that Bella's attempt to avoid thinking about recent events is connected to feelings or events involving Edward even though he is not present.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: I inferred that the scene establishes Bella's attempt to avoid thinking about recent events and introduces her private coping ritual.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc1.description: I felt that Bella was emotionally withdrawing into solitude, which suggests a temporary distancing from relationships that include Edward.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: I noticed the sequence emphasizes Bella's solitude and the private nature of her coping routine.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward beckoned me toward him in the dream.
I perceived Edward as an alluring, calm figure whose presence intensified the sense of an approaching violent confrontation.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: I recalled 'Edward beckons Bella' and 'a violent confrontation approaches'.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward Cullen is not present in this scene because only Bella Swan is listed as present.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc4.description: I observed that the Cullen sunlight behavior does not align with the vampire traits described in the sources I found online.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc4.source_text: I read: 'The sunlight incompatibility problem puzzles her.'

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc4.description: I grew more curious and uncertain about Edward's nature after encountering contradictory and irrelevant folklore alongside my direct observations.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc4.source_text: I read: 'She sifts through myths and folklore, comparing entries with what she and Jacob have said and with her own observations of the Cullens.'

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward, as a member of the Cullens, was included in my suspicion that the Cullens could be vampires.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc5.source_text: I wondered whether the Cullens, including Edward, could be vampires.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc5.description: I realized that I would have difficulty staying away from Edward if he were a vampire because I could not make myself avoid the Cullens.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc5.source_text: I recognized that I could not make myself stay away from the Cullens, which included Edward.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc6.description: I observed that Edward Cullen was not present in this scene.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc7.description: I felt my thoughts about Edward were part of the inner turmoil that family time helped ground.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc7.source_text: (This scene provides social dynamics of family, grounding Bella's life amid her inner turmoil.)

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward was absent from Biology again during this school day.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: I read 'Biology finds Edward absent again.'

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.description: I learned that the Cullen table was empty at lunch, which caused disappointment.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: I read 'the Cullen table is empty, causing disappointment.'

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.description: I felt an increased longing to see Edward after his absence deepened my disappointment at lunch.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: I read 'Bella's hope of seeing the Cullens rises' and 'the Cullen table is empty.'

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward's absence created a sense of distance and altered how I related to my peers that day.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: I read 'This scene shifts social dynamics, showing Bella among peers while her fixation on Edward grows.'

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward is not present in this scene.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc9.source_text: I note that the characters present are Bella Swan, Jessica Stanley, Charlie Swan.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc10.description: I learned that the Cullen table was again empty, implying Edward or his family were not present at breakfast.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc10.source_text: The Cullen table is again empty, heightening her anxiety.

tw-book1-chapter7_Sc10.description: I noted that I hoped to see Edward at school when I drove there, indicating my expectation of his presence.
tw-book1-chapter7_Sc10.source_text: Bella wakes to another sunny morning, dresses for warmth, and drives to school hoping to see Edward.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc2.description: I learned that the Cullens often go backpacking when the weather is good and that they are very outdoorsy.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: Yes, when the weather is good they go backpacking all the time — even the doctor. They're all real outdoorsy, she told me quietly, examining her shoes, too.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc2.description: I realized that the Cullens are frequently out of school for outdoor activities, which explains their absences.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: Yes, when the weather is good they go backpacking all the time — even the doctor. They're all real outdoorsy, she told me quietly, examining her shoes, too.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc3.description: I associated the sight of a silver Volvo parked on the street with him and I felt my hopes collapse.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: when I looked up to see someone's silver Volvo parked along the street and it all came crashing down on me.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc3.description: I judged him in my thoughts as a stupid, unreliable vampire and I felt mistrust and frustration toward him.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: Stupid, unreliable vampire, I thought to myself.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc3.description: I feared that he might disappoint me on Saturday and I tried to suppress my hopes to avoid more pain.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: I was trying so hard not to think about him, and what Angela had said… and more than anything trying to beat down my hopes for Saturday, fearing a disappointment more painful than the rest,

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.description: I learned that the rescuer arrived in a silver car that fishtailed to a stop with the passenger door open and commanded me to get in.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: The silver car unexpectedly fishtailed around, skidding to a stop with the passenger door open just a few feet from me.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.description: I was ordered by the driver to get in immediately and I obeyed.
I observed the driver accelerate too quickly, swerve toward the men, and blow through several stop signs as he sped toward the harbor.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: The tires squealed as he spun around to face north, accelerating too quickly, swerving toward the stunned men on the street.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.description: I was told by the driver to put on my seat belt during the escape.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: "Put on your seat belt," he commanded, and I realized I was clutching the seat with both hands.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.description: I realized that the driver was murderously angry when I studied his face and I heard him reply curtly when I asked if I was okay.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: "No," he said curtly, and his tone was livid.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward asked me to distract him by prattling about something unimportant so he could calm down.
I learned that Edward admits he sometimes has a problem with his temper and that he consciously tries to restrain himself.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: "Sometimes I have a problem with my temper, Bella."

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc6.description: I became more aware that Edward's fury was plain on his face even when he did not look at me and tried to control himself.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: He still didn't look at me, but the fury was plain on his face.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc6.description: I observed that Edward drove back to town at high speed, wove easily through traffic, and parallel-parked the Volvo effortlessly.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: He parallel-parked against the curb in a space I would have thought much too small for the Volvo, but he slid in effortlessly in one try.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward can charm others with a silken, irresistible voice and that my friends were surprised by it.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.source_text: "Would it be all right if I joined you?" he asked in his silken, irresistible voice. I could see from their staggered expressions that he had never unleashed his talents on them before.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward offered to drive me home and that he was willing to manage the situation to protect my friends from waiting.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.source_text: "Do you mind if I drive Bella home tonight? That way you won't have to wait while she eats."

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.description: I now perceive Edward as authoritative and capable of issuing commands when he thinks it necessary.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.source_text: "I think you should eat something." Edward's voice was low, but full of authority.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward can be physically assertive and demonstrative in public actions, such as stepping out, slamming the car door, and holding the restaurant door open.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc7.source_text: He stepped out of the car and slammed the door.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward requested a more private table and appeared to hand the hostess a tip to secure it.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.source_text:
"Perhaps something more private?" he insisted quietly to the host.
I wasn't sure, but it looked like he smoothly handed her a tip.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward's smile has a strong effect on people and can daze them momentarily.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.source_text: He flashed his gleaming smile, dazing her momentarily.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward often refuses to eat when we are together, saying he wanted 'nothing' for himself.
I recognized that Edward prioritizes my wellbeing and watches me closely, asking directly about symptoms like dizziness or cold.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.source_text:
"How are you feeling?"
"You don't feel dizzy, sick, cold… ?"

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.description: I heard Edward admit that he was 'waiting' for me to go into shock, indicating he anticipates extreme reactions from me.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc8.source_text: "Well, I'm actually waiting for you to go into shock."

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.description: I learned that he gave me his jacket and complimented how the color blue looked with my skin, showing attentiveness to my appearance.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: I read 'He handed me the jacket' and I read 'That color blue looks lovely with your skin'

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.description: I inferred that he has some capacity related to mind reading and that he acknowledged there is one exception to that ability.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: I read 'with a few exceptions' and I read 'Just one exception,' he corrected

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.description: I heard him say that he used to be always right but that he was wrong about me on at least one occasion.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: I read 'I used to be.' and I read 'I was wrong about you on one other thing, as well'

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.description: I recognized that he unequivocally placed himself in the category of those who would put themselves into danger to protect me.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: I read 'Unequivocally' in response to 'And you put yourself into that category?'

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.description: I learned that he drove in circles listening to people's thoughts and waited because he expected me to turn around.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.source_text: "I started to drive in circles, still… listening. The sun was finally setting, and I was about to get out and follow you on foot. And then —"

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.description: I learned that he tracked me by searching the minds of people on the street and by reading Jessica's mind to find clues about my location.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.source_text: "I was keeping tabs on Jessica, not carefully — like I said, only you could find trouble in Port Angeles — and at first I didn't notice when you took off on your own. Then, when I realized that you weren't with her anymore, I went looking for you at the bookstore I saw in her head."

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.description: I learned that he saw my face in another man's mind, which enraged him and tempted him to harm those men to take me away.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.source_text: "I heard what they were thinking,' he growled, his upper lip curling slightly back over his teeth. 'I saw your face in his mind.' ... 'It was very… hard — you can't imagine how hard — for me to simply take you away, and leave them… alive.'"

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.description: I learned that he admitted he was afraid that if I left him alone he would go looking for them, revealing his fear of losing control over his impulses.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.source_text: "I could have let you go with Jessica and Angela, but I was afraid if you left me alone, I would go looking for them,' he admitted in a whisper."

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc10.description: I recognized that he negotiated closeness and communication with me, shown when he said 'You eat, I'll talk,' indicating his desire to keep me near while he disclosed difficult truths.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.description: I observed him thank the waitress without looking away from me.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.source_text: He didn't look away from me as he thanked her.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.description: I noticed he opened the passenger door, held it for me, and shut it softly behind me.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.source_text: He opened the passenger door, holding it for me as I stepped in, shutting it softly behind me.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.description: I noticed he started the engine and turned the heater on high to warm the car.
tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.source_text: Once inside the car, he started the engine and turned the heater on high.

tw-book1-chapter8_Sc11.description: I heard him say 'Now, it's your turn,' suggesting he expected me to act next.

tw-book1-chapter9_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward admitted following my scent as a way to locate me.
I learned that Edward's telepathy requires proximity and increases with how familiar a person's 'voice' is to him, with an upper limit of a few miles.
tw-book1-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: "I have to be fairly close. The more familiar someone's… 'voice' is, the farther away I can hear them. But still, no more than a few miles."

tw-book1-chapter9_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward actively tunes out the mental background because the constant noise would be distracting and impede appearing normal.
tw-book1-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: "Most of the time I tune it all out — it can be very distracting. And then it's easier to seem normal" — "when I'm not accidentally answering someone's thoughts rather than their words."
