tw-book2-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: "Edward relaxed. His jaw unclenched.""I should probably take you home," he said, more calm now, but clearly in a hurry to get me out of here.

tw-book2-chapter24_Sc2.description: I experienced Edward's controlling protectiveness when he physically seized my face and positioned himself between me and Carlisle.
tw-book2-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: Edward grabbed my face in his hand, forcing me to look at him. His other hand was out, palm toward Carlisle.

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward feared a fight with Jacob could end with Jacob being killed and that Edward would try very hard not to let that happen.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "It would most likely turn into a fight, and I don't know if I could stop it before I k—" he broke off, and then quickly continued. "I would try… very hard… not to do that."

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc2.description: I became convinced that Edward's restraint stems from protective concern for me and a fear of losing control.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "I can control myself, but I doubt he can. He's very young."

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc2.description: I updated my perception of Edward as intensely protective and serious because I saw him drive slowly, become statue-still, and whisper that I was already in more trouble.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "You're already in more trouble, Bella," he whispered through unmoving lips.

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward noticed the motorcycle and associated it with trouble at Charlie's house.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: Edward glanced back at Charlie's house. I followed his gaze, and noticed for the first time what was parked in the driveway next to the cruiser.

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward believed Charlie would be very angry and possibly violent toward me.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: Edward had said that Charlie was ready to kill me, so he must know that—that it was mine.

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward warned me that Charlie would hear me and that he might brick over the doorway if I caused a scene.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: Charlie will hear you," Edward warned me. "And once he gets you inside, he may brick over the doorway.

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.description: I relied on Edward to restrain me and to steer the situation away from immediate confrontation.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: He caught me around the waist before I made the path. "We should hurry. Charlie's getting impatient."

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.description: I heard Edward thank Jacob for keeping Bella alive and express overwhelming gratitude and indebtedness.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: "Thank you," Edward said, and his voice throbbed with the depth of his sincerity. "I will never be able to tell you how grateful I am. I will owe you for the rest of my… existence."

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward protectively shifted Bella behind him and positioned himself between her and Jacob.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: Edward turned his body, shifting me so that I was behind him.

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.description: I understood Edward's resolve to stay with Bella and his claim that he will not make the same mistake twice.
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: "I'm a quick learner, Jacob Black, and I don't make the same mistake twice. I'm here until she orders me away."

tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward acknowledged a past failure to keep Bella safe when he said, 'When I… didn't.'
tw-book2-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: "For keeping Bella alive," Edward clarified, his voice rough and fervent. "When I… didn't."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.description: I watched Edward kiss my forehead quickly and duck out my window.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: Edward's face was smooth and remote as he kissed my forehead quickly and ducked out my window.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.description: I saw Edward's face as smooth and remote and I sensed something buried in his eyes that scared me.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: It didn't help my outlook that Edward's face was smooth and remote... There was something buried in his eyes that I couldn't be sure of—and it scared me.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward waiting for me at school, opening my car door for me, and shortening his stride to match mine.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: Edward was waiting for me at school, as usual... He opened my door for me. We walked in silence, he shortening his stride to match mine.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.description: I worried that Edward might have been thinking about right and wrong while he watched me sleep.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: I was afraid of the time I'd spent unconscious, afraid that he might have been thinking about right and wrong again while he watched me sleep.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.description: I perceived Edward as aloof during the morning.
I noticed Edward occasionally asked about my arm.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: Occasionally he would ask about my arm, and I would lie.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.description: I observed Edward slowly pulverizing a granola bar between his fingertips while answering me.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: He looked at the granola bar he was slowly pulverizing between his fingertips while he answered.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.description: I learned from Edward that Alice was trying to convince Jasper to go to Denali and that both would be gone for a while.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: "She was trying to convince him to go to Denali."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward asked solicitously about my arm, revealing a caring side despite his aloofness.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: "Is your arm bothering you?" he asked solicitously.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc3.description: I heard him say "Later?" and I noted that he seemed surprised when I mentioned my schedule.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: "'Later?' It pleased me that he seemed surprised."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc3.description: I heard him reply "If you want me to" when I asked him to come over later that night.
I noticed he spoke and acted with indifference in responding to my insistence that he come over.
I watched him turn his back and I watched him lope gracefully toward his car after our interaction.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: "Then he turned his back and loped gracefully toward his car."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc5.description: I saw Edward stand up during the show and heard him say he needed to get home.
I heard Edward tell me he would not stay that night and then watched him drive away.
I felt Edward was distant toward me as he walked beside me without seeming to look at me and returned to ignoring me after briefly whispering an answer.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: He walked silently beside me, never seeming to actually look at me. Edward whispered the correct answer under his breath and then went back to ignoring me.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.description: I observed that Edward can appear warmly amused in one setting and coldly reserved in another, as shown by the different prints.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: The first was the picture of Edward in the kitchen, his warm eyes touched with tolerant amusement. The second was Edward and Charlie, watching ESPN. The difference in Edward's expression was severe. His eyes were careful here, reserved.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.description: I noticed that Edward's face was described as 'cold and statue-like' in the photograph of him standing next to me.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: The last was the picture of Edward and me standing awkwardly side by side. Edward's face was the same as the last, cold and statue-like.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.description: I perceived Edward as more distant and less emotionally present than before because his expressions in the photos made him seem less alive.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: His face was colder, more like a sculpture, less alive.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.description: I began to believe that spending time apart might be better because I thought time with me obviously wasn't helping things.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: Edward walked me back to the parking lot in silence. I had to work again, and for once, I was glad. Time with me obviously wasn't helping things. Maybe time alone would be better.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward believes it is time for his family to leave Forks because they can no longer plausibly pass for their stated ages.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: I quote: "It's time. How much longer could we stay in Forks, after all? Carlisle can barely pass for thirty, and he's claiming thirty-three now."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward explicitly states that he is not human and that he is tired of pretending to be someone he is not.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: I quote: "Because I'm… tired of pretending to be something I'm not, Bella. I am not human."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.description: I observed that Edward asserts emotional distance by saying he will always love Bella 'in a way' while refusing to allow her to join his family.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: I quote: "Of course, I'll always love you… in a way."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.description: I changed my belief about Edward's demeanor when I noticed his eyes harden and his resolve to end the possibility of Bella joining him.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: I quote: "When he finally looked up, his eyes were different, harder—like the liquid gold had frozen solid."

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc8.description: I learned that I had been searching specifically for him and equated his absence with the end of everything important to me.
tw-book2-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: I had to keep moving. If I stopped looking for him, it was over. Love, life, meaning… over.

tw-book2-chapter3_Sc8.description: I believed that he was gone as I kept repeating or being described as saying that 'He's gone.'
I realized that I saw him as central to my life and meaning during the search and in my panic.

tw-book2-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that there has been no contact with him for months—no calls, no letters, no contact.
tw-book2-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: "It's been months. No calls, no letters, no contact. You can't keep waiting for him."

tw-book2-chapter4_Sc1.description: I feel that the subject of him is taboo in my household and that mentioning him is forbidden.
tw-book2-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: This whole subject was utterly forbidden, as he was well aware.

tw-book2-chapter4_Sc3.description: I heard Edward's voice as furious yet protective and I inferred that the voice expressed care by commanding me to keep my promise.
tw-book2-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: "Go back to Jessica," the lovely voice ordered, still angry. "You promised—nothing stupid."

tw-book2-chapter4_Sc3.description: I noted that Edward was not physically present yet I felt him improbably close in my perception.
tw-book2-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I knew he wasn't there, and yet, he felt improbably close, close for the first time since… since the end.

tw-book2-chapter5_Sc4.description: I felt that reminders of the one I could not bear would surface if others reacted with pleasure, making me want to avoid those reminders today.
tw-book2-chapter5_Sc4.source_text: His pleasure and relief would only remind me of the one I couldn't bear to be reminded of. Not again today, I pleaded silently.

tw-book2-chapter5_Sc4.description: I felt emotionally spent and I acknowledged that thoughts of that one drained me.

tw-book2-chapter5_Sc6.description: I learned that Billy wanted me to stay a safe distance from the most important person in my life.
tw-book2-chapter5_Sc6.source_text: Billy wanted me to stay a safe distance from the most important person in my life.

tw-book2-chapter5_Sc6.description: I realized that Billy's concern proved unnecessary because I was 'all too safe' now and I intended to change that.
tw-book2-chapter5_Sc6.source_text: It turned out that his concern was, in the end, unnecessary. I was all too safe now. But I was going to see what I could do to change that.

tw-book2-chapter5_Sc6.description: I continued to regard that person as the most important person in my life, which influenced my feelings about taking risks.
tw-book2-chapter5_Sc6.source_text: the most important person in my life.

tw-book2-chapter6_Sc4.description: I recognized that I didn't normally relate to people so easily on such a basic level and I separated that tendency from how I reacted to Jacob.
tw-book2-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: I didn't normally relate to people so easily, on such a basic level. Not human beings.

tw-book2-chapter6_Sc4.description: I realized the hug with Jacob was emotionally different from the last time someone had embraced me and I reframed the previous embrace by contrast.
tw-book2-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: This didn't feel anything like the last time someone had embraced me this way. This was friendship.

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc1.description: I perceived him as unattainable, impossible, uncaring and distracted.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: Unattainable and impossible, uncaring and distracted…

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc1.description: I believed he was out there somewhere and that I had to maintain belief in his presence.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: but he was out there, somewhere. I had to believe that.

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc1.description: I became convinced that searching for him was necessary despite knowing the attempt felt unhealthy.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: There was something to search for. This was not a healthy thing to do.

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc2.description: I noticed that his voice could come from some other part of me than my conscious memory.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: when his voice came from some other part of me than my conscious memory,

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc2.description: I observed that his voice was perfect and honey smooth rather than the pale echo my memories usually produced.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: when his voice was perfect and honey smooth rather than the pale echo my memories usually produced,

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc2.description: I felt an irresistible lure to repeat the experience of hearing his voice, which revealed my increased emotional dependence on him.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: But those precious moments when I could hear him again were an irresistible lure. I had to find some way to repeat the experience…

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc3.description: I realized that I could not sense his presence and that there was no mental voice reaching me here.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc3.source_text: But nothing happened. No voice in my head.

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc3.description: I felt less connected to him because the house's emptiness removed the comforting proof of his presence.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc3.source_text: There was nothing here. No lingering sense of their presence… of his presence.

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward was not present or mentioned in this scene and that the focus was solely on Bella and Jacob.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: We started down the road again.

tw-book2-chapter7_Sc8.description: I recognized that no new information about Edward's whereabouts, reactions, or behavior was provided in this excerpt.
tw-book2-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: That was when I noticed four figures standing on a rocky ledge, much too close to the precipice.

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc1.description: I heard Edward's voice clearly inside my head, delivering a critical, velvet reprimand that interrupted my concentration while I was learning to ride.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: "This is reckless and childish and idiotic, Bella," the velvet voice fumed. "I told you so," the perfect voice murmured, crystal clear."

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc1.description: I started to believe that Edward's internal voice can intrude at moments of stress or danger and that those intrusions have immediate physical consequences for me.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: "The bike bucked under me... The growling engine choked to a stop." "The voice in my head was back. It still rang in my ears—soft, velvety echoes." "Some combination of adrenaline and danger..."

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc1.description: I felt a complex reaction to Edward's return in my mind, sensing both familiar comfort in his voice and annoyance or vulnerability when it judges me aloud.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: "More than fine. The voice in my head was back. It still rang in my ears—soft, velvety echoes." "This is reckless and childish and idiotic, Bella," the velvet voice fumed.

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc2.description: I heard a honey-sweet, angry internal voice that warned me and ordered me to go home to Charlie, which I associated with Edward.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: I recalled: "Go home to Charlie," the voice ordered... "No, Bella!" the angry, honey-sweet voice ordered in my ear.

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc2.description: I was amazed by the sheer beauty of the internal voice and felt I could not let my memory lose it.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: I remembered: "The sheer beauty of it amazed me. I couldn't allow my memory to lose it, no matter the price."

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc2.description: I noticed that I was answering both Jacob and the internal voice, which made me uneasy about how Edward's presence affected my actions.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: I reported: "It bothered me a bit when I realized I was answering both of them."

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc3.description: I remembered hearing the perfect voice in Port Angeles that I associated with him and that that memory continues to haunt me.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: That night was not as bad as that first night, after I'd heard the perfect voice in Port Angeles.

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc3.description: I became convinced that the meadow was a place that would always belong to him and that visiting it might make his memory feel more tangible.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: One place that would always belong to him and no one else. A magic place, full of light.

tw-book2-chapter8_Sc3.description: I believed that the memories of him were different from other landmarks and that I needed a unique place to preserve his presence.
tw-book2-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: There had to be a place where he seemed more real than among all the familiar landmarks that were crowded with other human memories.

tw-book2-chapter9_Sc1.description: I noticed that the voice in my head associated with him began to fade until I heard it no more.
tw-book2-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: But it also meant that the voice in my head began to fade, until I heard it no more.

tw-book2-chapter9_Sc1.description: I panicked at the silence created by his absence and increased my search for the meadow and other adrenaline-producing activities.
tw-book2-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: Quietly, I panicked. I threw myself into the search for the meadow with slightly frenzied intensity. I racked my brain for other adrenaline-producing activities.

tw-book2-chapter9_Sc1.description: I recognized that his absence left an emotional void that affected my orbit and daily focus.
tw-book2-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: I was like a lost moon—my planet destroyed in some cataclysmic, disaster-movie scenario of desolation—that continued, nevertheless, to circle in a tight little orbit around the empty space left behind, ignoring the laws of gravity.

tw-book2-chapter9_Sc4.description: I recognized that I still have a different, deeper attachment to the other person that Jacob perceives without being named.
tw-book2-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: "It's still the other one, isn't it?"

tw-book2-chapter9_Sc4.description: I understood that I avoid saying his name aloud and that others around me, like Jacob, pick up on that without needing the name spoken.
tw-book2-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: "Funny how he seemed to know not to say the name—just like before in the car with the music."

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc1.description: I learned that Jacob invoked the idea of 'mortal enemies' as a reason for distancing himself from me and my companions.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: What part of ‘mortal enemies’ is too complicated for you to

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc1.description: I understood that Jacob blamed my choices regarding who I spend time with and that this blame indirectly references my association with those he considers enemies.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc1.source_text: You made the choice here, okay? You can’t have it both ways when

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward was not present yet during this scene.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: Edward wasn’t here yet; usually my dad reserved this kind of behavior for my boyfriend’s benefit, doing his best to illustrate the theme of “unwelcome” with every word and posture.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward had a specific word in mind for our relationship that caused me tension.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: Edward had another word in mind, and that word was the source of the tension I felt.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward understands what my father is thinking without needing my father's theatrics.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: Charlie’s efforts were unnecessary — Edward knew exactly what my dad was thinking without the show.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward is a vampire who has been allowed to see me only at specific evening hours under my father's supervision.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: Ever since my former best friend (and werewolf), Jacob Black, had informed on me about the motorcycle I’d been riding on the sly — a betrayal he had devised in order to get me grounded so that I couldn’t spend time with my boyfriend (and vampire), Edward Cullen — Edward had been allowed to see me only from seven till nine-thirty p.m., always inside the confines of my home and under the supervision of my dad’s unfailingly crabby glare.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc3.description: I know that Edward can enter my room by climbing through my second-story window and that he can read my father's mind.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: Edward's ability to climb easily and silently through my second-story window was almost as useful as his ability to read Charlie's mind.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc3.description: I feel that Edward's stealth and mental abilities make him especially helpful in maintaining our relationship during my grounding.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: Edward's ability to climb easily and silently through my second-story window was almost as useful as his ability to read Charlie's mind.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.description: I saw that Edward's eyes were described as wide, warm, liquid gold and framed by a thick fringe of black lashes.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: They were wide, warm with liquid gold, and framed by a thick fringe of black lashes.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward remained flawlessly polite to Charlie despite Charlie's gruffness and displeasure.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: “Good evening, Charlie.” Edward was always flawlessly polite, though Charlie didn’t deserve it.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward was wearing a roll of stamps like a ring around his littlest finger.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: He was wearing a roll of stamps like a ring around his littlest finger.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.description: I imagined that Edward had to exert Herculean effort to resist the intoxicating scent of my blood when he pressed my wrist to his face.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I could only dimly imagine the Herculean effort behind this simple gesture.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward has been accepted to multiple universities including Syracuse, Harvard, Dartmouth, and the University of Alaska Southeast.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: Syracuse . . . Harvard . . . Dartmouth . . . and I just got accepted to the University of Alaska Southeast today.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.description: I observed that Edward organized a stack of application forms and suggested recycling essays for efficiency.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I think you can recycle your essays for this one. Same questions.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward tried to placate Charlie and that he preferred not to have Bella go to Seattle, indicating a protective stance.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: No, that’s fine, Charlie. I didn’t mean Seattle. I was thinking Portland, actually. I wouldn’t have Bella in Seattle, either. Of course not.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.description: I felt that Edward was intentionally calming Charlie by reading the newspaper and addressing his concerns about safety.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: I looked at him in disbelief, but he had Charlie’s newspaper in his hands and he was reading the front page intently.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward suggested Alice would like a shopping partner and that he wanted Bella to see city lights, showing encouragement for social outings.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: Alice has been itching for a shopping partner, and I’m sure Bella would love to see some city lights.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc6.description: I proposed New Hampshire because it offers night courses and nearby forests that suit our needs.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: I think you’d like New Hampshire. There’s a full complement of night courses for me, and the forests are very conveniently located for the avid hiker. Plentiful wildlife.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc6.description: I argued that there was no immediate danger and that Bella might enjoy a semester or two of human college experiences.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: There’s no danger yet, he insisted. You might enjoy a semester or two of college. There are a lot of human experiences you’ve never had.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc6.description: I know that a bloodthirsty newborn vampire is loose in Seattle and that Carlisle's group has been monitoring the situation.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: The information here indicates a newborn vampire is loose in Seattle. Bloodthirsty, wild, out of control. We’ve been monitoring the situation for a few weeks.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc7.description: I understood that Edward forbade me from being around a werewolf unprotected and that he feared breaking the treaty might start a war.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: “You know it’s out of the question for you to be around a werewolf unprotected, Bella. And it would break the treaty if any of us cross over onto their land. Do you want us to start a war?”

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc7.description: I noticed Edward’s demeanor shift from teasing to formal and hard when Jacob’s name was mentioned, revealing his wariness.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: Before I could recover, the confusion vanished and his whole body seemed to harden. “Oh. Never mind the wolves, then, if the idea is offensive to you.” His voice was stiff, formal, his shoulders rigid.

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc7.description: I felt Edward’s tenderness when he coaxed my face up and apologized sincerely, showing care beneath his formality.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: His cool finger was under my chin, coaxing my face up. “Sorry. Really.”

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc8.description: I understand that Edward believes werewolves are unstable and that people near them can be hurt or killed.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Werewolves are unstable. Sometimes, the people near them get hurt. Sometimes, they get killed."

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward was surprised by the idea that the vampires' arrival could have caused the werewolves to return, indicating a change or expansion in his understanding.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Edward stared at me, his body motionless with surprise."

tw-book3-chapter1_Sc8.description: I perceived that Edward will not tolerate anything he deems dangerous to me and that he feels intense guilt and fear about having lost me before.
tw-book3-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "I am not going to tolerate anything dangerous."

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward deliberately left so Jacob could come over while he stayed nearby.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: "I’ll be right back," he said, and then he laughed aloud as if I’d just told a good joke.

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward pull Bella close, bury his face in her hair, and exhale cool breath that raised goose bumps.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: "He pulled me close, burying his face in my hair. I could feel his cool breath saturate the strands as he exhaled; it raised goose bumps on my neck."

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc1.description: I inferred that Edward is playful and lightly teasing in his interactions with Bella.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: "He smiled, and then a sly look came into his eye."

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward collected my mail and sent in my Dartmouth application without my prior knowledge.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "I got your mail." "I sent in your application, that’s all."

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward is willing to support me emotionally and financially and that he repeatedly reassures me of my safety.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "I don’t need another sports car. And you don’t have to pretend anything," he murmured. "One year of college wouldn’t kill you." "No one is going to hurt you. You have all the time in the world."

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc2.description: I discovered that Edward has a dry, slightly amused sense of humor about violent scenarios which unsettles and amuses me.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc2.source_text: "I was just wondering why you stabbed him. Not that I object."

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward and the Cullens are concerned about the possibility of newborn vampires and that Jasper would be especially helpful in that scenario.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: If we are dealing with newborns, he’ll be helpful.

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward described Jasper as 'sort of an expert on young vampires.'
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: Jasper is sort of an expert on young vampires.

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward intended to be reasonable and to trust my judgment while still offering protective measures, which updated my sense of his willingness to balance trust and care.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: I told you that I was going to be reasonable and trust your judgment. I meant that.

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward acquired a large sleek silver motorcycle and offered to ride with me if I wanted, demonstrating both romantic gesture and practical accompaniment.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: It was big and sleek and silver and — even totally motionless — it looked fast. I thought I could go with you, if you wished.

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc4.description: I heard the Volvo's engine growl and I watched the silver car disappear around the curve in the road, indicating Edward's departure.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: I heard the Volvo’s engine growl, and I struggled to get free. I turned to wave goodbye, but the silver car was already disappearing around the curve in the road.

tw-book3-chapter10_Sc4.description: I judged Edward to be unusually pleasant about whatever was happening, prompting me to warn Jacob not to push his luck.
tw-book3-chapter10_Sc4.source_text: He’s being pretty dang pleasant about this; you don’t need to push your luck.

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc6.description: I observed that Edward Cullen was not listed among those present for the storytelling.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc6.source_text: Characters present: Billy, Old Quil, Bella Swan, Jacob Black, Quil, Sam

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc9.description: I learned that some cold ones negotiated with the Quileutes and that Jacob's ancestor Ephraim Black accepted a treaty with a coven leader.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "A bigger coven came, and your own great-grandfathers prepared to fight them off. But the leader spoke to Ephraim Black as if he were a man, and promised not to harm the Quileutes."

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc9.description: I worried that the presence of established covens near the Quileutes could draw additional cold ones and complicate the safety of nearby people, including vampires like Edward.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "They've stayed true to their side, though their presence does tend to draw in others."

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc9.description: I reassessed how treaties between some cold ones and the tribe might affect alliances or tensions involving vampires such as Edward and the Quileutes.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "A bigger coven came, and your own great-grandfathers prepared to fight them off."

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc10.description: I did not learn anything new about Edward in this scene because my mind was focused elsewhere.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc10.source_text: My mind was a thousand years away.

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc11.description: I learned that Edward was waiting by the Volvo and that Jacob had already called him on my behalf.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc11.source_text: Easy. It’s not even midnight yet. And I already called him for you. Look — he’s waiting there. I stared into the darkness, and my heartbeat picked up when my eyes made out the shape of the Volvo, thirty yards away.

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc12.description: I learned Edward already knew I was late because Jacob had explained the situation to him.
I felt Edward's relief and protective embrace reinforce that he cares for and watches over me.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc12.source_text: "Bella," he said, relief strong in his voice; his arms wound tightly around me.

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc12.description: I heard Edward offer to carry me when he asked if I was tired.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc12.source_text: "Are you tired? I could carry you."

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc12.description: I heard Edward ask me to tell him about the legends after I had slept.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc12.source_text: "You’ll have to tell me about it. After you’ve slept."

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc13.description: I saw Edward slide through my open window and I noticed that his hands were colder than the rain.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc13.source_text: Edward slid through my open window, his hands colder than the rain.

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc13.description: I heard Edward say that Jacob was out there somewhere and that Esme was on her way home.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc13.source_text: "Yes . . . somewhere. And Esme's on her way home."

tw-book3-chapter11_Sc13.description: I heard Edward say he was reading Wuthering Heights.
I learned that Edward claimed the more time he spent with me the more human emotions seemed comprehensible to him and that he was discovering he could sympathize with Heathcliff.
tw-book3-chapter11_Sc13.source_text: the more time I spend with you, the more human emotions seem comprehensible to me. I’m discovering that I can sympathize with Heathcliff in ways I didn’t think possible before.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward was making Alice tell Bella about the party.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: Fine,” she grumbled. “Edward is making me do this. But Idid foresee that you would be more difficult if I surprised you.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.description: I watched Edward throw an elbow toward Alice's ribs, which she neatly dodged.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: Edward threw an elbow toward her ribs, which she neatly dodged.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.description: I watched Edward reach over to muss Alice's hair as she danced away from him.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: she danced out of the way as Edward reached over to muss her hair

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward muttered that someone so tiny could be annoying, which suggested a teasing, impatient attitude toward Alice.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: Amazing,” Edward muttered. “How can someone so tiny be so annoying?

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward’s eyebrows lift in surprise.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: Neither one answered. Alice just shook her head sadly, feigning disappointment, and Edward’s eyebrows lifted.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward holding the car door for me.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: In a vague way, I was aware of Edward holding the car door for me, of Alice chattering from the backseat, of the rain hammering against the windshield.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward seemed to realize I was only there in body and that he didn’t try to pull me out of my abstraction.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: Edward seemed to realize I was only there in body; he didn’t try to pull me out of my abstraction. Or maybe he did, and I was past noticing.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward asked me to tell him what I was thinking to prevent him from going mad.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.source_text: “Would you please tell me what you are thinking?Before I go mad?”

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward firmly believed I should not be forced into a choice and that choice must be voluntary.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.source_text: “You don’t have to be anything.” “You will have a choice.”

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward vowed to take care of me and to handle threats so I could decide later without fear.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.source_text: “We will take care of the problems, and I will take care of you,” he vowed.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.description: I observed Edward physically comfort me by placing his cold hands on either side of my face and kissing my forehead.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc3.source_text: He put his cold hands on either side of my face and fixed his golden eyes on mine. There. He kissed my forehead.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.description: I heard Edward say that allowing me to become what he is would be the most selfish act he could imagine.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.source_text: I heard him say, "For me to allow this — to let you become what I am just so that I’ll never have to lose you — is the most selfish act I can imagine."

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward would choose to become human for me no matter the cost if that were possible.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.source_text: I heard him say, "If there were any way for me to become human for you — no matter what the price was, I would pay it."

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.description: I understood that Edward cherishes me as his priority and intends to keep me even if I change.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.source_text: I heard him say, "You. That's what I'm keeping. You'll always be my Bella, you'll just be a little more durable."

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward ask whether I did not want to be his wife, revealing vulnerability about our future.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc4.source_text: I heard him ask, "You don't want to be my wife?"

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc5.description: I heard Edward say that he hadn’t seen today’s news yet but that he knew the situation was getting worse and that they would have to act quickly.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc5.source_text: “I hadn’t seen today’s news yet. But I knew it was getting worse. We’re going to have to do something . . quickly.”

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc5.description: I observed Edward’s concern for Alice’s failing visions and his anxiety about that loss of information.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc5.source_text: She can’t see anything . . . She’s starting to lose confidence. She feels like she’s missing too much these days, that something’s wrong. That maybe her vision is slipping away.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward knocked, apologized for startling me, and immediately took my hand, which conveyed protectiveness and immediacy.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc5.source_text: “Did I startle you? I’m sorry. I did knock. . . .” Then he was suddenly at my side, taking my hand.

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward does not want the Volturi to be drawn to them because that would reduce their reaction time.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc6.source_text: "I don’t want the Volturi to have to come here," Edward said. "It gives us so much less reaction time."

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward immediately accepted Jasper's insight and declared that realization changed everything.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc6.source_text: "Oh," Edward said sharply, turning his head slightly to look at Jasper. "I didn’t think of that. I see. You’re right, that has to be it. Well, that changes everything."

tw-book3-chapter12_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward had withheld a story from me but acknowledged that I need to hear it now.
tw-book3-chapter12_Sc6.source_text: "No," Edward answered his thought. "I’m sure you can understand why I haven’t told her that story. But I suppose she needs to hear it now."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward was just as absorbed as I was and that I could feel his eyes on my face reading every flicker of emotion.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: "But Edward was just as absorbed as I was; I could feel his eyes on my face, reading every flicker of emotion."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc1.description: I recognized that Jasper wasn't worried about frightening me, which reminded me that Edward is more overprotective than Jasper.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: "Jasper wasn’t worried about frightening me, not overprotective like Edward always was."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc2.description: I learned that the Volturi's intervention prevented the fever for conquest from spreading and that vampires owe them for the present way of life.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: It was enough that the fever for conquest did not spread from the South. The rest of the world stayed sane. We owe the Volturi for our present way of life.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc2.description: I learned that after the purge southern covens resumed conflicts on a smaller scale and that newborns were later selected and trained more carefully to avoid provoking the Volturi.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: The newborns were selected from the human pool with more care, and given more training. They were used circumspectly, and the humans remained, for the most part, oblivious.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc2.description: I felt horror learning that human histories blamed a disease for the population slump that was actually caused by vampire warfare and massive body counts.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: When the body count reached epidemic proportions — in fact, your histories blame a disease for the population slump — the Volturi finally stepped in.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc3.description: I learned no direct information about Edward Cullen from this scene.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: I was placed in charge of evacuating the women and children from the city when the Union’s mortar boats reached the harbor.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc4.description: I felt a strong tension radiating from Edward during Jasper's telling and I believed that Edward's presence influenced the way Jasper narrated parts of his past.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "A few days later," he finally said, and I wasn’t sure if he had edited his story for my sake or because he was responding to the tension that even I could feel exuding from Edward"

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc6.description: I learned that Jasper can manipulate the emotions around himself and that the feelings in a room affect him personally.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: "You’ve experienced the way I can manipulate the emotions around myself, Bella, but I wonder if you realize how the feelings in a room affectme ."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc6.description: I began to believe that Jasper's struggle with thirst and self-discipline after a century of instant gratification is particularly intense and personal.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc6.source_text: "After a century of instant gratification, I found self-discipline . . . challenging. I still haven’t perfected that."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward and Emmett had been away hunting when Jasper and Alice arrived.
I noticed Edward teasing Jasper about his dramatic arrival and about Alice's familiarity with the family, indicating playful camaraderie.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc7.source_text: "Jasper shows up, covered in battle scars, towing this little freak" — he nudged Alice playfully — "who greets them all by name, knows everything about them, and wants to know which room she can move into."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.description: I realized the newborns might be targeting our family specifically rather than the region at large.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: “Does it occur to anyone else that the only possible threat in the area that would call for the creation of an army is . . . us?”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.description: I learned that Aro knows Alice as well as she knows herself and could exploit that intimate knowledge to hide actions from her.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: “Aro knows you as well as you know yourself.”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.description: I concluded the Volturi might be employing intermediaries or offering a favor to another coven to carry out attacks so they would not have to get their hands dirty.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: “Unless they didn’t want to get their hands dirty.” "A favor," Rosalie suggested, speaking for the first time. "Someone in the South . . . someone who already had trouble with the rules. Someone who should have been destroyed is offered a second chance — if they take care of this one small problem. . . . That would explain the Volturi’s sluggish response."

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.description: I understood that Aro's motives include jealousy and fear of our coven's growth and that he was intoxicated with the idea of knowing both present and future through Alice and me.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc8.source_text: “I’m surprised it’s come to this so soon, because the other thoughts were stronger. In Aro’s head he saw me at his one side and Alice at his other. The present and the future, virtual omniscience. The power of the idea intoxicated him. I would have thought it would take him much longer to give up on that plan — he wanted it too much. But there was also the thought of you, Carlisle, of our family, growing stronger and larger. The jealousy and the fear: you having . . . not more than he had, but still, things that he wanted. He tried not to think about it, but he couldn’t hide it completely. The idea of rooting out the competition was there; besides their own, ours is the largest coven they’ve ever found. . . .”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc9.description: I heard Edward say the Volturi would 'clean up afterward' and call that a double betrayal, implying no overt rule-breaking would be admitted.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: “They’ll clean up afterward. A double betrayal,” Edward said in a grim voice. “No harm done.”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc9.description: I noticed Edward's grim acceptance and his decisive nod that indicated he agreed to move forward.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: Carlisle and Edward exchanged a long glance. Edward nodded once.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc9.description: I recognized that Edward is imagined in Aro's vision as being close to Aro, which affects how others might perceive Edward's relationship to the Volturi.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc9.source_text: Edward and Alice in black, flowing robes, drifting along at Aro’s side with their eyes cold and blood-red.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc10.description: I learned that Irina was closely tied to Laurent and that she wanted revenge and would trade help for permission to attack the wolves.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc10.source_text:
“Irina was more involved with our friend Laurent than we knew. She’s holding a grudge against the wolves for destroying him to save Bella. She wants —”

“She wants revenge. To take down the pack. They would trade their help for our permission.”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc10.description: I noticed Edward's anger and I heard him say that Laurent 'had it coming' and that he still owed the wolves, indicating vindictive satisfaction and indebtedness to the pack.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: “Laurent had it coming” — this was almost a growl — “and I still owe the wolves for that.”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc10.description: I understood that Edward agreed with Carlisle that they would not break the truce or accept Irina's offer, and I observed his refusal alongside Carlisle's.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc10.source_text: “Don’t worry,” he told me in a flat voice. “Carlisle would never agree to it.” He hesitated, then sighed. “Nor would I.”

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc11.description: I noticed that Edward was present with the rest of our group during the discussion of the fight.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I looked around the room at their faces — Jasper, Alice, Emmett, Rose, Esme, Carlisle . . . Edward — the faces of my family.

tw-book3-chapter13_Sc11.description: I saw Edward among those I consider my family when I scanned the room.
tw-book3-chapter13_Sc11.source_text: I looked around the room at their faces — Jasper, Alice, Emmett, Rose, Esme, Carlisle . . . Edward — the faces of my family.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc1.description: I learned that Jasper thinks they could use help and that Carlisle and Jasper are contacting various friends while hesitating to involve the southern covens.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: "Jasper thinks we could use some help. Tanya’s family isn’t the only choice we have. Carlisle’s trying to track down a few old friends, and Jasper is looking up Peter and Charlotte. He’s considering talking to Maria . . . but no one really wants to involve the southerners."

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc1.description: I heard Edward say that allies would be gone in a week.
I noticed Edward reacted protectively and tensely when Bella offered to go, as shown by his rigid body, too-tight arm, and a hissed exhale.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: Edward’s body was suddenly rigid, his arm too tight around me. He exhaled, and the sound was a hiss.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward whispered a reminder to Bella intended to clarify her motives.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc1.source_text: He whispered the reminder in my ear. "Not because you’re afraid."

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward asked who had canceled while he ignored my reaction.
I observed that Edward's attention seemed elsewhere when he inquired about the cancellation, which affected how I felt acknowledged in the moment.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc3.description: I observed Edward roll his eyes in response to my comment and I noticed him smile while saying 'Confidence.'
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: He rolled his eyes. He smiled. "Confidence."

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc3.description: I realized that Edward's beauty and his smile made it hard for me to think about anything else.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: He was so beautiful that it made it hard sometimes to think about anything else, hard to concentrate on Phil’s troubles or Renée’s apologies or hostile vampire armies.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward pulled away from my kiss too soon as usual.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc3.source_text: Too soon, as usual, he pulled away.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward seemed comfortable while I was on the phone with Renée and that he played with my hair.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.source_text: I took a break to call Jacob, and Edward seemed just as comfortable as he had when I was on the phone with Renée. He played with my hair again.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.description: I heard Edward offer to bribe Mr. Varner to give me an A when I worried about my Calculus exam.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.source_text: I’m sure you did fine. Or, if you’re really worried, I could bribe Mr. Varner to give you an A.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.description: I realized that Edward insisted on delivering me to the border like a custodial guardian, which felt infantilizing.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.source_text: Some of that dignity was lost when Edward insisted again on delivering me to the border line like a child being exchanged by custodial guardians.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward suddenly became serious and upset as he stared through the windshield and I reconsidered his composure.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.source_text: He frowned in concentration, and then, as he parked the car, he sighed. "What's wrong?" I asked, my hand on the door. He shook his head. "Nothing." His eyes were narrowed as he stared through the windshield toward the other car. I'd seen that look before.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.description: I observed that Edward was irritated by Jacob's honking and I sensed that the honking affected him strongly.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc5.source_text: Jacob honked his horn — two quick impatient honks. "That's impolite," Edward growled.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc6.description: I heard that Jacob drove a little faster than Bella but slower than Edward when he was going back to La Push.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc6.source_text:
Jacob looked different, maybe even sick. His eyelids drooped and his face was drawn. His shaggy hair stuck out in random directions; it was almost to his chin in some places.
“Are you all right, Jake?”
“Just tired,” he managed to get out before he was overcome by a massive yawn. When he finished, he asked, “What do you want to do today?”
I eyed him for a moment. “Let’s just hang out at your place for now,” I suggested. He didn’t look like he was up for much more than that. “We can ride our bikes later.”
“Sure, sure,” he said, yawning again.
Jacob’s house was vacant, and that felt strange. I realized I thought of Billy as a nearly permanent fixture there.
“Where’s your dad?”
“Over at the Clearwaters’. He’s been hanging out there a lot since Harry died. Sue gets lonely.”
Jacob sat down on the old couch that was no bigger than a loveseat and squished himself to the side to make room for me.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc6.description: I realized that mention of 'bloodsuckers' and distrust reflects a tension involving vampires like Edward in the community dynamic.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc6.source_text: Sam’s being difficult. He doesn’t trust your bloodsuckers. I’ve been running double shifts for two weeks and nobody’s touched me yet, but he still doesn’t buy it.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc7.description: I noticed that Edward used a 'not because you’re scared' excuse to delay changing me.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc7.source_text: I wondered how long Edward planned to use this “not because you’re scared” excuse.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc7.description: I inferred that Edward was deliberately delaying the transformation by insisting on marriage.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc7.source_text: But I knew he was going to stick to his marriage scheme like glue — because a delay was what he was clearly after and it was working so far.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc7.description: I believed that Edward wanting to be the one to change me would signify his active desire to keep me.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc7.source_text: There was just something about him being the one to make the choice — to want to keep me enough that he wouldn’t just allow me to be changed, he would act to keep me.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc8.description: I remembered Edward had told me that Jacob would tell me whatever he was shouting in his head.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc8.source_text: I suddenly remembered what Edward had said when he dropped me off — that Jacob would tell me whatever he was shouting in his head.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc8.description: I intended to call Edward to come pick me up after leaving, indicating I relied on him for a ride.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc8.source_text: “Jake, go back to sleep. I’m good. I’ll call Edward to come pick me up.”

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc8.description: I continued to depend on Edward for support and information, as shown by remembering his earlier remark and planning to call him.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc8.source_text: I patted my pockets as I spoke, and realized they were empty. “Shoot, I’ll have to borrow your phone. I think I must have left his in the car.”

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc9.description: I learned that Jacob explicitly positioned Edward as a rival by asking me to pick Jacob instead of him.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc9.source_text: And I want you to pick me instead of him.

tw-book3-chapter14_Sc9.description: I heard Jacob reference Edward directly when he said Jacob wanted me to pick him instead of the other man.
tw-book3-chapter14_Sc9.source_text: And I want you to pick me instead of him.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc1.description: I noted that Edward Cullen was not present during this roadside confrontation.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: Characters present: Bella Swan, Jacob Black

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc1.description: I observed that Bella's immediate focus was on Jacob rather than Edward in this scene, indicating a shift in the momentary emotional center away from Edward.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc1.source_text: "I STARED AT HIM FOR A LONG MINUTE, SPEECHLESS."

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc2.description: I declared my love for Edward and said he is my whole life.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: I love him, Jacob. He’s my whole life.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc2.description: I heard Jacob say that Edward left and that this absence changes Edward's place in my life.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc2.source_text: But he’s not your whole life, either. Not anymore. Maybe he was once, but he left.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward responded to my shutdown by pulling back and kissing me softly several times.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: It worked. The anger seemed to evaporate, and he pulled back to look at me. He pressed his lips softly to mine again, once, twice . . . a third time.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward sighed, smiled, and closed his eyes after I asked if he was done.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: "Are you done now?" I asked in an expressionless voice. "Yes," he sighed. He started to smile, closing his eyes.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc3.description: I recognized that my shutdown gave me some control over Edward's emotional intensity in that moment.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc3.source_text: Acting on instinct, I let my hands drop to my side, and shut down. I opened my eyes and didn’t fight, didn’t feel . . . just waited for him to stop. It worked. The anger seemed to evaporate...

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward left Bella once according to Jacob's argument.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: You’ll never be able to be as sure of him as you are of me. He left you once, he could do it again.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc4.description: I learned that Jacob asserted Edward would hurt Bella if he tried to kiss her.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: I’ll bet he couldn’t even kiss you like that — because he would hurt you.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc4.description: I observed that Bella remains convinced she cannot be happy with anyone but Edward.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc4.source_text: I don’t want to be happy with anyone but him.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward answered the phone sounding delighted and that he was already in his car when Bella called.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: "Bella?" he answered on the first ring. He sounded more than relieved — he was delighted. I could hear the Volvo’s engine in the background; he was already in the car — that was good.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward's tone shift from pleased to wary when he heard Bella say she had punched Jacob and that Jacob had kissed her.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: "Good," Edward said bleakly. "Though I’m sorry you’re hurt." "That doesn’t sound like you," he said, wary now. "What did he do?"

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc6.description: I saw Edward act protectively and aggressively in response to Bella's injury and the kiss, offering to 'fix' the situation and racing over to confront Jacob.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc6.source_text: "I can fix that," he offered. "I’m around the corner," he said darkly, and the line disconnected.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc7.description: I observed that Edward's hands were almost as cold as ice but felt pleasant against my skin.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: His hands were almost as cold as the ice, and they felt good against my skin.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc7.description: I realized that Edward was prepared to threaten physical harm to Jacob to protect Bella.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: And if you ever kiss her again, I will break your jaw for her,

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward declared he would actively fight for Bella and not take her for granted.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc7.source_text: I’ll be fighting for her, too. You should know that. I’m not taking anything for granted, and I’ll be fighting twice as hard as you will.

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.description: I observed Edward claim ownership by saying "She is mine" and indicate he did not promise to fight fair.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: I heard: "She is mine." and I heard: "I didn’t say I would fight fair."

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward's protective behavior as he tightened his arm around me like iron and hurried me toward the house and to Carlisle.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: I read: "His arm was like iron around me." and I read: "He tightened his arm around my waist and pulled me toward the house."

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.description: I observed Edward drive us to Carlisle and ask repeatedly about my hand and whether I was in pain.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: I read: "How do you feel?" Edward asked as we drove away and I read: "He worried aloud a few times that I was in pain."

tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.description: I realized that Edward cared deeply that I not miss human experiences and that he would try to preserve those for me if possible.
tw-book3-chapter15_Sc8.source_text: I read: "Edward was so obsessed with me not missing anything while I was human."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc1.description: I associated vampires with thieving behavior and annoyance, which could influence how I perceive Edward even though he is not named in this scene.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc2.description: I remembered Edward's idea that someone was exploiting the holes in my vision to hide the newborns from me.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: Remember what Edward said? About someone using the holes in your vision to keep you from seeing the newborns?

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc2.description: I judged that Edward's initial theory about who was responsible needed revision after realizing the break-in was a deliberate test.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc2.source_text: “Edward had it wrong,” I whispered. “It was a test . . . to see if it would work.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward is coming to the location soon.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: I read: "Edward is coming. If he hears this . . ."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc3.description: I came to believe that Edward would react extremely if he found out at the ceremony.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: I read: "Edward would go berserk when he knew."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward's presence prompts urgent and protective behavior from Alice.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc3.source_text: I read: "I have to go," Alice whispered. "Edward is coming. If he hears this . . ."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.description: I learned Edward arrived just a few minutes after his sister left.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: Edward arrived just a few minutes after his sister left.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.description: I learned Edward rode in the backseat of my father’s police car behind the fiberglass divider.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: And now Edward rode in the backseat of my father’s police car, behind the fiberglass divider, with an amused expression

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward had an amused expression that seemed tied to my father’s amusement and to Charlie’s glances.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: with an amused expression — probably due to my father’s amused expression, and the grin that widened every time Charlie stole a glance at Edward in his rearview mirror.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.description: I learned Edward whispered concern and helped me from the car in the school parking lot.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: “Are you all right?” Edward whispered when he helped me from the front seat in the school parking lot.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward told me I was beautiful and seemed restrained by Charlie’s interposition when he wanted to say more.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc4.source_text: “You are so beautiful,” he said. He looked like he wanted to say more, but Charlie, in an obvious maneuver that he meant to be subtle, shrugged in between us and put his arm around my shoulders.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.description: I saw Edward kiss me quickly, sigh, and go to stand with the C's before the ceremony.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "Edward kissed me quickly, sighed, and went to go stand with the C’s."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward looking at the clouds with a thoughtful expression as the events unfolded.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "Edward looked at the clouds, his face thoughtful."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.description: I felt Edward's subdued pride and remembered that he had not been in a hurry for me to reach this milestone when he later whispered congratulations with his arms around me.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "'Congratulations,' Edward whispered in my ear, his arms winding around my waist. His voice was subdued; he’d been in no hurry for me to reach this particular milestone."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.description: I began to view Edward and Alice as otherworldly and conspicuous in their beauty during the ceremony.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc5.source_text: "They stood out from the rest of the crowd, their beauty and grace otherworldly."

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc6.description: I observed Edward's panic escalate into clear, pure fury after hearing that the threat was aimed at me.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: “Though his expression was past the fear now — it was pure fury that was suddenly plain on his features.”

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc6.description: I heard Edward insist that no one was coming for the rest of his family and that Esme, Alice, and Carlisle were not in danger.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: “But no one’s coming for you, don’t you see? This is good — Esme and Alice and Carlisle, no one wants to hurt them!”

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc6.description: I realized Edward's protectiveness can become physically impulsive, which updated my sense of how dangerous his reactions could be in public.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc6.source_text: “And nothing breakable close by — like windows . . . cars . . . school buildings.”

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward felt unwell and apologized for losing control earlier while saying he had a handle on himself.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.source_text: “Not so great,” he murmured. “But I’ve got a handle on myself. I’m sorry that I lost it back there.”

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.description: I observed physical tension in Edward during the kiss, specifically noting the tension in his jaw.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.source_text: One cool hand found my chin, and pulled my face up so that he could press his hard lips to mine. I could feel the tension in his jaw.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward expressed that he needed to know something and that he was surprised he had not seen it before.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.source_text: “This is something I needed to know. I can’t believe I didn’t see it!”

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc8.description: I saw Edward demonstrate protectiveness by telling Bella he would follow her to her house after their encounter.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc9.description: I noticed Edward asked me how I felt while he drove us north along the highway.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc9.source_text: "So, how do you feel?" he asked me as we drove north along the highway.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc9.description: I observed that Edward laughed and saw through my initial lie easily.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc9.source_text: He laughed, seeing through me easily.

tw-book3-chapter16_Sc9.description: I realized that Edward is perceptive about my emotions and that he pays attention to how I respond.
tw-book3-chapter16_Sc9.source_text: He laughed, seeing through me easily. "Worried about the party?" he guessed.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.description: I observed Edward arrive windblown and urgent, calling my name from behind as he sprang up the porch steps.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: "BELLA?" Edward’s soft voice came from behind me. I turned to see him spring lightly up the porch steps, his hair windblown from running.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.description: I watched Edward pull me into his arms at once and kiss me again, mirroring a previous moment in the parking lot.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: He pulled me into his arms at once, just like he had in the parking lot, and kissed me again.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.description: I recognized Edward's protectiveness when he placed his hands on either side of my face and waited until I looked up.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: He put his hands on either side of my face, waiting until I looked up.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward shift from tension to a slight relaxation after he took a deep breath and smiled faintly.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: He took a deep breath, and then he smiled slightly.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward held the door for me while keeping his arm securely around my waist as we prepared to enter the party.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: He held the door for me, keeping his arm securely around my waist.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc2.description: I heard Edward recommend keeping the music comforting and say that you can only lead the horse to water.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: I heard: "Keep it comforting," Edward recommended. "You can only lead the horse to water."

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc2.description: I observed Edward refuse to let me go for a second and drag me along as he went to tell Jasper and then Carlisle about my epiphany.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Edward refused to let me go for a second, dragging me along with him as he hunted up Jasper and then Carlisle to tell them of my epiphany."

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc2.description: I heard Edward tell me that I was perfect when I expressed feeling underdressed.
I listened as Edward and the others discussed their planned attack on the army in Seattle.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc2.source_text: I read: "I listened with quiet horror as they discussed their attack on the army in Seattle."

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward was one of the honorees of the party.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc3.source_text: Though the party had been billed as a joint event for Alice, Edward, and me, there was no denying that I was the most popular target for congratulations and thanks.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc3.description: I observed Edward among the Cullens who took their places to perform a perfect human charade.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc3.source_text: The room wasn’t empty; all the Cullens had taken their places, ready to put on their usual perfect human charade.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc3.description: I noticed that the Cullens' presence, including Edward's, made the human guests instinctively edgy.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc3.source_text: The party was a clear success, despite the instinctive edginess cause by the Cullens’ presence — or maybe that simply added a thrill to the atmosphere.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.description: I heard him murmur to me to stay and promise he would be right back before he left.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.source_text: “Stay here,” he murmured in my ear. “I’ll be right back.”

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.description: I watched him pass gracefully through the crowd without seeming to touch any of the close-packed bodies and go too quickly for me to ask why he was leaving.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.source_text: He passed gracefully through the crowd without seeming to touch any of the close-packed bodies, gone too quickly for me to ask why he was leaving.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.description: I saw him leaning over someone in the dim area by the kitchen doorway though I could not see past the heads between us.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.source_text: He was leaning over someone, but I couldn’t see past all the heads between us.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.description: I realized his face was empty as a stone when he looked across at Alice and then turned and disappeared into the shadows under the stair.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc4.source_text: I followed her gaze and watched as she caught Edward’s eye across the room. His face was empty as a stone. He turned and disappeared into the shadows under the stair.

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc6.description: I noticed that Edward and Alice were absent from the immediate area and that their whereabouts were unknown to me at the party.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Where had they gone? My eyes scanned the darkened room."

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc6.description: I believed that Edward and Carlisle would have discussed and known details about whatever Alice had seen, making their absence frustrating.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc6.source_text: I read: "I wanted to know what Alice had seen and what Edward and Carlisle were saying about it."

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc6.description: I felt dependent on Edward's and Carlisle's knowledge for answers and grew impatient or uneasy when they were not immediately available.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc6.source_text: I read: "I wanted to know what Alice had seen and what Edward and Carlisle were saying about it."

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc7.description: I learned that the werewolves were referring to a 'bloodsucker' in my room when they questioned me.
tw-book3-chapter17_Sc7.source_text: Is this about the bloodsucker in your room?

tw-book3-chapter17_Sc7.description: I learned that the immediate danger involved vampires coming to search, linked to my connection with them.
I believed more strongly that my association with a vampire increased the risk to Forks.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward remained calm and tried to soothe me by rubbing my arm and saying it was over.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: Edward didn’t seem to disagree. "It’s over now," he said, rubbing my arm soothingly.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc1.description: I understood that Edward was concerned about the upcoming experiment and did not want me in the middle of it for fear we might not all be able to cooperate.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "This is an experiment. I’m not sure if it will be possible for us all to . . . cooperate. I don’t want you in the middle of that."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc1.description: I perceived Edward as protective and willing to make decisions to keep me out of danger during their plans.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc1.source_text: "I don’t want you in the middle of that."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward Cullen is a tracked character for the broader context but does not appear in this particular scene.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: Characters to track: Bella Swan, Edward Cullen, Jacob Black; Characters present: Bella Swan, Charlie

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc2.description: I have no direct observational information about Edward Cullen's actions or presence in the events described.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc2.source_text: Characters to track: Bella Swan, Edward Cullen, Jacob Black; Characters present: Bella Swan, Charlie

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward set me down and I walked hand in hand with him toward his family while they stood relaxed in the clearing.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: When we got to the big open field, his family was there, talking casually, relaxed. Emmett’s booming laugh echoed through the wide space now and then. Edward set me down and we walked hand in hand toward them.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc4.description: I observed Edward think through my theory, voice that the Volturi were most likely, but concede that my view of Victoria was plausible and strategically consistent with her personality.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: "I still think the Volturi are most likely . . . But your theory — there’s something there. Victoria’s personality. Your theory suits her personality perfectly. She’s shown a remarkable gift for self-preservation from the start — maybe it’s a talent of hers."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc4.description: I recognized Edward's intense protectiveness and I witnessed him praise my perceptiveness while also expressing an intense, personal desire to confront and end those who threaten me.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc4.source_text: "You’re very perceptive today," he added. "It’s impressive." "What I wouldn’t give to have her that close... To have the chance to end this myself. To finish it with my own hands this time."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward could sense and time the wolves' arrival and that he planned to act as translator because the wolves would not meet in human form.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: "A minute and a half. But I’m going to have to translate. They don’t trust us enough to use their human forms."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward’s expression unexpectedly brightened with a strange gleam as the wolves revealed themselves.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: "A strange gleam came into Edward’s eyes, as though something had just occurred to him, something that was not altogether unpleasant."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc5.description: I observed that Edward wanted to be more engaged with the others and that he leaned forward as if wishing to stand with them.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc5.source_text: "From the way Edward leaned forward next to me, I could tell that he wished he was standing beside them."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc6.description: I observed Edward functioning as a translator for Sam's words, conveying the wolf pack's agreement to limit their actions.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: I read: "'Thank you,' Edward responded in a strange, flat tone, and I realized at once that the words came from Sam."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward's tone shift from detached to more engaged when he relayed the wolves' willingness to take extra risk, which updated my sense of his investment in the truce.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: I read: "'We are willing to take more than our share, if necessary,' Edward translated, his tone less indifferent now."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward paid close attention to the demonstration between Emmett and Jasper, indicating his interest in the combat tactics being taught.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Beside me, Edward leaned forward intently, his eyes locked on the brawl."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc9.description: I observed Edward watching me closely and carefully evaluating my reaction to the wolves and Jacob.
