tw-book3-chapter18_Sc9.source_text: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw that Edward was watching me, carefully evaluating my reaction.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc9.description: I realized that Edward expected me to be terrified and that he felt on edge and disappointed when I did not react that way.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc9.source_text:
And then there was Edward, on edge and clearly disappointed.
I realized he’d been hoping for a different reaction from me.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc9.description: I noticed that the Cullens, including Edward, displayed perplexed and somewhat disgusted expressions at Jacob's behavior.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc9.source_text:
I thought Sam looked unhappy.
I realized everyone was watching us, the Cullens and the werewolves — the Cullens with perplexed and somewhat disgusted expressions.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.description: I learned that Edward insisted he had to consider every possibility and refused to take chances regarding my safety.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.source_text: "I have to consider every possibility," Edward said. "It's a very long shot, but I'm not taking chances."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.description: I learned that Edward believes Alice sees only very young vampires and that someone more experienced may be behind the current threat.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.source_text: Alice only sees very young vampires coming on the hunt, but obviously someone created them. There is someone more experienced behind this.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.description: I noticed Edward acting protective and pacifying by taking my hand and touching my cheek while reassuring me.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.source_text: Edward sighed, and — ignoring Jacob — came to stand on my other side, taking my hand. He touched my cheek.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.description: I believed Edward trusted that Jacob would return and wanted Jacob to be able to speak for himself.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc10.source_text: "He’s coming back," Edward said. He sighed. "He wants to be able to talk for himself."

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc11.description: I recognized that Edward believes Bella's scent combined with his is a distinctive trail that could draw dangerous attention.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc11.source_text: Her scent is too strong and, combined with mine, especially distinct. Even if I carried her, it would leave a trail.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc11.description: I decided that it would be fairer and more informative to test the scent-masking idea by having someone else carry Bella because her scent is more potent to me.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc11.source_text: Bella’s scent is so much more potent to me — I thought it would be a fairer test if someone else tried.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc11.description: I acknowledged cooperation with Jacob and his pack on a tactical experiment despite tension between us.

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc12.description: I heard Edward explain that when the newborns catch our scent they will split and half will go through the forest where Alice's vision disappears, creating the tactical opening.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc12.source_text: “When they catchour scent, they’ll split up and try to come at us from two sides. Half will go through the forest, where her vision suddenly disappears. . . .”

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc12.description: I noticed Edward defending Jasper by framing Jasper's suggestions as military thoroughness rather than callousness.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc12.source_text: “Jasper looks at things from a military perspective,” Edward quietly defended his brother. “He looks at all the options — it’s thoroughness, not callousness.”

tw-book3-chapter18_Sc12.description: I watched Edward refuse the idea of Bella staying in the clearing by saying 'Not a chance,' demonstrating his protective stance.
tw-book3-chapter18_Sc12.source_text: “Not a chance,” Edward said suddenly, his voice disgusted.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward stayed close, monitored my movements, and offered to bring breakfast in bed.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: I quote: 'Are you really awake this time?' he murmured. 'Hungry?' he guessed. 'Do you want breakfast in bed?'

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc1.description: I perceived Edward as protective and cautious when I noticed him eyeing me carefully as if I might fall or be sleepwalking.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: I quote: 'He held my hand on the way to the kitchen, eyeing me carefully, like I might fall over. Or maybe he thought I was sleepwalking.'

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward's tenderness in carrying me, holding my hand, and reassuring me, which increased my sense of dependence on him for comfort.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: I quote: 'EDWARD CARRIED ME HOME IN HIS ARMS...' 'You’d earned a day in bed.'

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc2.description: I noticed him balance the little figurine in his snowy palm and then let it fall back to my wrist.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: He moved his hand under the charm bracelet and balanced the little figurine in his snowy palm. He only weighed the wolf in his palm for a moment, and then let it fall. It swung lightly from my wrist.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc2.description: I heard him state that everyone else is able to give me things except him and that he found that inequality unfair.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: Everyone else is able to get away with giving you things. Everyone but me. I would have loved to get you a graduation present, but I didn’t. I knew it would have upset you more than if anyone else did. That’s utterly unfair.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc2.description: I realized he wanted a tangible representation of himself to keep him on my mind and to be worn by me.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: If I gave you something, would you wear it? ... A charm — something to keep me on your mind.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward had access to the pack's thoughts and found the imprinting compulsion astonishing and almost magical.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: I quote: 'The imprinting compulsion is one of the strangest things I’ve ever witnessed in my life, and I’ve seen some strange things.'

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward compared the power of Sam's imprinting to the strength of his feelings for me, which clarified his emotional framing of the situation.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: I quote: 'It’s very nearly as strong as the way I feel about you.'

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc4.description: I felt that Edward's fascination with the pack mind made me more curious about the phenomenon and more aware of how invasive it is.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc4.source_text: I quote: 'The pack mind is mesmerizing. All thinking together and then separately at the same time.'

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward planned to speak with Jasper about the possibility of him sitting out of the upcoming confrontation.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc5.source_text: "I’m going to discuss . . . me sitting out."

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc5.description: I heard Edward tell Bella that she was his first priority, showing he was prioritizing her feelings in his decision.
I heard Edward reassure me that the fight would be easy and that there was no reason for my fears about danger.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc5.source_text: "It’s going to be easy, Bella. There’s no reason for your fears."

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.description: I heard Edward ask who the third wife was, showing that he noticed Bella's sleep-mumbling and sought clarification.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.source_text: “Who’s the third wife?” he asked me suddenly.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward planned to go work things out with the others, to rearrange things, and to return later that night.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.source_text: “I’ll be back later tonight,” he promised me. “I’ll go work this out with the others, rearrange things.”

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.description: I perceived Edward as briefly confused by Bella's uncomfortable tone when he leaned away and cocked his head to the side.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.source_text: Edward leaned away from me and cocked his head to the side, probably confused by the uncomfortable edge to my voice.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.description: I noticed that Alice characterizes Edward as a grouch when he doesn't get his way, which colors expectations about living with him.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.source_text: Edward is such a grouch when he doesn’t get his way. I’m just anticipating living with him for the next few months.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.description: I learned that Emmett is pleased with the arrangements according to Alice.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc6.source_text: There’s not much to arrange," Alice said. "I already told them. Emmett is pleased.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward was planning the weekend with Emmett and Carlisle and that they intended to go backpacking.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc7.source_text:
No. He’s off planning the weekend with Emmett and Carlisle.
“We always go backpacking at the end of the school year, sort of a celebration...

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc7.description: I perceived Edward as absent from home plans and unavailable to stay with Alice.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc7.source_text:
No. He’s off planning the weekend with Emmett and Carlisle.
“Yes. They’reall going, except me.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward said he was the only one who had permission to hold me hostage and that Alice was going hunting with the rest of them.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc8.source_text: “I’m the only one who has permission to hold you hostage, remember?” he said. “Alice is going hunting with the rest of them.”

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc8.description: I saw Edward lying across my bed upstairs.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc8.source_text: Upstairs, Edward was lying across my bed.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward seemed relieved and laughed when I asked why Alice hadn't told Charlie we were leaving.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.description: I noticed that Edward was apparently fine with the idea of missing the fight and that he framed the decision as something that would be easy.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.source_text: Edward was apparently fine with the idea of missing the fight . . . and that made it very hard not to believe him when he said this would be easy.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.description: I inferred that Edward’s confidence carried weight for me because I believed he wouldn’t leave his family if he didn’t believe in the plan himself.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.source_text: He wouldn’t leave his family if he didn’t believe it himself.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.description: I heard Edward say that he would help Jasper when needed and that Jasper wanted to try unequal groupings to train against multiple attackers.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.source_text: I’ll help Jasper when he needs it. He wants to try some unequal groupings, teach them how to deal with multiple attackers.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.description: I felt reassured by Edward’s confidence about his family but I realized that his assurance did not alleviate my worry about the wolves.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc9.source_text: Edward’s confidence was reassuring, because it was plain that he wasn’t truly worried about his family. But would it hurt him if something happened to the wolves? ... Edward’s confidence only applied to one set of my fears.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc10.description: I noticed Edward greeted Jacob politely when Jacob approached.
I learned that Edward translates Jacob’s vocalizations and sometimes edits the translation to be less rude.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc10.source_text: He thinks my translations leave something to be desired. What he actually thought was, ‘That’s really stupid. What is there to be worried about?’ I edited, because I thought it was rude.

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc10.description: I observed Edward sigh and say that Jasper wanted help before he walked away to assist him.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc10.source_text: Edward sighed. “Jasper wants help. You’ll be okay without a translator?”

tw-book3-chapter19_Sc10.description: I noticed Edward looked wistful at me for a minute and I found his expression hard to read.
tw-book3-chapter19_Sc10.source_text: Edward looked at me wistfully for one minute, his expression hard to understand, then turned his back and strode over to where Jasper waited.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc1.description: I held hands with Edward as we walked to the cafeteria.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I was holding hands with the most perfect person on the planet

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc1.description: I had an ironclad promise from Edward that I would not be subjected to the prom again.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I had an ironclad promise from Edward that I would not be subjected to that again.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc1.description: I viewed Edward as the most perfect person on the planet, which updated my sense of our relationship.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I was holding hands with the most perfect person on the planet

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc2.description: I learned that I was sitting with Edward when Angela asked about announcements.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: "'Have you sent your announcements, yet?' Angela asked when Edward and I sat down at our table."

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc2.description: I saw Edward smile from the corner of my eye when I volunteered to help with the invitations.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: From the corner of my eye, I saw Edward smile.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc2.description: I inferred that Edward approves of my following Charlie's rules rather than involving the werewolves.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc2.source_text: He must like that, too — me fulfilling Charlie's conditions without involving werewolves.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc3.description: I heard Edward laugh, a very natural, relaxed sound during the lunchroom conversation.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc3.source_text: Then Edward laughed, a very natural, relaxed sound.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward tease Alice and later play absentmindedly with a strand of my hair.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc3.source_text: “Is it naptime already, Alice?” Edward teased. Edward was quiet, playing absentmindedly with a strand of my hair.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc3.description: I relied on Edward as the person I wanted to ask about Alice’s vision and felt anxious when I could not get a moment alone with him.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc3.source_text: I waited anxiously for a chance to ask Edward what Alice had seen in her vision, but the afternoon passed without one minute of alone time.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc4.description: I saw Edward offer to help Mike with his car and say he could take a look if he dropped Alice and Bella at home first.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc4.source_text: I know a few things — I could take a look, if you like. Just let me drop Alice and Bella at home.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward hold the passenger door for me and then drive quietly back toward Forks after dropping Alice.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc4.source_text: What was that about? I muttered as Edward held the passenger door for me. "Just being helpful," Edward answered. He was quiet as he turned the car around and headed back to Forks.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc4.description: I suspected Edward was trying to appear helpful and normal as a way to deflect suspicion about whatever he was hiding.
I noticed Edward exchange a subtle nod with Alice after she gave him a sharp look, indicating a private communication between them.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc4.source_text: As she got out, Alice threw a sharp look at his face. Edward seemed completely at ease. "See you later," he said. And then, ever so slightly, he nodded.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc5.description: I saw Edward follow me up the stairs and lounge on my bed while gazing out the window.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc5.source_text: Inside, I headed up the stairs, and Edward followed. He lounged on my bed and gazed out the window, seeming oblivious to my edginess.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc5.description: I noticed that his fingers braided themselves into my hair, securing my face to his in a possessive, intimate gesture.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc5.source_text: his fingers braided themselves into my hair, securing my face to his.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc5.description: I observed that he kept his excitement disciplined and implied we had already risked my life enough for one afternoon.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc5.source_text: His eyes were bright with the excitement he so rigidly disciplined. "we’d risked my life enough for one afternoon."

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.description: I saw Edward react in a horrorstruck voice and accuse me of damaging the stereo by asking what I had done to it.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.source_text: “What did youdo to this?” he asked in a horrorstruck voice.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.description: I heard Edward bluntly tell me that I had killed the stereo.
I noticed Edward intended to replace the stereo not for my sake but to avoid hurting the Cullens’ feelings.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.source_text: “It’s not for your sake that I’m going to replace it.”

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.description: I understood that Edward expected to replace the broken stereo while I had been on house arrest so the others would not notice.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.source_text: “I guess it’s a good thing that you’ve been on house arrest. I’ll have to get another one in place before they notice.”

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.description: I realized that Edward was more sensitive about my eighteenth birthday than I had expected when he brought up my poor luck with last year’s presents.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.source_text: “You didn’t get much good out of your birthday presents last year,” he said in a disgruntled voice.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward suggested using the airplane voucher to celebrate my newly granted freedom because we had no plans for the weekend and I had refused to go to the prom with him.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc6.source_text: “Well, we still have a little time. You’ve been liberated . . . and we have no plans this weekend, as you refuse to go to the prom with me.”

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.description: I asserted that Renée still has primary custody and that Charlie cannot keep Bella from visiting her.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.source_text: Charlie can’t keep you from visiting your mother. She still has primary custody.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.description: I declared that the outside world holds no interest for me without Bella, expressing my deep attachment.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.source_text: The outside world holds no interest for me without you.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.description: I observed and reported that Alice has been seeing Jasper in a strange place in the southwest and that Jasper has no conscious intent to return.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.source_text: She’s been seeing Jasper in a strange place, somewhere in the southwest, she thinks, near his former . . . family. But he has no conscious intentions to go back.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.description: I muttered that this weekend is perfect to visit Renée, indicating my desire to go sooner rather than later.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc7.source_text: I think this weekend is perfect.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward finished his homework in minutes while I struggled with calculus.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.source_text: Edward finished in minutes; I slogged laboriously through my calculus until I decided it was time to fix Charlie’s dinner.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward found raw human food mildly repulsive and made faces at the ingredients.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.source_text: Edward helped, making faces every so often at the raw ingredients — human food was mildly repulsive to him.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward excused himself from eating with us, as he usually did.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.source_text: Edward excused himself from eating with us, as usual.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward brought up the airplane tickets to Charlie and framed them as a gift from his parents for me to visit Renée.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.source_text: Did Bella ever tell you that my parents gave her airplane tickets on her last birthday, so that she could visit Renée?

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward suggested I use the tickets because they were about to expire and mentioned Esme's feelings.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc8.source_text: They're about to expire. I think it might hurt Esme’s feelings if Bella doesn’t use her gift. Not that she’d say anything.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc9.description: I heard Edward state that his parents provided one ticket for Bella and one for himself.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc9.source_text: “Just one for her . . . and one for me.”

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc9.description: I noticed that Edward reacted with visible physical tension when Jacob's name was mentioned, changing my impression of his emotional involvement.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc9.source_text: I’d only picked the name because I knew of my father’s preference for Jacob, but I quickly wished I hadn’t; Edward’s teeth clenched together with an audible snap.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc9.description: I realized that Edward was eager to go out with me and wanted private time to speak alone, which suggested greater investment in my plans.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc9.source_text: “We’re going out?” Edward asked, his voice low but enthusiastic.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc11.description: I observed that Edward beat Alice at chess in a very short game that relied on Alice's foresight and Edward's mental responses.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc11.source_text: Edward and Alice playing chess was one of the funniest things I’d ever seen. They’d sat there nearly motionless, staring at the board, while Alice foresaw the moves he would make and he picked the moves she would make in return out of her head.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc11.description: I came to believe that Edward is very old-fashioned, which I mentioned to reassure my father.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc11.source_text: Maybe the times have, but Edward is very old-fashioned. You have nothing to worry about.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc11.description: I suspected that Edward had anticipated my father's awkward sex talk because I remembered he had seemed smug in the car.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc11.source_text: No wonder he’d seemed so smug in the car.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc12.description: I learned that Edward was probably out hunting to pass the time.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc12.source_text: Edward was long gone and he wouldn’t be back until Charlie was asleep — he was probably out hunting or something to pass the time —

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc12.description: I judged that the pros of seeing Jacob were valid while the cons of making Edward furious were not.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc12.source_text: Long enough to decide that the pros were valid while the cons were not.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc12.description: I viewed Edward as someone primarily concerned with my safety rather than seeking to control my choices.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc12.source_text: Edward was only concerned about my safety, and I knew that there was really no problem on that count.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc13.description: I learned that Edward had been watching me in the truck and that Alice had called him about my sudden disappearance.
I learned that Edward can read some minds but that Alice cannot see the wolves or their futures.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc13.source_text: That doesn’t seem entirely likely, since I haven’t had any trouble reading their thoughts. The Blacks’ at least.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc13.description: I became aware that Edward was anxious about my safety because Alice could not confirm where I was when my future disappeared.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc13.source_text: Alice saw you disappear, and she couldn’t even tell if you’d come home or not.

tw-book3-chapter2_Sc13.description: I recognized that Edward is willing to respect boundaries while also offering practical help, such as repairing my car and offering to stay away if I prefer.
tw-book3-chapter2_Sc13.source_text: Shut your window if you want me to stay away tonight. I’ll understand, he whispered just before I slammed the door.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward pleaded with me to relax and asked that we forget everything besides just the two of us for one night.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc1.source_text: I read: "For this one night, could we try to forget everything besides just you and me?" he’d pleaded, unleashing the full force of his eyes on me. "It seems like I can never get enough time like that. I need to be with you. Just you."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward did not insist on taking the wheel and seemed content to go at my speed that night.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc1.source_text: I read: "I was surprised that he hadn’t insisted on taking the wheel, but tonight he seemed content to go at my speed."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc1.description: I watched Edward act protectively and intimately by opening my door, lifting me from the truck, carrying my bag, kissing me, and carrying me into the house.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc1.source_text: I read: "As soon as I cut the engine he was at my door, opening it for me. He lifted me from the cab with one arm, slinging my bag out of the truck bed and over his shoulder with the other. His lips found mine as I heard him kick the truck’s door shut behind me. Without breaking the kiss, he swung me up so that I was cradled in his arms and carried me into the house."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward’s kisses were enthusiastic, less guarded, and physically cold yet urgent.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.source_text:
His lips were not anxious, but enthusiastic now — he seemed as thrilled as I was that we had tonight to concentrate on being together.
he seemed less guarded than usual, his mouth cold and urgent on mine.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward presented a "hand-me-down" bracelet that he said was his mother’s while downplaying its significance.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.source_text: “It was my mother’s.” He shrugged deprecatingly. “I inherited quite a few baubles like this. I’ve given some to Esme and Alice both. So, clearly, this is not a big deal in any way.”

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.description: I understood Edward to express that his silent heart belongs to Bella when he mused about his heart being hers.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.source_text: “My heart is just as silent,” he mused. “And it, too, is yours.”

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.description: I witnessed Edward act eager and playful by scooping Bella up and nearly flying up the stairs to fetch the gift quickly.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc2.source_text: He scooped me up again and nearly flew up the stairs to his room.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward insists on matrimony as the starting prerequisite for transforming me.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: “You know what I want.” "Matrimony." "To start with."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward framed his willingness to transform me as a major concession that entitles him to some compromises from me.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: “I’ve already made the largest concession by far and away — I’ve agreed to take your life away against my better judgment. And that ought to entitle me to a few compromises on your part.”

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward believes the post-transformation obsession with blood will not last forever and he tried to reassure me of that.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: “Bella, that part doesn’t last forever,” he assured me.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward used gentle physical contact and teasing during the negotiation, indicating a mixture of affection and persuasive warmth.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: He grinned widely when I grimaced, then took my hand and began playing with my fingers. "His cool fingers brushed my cheek. 'You're blushing?'"

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward refused to allow sexual intimacy and insisted on saying no.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: "I say we’re not having this discussion." "I say we’re not."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward physically restrained me by grabbing my wrists and pinning them and by placing a hand over my mouth.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: He grabbed my wrists and pinned them to my sides. ... he pulled my hands together to restrain them in just one of his, and put his other hand over my mouth.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward both wants me and fears making a mistake because he sees me as dangerously desirable.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: "You know that I want you, too." "Doesn’t everyone? I feel like there’s a line behind me, jockeying for position, waiting for me to make a big enough mistake. . . . You’re too desirable for your own good."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.description: I saw Edward shift from stern refusal to tender concern when he worried he had hurt my feelings and then comforted me.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: His brow furrowed, and his expression became horrified. "Did I hurt your feelings?" he asked, shocked. ... I was in his arms, my face cradled between his shoulder and his hand, while his thumb stroked reassuringly against my cheek.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward explicitly acknowledged he could kill Bella and physically demonstrated his strength by crushing a wrought-iron rose into black sand.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.source_text:
“Bella, I could kill you,” he whispered.

There was a muffled snapping sound, and the bed quivered beneath us. Something dark was in his hand; he held it up for my curious examination. It was a metal flower, one of the roses that adorned the wrought iron posts and canopy of his bed frame. His hand closed for a brief second, his fingers contracting gently, and then it opened again.

Without a word, he offered me the crushed, uneven lump of black metal. It was a cast of the inside of his hand, like a piece of play dough squeezed in a child’s fist. A half-second passed, and the shape crumbled into black sand in his palm.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward categorized marriage as a demand while calling other requests mere requests, revealing his stance on what he requires.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.source_text: “Only the first is a demand.” He seemed to be having a hard time keeping a straight face. “The others are merely requests.”

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.description: I realized that Edward is deeply conflicted and reluctant to risk hurting me, which makes him hesitate to allow a transformation now.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.source_text:
“No,” he murmured silkily. “It’s not possible now. Later, when you’re less breakable. Be patient, Bella.”

His face was torn.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.description: I perceived that Edward values my safety above his desires and that refusing my plea causes him visible anguish.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc5.source_text: “This is unbearable. So many things I’ve wanted to give you — and this is what you decide to demand. Do you have any idea how painful it is, trying to refuse you when you plead with me this way?”

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward enforces a rule that we must wait until marriage because of my promise and concerns about me leaving.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: Out of the two of us, which do you think is more unwilling to give the other what they want? You just promised to marry me before you do any changing, but if I give in tonight, what guarantee do I have that you won’t go running off to Carlisle in the morning?

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward feels intense sexual desire yet experiences conflict and restraint in acting on it.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: His mouth was not gentle; there was a brand-new edge of conflict and desperation in the way his lips moved. He didn’t stop kissing me.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.description: I realized that Edward admitted he was clearly much less reluctant to give me what I wanted than I was to give him what he wanted.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: I am — clearly — much less reluctant to give you what you want. Therefore . . . you first.

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.description: My view of Edward now includes recognizing his combination of coercive insistence and protective boundary-setting in our intimacy.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: Cold iron fetters locked around my wrists, and pulled my hands above my head, which was suddenly on a pillow. 'Bella,' he murmured, his voice warm and velvet. 'Would you please stop trying to take your clothes off?'

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc7.description: I heard Edward solemnly promise that he will not go back on his word and that 'we will try' after marriage.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc7.source_text: "No," he promised solemnly. "I swear to you, we will try. After you marry me."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward has killed people and that he worries about the moral and possibly spiritual consequences.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc7.source_text: "'Thou shalt not kill' is commonly accepted by most major belief systems. And I’ve killed a lot of people, Bella."

tw-book3-chapter20_Sc7.description: I noticed that Edward felt 'exceptionally' happy about the engagement.
I understood that Edward coveted me, admitting he had no right to want me yet reached out and took me anyway.
tw-book3-chapter20_Sc7.source_text: "I coveted you. I had no right to want you — but I reached out and took you anyway."

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.description: I watched as Edward left Bella alone to get dressed, packed cold-weather camping gear, and handed Bella his phone to call Jacob.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.source_text:
He left me alone to get dressed, and I appreciated the chance to think.
Edward had more than enough camping gear to choose from...
When he was done packing, Edward handed me his phone.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward told Bella she didn’t have to tell anyone about their plans.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.source_text: He said I didn’t have to tell anyone, and I was planning to hold him to that.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward was amused by Alice’s frustration and that he laughed at her pleas despite the tension.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.source_text:
I looked at Edward, and he was smiling; whatever was bugging Alice amused him.
He laughed. Something about her response was funny to him.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.description: I realized that Edward tried to keep control of Bella’s plans and resisted Alice’s involvement, which created an argument between him and Alice.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc1.source_text:
“Bella, could I please speak to you alone?” Alice asked.
“ You’re about to make my life harder than it needs to be, Alice,” Edward warned her through his teeth.
“This isn’t about you, Edward,” she shot back.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc2.description: I saw Edward carry a first aid kit and I heard him say he had a feeling he might need it.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: I quote: I’ve got a first aid kit, he said pulling off the backpack; I had a feeling I might need it.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward said he had 'got over' being bothered by my blood after he experienced twenty-four hours thinking I was dead and that this changed his reactions.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: I quote: This doesn’t bother me anymore; I lived through an entire twenty-four hours thinking that you were dead, Bella; That changed the way I look at a lot of things.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward express that he wanted the wedding to be what I wanted and I observed that he would avoid any course that could inspire the pain of losing me again.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: I quote: I want this to be what you want it to be; My entire being shies away from any course that could inspire that kind of pain again.

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward agreed to stay home from the fight because I persuaded him to remain with me.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc3.source_text: “Edward isn’t going to fight tomorrow.” “I am making him stay with me.”

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc3.description: I understood that Edward is not considered 'really a person' in my view.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc3.source_text: “According to you, you’ve kissed just one person — who isn’t even really a person — in your whole life”

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc4.description: I observed Edward express acute relief and gratitude and hug me tightly when he found me.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: "Bella!" Edward called out in acute relief.... He flashed to my side, sort of blurring as he moved so swiftly.... Edward ignored his reaction and caught me in a tight hug. "Thank you," Edward said over my head. His tone was unmistakably sincere. "That was quicker than I expected, and I truly appreciate it."

tw-book3-chapter21_Sc4.description: I felt reassured by Edward's protective response and his sincere appreciation for my safety.
tw-book3-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: "Thank you," Edward said over my head. His tone was unmistakably sincere. "That was quicker than I expected, and I truly appreciate it."

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.description: I heard Edward answer that it was two o'clock when I asked the time.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.source_text: “W-w-w-w-w-what t-t-t-t-time is it?” I forced the words through my rattling teeth. “Two,” Edward answered.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.description: I observed Edward become wild with worry, indecision, and frustration about our situation.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.source_text: his voice was wild with worry, indecision, and frustration.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.description: I felt Edward try to protect me while also scolding Jacob for not being more useful or careful.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.source_text: “He’s just worried about you,” Edward translated. “He’s fine.His body is equipped to deal with this.”

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward move from anxious pleading to impatient growling as he asked what he should do.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc1.source_text: “What do you want me to do?” Edward growled, too anxious to bother with politeness anymore.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward strongly objected to Jacob staying and demanded that Jacob give the coat and leave.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: "“I don’t like this,” Edward hissed as Jake zipped the tent door shut. “Just give her the coat and get out.”"

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward is fiercely protective of me and will physically restrain another man to assert that protectiveness.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: "Edward’s hand was suddenly hard on his shoulder, restraining, snow white against the dark skin."

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward can be frighteningly flat and cold when giving a warning, which increased my unease.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: "His voice was flat and frightening. “Watch yourself.”"

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.description: I heard Edward warn Jacob to watch himself after a tense exchange and then withdraw to the corner.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: "His voice was flat and frightening. “Watch yourself.”"

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward feels intense jealousy and wishes he could physically warm Bella as Jacob does.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc3.source_text: "You don't have the faintest idea how much I wish I could do what you're doing for her, mongrel."

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward controls his tone and can speak softly and restrain himself even when emotionally affected.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc3.source_text: Edward's voice was velvet again, under control, a musical murmur in the darkness.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc3.description: I saw Edward as possessive and emotionally invested in Bella's wellbeing, which intensifies his rivalry with Jacob.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward tell Jacob that Seth was there and that he would take care of my girlfriend while Jacob kept an eye on everything else.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc4.source_text: "Perfect. Now you can keep an eye on everything else, while I take care of your girlfriend for you."

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc4.description: I sensed Edward's protective and slightly teasing stance toward Bella when he offered to take care of her and coordinated with Jacob.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc4.source_text: "Perfect. Now you can keep an eye on everything else, while I take care of your girlfriend for you."

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc4.description: I heard Edward laugh quietly under his breath during the conversation.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc4.source_text: He didn’t answer right away this time, and Edward laughed under his breath.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward can hear Jacob’s fantasies loudly and is affected by them.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.source_text: “You have no idea how loud your little fantasies are. It’s like you’re shouting them at me.”

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.description: I heard Edward admit that he is jealous.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.source_text: “Yes,” Edward answered an unspoken thought in a murmur so low I barely made it out. “I’m jealous of that, too.”

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward explain that his mind works differently and that he can think of many things at once, including wondering where my thoughts are.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.source_text: “My mind doesn’t work quite the same as yours. I can think of many more things at one time. Of course, that means that I’malways able to think of you, always able to wonder if that’s where her mind is, when she’s quiet and thoughtful.”

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.description: I observed Edward claim he has had a hundred years to gain patience and that he can smother less civilized feelings toward Jacob most of the time.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc5.source_text:
“I should. I’ve had a hundred years to gain it. A hundred years of waiting forher. ”

“I can smother the . . . less civilized feelings I may have for you fairly easily most of the time.”

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward considered exactly "four possibilities" after he realized he loved me and that he thought through each outcome.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.source_text: Jacob, from the second that I realized that I loved her, I knew there were only four possibilities.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward originally left because he did not want to make me a bloodsucker and because he wanted me to remain human.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.source_text: But you left because you didn’t want to make her a bloodsucker. You want her to be human.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.description: I understood that Edward now views choosing to remove himself from my life as "the worst mistake of my very long life" and that he has been trying to delay my decision.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.source_text: So I chose option three. Which turned out to be the worst mistake of my very long life, as you know... I’ve been trying to delay her, to give her time to find a reason to change her mind, but she’s very . . . stubborn.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward admitted he would not try to kill Jacob even if my choice changed.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc6.source_text: "Would you try to kill me?" "No." "Do you really think I would hurt her that way?"

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward asked Alice to see whether Bella would be better off with Jacob but that Alice could not see Jacob.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc7.source_text: I even asked Alice if she could see that — see if Bella would be better off with you. She couldn’t, of course.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc7.description: I acknowledged that I have considered Jacob as potentially better suited for Bella in some ways.
I recognized Jacob as a presence I begrudgingly respect despite us being natural enemies and despite Jacob trying to take the reason for my existence.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc7.source_text: if it weren’t for the fact that we’re natural enemies and that you’re also trying to steal away the reason for my existence, I might actually like you.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward would let Bella go if she chose Jacob while he would never show how hard it was for him and would keep watch.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc7.source_text: I would let her go. In the sense that I’d never show her how hard it was for me, yes. But I would keep watch.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward can only hear a story if someone thinks of it.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.source_text: I can only hear if you think of it. It’s just a story that Bella seemed reluctant to tell me about the other day. Something about a third wife . . . ?

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward listened to the story in Jacob's head and reacted quietly.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.source_text: Edward didn’t answer, listening to the story in Jacob’s head. I heard his low hiss in the darkness.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward attempted to make peace between the sides and downplay harm.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.source_text: “Neither side meant any harm,” Edward whispered, peace-making now.

tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward offered to help Jacob sleep and deliberately hummed louder to drown out Jacob's thoughts.
tw-book3-chapter22_Sc8.source_text: Would you like me tohelp you sleep, Jacob?" Edward offered. "Edward started humming to himself, louder than usual — trying to drown out Jacob’s thoughts, I assumed.

tw-book3-chapter23_Sc1.description: I saw Edward unzip the sleeping bag swiftly and I watched Jacob fall onto the icy tent floor.
tw-book3-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Edward unzipped the sleeping bag in a swift, abrupt movement. Jacob fell out, his bare back hitting the icy floor of the tent."

tw-book3-chapter23_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward's anger and disgust toward Jacob after Jacob knocked into Bella accidentally.
tw-book3-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I read: "He was looking at me, his expression hard and angry. 'That wasn't nice. You should say sorry.' His eyes widened in disgust."

tw-book3-chapter23_Sc1.description: I observed Edward wrap his hand around Bella's waist protectively and I recognized his readiness to shield her.
tw-book3-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I read: "Edward wrapped his hand around my waist, ready to yank me out of the way."

tw-book3-chapter23_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward intentionally provoked Jacob because he believed Jacob deserved to know.
tw-book3-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: "I never promised to fight fair," he reminded me quietly. "And he deserves to know."

tw-book3-chapter23_Sc2.description: I heard Edward apologize directly for his action that caused Jacob's agony.
I noticed Edward restraining and comforting me, showing both control and tenderness in response to the crisis.
tw-book3-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: "His hand caught my left wrist." and "His arms folded around me, and my tears soaked into his shirt."

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.description: I heard Edward promise he could be noble and that he would not force Bella to choose between him and anyone else.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I can be noble, Bella. I’m not going to make you choose between us. Just be happy, and you can have whatever part of me you want, or none at all, if that’s better."

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward wanted to protect Bella emotionally by discouraging decisions made from a sense of debt or reaction to Jacob Black.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "Don’t let any debt you feel you owe me influence your decision."

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.description: I observed Edward prioritize calm, practical restraint in the moment by citing cold, morality, and the inappropriateness of reacting to Jacob as reasons not to fully indulge passion.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "Firstly, because it is cold... First, because you are bizarrely moral for a vampire... We will try, Bella. I’ll make good on my promise. But I’d much rather it wasn’t in reaction to Jacob Black."

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.description: I understood that Edward believed skill, training, and surprise would make their side prevail and that he trusted the plan involving Jasper and Sam.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "It’s going to be fine, Bella. We’ve got skill, training, and surprise on our side... The newborns have reached the end of the trail — it worked like a charm, Jasper’s a genius... Sam’s taking us around to head off the ambush party."

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.description: I felt Edward’s tenderness as he wrapped a sleeping bag around me, advised me to breathe, and soothed my panic by smoothing my hand.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "Careful, love," he murmured... "Breathe, Bella."... "It’s going to be fine, Bella," he promised.

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc3.description: I recognized that Edward could hear Victoria's thoughts when she approached close enough.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: I read: "She was close enough that he could hear her thoughts"

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc3.description: I observed Edward directing movements and issuing orders to separate and drive the opponents toward the clearing.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: I read: "Separate them — don’t let them protect each other’s backs"

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc3.description: I saw that Edward prioritized my safety by sending Seth away and taking a defensive stance to protect me.
I understood that Edward believed he could survive a fight with Victoria if she had not brought too many others.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: I read: "But with Victoria, it didn’t have to be both. Edward could survive this."

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward deliberately used verbal and mental tactics to pull at Victoria's concentration and gain positional advantage.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: “Look more closely, Victoria,” he murmured, pulling at the threads of her concentration.

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward framed Victoria as a common enemy to unite his allies against her.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: You provided us with a common enemy. You allied us.

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward's priority was my safety as he stood between Victoria and me and vowed that she would not touch me.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: “Except what you want. You’ll never touch her.”

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc5.description: I observed Edward move almost invisibly and twist backward to catch the unsuspecting Riley by the arm.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc5.source_text: Simultaneously, Edward — all but invisible with speed — had twisted backward and caught the unsuspecting Riley by the arm.

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc5.description: I watched Edward catch Victoria at the forest edge and kiss her neck moments before her head was separated from her body.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc5.source_text:
He caught her unprotected back at the edge of the trees and, with one last, simple step, the dance was over.

Edward’s mouth brushed once across her neck, like a caress.

And then the fiery tangle of hair was no longer connected to the rest of her body.

tw-book3-chapter24_Sc5.description: I trusted Edward's speed and decisiveness more after I saw him intercept Riley and finish Victoria in an instant.
tw-book3-chapter24_Sc5.source_text:
But Edward was faster — a bullet from a gun.

He caught her unprotected back at the edge of the trees and, with one last, simple step, the dance was over.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.description: I observed Edward dismember a headless corpse with swift, cool, businesslike motions.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: Swift and coolly businesslike, he dismembered the headless corpse.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.description: I watched Edward pull a silver rectangle from his pocket, flip open the butane lighter, and ignite the dry tinder to start the pyre.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: Edward pulled a silver rectangle from his pocket. He flipped open the butane lighter and held the flame to the dry tinder.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.description: I noticed cooperative camaraderie between Edward and Seth as they worked together to ensure every piece was burned.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: "Get every piece," Edward said in a low aside to Seth.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.description: I realized Edward could perform clinical violence without visible disturbance when he calmly dismembered the corpse and later allowed a brief, controlled smile.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: Swift and coolly businesslike, he dismembered the headless corpse.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward approached Bella with exaggerated slowness and his hands held up, palms forward, as if to show he was unarmed and not a threat.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "walking toward me with exaggerated slowness, his hands held up, palms forward."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward had just beheaded and dismembered a sentient creature very close by and that he referenced that act when speaking to Bella.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "I just beheaded and dismembered a sentient creature not twenty yards from you."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward feared he might have terrified Bella by his actions and apologised repeatedly while attempting to reassure her that she was safe.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "I’m so sorry. It’s over, it’s over." and "I know I must have terrified you."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward prioritized calming and protecting Bella by keeping distance initially, then comforting her physically and verbally, and reaffirming he would not hurt her.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: "You don’t have to be afraid, Bella," Edward murmured. "You’re safe. I won’t hurt you."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc3.description: I observed Edward step in because Seth could not see what I was doing.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: “Seth couldn’t see what you were doing, so I had to step in. Seth’s a bit disgruntled that he can’t claim a single-handed defeat now.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward move from sudden livid anger to amusement and relief as the situation resolved.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: “His suddenly livid expression made my voice fade out.” and “A dozen emotions flitted across his face before he settled on being amused.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc3.description: I felt Edward assert his protectiveness and demand that I trust him when he took my face between his palms and told me I had no reason to be afraid.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: “We only have a minute, so don’t panic, all right? I told you that you had no reason to be afraid. Trust me on that, please?” and “Edward took my face between his palms.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.description: I observed Edward gasp 'No!' and reach out as if toward an unseen object, indicating a sudden, reflexive response to something not visible to me.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "And then Edward gasped, 'No!' and one of his hands flew out as if to grab something that I couldn't see."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward fell to his knees and gripped his head in clear, visible pain and that he winced repeatedly while trying to speak.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "Edward fell to his knees at the exact same moment, gripping the sides of his head with two hands, his face furrowed in pain... 'What’s happening?' I cried out while Seth howled in anguish. 'We’re fine. We’re going to be okay,' Edward gasped. 'Sam — help him —'"

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.description: I realized Edward attempted to reassure us verbally even as he experienced the pain and that he invoked the pack by calling for Sam.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "'It's okay. We're going to be fine. It's —' He broke off, and winced again. 'What’s happening?' ... 'We’re fine. We’re going to be okay,' Edward gasped. 'Sam — help him —'"

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.description: I understood that Edward's concern extended beyond those immediately with him because I noticed he used the pack plural, showing he was thinking of others in the pack.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "And I realized in that instant, when he said Sam’s name, that he was not speaking of himself and Seth. ... He was using the pack plural."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc5.description: I observed Edward order Seth to go home immediately and to trust him.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc5.source_text: “No!” Edward ordered. “You gostraight home. Now. As fast as you can!” Seth whimpered, shaking his great head from side to side. “Seth. Trust me.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward believed the Volturi’s arrival was timed and that he suspected their intentions might be hostile toward the Cullens.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc5.source_text: Of course, they seem to have timed their arrival very carefully. Which leads me to believe that no one in Italy would mourn if these newbornshad reduced the size of the Cullen family.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward was determined to protect me and to bring us back together with the others rather than leave us alone.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc5.source_text: “We have to go back to the clearing,” he told me in a low voice. “Mostly, it will be safer for us to present a united front at this point.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.description: I stated that the Volturi would not recognize the wolves by scent and that the pack would be fine because of that unfamiliarity.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: "The Volturi won’t recognize the scent — they won’t realize the wolves are here; this isn’t a species they are familiar with. The pack will be fine."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.description: I said that one of the newborns was hiding and that Leah engaged him alone.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: "One of the newborns was hiding. . . . Leah found him — she was being stupid, cocky, trying to prove something. She engaged him alone. . . ."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.description: I showed distress and urgency when I gasped for Sam’s help and corrected my thought toward who was hurt.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: "Sam — help him —Edward had gasped. Him, not her."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.description: I acted to shield Bella from the full truth, focusing on calming her rather than detailing the pack’s losses.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: "Shh, Bella, shh. It’s all going to be fine. Alice can see that." "I swear they will be fine," Edward promised me.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc7.description: I observed that Edward was anxious about my condition and actively seeking updates from Carlisle and Alice.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc7.source_text: “Carlisle — it’s been five minutes.” Edward’s voice, anxious.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc7.description: I noticed Edward’s fear shift to relief when I opened my eyes and when he heard that Jacob was healing.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc7.source_text: “Oh, Bella,” Edward sighed in relief, and his lips touched mine. “He’s going to live, Bella. Jacob Black is healing as I speak. He’ll be fine.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc7.description: I experienced Edward’s protectiveness through his touch and words, which reinforced my sense of being cared for by him.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc7.source_text: Then cool lips were at my ear, and Edward was speaking the words... “Oh, Bella,” Edward sighed in relief, and his lips touched mine.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc8.description: I observed Edward announce the newborn's surrender calmly and explain the unusual nature of the situation to me.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc8.source_text: "She surrendered," he told me quietly. "That's one I've never seen before. Only Carlisle would think of offering. Jasper doesn't approve."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc8.description: I observed Edward remain very still and tightly in control while facing the approaching Volturi and protecting those around him.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc8.source_text: Edward was very still at my side, tightly in control.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward insisted that we stay in position to face the threat and to maintain our united front.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc8.source_text: "We have to stay here," Edward murmured.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward told Jane he dealt with the creator.
I noticed Edward become tense and show physical signs of stress when the conversation implicated Bella and the attacker group.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc9.source_text: I heard Edward’s jaw flex beside me.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc9.description: I saw Edward try to limit Jane's torture by stating that Bree would tell them anything and that the infliction was unnecessary.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc9.source_text: "She’ll tell you anything you want to know," Edward said through his teeth. "You don’t have to do that."

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc10.description: I heard Edward suggest explaining the rules to the young vampire and propose instruction rather than punishment.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc10.source_text: “We could explain the rules to the young one. She doesn’t seem unwilling to learn. She didn’t know what she was doing.”

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc10.description: I noticed Edward act protectively and anxiously toward me, whispering that I should not watch the violent aftermath.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc10.source_text: “Don’t watch,” Edward whispered in my ear.

tw-book3-chapter25_Sc10.description: I recognized Edward’s sharp, quick rebuttal to Jane’s apathy and his pointed comment that she had missed arriving by about a half hour.
tw-book3-chapter25_Sc10.source_text: “Yes,” Edward answered her quickly, his voice sharp. “And you were so close. It’s a shame you didn’t arrive just a half hour earlier. Perhaps then you could have fulfilled your purpose here.”

tw-book3-chapter26_Sc2.description: I noticed Carlisle's black Mercedes was not in front of Billy's house and inferred Edward was not there.
tw-book3-chapter26_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "Carlisle’s black Mercedes was not in front of Billy’s house."

tw-book3-chapter26_Sc2.description: I learned that Bella feels she cannot live without Edward and that his absence intensifies her longing and emotional pain.
tw-book3-chapter26_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I missed Edward — it had seemed like a very long afternoon ... I already knew that I couldn’t live without Edward."

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.description: I saw Edward arrive after Alice spotted me and I felt him pull me into his arms without speaking.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.source_text: But I wasn’t alone for very long — just exactly long enough for Alice to see me here, and then the few minutes it took him to arrive. The door creaked open, and he pulled me into his arms.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward kept one arm wrapped tightly around me and I observed that he drove much more slowly than usual.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.source_text: So he drove me home — for once not even getting close to my truck’s internal speed limit — keeping one arm wrapped tightly around me.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.description: I realized that Edward provided quiet, patient comfort by letting me sob until I could regain some control.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.source_text: He didn’t say anything, he just let me sob until I began to blubber out Charlie’s name.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.description: I felt Edward hug me closer for a minute before he left me at the door, and I asked him to wait for me upstairs.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc1.source_text:
He hugged me closer for one minute, and then he was gone.
“Wait for me upstairs,” I mumbled when we were in front of the house.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward captured my hands, pulled me into his arms, and comforted me through the night.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc3.source_text: "No, Bella," Edward whispered, capturing my hands. "It's part of who you are." He pulled me into the cradle of his arms as the sobs broke free again.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward was frightened by my hysteria but remained present and held me despite being scared.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc3.source_text: The thought brought on a round of hysteria which frightened Edward more than the weeping. But it passed, too, when it had run its course. Edward said little; he just held me on the bed and let me ruin his shirt, staining it with salt water.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward was anxious and questioned whether I had made the right choice because he had never seen me in so much pain.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc4.source_text: Bella . . . are you sure ? Did you make the right choice? I\'ve never seen you in so much pain —

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc4.description: I felt Edward\'s tenderness when he put his hands on either side of my face and later wrapped his arms around my waist.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc4.source_text: He put his hands on either side of my face. He wrapped his arms around my waist.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc4.description: I observed Edward echo the book\'s passionate line, which showed his emotional alignment with my declaration of dependence.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc4.source_text: 'I cannot live without my life! I cannot live without my soul!'

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward had already seen the dress in Alice’s mind, according to Bella’s remark.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: “And you know he’s already seen it in your head.”

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward was protective and reluctant to leave when Alice enforced the rule that he not see the dress.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: “He didn’t even look at her — his eyes were on me, wary, afraid to leave me alone.”

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.description: I felt reassured by Edward’s tenderness when he squeezed my hand and later touched my face to study my expression.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: “Edward squeezed my hand.” and "He touched my face; his eyes — too dark, it had been so long since he’d left me — searched my expression minutely."

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward expressed gratitude and approval for Alice’s thoughtfulness in arranging the dress.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: “That was very, very nice of you,” he told me.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc6.description: I heard Edward say that the danger was behind us.
I saw Edward take back his guest-list veto and offer to let me do things my way with no strings attached.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc6.source_text: “Deal’s off,” he said abruptly. "I’m not backing out, Bella. I’ll still keep my side of the bargain. But you’re off the hook. Whatever you want, no strings attached."

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward admit that his obstinacy had hurt me and that he now prioritized my happiness over his previous controlling plans.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc6.source_text: “I don’t care about anyone else’s feelings. I only need you to be happy. Don’t worry about breaking the news to Alice. I’ll take care of it. I promise she won’t make you feel guilty." "My way is always wrong."

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward planned to speak to Carlisle and he suggested trying morphine to ease my experience.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc6.source_text: “We’re doing it your way, Bella. Tonight. Today. The sooner the better. I’ll speak to Carlisle. I was thinking that maybe if we gave you enough morphine, it wouldn’t be so bad. It’s worth a try.”

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc7.description: I learned that trusting Edward to keep Bella alive required faith I did not want to give.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc7.source_text: I had to believe that Bella would survive. But that required trust — a trust I didn’t want to feel, a trust in that bloodsucker’s ability to keep her alive.

tw-book3-chapter27_Sc7.description: I updated my view of Edward to include both his role as Bella’s chosen partner and the threat he posed to Bella’s humanity.
tw-book3-chapter27_Sc7.source_text: She’s going to marry that thing. He’s going to try to change her into one of them!

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward observed that I had been very quiet and he asked if the plane had made me sick.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: “You’ve been very quiet,” Edward observed. “Did the plane make you sick?”

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc1.description: I heard Edward ask me if I was sad to leave.
I heard Edward describe my mother as having a very interesting mind, almost childlike but very insightful.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: Edward laughed. “Your mother has a very interesting mind. Almost childlike, but very insightful. She sees things differently than other people.”

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward fabricated a term paper to give himself an excuse to stay indoors during the day.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc1.source_text: Edward had fabricated a term paper to give himself an excuse to stay indoors during the day.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward watches me in a protective, intense way and acts very careful around me.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: The way he watches you -- it's so . . . protective. Like he's about to throw himself in front of a bullet to save you or something.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc2.description: I understood that others perceive my relationship with Edward as secretive and intensely serious, which makes it puzzling to them.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: There's something . . . strange about the way you two are together. I feel like I don't really understand your relationship. Like there's some secret I’m missing. He’s very intense about you . . . and very careful.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward asked if everything was all right in a low, careful voice immediately after the call ended.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: “Is everything all right?” Edward asked. His voice was low and careful.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward's expression was perfectly smooth and impossible to read, which made me aware of his emotional control.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: I turned slowly to face him. His expression was perfectly smooth — impossible to read.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc4.description: I felt Edward's protectiveness when he caught the dropped hamburger and embraced me, reinforcing his attentive role in my life.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: The package of icy hamburger in my hands slipped through my numb fingers. Edward had caught it and thrown it onto the counter. His arms were already around me, his lips at my ear.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward became protective and tense when the treaty risk was raised, tightening his arms around me and hissing.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: Edward stiffened, and a low hiss sounded in my ear. "His arms tightened around me."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc5.description: I observed that Edward's calm could snap into intense stress as he clenched the steering wheel and listened to distant voices.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: Edward had been relaxed and joking just a moment ago, and now suddenly his hands were clenched tight on the steering wheel, his knuckles straining in an effort not to snap it into pieces. "I stared at his anxious expression — his eyes were far away, like he was listening to distant voices."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc5.description: I recognized that Edward agreed leaving was necessary to prevent a treaty breach and understood the stakes.

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward deliberately withheld information from Bella and removed her from the situation to prevent her learning the truth.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: You didn’t tell her anything at all, did you? Is that why you took her away? So she wouldn’t know that —?

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc7.description: I observed Edward express intense, vampiric loathing toward Jacob and call him 'mongrel'.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: He glared at Jacob with vicious, unveiled loathing. “Does that answer your question, mongrel?”

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc7.description: I recognized Edward’s willingness to risk pain to protect Bella and to soothe her fears.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc7.source_text: “Do you really think hurting her is better than protecting her?” he murmured. “It’s fine,” he whispered to me. “It’s fine. I’ll never let her get close to you, it’s fine.”

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward remained calm and patient while keeping his arms around Bella in a protective manner during the confrontation.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: "I was vividly conscious of Edward, his arms still wrapped protectively around me, motionless as a stone." "I shot a look at his face — it was calm, patient."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward publicly distanced himself from Jacob by denying friendship while assuring the principal he would pass along the warning.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: "He’s no friend of mine, Mr. Greene, but I’ll pass along the warning."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.description: I observed that Edward communicates quietly by writing detailed notes in class and that his handwriting is like personal calligraphy.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: I read: "he wrote an entire paragraph in his own personal calligraphy before he slipped the paper back."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.description: I learned that Emmett and Jasper very nearly caught Victoria during the chase and that the Cullens overall nearly had her.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: I read: "Emmett and Jasper very nearly had her, but Victoria seems to have some instinct for evasion."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.description: I noticed that Edward downplayed the danger to Charlie and tried to reassure me rather than alarm me further.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: I read: "I wasn’t about to send you off alone. With your luck, not even the black box would survive."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.description: I recognized Edward's quiet commitment to protect and to be transparent with me next time as he nodded and accepted my demand to be told.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: I read: "He sighed and then nodded once." and "Thanks."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc10.description: I heard classmates describe Edward as always being confident and able to take care of himself.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc10.source_text: "There's something about Edward. He's always so . . . confident. I have a feeling he can take care of himself."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc10.description: I learned that classmates believe Edward is protected by his "big brothers" who would get involved if he were harmed.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc10.source_text: "Besides, if that other kid messed Edward up, you know those big brothers of his would get involved."

tw-book3-chapter3_Sc10.description: I began to view Edward as someone classmates expect to be self-assured and defended by his family.
tw-book3-chapter3_Sc10.source_text: "There's something about Edward. He's always so . . . confident. I have a feeling he can take care of himself."

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc2.description: I came to view Edward as capable of restraint because I believe he would not harm Jacob out of consideration for my feelings.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: “At leasthe can be a grown-up about this. He knows that hurting you would hurt me — and so he never would.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc2.description: I defended Edward verbally in front of Jacob, reinforcing my trust in Edward’s maturity during their conflict.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: “At leasthe can be a grown-up about this. He knows that hurting you would hurt me — and so he never would.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc3.description: I learned that the Cullens had no idea that werewolves still existed here and that their arrival didn't alert them to the change it would cause.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: "The Cullens had no idea," I said in a whisper. "They didn’t think that werewolves still existed here. They didn’t know that coming here would change you."

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc3.description: I remembered Edward's look at me as comparable to Sam's look at Emily, which reinforced my perception of Edward's feelings toward me.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: The way he looked at her . . . well, it reminded me of a look I’d seen sometimes in Edward’s eyes — when he was looking at me.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc4.description: I learned that a large coven of vampires lives nearby and that their presence affects the tribe's ability to stop phasing.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc4.source_text: ’Course it doesn’t help that there’s a huge coven of vampires right down the road.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward wishes he could be in my head but is never in it.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc8.source_text: “Oh, no. Edward’s never in my head. He only wishes.”

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward cannot hear me and that I am the only one like that for him.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc8.source_text: “He can’t hear me,” I explained, my voice a tiny bit smug from old habit. “I’m the only one like that, for him.”

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward was bothered by Jacob's thoughts about Bella that Monday morning.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc9.source_text: Do you mind telling me what you were doing Monday morning? You were thinking something that bothered Edward.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc9.description: I began to see Edward as someone whom Jacob thought should be shown the consequences of his actions toward Bella.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc9.source_text: So I figured it would be harder for him. And I thought he ought to get a look at what he’d done.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc10.description: I heard Edward say that he did not know when he would see Bella again and that he sounded hurt.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc10.source_text: "I don't know when I'll see you again," he said in a hurt voice.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc10.description: I recognized that Edward would be away at times and that Bella planned to time her return around those absences.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc10.source_text: "I'll come back the next time he's away," I promised impulsively.

tw-book3-chapter5_Sc10.description: I observed that Edward's uncertain presence affected both Bella's plans and Jacob's reactions.
tw-book3-chapter5_Sc10.source_text: "I don't know when I'll see you again," he said in a hurt voice.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.description: I observed Edward following me closely in a silver Volvo that glinted in the sun.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: The next minute, the sun was glinting off a silver Volvo right on my tail.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.description: I noticed that the Volvo followed inches behind me and I recognized the vehicle's distinct presence compared to another car.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: The Volvo followed inches behind me. I kept my eyes on the road ahead.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.description: I noticed a contrast between the purr of the Volvo and another car's stutter and backfire which made the Volvo stand out to me.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: This engine stuttered to a stop, followed by the loud pop of a backfire. Nothing like the purr of the Volvo.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.description: I learned that Emmet was home for the weekend and I was told that they were supposed to be hiking.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: Emmet’s home for the weekend. They’resupposed to be hiking.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.description: I believed that Edward was mad at me based on my feelings and observations that night.
