tw-book3-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: No," I said. "You’re right. I am anxious. It’s . . . it’s Edward." "What’s wrong?" "Oh, he’s mad at me.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc2.description: I observed Edward standing against the wall in the shadow by the open window with a hard face and tense posture.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: Of course he was there. He stood against the wall across from me, in the shadow beside the open window. His face was hard and his posture tense. He glared at me wordlessly.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc2.description: I heard Edward admit that he came very close to crossing the line and breaking the treaty to come after me.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "Do you have any idea how close I came to crossing the line today? To breaking the treaty and coming after you? Do you know what that would have meant?"

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc2.description: I became more worried about Edward's volatility after he expressed the willingness to break rules to protect me.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "Do you have any idea how close I came to crossing the line today? To breaking the treaty and coming after you?"

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward was leaving Friday night with Jasper, Emmett, and Carlisle to Northern California to address a mountain lion problem.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: Edward had to make up for the missed hunting trip, and so he was leaving Friday night with Jasper, Emmett, and Carlisle to hit some reserve in Northern California with a mountain lion problem.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.description: I believed Edward when he said that all he cared about was my safety because the black fire in his eyes made his intent impossible to doubt.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: All I care is that you’re safe." "The black fire in his eyes was impossible to doubt.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward paid Alice with a Porsche to hold me at the Cullen house whenever he was gone.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: He paid me off." "The Porsche. It’s exactly like the one I stole in Italy.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.description: I heard Edward tell me that I smell like a dog during a tense moment.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: Well . . . don’t be offended, but you smell like a dog," he told me.

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.description: I observed that his room had been rearranged so a colossal bed dominated the center, with the couch pushed to the north wall and the stereo shoved against the CD shelves.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: I read: "The couch was pushed to the north wall and the stereo shoved up against the vast shelves of CDs — to make room for the colossal bed that now dominated the central space."

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.description: I noted that the bed's frame was black, made of intricately patterned wrought iron, with sculpted metal roses winding in vines up the tall posts and a bowery lattice overhead.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: I read: "The frame was black, made of intricately patterned wrought iron. Sculpted metal roses wound in vines up the tall posts and formed a bowery lattice overhead."

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.description: I called his phone and discovered it rang four times and then went to voicemail with no greeting, suggesting he did not have his phone on him.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: I read: "The phone rang four times, followed by a beep. There was no greeting."

tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.description: I perceived Edward as attempting to pamper or bribe me with extravagant items like a Porsche and a king-sized bed, which affected my feelings toward his gestures.
tw-book3-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: I read: "Porsches as bribes and king-sized beds in houses where nobody slept — it was beyond irritating."

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward so rarely leaves me alone, according to Rosalie’s remark.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: I quote: "He so rarely leaves you alone," she said.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc1.description: I realized that Rosalie timed her visit because Edward was away, implying his constant presence limits opportunities for private conversations.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: I quote: "He so rarely leaves you alone," she said. "I figured I’d better make the best of this opportunity."

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward had told me that Rosalie's transformation was similar to my own traumatic event in Port Angeles.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: Did Edward ever tell you what led to this? ... He said it was close to what happened to me that time in Port Angeles, only no one was there to saveyou .

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc2.description: I felt confused by Edward's brief explanation and wanted more details than he had provided.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: "Yes," I said, my voice blank with confusion. "Was there more?"

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc3.description: I learned that this passage reveals Rosalie's human background but provides no information about Edward.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc3.source_text: I took it all for granted then; in my home, it was as if the Great Depression was only a troublesome rumor.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc4.description: I realized that Rosalie’s human world was very close to the world Edward would have experienced when he was human.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc4.source_text: With a slight shock, I realized that this was very close to the world that Edward would have experienced when he was human, the world he had grown up in.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc4.description: I suspected that Edward’s upbringing had traditional, fairy-tale elements similar to Rosalie’s experiences.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc4.source_text: With a slight shock, I realized that this was very close to the world that Edward would have experienced when he was human, the world he had grown up in.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward sounded irritated and dismissive when Carlisle decided to save Rosalie and questioned Carlisle’s judgment aloud.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc6.source_text: ‘What were you thinking, Carlisle?’ Edward said. ‘Rosalie Hale?’” Rosalie imitated Edward’s irritated tone to perfection. “‘What are we going to do with her?’ Edward said disgustedly

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward believed the Kings were suspects and spoke about the practical problems Rosalie’s recognition might cause in the investigation.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc6.source_text: ‘Don’t you think she’s just a little recognizable, though? The Kings will have to put up a huge search — not that anyone suspects the fiend,’ he growled.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward had the ability to see what Carlisle had seen, which Rosalie did not understand at the time but later recognized as true.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc6.source_text: I didn’t know then that he really could see exactly what Carlisle had seen.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc7.description: I learned from Rosalie that she considered Edward to be quite decent despite their complicated history.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc7.source_text: "I probably ought to give him more credit. He’s really quite decent, isn’t he?"

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward avoids telling other people's stories because he feels it would betray their confidences due to hearing more than the intended parts.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc7.source_text: "He doesn’t like to tell other people’s stories — he feels like he’s betraying confidences, because he hears so much more than just the parts they mean for him to hear."

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc7.description: I realized that Edward had omitted important details when explaining Rosalie's feelings and actions to me, which changed my trust in how much he reveals.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc7.source_text: "He just didn’t tell you the whole story." "He was lying?"

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc8.description: I learned from Rosalie that she never wanted Edward romantically and considered him a brother.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: I don’t want Edward that way, Bella. I never did — I love him as a brother, but he’s irritated me from the first moment I heard him speak.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward historically showed no preference for others and did not want anyone until he met me.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: But he never wanted anyone, so it didn’t bother me long.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward's encounter with me marked a clear change in his attention and attraction.
I realized that Edward loves me more than I had understood and that he is terrified to be away from me.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc8.source_text: He loves you more than you know. It terrifies him to be away from you.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc9.description: I heard Alice say he was going to take the Porsche back.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc9.source_text: He’s going to take the Porsche back.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc10.description: I learned indirectly that Edward was going hiking that weekend from a classmate's question.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc10.source_text: “Edward hiking this weekend?” he asked sociably as we walked out into the light rain.

tw-book3-chapter7_Sc10.description: I felt that Edward's absence had a strong emotional effect on me and I associated his presence with comfort at school.
tw-book3-chapter7_Sc10.source_text: Without Edward, the day was guaranteed to be unbearable.

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc1.description: I inferred that Edward and his family would be furious with Bella that night.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: They’re going to be furious with me tonight, though.

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc1.description: I realized that Bella framed the choice as being between vampires and werewolves, implying tension with Edward.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc1.source_text: I wondered if he would feel the same if he knew the choice was really between vampires and werewolves.

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward Cullen was not present in this conversation.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc2.source_text: Characters present: Bella Swan, Jacob Black

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward is being referred to as the bloodsucker and that he will not be home during the day.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: I noted: "You have the whole day off, right? The bloodsucker won't be home yet."

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc3.description: I understood that Edward (along with Charlie) imposes restrictions on what I am allowed to do, such as riding a motorcycle.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: I noted: "By who? Charlie or the blood — orhim ?" "Both."

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc5.description: I knew that Edward was the one implicated in the question of whether he had bitten me when Jacob asked if he bit me and I said yes.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: "You know. When you said it was none of my business . . . if — if he bit you." "Yes," I whispered.

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc5.description: I learned that the Cullens had promised never to kill or change anyone as part of the treaty that kept peace with my people.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: "They promised they would never kill or change anyone ever again."

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc5.description: I understood that Edward's biting me would change how others, especially Jacob, see and relate to me.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc5.source_text: "You won't be Bella anymore," he told me. "My friend won't exist."

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc6.description: I learned that Edward is seventeen and that I am approaching nineteen.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: “He’sseventeen, Jacob. And I get closer to nineteen every day.”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc6.description: I was accused that Edward intends to change me into a vampire in just a few weeks.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: “He’s going to change you into a filthy bloodsucker in just a fewweeks !”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc6.description: I affirmed my commitment to Edward by stating that he is all I want and implying I will choose him.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: “He’s all I want. What else can I do?”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc7.description: I noted that the scene took place at the Cullens' home, linking Edward to the setting even though he did not speak in this excerpt.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc7.source_text: I walked the bike into the Cullens’ cavernous garage and was unsurprised to find Alice waiting for me, perched lightly on the hood of her Porsche.

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.description: I heard him apologize for leaving and say that he was wrong because perspective is better when Bella is safely with him.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.source_text: “I’m sorry. I was wrong. It’s much easier to have the proper perspective when I have you safelyhere .”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.description: I observed his protectiveness and insistence that certain activities are too dangerous for Bella.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.source_text: “For the hundredth time, Bella — it’s too dangerous.”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.description: I noticed that he felt relieved and less anxious about leaving her after admitting that going away made him go berserk.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.source_text: “I go a little berserk when I try to leave you. I don’t think I’ll go so far again. It’s not worth it.”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.description: I felt his touch as cold against my skin, noting the contrast between his icy physicality and warm emotional intimacy.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc8.source_text: Cold as ice, his tongue lightly traced the shape of my lips.

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward said he could quite literally kill Jacob for saying that to Bella and that he admitted he wanted to.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: “I could quite literally kill him for saying that to you. Iwant to.”

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc9.description: I learned that Tanya expressed a little interest in Edward and that Edward told her politely that he did not return that interest, while also stating a preference for brunettes and calling Tanya a strawberry blonde.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: “Tanya expressed a little interest. I let her know, in a very courteous, gentlemanly fashion, that I did not return that interest. End of story.” "I prefer brunettes." "Strawberry blonde — not at all my type."

tw-book3-chapter8_Sc9.description: I recognized that Edward told Bella she was the only one who had ever touched his heart and that he affirmed that his heart would always belong to her.
tw-book3-chapter8_Sc9.source_text: “You are the only one who has ever touched my heart. It will always be yours.”

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward was described as officially returning from his 'hiking' trip.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: It wouldn’t be long until Edward showed up, officially returning from his “hiking” trip.

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward moved so quickly that he disappeared and returned, put his finger to my lips to silence me, and then pulled me to the back of the kitchen and held me protectively.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: He put his finger to my lips. “Give me two seconds,” he whispered. “Don’t move.” ... I stood frozen on the doorstep and he . . . disappeared. ... Before I could compose myself enough to count to two, he was back. He put his arm around my waist and pulled me swiftly toward the kitchen. His eyes darted around the room, and he held me against his body as if he were shielding me from something.

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward identified the intruder as one of their kind but not a member of his family and that he did not recognize the scent.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: “Not one of them,” he interrupted me quickly, shaking his head. “One of us.” ... “It’s not a scent I recognize.”

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.description: I felt more reliant on Edward's protection after he shielded me and reacted instantly to the threat in my home.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc1.source_text: He put his arm around my waist and pulled me swiftly toward the kitchen. His eyes darted around the room, and he held me against his body as if he were shielding me from something.

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward glowered at Alice and initially accused her of missing something important.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: "I was shocked to see that he was glowering at Alice, his hands fisted in anger."

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward suspected the visitor might be from the Volturi or someone unfamiliar to him.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: "He might have been from the Volturi, someone I’ve never met. . . ."

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward considered Caius or Jane as possible instigators with motive and resources.
I observed Edward exhale, widen his eyes, and apologize to me, which showed him calming and accepting my correction.
I observed Edward take my hand tightly in both of his, demonstrating his protective attachment to me.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: "He held one of my hands tightly in both of his."

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward wished to approach the problem logically and asked about possibilities for the visitor’s identity.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: "Okay, let’s look at this logically. What are the possibilities?"

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward left quickly that night and I noted his rapid return the same evening.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: And Edward was back in record time.

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward intended to investigate the unfamiliar scent personally and I heard him say he had planned to go alone and leave Bella with the others.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: I’d planned to go alone, actually," Edward said, answering the unexpected question. "And leave her with the others.

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward told Jacob he would not let Bella out of his sight until he resolved the matter and I heard him state it plainly.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: I won’t be letting Bella out of my sight till I get this taken care of. It’s nothing personal —

tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.description: I observed Edward negotiate respectfully with Jacob and I inferred that he was willing to consider a truce or boundary changes.
tw-book3-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: That’s an interesting suggestion. We’re quite willing to renegotiate. If Sam is amenable.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc2.description: I accepted that Edward Cullen is my fiancé and that this fact was unavoidable in light of the imminent wedding.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: my… my fiancé (there really was no getting around that truth with the wedding just days away).

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc2.description: I inferred that Edward or his circle has access to rare, high-end vehicles given strangers' reverence for the Mercedes Guardian.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: “I know. But I was wondering, is that… are you driving a Mercedes Guardian?” ... “They aren’t supposed to be available in Europe yet,” the man went on, “let alone here.”

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc2.description: I felt more aware and uneasy about public attention because my engagement to Edward signals wealth and status to onlookers.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc2.source_text: I still felt like a spotlight was trained on me, drawing attention to the delicate ring on my left hand.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward arranged for a heavily armored loaner car and also kept a second 'after' car hidden for later.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: "The 'before' car and the 'after' car, he’d explained... This was just the 'before' car. He'd told me it was a loaner and promised that he was returning it after the wedding."

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc3.description: I recognized Edward's tendency to go to extremes to protect me, even if it meant extravagant measures.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: This wouldn't be the first time he's gone a little overboard trying to protect you.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc3.description: I felt that Edward viewed me as fragile and accident-prone, which seemed to motivate his decision to provide a virtually indestructible vehicle.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc3.source_text: Because I was so fragilely human, so accident-prone, so much a victim to my own dangerous bad luck, apparently I needed a tank-resistant car to keep me safe.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward was out hunting this Saturday, which made me glad because I did not want him to see my reaction to the flyers.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I was glad Edward was out hunting this Saturday. If Edward saw my reaction, it would only make him feel terrible, too.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc4.description: I knew that Edward had given me a cell phone to use for emergencies.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I pulled the cell phone Edward had given me for emergencies out of the glove compartment.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc4.description: I tried to hide my upset from Edward because I did not want him to feel terrible about Jacob's disappearance.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc4.source_text: I was glad Edward was out hunting this Saturday. If Edward saw my reaction, it would only make him feel terrible, too.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward thought to invite the Clearwater family to the wedding, which reflects his consideration.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: Though inviting the Clearwaters had been Edward's idea, I was glad he'd thought of it.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward and Seth have a surprising friendship that suggests interspecies cooperation.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc5.source_text: The friendship that had sprung up between Edward and Seth was something that still boggled my mind.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc6.description: I observed Edward call out to Charlie entirely relaxed as my father entered.
I heard Edward tell me to stop fidgeting and to remember that I was not confessing to a murder.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: “Stop fidgeting, Bella. Please try to remember that you’re not confessing to a murder here.”

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc6.description: I understood that Edward objected to the word 'okay' and would have preferred more glowing words like wonderful or perfect.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: Edward grimaced, and I knew it was in objection to the word okay. He probably would have used something more like wonderful or perfect or glorious.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward chuckle and run his hand through his tousled bronze hair, showing ease during the tense moment.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc6.source_text: Edward chuckled and ran his free hand through his tousled bronze hair.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.description: I heard Edward ask Charlie for his blessing to marry Bella rather than formally asking for her hand.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: I mean no disrespect, but since Bella has already said yes and I don't want to diminish her choice in the matter, instead of asking you for her hand, I'm asking you for your blessing.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward declared he loves Bella more than anything in the world, even more than his own life.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: I love her more than anything in the world, more than my own life, and—by some miracle—she loves me that way, too.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.description: I understood that Edward and Bella plan to attend Dartmouth together in the fall and that Edward intends to do things the traditional way.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: We’re going away to Dartmouth together in the fall, Charlie.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.description: I noticed that Edward spoke with absolute confidence and calm when addressing Charlie.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc7.source_text: He sounded so sure, so calm.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward watched Charlie and tried to hold back laughter by pressing his lips tightly together.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: Edward had his lips pressed tightly together, like he was trying to hold back laughter himself.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc8.description: I observed Edward quietly sharing the moment with Bella as she glanced at him and could not read his face while he watched Charlie.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc8.source_text: I glanced at Edward, but I couldn’t read his face, either, as he watched Charlie.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward’s mother, Esme, was actively coordinating wedding details with my mother, showing in-law cooperation.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: She’d spent hours every day on the phone with Edward’s mother, Esme—no worries about the in-laws getting along.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc9.description: I learned that I intend to marry Edward and that I consider him the person who makes me happy and whom I will not want to replace.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc9.source_text: “Does he make you happy, Bella?” “Yes, but—” “Are you ever going to want anyone else?” “No, but—”

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc10.description: I noticed that Edward was present during the scene as part of the household gathered for fittings.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: Characters present: Bella Swan, Charlie Swan, Alice, Edward Cullen

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc10.description: I observed that my attention was focused on Charlie's tux and the garment bag rather than on Edward during the fitting moment.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc10.source_text: I peeled my gaze off the unusually elegant Charlie for the first time and saw the dreaded white garment bag laid carefully across the sofa.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.description: I learned that Edward was keeping the location of our honeymoon a secret to surprise me.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: Edward was keeping the location of our honeymoon a secret to surprise me.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.description: I learned that before he turned me into a vampire he had one other stipulation to make good on.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: Before he turned me into a vampire—his big compromise—he had one other stipulation to make good on.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.description: I realized that Edward had an obsessive sort of concern over the human things I would be giving up and the experiences he didn’t want me to miss.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: Edward had an obsessive sort of concern over the human things that I would be giving up, the experiences he didn’t want me to miss.

tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.description: I observed that Edward agreed to try to let me have a real honeymoon despite the danger he feared it would put me in.
tw-book4-chapter1_Sc11.source_text: I wanted a real honeymoon with Edward. And, despite the danger he feared this would put me in, he’d agreed to try.

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward wanted to delay immediate extraction to give morphine before attempting to deliver the baby.
I observed Edward performing the delivery with blood on his skin and hands as he placed the warm newborn into my arms.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: I read 'The sparkles were tinged with red, with the blood that covered his skin. And more red in his hands. He touched the warm body to my weak arms.'

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward's hands flashing like crystal while he handled our bleeding newborn and that he named her in a whisper.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc1.source_text: I read 'The light danced, shattering off Edward’s crystal hands.'

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc2.description: I believed that Edward would be doing everything he could and would not give up on me.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: I knew Edward would be doing everything he could. He would not give up.

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc2.description: I believed that every scream of mine would torment Edward, and that belief made me determined to stay silent despite the pain.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: Because I knew that every scream that escaped my lips would torment Edward.

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc2.description: I remembered discussing morphine and venom with Edward and Carlisle as a possible way to ease the pain of the venom.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc2.source_text: It seemed like a million deaths ago that we’d discussed it—Edward, Carlisle, and I.

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward stayed relentlessly attentive and measured time by counting his breaths beside Bella.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: “I went back to counting Edward’s breaths to mark the time.”

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward whispered confessions of love and apology to Bella during the ordeal.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: “Bella, I love you. Bella, I’m sorry.”

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward’s mood shifted from despair to hope as Alice’s vision clarified Bella’s condition and he expressed confidence that she would be fine.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: “She’s really going to be fine,” he breathed. “You weren’t so sanguine two days ago.”

tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward felt conflicted about punishing others involved and protective of family unity while wanting to avoid bloodshed.
tw-book4-chapter19_Sc3.source_text: “I don’t know which side to take. I’d love to flog them both. Well, later.” “I’m sure, between the five of us, we can keep it from turning into bloodshed.”

tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.description: I heard Edward say that he does not need to leave and can stay with Bella.
tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I don’t need to leave. I can stay. . . .

tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward fears losing control around Bella and worries that she will get hurt if he cannot restrain himself.
tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: I won’t be able to control myself. You’ll get hurt.

tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward is eager to be married yet remains anxious about his reactions and the consequences of their union.
tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: Bachelor parties are designed for those who are sad to see the passing of their single days. I couldn’t be more eager to have mine behind me. So there’s really no point.

tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.description: I observed Edward's golden eyes and felt as if I could see into his soul when he looked at me.
tw-book4-chapter2_Sc1.source_text: Our gazes locked for a moment; his golden eyes were so deep that I imagined I could see all the way into his soul.

tw-book4-chapter2_Sc3.description: I observed that the Cullens live inconspicuously and follow practices designed to prevent humans from discovering that they do not age.
tw-book4-chapter2_Sc3.source_text: Keeping the secret meant a lot of things—living inconspicuously like the Cullens, moving on before humans could suspect they weren’t aging.

tw-book4-chapter2_Sc3.description: I imagined the Cullen family without Carlisle and realized how central he is to their cohesion and moral guidance.
tw-book4-chapter2_Sc3.source_text: I tried to visualize the Cullen family without their creator, their center, and their guide—their father, Carlisle. I couldn’t see it.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc2.description: I observed Edward leaning across the operating table with his hand reached toward me and an anxious expression.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc2.source_text: Edward was leaning across the operating table that had been my pyre, his hand reached out toward me, his expression anxious.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc2.description: I experienced a frozen first second of shock in response to the unfamiliar touch.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc2.source_text: After that first frozen second of shock, my body responded to the unfamiliar touch in a way that shocked me even more.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc2.description: I found that Edward's face dominated my attention and that my previous familiarity with it was an illusion.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc2.source_text: The greater part of my senses and my mind were still focused on Edward’s face. I thought I’d known his face better than my own.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward moved with slow, sinuous grace and that his steps were measured and fluid.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: He moved slowly around the table—each step taking nearly half a second, each step flowing sinuously like river water weaving over smooth stones—his hand still outstretched.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.description: I heard Edward speak in a low, calming, musical voice and reassure me that everything was fine.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: “Bella, love? I’m sorry, I know it’s disorienting. But you’re all right. Everything is fine.”

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.description: I experienced Edward as tentative, gentle, and caring when he stroked my cheek and touched my lips to calm me.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.source_text: “Don’t panic, love,” he said, lifting his hand to touch my lips, parted in horror.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc3.description: I perceived that Edward could feel pain in this moment when I was too strong for him.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.description: I perceived Edward's reciprocal love when he responded to my declaration with his own vow.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: "As I love you," he told me.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward initiated a kiss that progressed from a whisper to a fiercer intensity, indicating deep passion.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: He kissed me, soft as a whisper at first, and then suddenly stronger, fiercer.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.description: I recognized that Edward felt radiant relief and joy once the fear, pain, and uncertainties were behind us.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: He laughed, radiant with relief that it was all over—the fear, the pain, the uncertainties, the waiting, all of it behind us now.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.description: I heard Edward promise that Renesmee is healthy and well with a reverent gleam in his eyes.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc4.source_text: "Renesmee is healthy and well," he promised, a gleam I’d never seen before in his eyes.

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc6.description: I observed that Edward explained how diet affects eye color and that he spoke softly to reassure me about the change in my eyes.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: I read: "'They'll darken up in a few months,' Edward said in a soft, comforting voice. 'Animal blood dilutes the color more quickly than a diet of human blood. They'll turn amber first, then gold.'"

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc6.description: I noticed that Edward admires my restraint but is uncertain about its duration, calling my emotional control impressive yet not fully understood.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: I read: "'It's very impressive, Bella, but we don't understand it. We don't know how long it can hold.'"

tw-book4-chapter20_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward protested when Alice insisted on being there and I perceived a playful, protective dynamic between him and Alice during the mirror moment.
tw-book4-chapter20_Sc6.source_text: I read: "'Alice—,' Edward protested." and "'And maybe this has solely to do with your own voyeuristic gratification,' he countered."

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc1.description: I understood that Edward thought the window was the most convenient exit and offered to carry me if I was frightened.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc1.source_text: It’s the most convenient exit. If you’re frightened, I can carry you.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward believed Renesmee was perfectly safe and that he claimed to know exactly what Jacob was thinking.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc1.source_text: Trust me, she is perfectly safe. I know exactly what Jacob is thinking.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc1.description: I perceived Edward as protective and approving of me when he praised my grace and took my hand.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc1.source_text: That was quite graceful—even for a vampire. Edward took my hand—I couldn’t stop marveling at the smoothness, the comfortable temperature of his skin—and darted through the backyard to the edge of the river.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc2.description: I observed Edward touch my cheek, take two quick backward strides, and launch himself from a flat stone to arc over the water and somersault into the trees.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: He touched my cheek, took two quick backward strides, and then ran back those two steps, launching himself from a flat stone firmly embedded in the riverbank. I studied the flash of movement as he arced over the water, finally turning a somersault just before he disappeared into the thick trees on the other side of the river.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc2.description: I labeled Edward a show-off after his dramatic jump and invisible laugh.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: "Show-off," I muttered, and heard his invisible laugh.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward racing through the woods to find me and arriving with wide eyes, which updated my sense of his concern and attention toward me.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc2.source_text: Over the sound of my peals of delighted laughter, I could hear Edward racing to find me. ... When he reached my tree, his eyes were wide.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward could run with blinding speed and that he taunted me with a grin before breaking into a run.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.source_text:
"Follow me… if you can." He grinned, his expression suddenly taunting, and broke into a run.

He was faster than me.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward intended to hunt elk and chose something easy for my first time.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.source_text: "Elk. I thought something easy for your first time . . ."

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward's tone was approving and casual while his eyes showed surprise, which made his demeanor complex and amused.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.source_text:
"Was that good?" I wondered, my breathing accelerated with excitement.

"Very good." He smiled approvingly, but his casual tone didn’t match the surprised expression in his eyes.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.description: I understood why Edward never hit the trees when he ran because of a balance between speed and clarity.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc3.source_text: I could finally understand why Edward never hit the trees when he ran—a question that had always been a mystery to me.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward can detect and interpret subtle environmental sounds and scents and can instruct another to do the same.
I learned that Edward knew the exact number and positions of the animals by sound and smell, correcting my guess from three to five.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: "Three?" I guessed. "Five. There are two more in the trees behind them."

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc4.description: I realized that Edward's touch and approving tone had a soothing, authoritative effect that I relied on when my control slipped.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: "Hold still for a minute," he said, putting his hands lightly on my shoulders. The urgency of my thirst receded momentarily at his touch.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward's voice sounded like he was smiling, which encouraged me to follow his instructions.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc4.source_text: His voice sounded like he was smiling.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.description: I heard Edward express a wish to see into my mind for just one moment.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: “What wouldn’t I give to be able to see into your mind for just this one moment.”

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward's eyes were full of wonder when he touched my face.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: He put his hands on my face again, and his eyes were full of wonder.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward blink in shock and show concern about my ability to concentrate because of my thirst.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: He blinked in shock. “How can you even concentrate on that? Aren’t you unbearably thirsty?”

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.description: I sensed that Edward dropped his hands and did not breathe while I extended my senses farther into the woods.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc6.source_text: Edward dropped his hands, not even breathing while I listened farther and farther out into the web of green life, sifting through the scents and sounds for something not totally repellant to my thirst.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward was watching me and felt that it was more difficult for him to watch than it should have been.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.source_text:
I looked up to see him leaning casually against a tree trunk, watching me with a thoughtful look on his face.
"You did perfectly fine," he assured me. "It's just that… it was much more difficult for me to watch than it should have been."

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward experienced an anxiety attack while watching me wrestle with the lion.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.source_text: "It goes against the grain," he explained, "letting you wrestle with lions. I was having an anxiety attack the whole time."

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.description: I realized that Edward is protective of me and notices details like improvements to my dress even during dangerous moments.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.source_text: "Old habits die hard. I like the improvements to your dress, though."

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward does not return from hunting trips looking as disheveled as I was.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.source_text: Edward didn’t come home from hunting trips looking like this.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward noted plentiful deer nearby as an alternative food source.
I learned from Edward that meat-eaters smell more like humans than herbivores do.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc7.source_text: "Herbivores. The meat-eaters smell more like humans," he explained.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward hunts with centuries of practiced technique and that he attributed his skill to long experience.
I observed that Edward's movement while hunting was likened to a sinuous strike and that his hands and lips were described as sure, strong, and perfect.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc8.source_text: His smooth spring was like the sinuous strike of a snake; his hands were so sure, so strong, so completely inescapable; his full lips were perfect as they parted gracefully over his gleaming teeth.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward's eyes shifted to a disconcertingly lovely shade of honey gold while we were together after the hunt.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc8.source_text: His eyes were a disconcertingly lovely shade of honey gold now.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.description: I observed Edward ask 'Renesmee?' with uncertainty as he tried to ascertain what I wanted most in that moment.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.source_text: “Renesmee?” he asked uncertainly, trying to ascertain what I wanted most in this moment.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.description: I noticed Edward kissed me fearlessly and forcefully and that I responded to his intensity.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.source_text: It was an entirely different experience with Edward kissing me so fearlessly, so forcefully. I responded to his intensity, and then suddenly we were falling.

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.description: I heard him laugh when I fell on him and I felt him stroke my face while saying he felt slightly better than okay.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.source_text: “Oops,” I said, and he laughed underneath me. “I didn’t mean to tackle you like that. Are you okay?” He stroked my face. “Slightly better than okay.”

tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.description: I sensed Edward was not averse to delaying our return trip and that he was willing to linger with me.
tw-book4-chapter21_Sc9.source_text: I could tell that he wasn’t exactly averse to procrastinating our return trip, and it was hard to think about much besides his skin on mine—there really wasn’t that much left of the dress.

tw-book4-chapter22_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward promised to protect me and Renesmee and that he and the family would not risk the child.
tw-book4-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "We’ll take care of you, Bella, Don’t worry, we’ll be ready, None of us would risk Renesmee"

tw-book4-chapter22_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward's tenderness toward me as he gripped my hand, led me into the house, and positioned himself between me and potential danger.
tw-book4-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "He took my hand tightly in his and led the way into the house"

tw-book4-chapter22_Sc2.description: I perceived that Edward believed Renesmee had already wrapped the family around her little fingers and that he trusted she would be perfectly safe with them.
tw-book4-chapter22_Sc2.source_text: I quote: "I think you’ll be surprised at how entirely she’s already wrapped us all around her little fingers, She’ll be perfectly safe, no matter what"

tw-book4-chapter22_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward understood Renesmee's method as the opposite of his own power and that he labeled her ability as a gift.
tw-book4-chapter22_Sc3.source_text: “How do I hear thoughts? How does Alice see the future?” Edward asked rhetorically, and then shrugged. “She’s gifted.”

tw-book4-chapter22_Sc3.description: I felt Edward's immediate support as he stepped to my side, put his hands on my arms, urged me forward, and explained what Renesmee had shown me.
tw-book4-chapter22_Sc3.source_text: Edward darted back to my side. He put his hands lightly on my arms and urged me forward.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.description: I heard Edward apologize to Seth directly and express regret for not being closer.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I heard Edward say he was sorry to Seth and that he should have been closer.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward offering physical comfort to me and I felt his protective, soothing presence when he rubbed my arm and took my hand.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I felt Edward rubbing my arm from the other side and I saw him follow me to the back windows to take my hand.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.description: I believed Edward tended to take blame for situations and I did not want him to assume responsibility for my actions.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I recognized the pattern when I thought, "I didn’t want him taking the blame for this the way he always took everything on himself."

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.description: I sensed that Edward was irritated with Jacob and I suspected he might have enjoyed having an excuse to be more physical if he were a newborn.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc1.source_text: I noticed Edward having difficulty keeping a smile off his face and I imagined he might wish for the excuse of being a newborn to act on his irritation with Jacob.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward refused to leave my side to translate when Sam and Jacob came to talk to Carlisle.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: Once Sam had understood how absolutely everything had changed, he’d come back with Jacob to talk to Carlisle. They’d spoken in human form (Edward had refused to leave my side to translate), and the treaty had been renewed.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc2.description: I felt Edward’s gaze locked on my face when I suggested leaving to protect Charlie, which showed me his protective attention toward me.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc2.source_text: I could feel Edward’s gaze locked on my face, but I looked at Jasper.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc3.description: I observed Edward tighten and squeeze my hand while holding me close as Carlisle measured Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc3.source_text: He squeezed my hand, and his other arm wrapped securely around my waist, almost as if he needed the support.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc3.description: I realized that Edward was uncertain and scared about Renesmee’s growth when he admitted he did not know what to do.
I watched Edward view Renesmee’s memories with me and react aloud to what we saw.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc3.source_text: Edward chuckled, watching Renesmee’s thoughts with me.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward hovering protectively near Jasper and me while allowing me to hold Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc3.source_text: Jasper and Edward hovered but allowed it.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward initially interpreted Renesmee's memory as her remembering the taste of human blood.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: But she was remembering being thirsty," Edward muttered, "She was remembering the taste of human blood.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.description: I observed that Edward recognized his initial reaction as an overreaction and could laugh at it afterward.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: And nothing at all, it seems. The overreaction is mine this time.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward thought Jasper's distress came from questioning whether the newborn madness is inevitable or self-fulfilling.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.source_text: He’s wondering if the newborn madness is really as difficult as we’ve always thought, or if, with the right focus and attitude, anyone could do as well as Bella.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc4.description: I noticed that Edward was protective and reassuring toward me when dealing with Jasper's reaction.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward asked Carlisle whether self-control should be considered a talent, framing the group discussion about Bella's restraint.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc5.source_text: “Have you ever seen an equivalent to self-control as a talent?” Edward asked Carlisle.

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward crooned a song to Renesmee that she replayed as a memory twice for me.
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc5.source_text: Or the song Edward had crooned to her that was so perfect Renesmee played it for me twice;

tw-book4-chapter23_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward appeared expectant and relieved when Renesmee fell asleep and when Alice entered with the key, as signaled by his tone and the single word 'Finally.'
tw-book4-chapter23_Sc5.source_text: The change in Edward’s tone caught my attention when he said, “Finally,” and turned to gaze out the window.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc1.description: I learned that my husband is seventeen years old from the narration.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: I shook my head fiercely and then shot a glance at the smug smile on my seventeen-year-old husband’s face.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward produced another key, a longer silver one with a less gaudy blue bow, and that I recognized it as for the 'after car.'
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: “Presents,” Edward corrected, and he pulled another key—this one longer and silver with a less gaudy blue bow—from his pocket. I knew immediately what this key was to—the “after car.”

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward knows me well and intentionally arranged for Jacob to be awake so someone could express the right level of enthusiasm at the reveal.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc1.source_text: “I think it might be more fun if Jacob was awake for the big reveal, don’t you agree? So that someone there is able to express the right level of enthusiasm?” I grinned back. He knew me well.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc2.description: I saw Edward jump at the same time I did and match my actions during the leap across the river.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: Edward jumped at the same time I did; it was every bit as fun as it had been this afternoon.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward offered to remove my sight theatrically and instead chose to hold my hand and lead me, which showed calm protectiveness.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: "I could take care of that without the theatrics," Edward offered. I felt Edward’s fingers weave through mine.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc2.description: I felt more secure and appreciative of Edward’s patient guidance as he pulled me forward and thanked Alice for helping.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc2.source_text: "Just a few seconds more, Bella. Then she’ll go annoy someone else." "True. Thank you again, Alice."

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.description: I heard Edward say that the place was no more than a cottage and that the word house implies more legroom.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: "And it's no more than a cottage. I think the word house implies more legroom."

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward murmured about Esme's desire to renovate and that he helped arrange the gift.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: "Esme thought we might like a place of our own for a while, but she didn’t want us too far away," Edward murmured. "And she loves any excuse to renovate."

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward knew his way around and that he pulled my hand to show me what the family had done to the cottage.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.source_text: "Let me show you what they’ve done," he said, pulling my hand. "Edward knows his way around."

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc3.description: I recognized that Edward's correction of my wording to 'Us' signaled that he viewed the cottage as shared between us.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.description: I felt Edward lift me into his arms so fast that I didn't see it coming.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: He ducked down and yanked me up into his arms so fast that I didn’t see it coming—and that was really something.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.description: I heard Edward joke that thresholds are part of his job description.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: “Thresholds are part of my job description,” he reminded me.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.description: I heard Edward mention that Esme added an extra room because no one was planning for Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: “We’re lucky Esme thought to add an extra room. No one was planning for Ness—Renesmee.”

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.description: I learned from Edward that the closet beyond the double doors is bigger than the bedroom.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: “The closet is through those double doors. I should warn you—it’s bigger than this room.”

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward smiled widely and laughed, which made me feel his happiness and affection in the cottage.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc4.source_text: He smiled a wide, gleaming smile and then laughed.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward stated he does not miss human warmth and scent and that he feels purely full of joy about his current state.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.source_text: So the answer is no. I am purely full of joy, because I am missing nothing. No one has more than I do now.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward acknowledged that vampires never completely lose thirst or other desires but that they learn to balance and prioritize them over time.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.source_text: Neither thirst nor any other desire really ever fades. It’s simply a matter of learning to balance them, learning to prioritize and manage.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.description: I observed that Edward responded to Bella's warmth and softness as pleasing and remarked on those qualities directly.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.source_text: You are warm, he told me. You are soft.

tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.description: I realized that Edward had been holding back parts of himself before and that he was now giving more of himself physically.
tw-book4-chapter24_Sc5.source_text: So much of himself he’d been holding back. Necessary at the time, but I couldn’t believe how much I’d been missing.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc1.description: I heard Edward say Renesmee to remind me of my priorities with just one word.
I observed Edward using his sense of smell to identify denim and other fabrics quickly.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: "Denim has its own scent just like anything else. Now… stretch cotton?"

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward dressed himself in seconds and favored khakis and a pale beige pullover.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: "It only took him seconds to find his own clothes—if I hadn’t seen him undressed, I would have sworn there was nothing more beautiful than Edward in his khakis and pale beige pullover—"

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc1.description: I felt Edward as attentive and playful when he took my hand and raced me back toward the house, beating me in the sprint.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc1.source_text: "then he took my hand. We darted through the hidden garden, leaped lightly over the stone wall, and hit the forest at a dead sprint." and "He beat me this time."

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward accused Jacob and pointed out that Jacob had phased in front of Charlie.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc4.source_text:
Jacob was still troubled by Edward’s accusations, but mine didn’t seem to bother him.
“‘He phased in front of Charlie,’ Edward hissed.”

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc4.description: I observed Edward’s distrust and protective attitude toward Charlie and his suspicion of Jacob’s actions.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: Jacob was still troubled by Edward’s accusations, but mine didn’t seem to bother him.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc4.description: I heard Edward react with alarm and disapproval when Jacob described showing himself to Charlie.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc4.source_text: “He phased in front of Charlie,” Edward hissed.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc5.description: I learned that Jacob presented Renesmee to Charlie as Edward's orphaned ward.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc5.source_text: She’s your orphaned ward—like Bruce Wayne and Dick Grayson.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward did not respond when Jacob joked about lying.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc5.source_text: Edward didn’t respond in any way, so Jacob went on.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc5.description: I recognized Edward's parental role toward Renesmee as implied by Jacob's description.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc5.source_text: She’s your orphaned ward—like Bruce Wayne and Dick Grayson.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc6.description: I observed Edward offering reassurance, stroking Bella's face, and stating he would help and that he believed Bella could do this.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: Edward was back at my side, stroking my face. "You can do this. I know you can. I'll help you; we all will."

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward prioritizing Bella's happiness and advocating that maintaining a relationship with Charlie was preferable to disappearing.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: If I didn't believe you could handle it, we'd disappear today. This very minute. But you can. And you'll be happier if you can have Charlie in your life.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc6.description: I recalled Edward's expressed concern about the physical pain Bella might endure and the emotional pain if she failed to control herself.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc6.source_text: Did you consider the physical pain you're putting Bella through, even if she can resist? Or the emotional pain if she doesn't?

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc7.description: I observed that Edward crafted and delivered a convincing cover story claiming Renesmee was a niece and that Bella had lost her family.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc7.source_text: 'My niece,' Edward lied smoothly. 'I lost my parents. My older brother was adopted, like me. I never saw him after that.'

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc7.description: I saw Edward provide physical and emotional support to me by squeezing my shoulders sympathetically and touching Renesmee reassuringly.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc7.source_text: Edward squeezed my shoulders sympathetically. Edward brushed his fingers lightly over her cheek. I saw him touch her lips for just a moment—a reminder.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc7.description: I recognized that Edward can appear calm, controlled, and convincingly innocent when explaining difficult circumstances to Charlie.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc7.source_text: Edward was so good at this. His voice was even, with just the right amount of innocence.

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward insists the public story matters more than the full truth to protect Bella and Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc8.source_text: "I’m sorry," Edward said calmly, "but you need to know the public story more than you need to know the truth. If you’re going to be part of this secret, the public story is the one that counts. It’s to protect Bella and Renesmee as well as the rest of us. Can you go along with the lies for them?"

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward described Renesmee as the size of a three-month-old but with maturity in other ways.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc8.source_text: "Three months," Edward said, and then added slowly, "rather, she’s the size of a three-month-old, more or less. She’s younger in some ways, more mature in others."

tw-book4-chapter25_Sc8.description: I perceived Edward’s calm tone as an attempt to build trust with Charlie in asking for cooperation.
tw-book4-chapter25_Sc8.source_text: "I’m sorry," Edward said calmly, "but you need to know the public story more than you need to know the truth. ... Can you go along with the lies for them?"

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc1.description: I learned that Charlie was processing strange events he had witnessed and was hesitant about what to tell Renée, indicating ongoing unexplained incidents around the family.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc1.source_text: I read 'Charlie worries about how much to tell Renée and hesitates to leave, still processing the strange events he's witnessed.'

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc1.description: I inferred that Bella chose to shield Charlie from full details about the family's unusual nature to protect him and preserve his feelings.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc1.source_text: I read 'Bella reassures him' and 'leaving Bella feeling elated and stunned that she managed the day without hurting him.'

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.description: I watched Edward come to Bella and embrace her.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.source_text: Edward comes to Bella and embraces her.

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward at the piano among the relaxed family members.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.source_text: The group’s human charade has slipped slightly, and the family members are at ease — Alice lounging, Jasper nearby, Carlisle reading, Esme sketching, Rosalie and Emmett building a house of cards, Edward at the piano, and Jacob raiding the fridge.

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.description: I realized Edward and Bella are collaborating playfully because he reminded her of a favor and prompted a plan to provoke Emmett.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.source_text: Conversation turns playful and conspiratorial as Edward reminds Bella of a favor he once asked of her, prompting a plan to provoke Emmett into a contest.

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.description: I began to believe Edward enjoys orchestrating lighthearted mischief within the family by setting up contests or provocations.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc2.source_text: Conversation turns playful and conspiratorial as Edward reminds Bella of a favor he once asked of her, prompting a plan to provoke Emmett into a contest.

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward had expressed confidence in Bella's strength, which she remembered before the match.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc3.source_text: Bella is nervous but remembers Edward’s confidence in her strength.

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc3.description: I inferred that Bella trusts Edward's opinion enough to draw strength from his confidence in her.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc3.source_text: Bella is nervous but remembers Edward’s confidence in her strength.

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc4.description: I noticed the sunlight produced a dazzling effect on Edward when it illuminated Bella's crystalline skin.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: the sun breaks through the clouds in a dramatic sunset, illuminating everyone — and in particular the startling crystalline quality of Bella’s skin and the dazzling effect on Edward

tw-book4-chapter26_Sc4.description: I observed Edward's dazzled reaction in the sun and I inferred that he remains emotionally affected by Bella's presence and appearance.
tw-book4-chapter26_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: the sun breaks through the clouds in a dramatic sunset, illuminating everyone — and in particular the startling crystalline quality of Bella’s skin and the dazzling effect on Edward

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc1.description: I included Edward implicitly in my glowing tapestry of family and friends.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc1.source_text: The tapestry of family and friends that wove together around me was a beautiful, glowing thing, full of their bright, complementary colors.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc1.description: I felt that becoming immortal made my life more vibrant, a change I associated with my close relationships including Edward.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc1.source_text: I was sure my thread must have changed color; I thought it had probably started out as a nice beige, something supportive and non-confrontational, something that would look good in the background. Now it felt like it must be bright crimson, or maybe glistening gold.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc2.description: I observed that members of the Cullen family receive Charlie and Sue most days, as Sue came with him to the Cullens’ house frequently.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc2.source_text: I quote: She came with him to the Cullens’ most days, though she never seemed truly comfortable here the way her son and most of Jake’s pack did.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc2.description: I noticed that the Cullens' home is a regular gathering place where visitors respond to Renesmee's advanced behaviors.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc2.source_text: I quote: She was always the first person he looked to when Renesmee did something disturbingly advanced—which was often.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc3.description: I heard Edward assure me that no one doubts me, not in the slightest.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc3.source_text: “No one doubts you, Bella, not in the slightest,” he assured me.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc3.description: I felt Edward hug me tightly because nothing pleased him more than my overwhelming ecstasy in this new life.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc3.source_text: And then Edward hugged me tightly, because nothing pleased him more than my overwhelming ecstasy in this new life.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc3.description: I heard Edward explain Jasper's hovering as a natural gravitation toward my happiness.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc3.source_text: You know how Jasper is—he can’t resist a good emotional climate. You’re so happy all the time, love, he gravitates toward you without thinking.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc5.description: I noticed that Carlisle and Edward discussed options for the future from every angle in low voices that I tried not to hear.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: Carlisle and Edward discussed our options for the future from every angle in low voices that I tried not to hear.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc5.description: I learned that Carlisle and Edward had exhausted remote research and planned to travel to Brazil to seek local legends about children like Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: Carlisle and Edward had exhausted the research they could do from a distance, and now we were preparing to follow old legends at their source. We were going back to Brazil, starting there. The Ticunas had legends about children like Renesmee.…

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc5.description: I realized that Edward and I had only one argument since I became a vampire and that the main point of contention was my insistence on making the trip to the Volturi alone.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc5.source_text: This was the only argument that Edward and I had gotten in since I’d become a vampire. The main point of contention was the “solo” part.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.description: I observed Edward insist through clenched fists that I was not going alone.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.source_text: "You're not going alone," Edward had insisted through his teeth, his hands clenching into fists.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward become extremely opposed to my plan when Alice's visions were indistinct and the uncertainty concerned him.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.source_text: This uncertainty made Edward, already hesitant, extremely opposed to what I had to do.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.description: I heard Edward want to accompany me as far as my connection in London even though I refused to leave Renesmee without both her parents.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.source_text: He wanted to come with me as far as my connection in London, but I wouldn't leave Renesmee without both her parents.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc6.description: I recognized Edward's protectiveness and understood that his opposition to my going alone was rooted in his desire to keep our family safe.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc7.description: I learned Edward had a view about the trip that Jacob agreed with.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc7.source_text: Jacob knew, and he took Edward’s view on things.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc7.description: I observed Jacob siding with Edward on travel decisions which clarified Edward’s influence on Jacob.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc7.source_text: Jacob knew, and he took Edward’s view on things.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc7.description: I noticed Edward was present among the group during the disagreement about Brazil.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc7.source_text: However, today the argument was about Brazil. Jacob was determined to come with us.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward was absent from the hunt because he was with Carlisle planning the trip to Rio.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc8.source_text: But Edward was with Carlisle today, planning the trip to Rio, talking behind Jacob’s back.…

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc8.description: I noticed that Edward was talking behind Jacob's back and I registered that dynamic during the outing.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc8.source_text: But Edward was with Carlisle today, planning the trip to Rio, talking behind Jacob’s back.…

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc9.description: I contacted Edward by phone and I heard him answer on the first ring and I could hear the whoosh of his running as he came.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc9.source_text: I pulled out my cell phone and hit the speed dial. Edward answered on the first ring. I could hear the whoosh of the wind his running made.

tw-book4-chapter27_Sc9.description: I noticed Edward insisted on coming with Carlisle to find Irina, which reinforced my sense that he is protective and determined to help.
I learned that Edward and Carlisle tracked Irina's trail without calling for Jasper or Emmett, opting to go immediately.
tw-book4-chapter27_Sc9.source_text: Finally, Carlisle nodded, and they took off to find the trail without calling for Jasper or Emmett.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc1.description: I saw Edward search for Irina with Carlisle and fail to find her trail on the eastern shore.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc1.source_text: Carlisle and Edward had not been able to catch up with Irina before her trail disappeared into the sound.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc1.description: I heard Edward gasp when Alice's vision frightened her, showing his immediate shock.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc1.source_text: I heard Edward gasp; it was a broken, half-choked sound.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc1.description: I understood that Edward was participating in planning the longer trip and consulting with Carlisle about research logistics.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc1.source_text: I hadn’t told Charlie about the longer trip yet, and I stewed about what to say to him while Edward and Carlisle’s discussion went on.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward confirmed the scope of the threat when he groaned that it was "All of them."
I understood that Edward feared our numbers would be a focal point of the Volturi's scrutiny.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.source_text: "There are so many of us," Edward answered dully. "They must want to make sure that . . ."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward and Alice share synchronized visions and reactions, speaking together as one.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.source_text: "They’re coming for us," Alice and Edward whispered together, perfectly synchronized.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.description: I understood from Edward that Aro had seen Irina's proof and that the Volturi's response would be immediate and destructive.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.source_text: "It's not the kind of crime they hold a trial for, love," he said quietly. "Aro's seen Irina's proof in her thoughts. They come to destroy, not to be reasoned with."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward's resignation as he believed that reasoning with the Volturi was impossible and that destruction was likely.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.source_text: "They come to destroy, not to be reasoned with."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.description: I felt Edward's protectiveness as he knelt beside me and wrapped his arms around Renesmee and me.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.source_text: "I felt Edward kneel beside me, wrap his arms over us both."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.description: I learned that Alice could not see part of the vision and that Edward pressed her for clarification about what had appeared in the jungle.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "I can't see," Alice repeated, not meeting his eyes. A flash of confusion crossed Edward’s face. "That was too fast—I didn't understand. What was—?"

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.description: I felt Edward's confusion grow into urgency as Alice's incomplete vision implied greater unknown danger and forced immediate planning.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "I can't see!" she exploded back at him. "Jacob's almost here!"

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.description: I observed Edward rely on Alice's sight while simultaneously expecting clear answers, showing his protective stance and need for control.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "What was that?" Edward asked, his whisper a demand. "That part in the jungle. Are we going to look for them?"

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward call out for Alice with a voice like ice cracking and saw his panic surface.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.source_text: “Alice,” he said. The sound of his voice was like ice cracking as it melted.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.description: I realized Edward feared a preemptive strike and wondered aloud if Alice would have had time to see if they sent someone for her.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.source_text: Carlisle, you don’t think—something preemptive? Would Alice have had time to see if they sent someone for her?

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.description: I understood that Edward and I were mutually terrified of losing one another, which bound us tightly in our shared fear.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.source_text: We’d stared at each other all night, staring at what neither of us could live through losing: the other.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.description: I heard Edward suggest that this might be a trap while noting there was no scent but Alice and Jasper and questioning where they were going.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.source_text: “Is this a trap?” Emmett called from behind us. “Maybe,” Edward said. “There’s no scent but Alice and Jasper. Where were they going?”

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.description: I observed Edward running in the lead with his concentration total, which emphasized his focus and leadership during the pursuit.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.source_text: Edward ran in the lead, his concentration total.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.description: I heard Edward order us to keep to the main trail and to stay together as we approached the Quileute border to determine if the trail turned north or south.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.source_text: “Keep to the main trail—we’re almost to the Quileute border,” Edward ordered tersely. “Stay together. See if they turned north or south.”

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward’s face went absolutely white as he read what Sam was thinking.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.source_text: I watched Edward’s face go absolutely white as he read what Sam was thinking.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.description: I heard Edward ask Sam in a flat voice what the paper was.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.source_text: “Sam?” Edward asked in a flat voice. “What is this?”

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.description: I observed Edward defend Alice's decision and assert that they still had free will while advising the wolves to avoid what Alice saw.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.source_text: "Alice is neither unfeeling nor a coward. She just has more information than we do." "We each still have our free will." "This is not something you want to involve yourselves in. You can still avoid what Alice saw."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.description: I noticed the shape of pain in Edward's face and I remembered that Edward had created me.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.source_text: Edward’s expression was stiff—to Sam it probably looked angry or arrogant, but I could see the shape of pain in the hard planes of his face. Edward had created me.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward argued forcefully with the wolves about differences in binding and freedom.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.source_text: "You are bound differently than we are," Edward snapped. "We each still have our free will."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward believed the trail was from earlier in the day and that it was Alice without Jasper.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.source_text: It has to be from earlier in the day. It was just Alice, without Jasper," Edward said lifelessly.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.description: I observed that Edward's blank, emotionless demeanor flickered to life when I began to walk away, revealing his emotional vulnerability.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.source_text: At first I thought he would let me go alone, but then, as I moved a few steps away, his blank eyes flickered to life.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.description: I recognized Edward's attachment when he explained that he couldn't let me walk away because it hurt him to imagine it.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.source_text: “I couldn’t let you walk away from me,” he explained in a low voice. “It hurt just to imagine it.”

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward's brows tightened in confusion as he realized where the trail led and I watched him try to reason it out.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.source_text: Edward’s brows tightened in confusion as it became obvious where the trail led. He tried to reason it out.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.description: I heard Edward suggest that Alice had left Jasper to wait for her and that she might have come to the cottage.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.source_text: “She left Jasper to wait for her and came here?”

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.description: I inferred that if Alice had wanted Edward to know something she would have taken a page from one of his books, which altered my view of how Alice communicates with Edward.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.source_text: If it were something she wanted Edward to know, wouldn’t she have pulled a page from one of his books… ?

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.description: I felt Edward's hand in mine as reassurance and I watched his forehead crease when I pulled my hand free to enter the cottage.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.source_text: I was glad to have Edward’s hand in mine, but I also felt as if I should be here alone. 'Give me just a minute,' I said, pulling my hand free as we got to the door. His forehead creased.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.description: I observed that Edward could not read my mind, making me uniquely able to conceal certain truths from him.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.source_text: The one person whose mind Edward could not read.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.description: I noticed that Edward struggled to accept the notion that Alice would lie and that he argued with himself about her motives.
