tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.source_text: I don’t believe it," Edward said. He didn’t say it like he was arguing with me—he said it like he was arguing with himself.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.description: I recognized Edward's protective urgency when he took my hand and ran with me, indicating joint immediate action.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.source_text: Edward took my hand, and we ran.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward was asked to stay and be the one to field people brought to see Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "We’ll send whomever we can find back here to you—Edward, you’ll be the best at fielding that particular minefield."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward did not sound happy about the plan to stay and manage visitors.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "'We’re to stay here?' Edward asked, looking at Carlisle. He didn’t sound happy."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.description: I observed Carlisle put his hand on Edward’s shoulder and tell him his job might be the hardest, which I took as both reassurance and acknowledgement of heavy responsibility.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Carlisle put his hand on Edward’s shoulder for a second... 'Your job may well be the hardest.'"

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.description: I reported that Edward believes the vampires coming to help are not the same as his family and that Tanya’s family is one of the few who revere human life.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "The vampires who are coming to help us are not the same as we are. Tanya’s family is the only one besides ours with a reverence for human life, and even they don’t think much of werewolves."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.description: I recorded Edward’s judgment that it would be safer for Renesmee if her acceptance by visiting vampires was not tainted by association with werewolves.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "Safer for Renesmee," Edward continued, "if the choice to believe our story about her is not tainted by an association with werewolves."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.description: I learned from Edward that Carlisle explained the severe and lasting damage the immortal children left on vampire attitudes.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "You can’t imagine the depth of the scars they’ve left in the collective vampire psyche."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.description: I feared for Edward’s life alongside my own but felt even greater terror for Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.source_text: As much as I feared for my life, for Edward’s, for the rest of my family’s, it was not the same as the gut-wrenching terror I felt for my daughter.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.description: I expected Alice to act in Edward’s and my family's best interest and to have prepared a way to help us.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.source_text: But she’s Alice. She’s doing the right thing, like always.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward Cullen is not present in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: Characters present: Bella Swan, Charlie Swan

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward would be there before the music started.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: Don’t worry, he’ll be there before the music starts.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward had already peeked at me in my dress.
I learned that Edward had not dropped a single hint about our post-reception destination.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: Edward hadn’t dropped a single hint.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc3.description: I felt that Edward might try to leave if I failed to stay awake during the ceremony.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc3.source_text: I think the bigger problem is that I might fall asleep during the ceremony and not be able to say 'I do' at the right part, and then Edward will make his escape.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc4.description: I understood that Bella was comparing herself to him and expected to be judged in his presence.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: “Is this really necessary? I’m going to look plain next to him no matter what.”

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc4.description: I inferred that having Bella, a human, in the Cullen home was notable and prompted special preparation, implying his household's unusual status around humans.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc4.source_text: “You’re the first human in here; I hope I got it right.”

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward had returned home when the arrival was announced.
I learned from Rosalie's reassurance that Edward would not cross the threshold to enter and that he values his life too much to do so today.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc5.source_text: “He won’t cross you today,” Rosalie reassured her. “He values his life too much.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc5.description: I noticed Rosalie or others warned to keep Edward out of the room with the command to 'Keep him out of here!'

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc6.description: I observed that Edward is not present in the described dressing-room scene.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "Alice made me stand so that she could ease the dress over my hair and makeup."

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc6.description: I wondered if Edward was absent because I found myself relying on Alice and my own breathing techniques rather than his presence.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "I concentrated on my breathing, counting each movement of my lungs, and stared at the patterns that the bathroom light made on the shiny fabric of my skirt."

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward was waiting for me downstairs and that his presence was used as my focus to compose myself.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: “Focus, Bella. Edward is waiting for you down there.”

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc8.description: I depended on the idea of Edward waiting below to steady me and to motivate my feet to shuffle forward.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc8.source_text: I concentrated on the idea of Edward waiting below to get my feet to shuffle forward.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc9.description: I saw that his eyes were a buttery, burning gold.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: His eyes were a buttery, burning gold; his perfect face was almost severe with the depth of his emotion.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc9.description: I noticed Carlisle stood by his side and Angela's father stood behind them both.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: I was barely conscious that Carlisle stood by his side, and Angela’s father behind them both.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc9.description: I noticed his face was almost severe with the depth of his emotion and that he responded to me with an exultant, breathtaking smile.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc9.source_text: His perfect face was almost severe with the depth of his emotion. And then, as he met my awed gaze, he broke into a breathtaking smile of exultation.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc10.description: I heard him say 'I do' clearly and victoriously.
I saw Edward’s hands reach up to cradle my face carefully as if it were as delicate as the white petals swaying above our heads.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc10.source_text: Mr. Weber declared us husband and wife, and then Edward’s hands reached up to cradle my face, carefully, as if it were as delicate as the white petals swaying above our heads.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc10.description: I noticed his golden eyes looked as if they would have tears and I perceived a deep joy beneath his amused, almost smirking surface smile.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc10.source_text: His golden eyes looked as if they would have tears, too, if such a thing were not impossible. On the surface his sudden smile was amused, almost a smirk. But underneath his momentary entertainment at my public exhibition was a deep joy that echoed my own.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.description: I couldn't look away from Edward's face and I remained focused on him even as I greeted others.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.source_text: I couldn’t look away from his face to see them.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.description: I held Edward's hand clutched tightly in my own during the reception.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.source_text: my attention centered on Edward’s hand clutched tightly in my own.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward stood with his back to the fire before he spun and crossed the room almost instantly to kiss me.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.source_text: He stood with his back to me, staring into the fire. He spun and was across the room in what seemed like no time at all, not even the smallest part of a second.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.description: I observed Edward's urgent, possessive physical response which signaled intense protectiveness and passion.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.source_text: I only had time to register the ferocious expression on his face before his lips were crushing against mine and his arms were locked around me like steel girders.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.description: I realized that Edward and I both prioritized intense intimacy when faced with the possibility of only a month left together.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.source_text: If we had only a month left together… Well, I didn’t see how I could stand to have this end. For the moment I couldn’t help but be selfish. All I wanted was to love him as much as possible in the limited time given to me.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc2.description: I learned from Edward that Alec and Jane are considered the Volturi's greatest offensive assets.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Alec and Jane are their greatest offense," he said emotionlessly, like we were talking of a basketball team.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc2.description: I learned from Edward that Alec's ability can cut off all senses and leave a victim in total sensory deprivation.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Because he cuts off your senses altogether. No pain, but also no sight or sound or smell. Total sensory deprivation. You are utterly alone in the blackness. You don’t even feel it when they burn you."

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc2.description: I observed Edward's panic and protectiveness when I suggested I might act as a diversion and I understood his resistance to the idea of my sacrificing myself.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Yes, you're surely immune to his power, but you are still a newborn, Bella. I can't make you that strong a fighter in a few weeks. I'm sure he's had training."

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward claims to be Renesmee's biological father and emphasizes that he is her father, not her creator.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.source_text: Renesmee is one of a kind. I am her father. Not her creator—her biological father.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward saved Bella's life by forcing enough venom into her heart after the birth to preserve her.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.source_text: It nearly killed her. I was hard-pressed to get enough venom into her heart to save her.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.description: I observed Edward assert paternal authority and try to persuade the others by pointing out Renesmee's warmth and the presence of blood in her veins.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.source_text: Tell me another explanation that fits, Eleazar. You can feel the warmth of her body in the air. Blood runs in her veins, Eleazar. You can smell it.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.description: I heard Edward explain that Alice saw Irina go to the Volturi.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.source_text: “Alice saw her go to them,” Edward said.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.description: I heard Edward say that Aro, Caius, Marcus and even the wives were coming.
I heard Edward state that they were looking for witnesses so the Volturi might pause and allow an explanation.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.source_text: “We’re just looking for witnesses. If we can make them pause, just for a moment. If they would let us explain . . .”

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward winced slightly when he spoke Alice’s name, suggesting emotional strain regarding her absence.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.source_text: I wondered if the others noticed the way he winced just slightly when he spoke Alice’s name.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.description: I learned that Eleazar believed Bella's presence was actively blocking his ability to sense or read, which Edward heard and reacted to.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.source_text: I read "A shield, I think. She’s blocking me now, so I can’t be sure."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.description: I felt Edward's shock and bewilderment at being told about Bella's shielding, which made him question what Eleazar meant and prompted a protective response.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.source_text: I read "'Excuse me,' Edward said in a stunned voice. He reached out and caught Eleazar’s shoulder as he was about to turn again for the door. 'What did you just call my wife?'"

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.description: I watched Edward assertively intervene with Eleazar by physically stopping him, which demonstrated Edward's protective stance toward Bella in the council setting.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.source_text: I read "He reached out and caught Eleazar’s shoulder as he was about to turn again for the door."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc2.description: I realized that Edward could not read Bella's thoughts even during her humanity, which highlighted the unusual nature of her talent to others present.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc2.source_text: No, Edward murmured. But I’ve never been able to do that. Even when she was human.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward changed his understanding by recognizing Bella's ability as a shield and expressing clear satisfaction at that identification.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc2.source_text: A shield! Edward said, deep satisfaction saturating his tone.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc2.description: I observed Edward compare Bella's shield to another individual's talent and note that he had never seen one manifest in this way before, which framed his view of Bella as unique.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc2.source_text: I never thought of it that way. The only one I’ve ever met before was Renata, and what she did was so different.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward identified Kate's ability as an offensive skill and compared it to Jane's ability.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc3.source_text: "Kate’s got an offensive skill," Edward said. "Sort of like Jane."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward originally believed Bella's restraint was the product of good preparation, focus, and attitude before Carlisle suggested another possibility.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc3.source_text: Before Carlisle had suggested that my self-control could be something beyond the natural, Edward had thought my restraint was just a product of good preparation—focus and attitude, he’d declared.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward has a vividly painful memory of cringing on the ancient stones of the Volturi castle turret.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc4.source_text: I remembered Edward cringing on the ancient stones of the Volturi castle turret.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward mutter that Kate didn’t mean any harm while we focused on the projection lesson.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc4.source_text: “That wasn’t really necessary, Kate. She didn’t mean any harm,” Edward muttered under his breath.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc4.description: I heard Edward compare the projecting ability to Renesmee.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward asserted the troubling thought originated with Eleazar when he cut Eleazar off and stated, "The thought was yours, not mine."
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc5.source_text: Edward cut him off. "The thought was yours, not mine."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc5.description: I understood from Edward’s explanation that Eleazar had been privately passing intelligence to Aro and that Edward recognized a pattern of past punished covens that repeated roughly every other century.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc5.source_text: "He was trying to understand why so many of the Volturi would come to punish us. ... He was remembering other times that covens have been punished, for one thing or the other, and a pattern occurred to him. It was a pattern that the rest of the guard would never have noticed, since Eleazar was the one passing the pertinent intelligence privately to Aro. A pattern that only repeated every other century or so."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc5.description: I observed Edward’s tense, suspicious demeanor and updated my impression of him as someone who scrutinizes motives and defends against perceived breaches of trust.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc5.source_text:
They were leaning toward each other intently, Edward’s expression tight with suspicion, Eleazar’s unhappy and reluctant.
Edward nodded, his tense eyes following Eleazar as he spoke.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc6.description: I heard Edward explain that Aro personally intervenes only when he desires something and that evidence is manufactured to justify destroying a coven and pardoning one member.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc6.source_text: Aro does not often personally attend a punishing expedition. But in the past, when Aro wanted something in particular, it was never long before evidence turned up proving that this coven or that coven had committed some unpardonable crime. The ancients would decide to go along to watch the guard administer justice. And then, once the coven was all but destroyed, Aro would grant a pardon to one member whose thoughts, he would claim, were particularly repentant.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc6.description: I heard Edward identify Chelsea as a guard member who can loosen and secure emotional ties, making people feel bonded to the Volturi and susceptible to influence.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc6.source_text: There is one among the guard. Her name is Chelsea. She has influence over the emotional ties between people. She can both loosen and secure these ties. She could make someone feel bonded to the Volturi, to want to belong, to want to please them.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward's explanation connected Eleazar's anger to Chelsea's role and gave historical context for how the guard's cohesion was maintained.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc6.source_text: There is one among the guard,” Edward said, explaining Eleazar’s angry reaction. “Her name is Chelsea. She has influence over the emotional ties between people.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward observed Aro's obsession with Alice and believes Aro wants her above all.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc7.source_text: From what I saw of his thoughts last spring, Aro’s never wanted anything more than he wants Alice.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward believes Alice left to deny Aro access to her power.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc7.source_text: To keep Aro from gaining the thing he wants most of all. To keep her power out of his hands.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc7.description: I noticed Edward's assured demeanor and his conviction that Aro would need to force him to gain anything more from him.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc7.source_text: Not nearly as much. I can’t really give him anything more than he already has. And of course that’s dependent on his finding a way to force me to do his will. He knows me, and he knows how unlikely that is.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc8.description: I understood that Edward believes the Volturi had planned to act and were waiting for any pretext to justify their decision.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc8.source_text: "I think the Volturi were waiting for this—for some pretext. They couldn’t know what form their excuse would come in, but the plan was already in place for when it did come. That’s why Alice saw their decision before Irina triggered it. The decision was already made, just waiting for the pretense of a justification."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc8.description: I accepted Edward's claim that removing Aro's argument would likely force Aro to leave us in peace.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc8.source_text: "If we can take away his argument against us, he’ll be forced to leave us in peace."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward's discomfort discussing Aro's interest in me and how that discomfort influenced my own unease.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc8.source_text: Edward was uncomfortable with this topic. I didn’t like it, either.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc9.description: I heard Edward say it was not Bella's father and that Alice had sent Peter and Charlotte.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc9.source_text: “No,” Edward said in a distant voice. His eyes were far away, staring blankly at the door. “It’s not your father.” His gaze focused on me. “Alice sent Peter and Charlotte, after all. Time to get ready for the next round.”

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc9.description: I observed Edward speaking in a distant voice with his eyes far away and staring blankly at the door.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc9.source_text: “No,” Edward said in a distant voice. His eyes were far away, staring blankly at the door.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc9.description: I realized Edward was shifting into a preparatory, commanding role when he told us it was time to get ready for the next round.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc9.source_text: “Alice sent Peter and Charlotte, after all. Time to get ready for the next round.”

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward acted as a gracious host and lent out his cars without complaint to support the compromise.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.source_text: I watched Edward be a gracious host, lending out his cars as needed without so much as a wince.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.description: I noticed that the problems Edward had anticipated between his guests and Jacob did not materialize as he feared.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.source_text: I noticed that the problems Edward had anticipated had never materialized.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.description: I stood with Edward when we replayed Renesmee’s introduction to the Denali coven a half dozen times.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.source_text: We’d replayed the scene of Renesmee’s introduction to the Denali coven a half dozen times.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.description: I learned that Alice and Jasper had sent Peter and Charlotte our way without giving them any explanation at all.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.source_text: First for Peter and Charlotte, whom Alice and Jasper had sent our way without giving them any explanation at all; like most people who knew Alice, they trusted her instructions despite the lack of information.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.description: I knew that Edward, like most people who knew Alice, trusted her instructions despite the lack of information.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.source_text: like most people who knew Alice, they trusted her instructions despite the lack of information.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.description: I recognized that curiosity had driven Peter and Charlotte to allow Renesmee’s “explanation” rather than immediate condemnation.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.source_text: Curiosity had driven them to allow Renesmee’s “explanation.”

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.description: I noted that Peter and Charlotte were committed witnesses in the same way as Tanya’s family.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc2.source_text: Now they were as committed to witnessing as Tanya’s family.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc3.description: I learned that Maggie declared that Edward spoke the truth.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc3.source_text: Maggie declared that Edward spoke the truth, and so Siobhan and Liam accepted our story absolutely before even touching Renesmee.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc3.description: I noticed that Siobhan and her hard-faced mate Liam were long used to trusting the judgment of their newest coven member.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc3.source_text: Siobhan—a woman of immense presence whose huge body was both beautiful and mesmerizing as it moved in smooth undulations—was the leader, but she and her hard-faced mate, Liam, were long used to trusting the judgment of their newest coven member.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward said Benjamin's gift is so singular that Amun is terrified of losing him.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.source_text: "His gift is so singular that Amun is terrified of losing him."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward explained Amun has been keeping Benjamin from Aro's attention.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.source_text: "Amun has been keeping Benjamin from Aro’s attention."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward said Benjamin's ability is something Eleazar had never seen and something Edward had never heard of.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.source_text: "Something Eleazar’s never seen before. Something I’ve never heard of."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward described Benjamin's power as true physical manipulation of earth, wind, water, and fire.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.source_text: "He can actually influence the elements—earth, wind, water, and fire. True physical manipulation, no illusion of the mind."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.description: I noticed that Edward likes Benjamin and appreciates his moral clarity.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.source_text: "He has a very clear sense of right and wrong. I like his attitude."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.description: I felt that Edward's tone showed affection toward Benjamin.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc5.source_text: "You like him," I surmised from the tone of his voice.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.description: I heard Edward tell Carlisle, Esme, and me that Alistair was afraid to be here but more afraid of not knowing the outcome.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Edward told Carlisle, Esme, and me that Alistair was afraid to be here, but more afraid of not knowing the outcome."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward served as an intermediary by informing the family about Alistair's feelings and attitudes toward the Volturi and the situation.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Edward told Carlisle, Esme, and me that Alistair was afraid to be here... He was deeply suspicious of all authority, and therefore naturally suspicious of the Volturi."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.description: I learned that Edward was thrilled to have the Amazons with us.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.source_text: I quote: 'Edward was thrilled to have the Amazons with us,'

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.description: I learned that Zafrina’s gift could serve as a very dangerous offensive weapon.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.source_text: I quote: 'Zafrina was enormously talented; her gift could make a very dangerous offensive weapon.'

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.description: I understand that Edward values the Amazons as potential tactical allies who might influence the Volturi’s decisions.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.source_text: I quote: 'Not that Edward was asking for Zafrina to side with us in the battle, but if the Volturi did not pause when they saw our witnesses, perhaps they would pause for a different kind of scene.'

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc8.description: I learned that Edward can perceive Zafrina's illusions vividly yet still senses Bella physically in his arms.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "She can make most people see whatever she wants them to see—see that, and nothing else. For example, right now I would appear to be alone in the middle of a rain forest. It’s so clear I might possibly believe it, except for the fact that I can still feel you in my arms."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward's admiration for my immunity and his playful interaction with Zafrina when he called the display impressive.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Zafrina’s lips twitched into her hard version of a smile. A second later, Edward’s eyes focused again, and he grinned back. 'Impressive,' he said."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward refused to teach because he admitted that analyzing me as a target and imagining ways to kill me made it too real for him.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.source_text: "Looking at you that way, analyzing you as a target. Seeing all the ways I can kill you . . ." "It just makes it too real for me."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.description: I heard Edward say that Emmett and Rosalie knew as much as he did and that Tanya and Eleazar probably knew more, and I was told to ask someone else.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.source_text: "Emmett and Rosalie know as much as I do. Tanya and Eleazar probably know more. Ask someone else."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.description: I noticed Edward's eyes went dark and I observed him flinch when he discussed the violent thoughts he had about me.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.source_text: His eyes were dark, barely any gold to lighten the black. He flinched.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.description: I learned that Edward was the only one willing to be the guinea pig and that he endured repeated shocks from Kate to help my training.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.source_text: Only Edward was willing to be our guinea pig—to receive shock after shock from Kate while I grappled incompetently with the insides of my head.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.description: I noticed that Edward encouraged me and tried to hide his distress to keep me from worrying during practice.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.source_text: Edward encouraged me in this training. "Hey," Edward said cheerfully, trying to hide any evidence of distress in his voice. Anything to keep me from fighting practice.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.description: I felt crushed that Edward had to suffer for my training and that his pain became a primary motivator for my efforts.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.source_text: It killed me that it was Edward who had to suffer, my arms wrapped uselessly around him while he winced over and over from Kate’s “low” setting.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.description: I intervened by moving between Bella and Kate to block Bella's line to Kate.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.source_text: Edward darted into the space between us, blocking my line to Kate.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.description: I warned Kate to give Bella space and emphasized that Bella was only a few months old in vampire terms.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.source_text: "Now give Bella some space to calm down, Kate. You shouldn’t goad her like that. I know she doesn’t seem her age, but she’s only a few months old."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.description: I took a protective stance in support of Bella by insisting Kate back off and letting Bella calm.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc12.description: I noticed Edward describe the shield as behaving like one-way glass that lets him read others while keeping him unreadable from outside.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc12.source_text: It’s like one-way glass. I can read everything they’re thinking, but they can’t reach me behind it.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc12.description: I heard Edward report that he could hear Renesmee from inside the shield even though he could not when he was on the outside.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc12.source_text: And I can hear Renesmee, though I couldn’t when I was on the outside.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc12.description: I observed Edward becoming curious and speculating aloud about the shield’s mechanics and potential tests involving Kate’s position under the shield.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc12.source_text: I’ll bet Kate could shock me now, because she’s underneath the umbrella. I still can’t hear you… hmmm. How does that work? I wonder if . . .

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.description: I noticed Edward dart into the house quickly and call for Renesmee to be brought forward with a hard voice to potentially test the Romanian visitors.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.source_text:
Edward darted into the house and most of the others imitated him.

"Bella?" Edward called to me in a hard voice. "Bring Renesmee here, please. Maybe we should test our Romanian visitors’ claims."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.description: I perceived Edward as immediately protective and ready to confront the newcomers on Renesmee's behalf.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.source_text:
It helped to know that probably half of the vampires in the other room would come to Renesmee’s defense if these Romanians were upset by her.

"Bella?" Edward called to me in a hard voice.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.description: I saw Edward's urgency influence others to act similarly, as many imitated his quick movement into the house.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.source_text: Edward darted into the house and most of the others imitated him.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.description: I observed Edward answering unspoken questions while others watched.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.source_text: They watched me practice my shield with Zafrina and Kate, watched Edward answer unspoken questions, watched Benjamin pull geysers of water from the river or sharp gusts of wind from the still air with just his mind, and their eyes glowed with their fierce hope that the Volturi had finally met their match.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.description: I felt reassured by Edward's calm ability to communicate without words as witnesses studied him.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.source_text: They watched me practice my shield with Zafrina and Kate, watched Edward answer unspoken questions, watched Benjamin pull geysers of water from the river or sharp gusts of wind from the still air with just his mind, and their eyes glowed with their fierce hope that the Volturi had finally met their match.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.description: I grew more hopeful about our prospects as Edward and others demonstrated control and unity in front of potential allies.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.source_text: We all were beginning to be a little bit hopeful. Even I couldn’t help it. Renesmee had won over so many in such a brief time.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc1.description: I acknowledged that we still had a strictly need-to-know company situation in effect.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc1.source_text: Charlie, we’ve still got that strictly need-to-know company situation going.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.description: I noticed that I was already in Edward's Volvo with Renesmee and that Edward had shown me my 'after car' earlier.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.source_text:
I was already in Edward’s Volvo with Renesmee.
Edward had gotten around to revealing my after car;

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.description: I realized that I did not show the expected enthusiasm for an expensive, fast car because I prefer to run.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.source_text: Sure, it was pretty and fast, but I liked to run.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.description: I recognized that Edward had correctly suspected I would not be capable of showing the appropriate enthusiasm for the after car.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.source_text: Edward had gotten around to revealing my after car; as he’d suspected, I had not been capable of showing the appropriate enthusiasm.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob is able to control his thoughts specifically around Edward.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.source_text: Jake, you know how you’re pretty good at controlling your thoughts around Edward?

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.description: I noted that Edward was referenced in conversation but was not present at the lunch.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: "Even if he couldn’t help but think about this near Edward, at least there wasn’t much for him to share."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.description: I understood that Jacob's thoughts or behavior were influenced by proximity to Edward or by Edward's presence in their concerns.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: "Even if he couldn’t help but think about this near Edward..."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.description: I believed Edward knew how to obtain or fabricate identification and had methods of escape without official papers.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.source_text: "I was sure IDs were something Edward knew how to get his hands on or make himself, and I was sure he knew ways to escape without them."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.description: I understood that secrecy was important because Edward's knowledge could be accessed by Aro through mental powers.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.source_text: "And all the secrecy to keep this out of Edward’s head. Because there was a good chance that everything he knew, Aro would know."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.description: I feared that if Aro learned what Edward knew, Aro would obtain the information and then destroy Edward.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.source_text: "If we lost, Aro would certainly get the information he craved before he destroyed Edward."

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I heard Edward murmur that 'Alistair is gone.'
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: "Alistair is gone," Edward murmured as we darted up the steps.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I watched Edward move quickly to Esme’s side while towing me by the hand.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: Edward’s jaw tightened and he moved quickly to Esme’s side, towing me by the hand.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward park in front of the house rather than going around to the garage and exchange a wary glance with him before exiting the car.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: Edward parked in front of the house rather than going around to the garage. We exchanged one wary glance before we got out of the car.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I learned from Edward that Alistair likely left because he thought a fight was inevitable and cared too much for Carlisle to join the Volturi.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: No one can be positive; he didn’t leave a note. From his mutters, it’s been clear that he thinks a fight is inevitable. Despite his demeanor, he actually does care too much for Carlisle to stand with the Volturi. I suppose he decided the danger was too much.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.description: I guessed that Demetri would likely track Edward when the Volturi arrived because Demetri could not track me.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.source_text: I wondered who he would track in, and guessed that it would be Edward since he couldn’t track me.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.description: I observed Edward hurry to my side when I reacted badly while hunting and leave his own kill undrained to come to me.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.source_text: Edward saw my reaction and hurried to my side, leaving his own kill undrained.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.description: I felt reassured when Edward spoke comfortingly to me and tried to relieve my sense of sole responsibility for protecting others.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.source_text: "Bella, what brought this on? Of course, it's wonderful that you can protect yourself, but you're not responsible for saving anyone. Don't distress yourself needlessl"

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.description: I heard him ask 'Headed out?' in a nonchalant tone and I registered the question.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.source_text: “Headed out?” Edward asked, his tone nonchalant.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.description: I noticed a sort of forced composure about his expression and I felt its presence.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.source_text: There was a sort of forced composure about his expression.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.description: I watched him hug Renesmee just a little bit tighter to his chest and I observed his protective gesture.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.source_text: He hugged Renesmee just a little bit tighter to his chest.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.description: I saw him smile my favorite smile and tell me to hurry back and I felt the intimacy in that exchange.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.source_text: He smiled my favorite smile. 'Hurry back to me.'

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.description: I realized he had demanded no reasons from me, which I interpreted as a deliberate restraint to avoid speculation.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc1.source_text: which explained why he had demanded no reasons from me. I guessed he was trying not to speculate too much, trying to keep my behavior off his mind.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward estimated they had about two more days.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc2.source_text: Edward estimated that we had about two more days.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc2.description: I learned that others, like J, were obviously aware that something was up with the Cullens.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc2.source_text: Not that J wasn’t obviously aware that there was something up with the Cullens, but it was still a good habit to practice.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella is identified in this meeting as Mr. Edward's bride and publicly associated with the Cullen family.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.source_text: “You would be Mr. Edward’s bride, then?” “Yes.”

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.description: I learned that Bella is preparing a contingency safe place for the little girl in case something were to happen to her husband and her.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.source_text: I’m simply preparing a safe place for her in case something were to happen to my husband and me.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.description: I learned that the Cullen family is a long-term client of J and that J offered future services for anything the Cullens might need.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.source_text: In the future, feel free to come to me for anything the Cullen family needs.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.description: I inferred that Edward must have taken Renesmee home to sleep.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.source_text: Edward must have taken Renesmee home to sleep.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.description: I felt reassured about Edward’s role because I assumed he had taken Renesmee home to sleep and care for her.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.source_text: Edward must have taken Renesmee home to sleep.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I stayed in the clearing with Carlisle for two days while anticipating the Volturi’s arrival.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: For two days, Edward and Carlisle stayed in the clearing where Alice had seen the Volturi arrive.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I observed Edward holding my hand and refusing to speak a final goodbye, which showed our mutual decision to remain connected until the end.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: Edward and I had not had a last grand scene of farewell... So we did not say our goodbyes, and we stayed very close to each other, always touching.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I watched Edward and Carlisle array the others into a front line with Carlisle, Emmett, Rosalie, Tanya, Kate, and Eleazar leading as witnesses.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: Edward and Carlisle were arraying the others into a loose formation, our witnesses to the sides like galleries.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward’s brief embrace with us and inferred that he might harbor more hope for something after this life than he let on.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: Edward cocked one eyebrow as I approached... He just put his arms tight around us both for one long moment and then, with a deep sigh, let us go. I couldn’t see a goodbye anywhere in his eyes. Maybe he had more hope for something after this life than he’d let on.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.description: I realized that the Volturi’s combined force and the supporting mob created an advantage so great that we had no realistic chance of victory.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.source_text: We didn’t have a prayer. Even if we could somehow neutralize the Volturi’s advantages, they could still bury us in bodies.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.description: I began to believe that Edward would be unable to protect us from being overwhelmed by sheer numbers despite any personal strengths.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.description: I heard Edward murmur that Alistair was right and state that Caius and Aro had come to destroy and acquire.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.source_text: “Alistair was right,” he murmured to Carlisle. “They—Caius and Aro—come to destroy and acquire,” Edward breathed almost silently back; only our side could hear.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward make a very low, fervent snarling sound indicating anger.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.source_text: Edward snarled, a very low but fervent sound.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.description: I inferred from Edward's words that he believed the Volturi had layered strategies and would not listen to the truth about Renesmee, reinforcing his determination to defend her.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.source_text: “They have many layers of strategy already in place. If Irina’s accusation had somehow proven to be false, they were committed to find another reason to take offense. But they can see Renesmee now, so they are perfectly sanguine about their course. We could still attempt to defend against their other contrived charges, but first they have to stop, to hear the truth about Renesmee.”

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward squeeze my hand and caution me as the standoff intensified.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.source_text: Edward squeezed the hand he still held, cautioning me.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.description: I heard Edward explain that the Volturi were weighing options and choosing key targets including me, Carlisle, Eleazar, and Tanya while noting concerns about unfamiliar faces and the wolves.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.source_text: “They’re not sure how to proceed. They’re weighing options, choosing key targets—me, of course, you, Eleazar, Tanya. Marcus is reading the strength of our ties to each other, looking for weak points. The Romanians’ presence irritates them. They’re worried about the faces they don’t recognize—Zafrina and Senna in particular—and the wolves, naturally. They’ve never been outnumbered before. That’s what stopped them.”

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.description: I watched Edward hesitate then nod, signaling Carlisle that this was the only chance to speak.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.source_text: Edward hesitated, then nodded. “This is the only chance you’ll get.”

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.description: I could feel the tension rolling off Edward as he listened to Aro's assessment.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.source_text: I could feel the tension rolling off Edward as he listened to Aro’s assessment of Carlisle’s words.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.description: I perceived Edward as tense and highly alert during the parley.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.source_text: The strain mounted as the seconds ticked by.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc6.description: I learned that Aro specifically demanded Edward be presented so Aro could obtain evidence directly from him and examine his mind.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "And the best way to get that is to have the evidence directly from your talented son."

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc6.description: I noticed Edward deliberately kissed my and Renesmee's foreheads and avoided meeting my eyes before he approached Aro, which updated my view of him as protective and resigned to confront the Volturi threat.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "Edward turned to quickly kiss my forehead and Renesmee’s, not meeting my eyes. Then he strode across the snowy field, clapping Carlisle on the shoulder as he passed."

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.description: I saw Edward move across the clearing toward Aro and noted that he crossed the midpoint, closer to them than to us.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.source_text: I saw Jane smile as Edward crossed the midpoint in the distance between us, when he was closer to them than he was to us.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.description: I observed Edward stop a few steps from Aro and present himself with an arrogant, confident posture.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.source_text: Edward stopped a few steps away from Aro, and I realized with some chagrin that though I certainly could, I should not prevent this exchange from happening.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.description: I decided that despite my ability to shield him continuously, I should withdraw my protection to allow Edward's exchange with Aro to proceed.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.source_text: It was almost physically painful to do it, but reluctantly I pulled my shield back and left Edward exposed again.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.description: I perceived Edward's attitude toward Aro as arrogant and as flattering to Aro, which influenced how I watched the negotiation.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.source_text: Edward’s chin came up arrogantly, and he held his hand out to Aro as if he were conferring a great honor.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.description: I learned that Aro absorbed Edward's memories and responded with awe and curiosity about the clarity of what he had seen.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.source_text: I doubt whether any two among gods or mortals have ever seen quite so clearly.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.description: I observed that Edward remained composed enough to speak calmly, asking 'You see?' in a velvet voice while Aro held his hand.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.source_text: 'You see?' Edward asked, his velvet voice calm.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.description: I realized that Edward endured significant strain while his muscles locked and bowed during the reading, which increased my belief in his resilience under pressure.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.source_text: Edward’s head bowed, too, the muscles in his neck locking tight as he read back again everything that Aro took from him, and Aro’s response to it all.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.description: I observed Edward nod reluctantly when Aro asked to be introduced to Renesmee and agree to the meeting.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.source_text: I watched Edward nod reluctantly after Aro asked, 'Will you introduce me to your daughter?'

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.description: I saw Edward allow Aro to maintain physical contact, and I felt that Aro had a persuasive hold on Edward in that moment.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.source_text: I saw Aro maintain contact with Edward's skin and drape an arm over his shoulder as they returned toward our side.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.description: I felt alarm and uncertainty because I noticed the muscles in Edward's back tighten even as he agreed, which suggested internal conflict.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.source_text: I observed the muscles in Edward's back tighten when Aro spoke and when Edward nodded in response.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.description: I heard Edward suggest bringing some of Aro's guard along to make them more comfortable.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.source_text: I heard 'Perhaps you should bring a few members of your guard with us,' Edward suggested.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.description: I watched Edward duck under Aro's arm and quickly join us, taking my hand.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.source_text: I watched 'Edward ducked under Aro’s arm and quickly joined us, taking my hand.'

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.description: I felt closer to Edward because I relied on his judgment in a dangerous diplomatic situation.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.source_text: I remembered 'I trusted Edward. He would know if Aro was planning any treachery at this point.'

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.description: I learned that Edward understands the distinction between subconscious stray thoughts and deliberate, purposeful thoughts.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.source_text: “I do know how that is. And I also know the difference between that kind of thought and the kind with a purpose behind it.”

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.description: I noticed Edward's neutrality vanish and his tone sharpen when Aro's attention turned toward Jacob and the wolves, reflecting increased alarm.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.source_text: “It doesn’t work that way,” Edward said, the careful neutrality gone from his suddenly harsh tone.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.description: I became aware that Edward viewed Aro as a potential threat to our family and readied himself to defend us.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.description: I observed Edward backing up immediately while pulling my arm and Emmett’s.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.source_text: Edward started backing up immediately, pulling my arm and Emmett’s.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.description: I felt Edward’s actions were protective toward me and Emmett as he led the retreat.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.source_text: Edward started backing up immediately, pulling my arm and Emmett’s.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.description: I believed retreat was chosen over immediate engagement as we hurried backward keeping our eyes on the advancing threat.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.source_text: We hurried backward, keeping our eyes on the advancing threat.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.description: I recognized Edward’s mental signature as the brightest of all the sparks I could feel.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.source_text: I already knew Edward’s—his was the very brightest of them all.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.description: I felt compelled to protect Edward and I adjusted my shield carefully to include him and other close allies like Carlisle.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.source_text: I flexed it now into a low, wide dome that arced over our company. I could feel the sharp plumes of light where my family and friends stood—each one an individual flavor that I thought I would be able to recognize with practice. I already knew Edward’s—his was the very brightest of them all. I sucked the shield back inch by inch, trying to wrap it as exactly to his body as I could.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward defended the pack and asserted they bore no relation to the Children of the Moon, positioning himself against Caius's accusation.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.source_text: “Caius, it’s the middle of the day,” Edward pointed out. “These are not Children of the Moon, clearly. They bear no relation to your enemies on the other side of the world.”

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.description: I recognized that Edward relied on Aro's authority to explain that the creatures present are not werewolves and that Aro could confirm the distinction.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.source_text: “They aren’t even werewolves. Aro can tell you all about it if you don’t believe me.”

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc4.description: I learned that Edward recognized Caius's intent and the deadly stakes of the situation.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc4.source_text: Caius knew this. So did Edward.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward made a disgusted sound under his breath, revealing his reaction to the Volturi's actions.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc4.source_text: I heard Edward make a disgusted sound under his breath.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc5.description: I heard Edward shout to stop them and I watched him seize Tanya's arm in an attempt to restrain her.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc5.source_text: "Stop them!" Edward cried out, jumping to grab Tanya’s arm as she lurched forward toward the smiling Caius with a maddened cry of pure rage.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc5.description: I heard Edward call for Zafrina when the situation escalated.
I noticed Edward and the others become guarded again, which made me see him as protective and alert in the crisis.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc5.source_text: And my attention returned to the weight of the stares that pressed down on our moment of chaos. From the corners of my eyes, I could see that Edward and everyone else besides Carlisle and Garrett were on their guard again as well.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.description: I learned that Aro had accessed Edward's memories to perceive Kate's potency.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.source_text: He knew what Kate could do. He had felt her potency through Edward’s memories.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.description: I wondered whether Aro believed Garrett had learned his own form of immunity instead of recognizing that my shield had evolved beyond what Edward knew.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.source_text: Did he understand what was happening now—did he see that my shield had grown in strength and subtlety far beyond what Edward knew me to be capable of? Or did he think Garrett had learned his own form of immunity?

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.description: I realized that Edward's memories could be used by Aro as evidence and that this made Edward's perceptions a tool for Volturi judgment.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.source_text: He knew what Kate could do. He had felt her potency through Edward’s memories.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc7.description: I learned from Amun's witness that others perceived the child as biologically Edward's and noted that she grows quickly and learns.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc7.source_text:
"That the child is his biologically. That she grows. That she learns."

"That she grows… quickly."

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc7.description: I observed Edward's immediate fury and his instinct to protect Bella when he hissed and restrained her, updating my view of his volatility and protectiveness.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc7.source_text:
Edward hissed, his hands balling up in fists so tight it looked like the bones in his knuckles would split through his diamond-hard skin.

Edward stepped back and wrapped a restraining hand around my wrist.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc8.description: I saw Edward growl in response to Aro's questions, showing immediate defensive aggression.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc8.source_text: Edward growled, a low ripping sound deep in his throat.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc8.description: I recognized Edward's protectiveness of his family and of Renesmee when he reacted to Aro's doubts about her future.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc8.source_text: Her own parents are plagued by fears of her future. We cannot know what she will grow to be.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc8.description: I felt more certain that Edward would oppose Volturi actions regarding Renesmee and that he would defend her fiercely.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc8.source_text: Edward growled, a low ripping sound deep in his throat.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.description: I learned that Edward Cullen is not listed among the present characters for this scene.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.source_text: Characters present: Garrett, Kate, Aro, Makenna, Charles, Eleazar, Bella Swan, Carlisle

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.description: I noticed that the immediate conflict centers on the Cullen family as a whole and Volturi motives rather than on any individual act by Edward in this moment.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.source_text: I came here at Carlisle’s request, as the others, to witness," he said. "That is certainly no longer necessary, with regard to the child. We all see what she is.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc10.description: I noticed Edward Cullen was not listed among the present characters in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc10.source_text: I quote: "Characters present: Aro, Makenna, Charles, Marcus, Caius, Renata, Felix, Demetri, Bella Swan, Garrett"

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.description: I realized that Edward had been kept from knowing about Renesmee by Aro and I observed the pain and understanding cross his face.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.source_text: "This is what you kept from me?" he whispered over her head. "From Aro," I breathed. "His face twisted with understanding and pain."

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.description: I heard Edward offer a complex farewell to Jacob that combined brotherly and paternal feeling when he said goodbye to him.
I perceived Edward's horror and helplessness at the plan while also noting that he accepted being included in my fate when he took my hand.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.source_text: "Edward's and Jacob's faces were almost identical masks of horror," and "Edward took my hand. He knew that he was included."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.description: I noticed that Edward can sense attempts to break bindings and identify attackers quickly, naming Jane when the assault began.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.source_text: I read that Edward whispered, 'Chelsea is trying to break our bindings' and that Edward gasped, 'Jane,' when the pointed attacks started.

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.description: I learned from observation that Edward understands the nature and timing of others' gifts, noting that Alec's power is slower and more insidious than Jane's.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.source_text: I read that Edward said Alec's gift is 'slower than Jane's' and that 'it creeps' and 'will touch us in a few seconds.'

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.description: I saw Edward take on a protective role by prioritizing actions to help allies reach key opponents and by preparing to defend the shield-bearer.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.source_text: I read that Edward said, 'I'll keep them off you' and that he was told to go after Demetri while Zafrina would keep attackers away from the shield.

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.description: I heard Edward insist on clarifying that the danger posed by our daughter stemmed from uncertainty about her future development.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.source_text:
“The danger you foresee from my daughter—this stems entirely from our inability to
guess how she will develop? That is the crux of the matter?”

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.description: I witnessed Edward propose that certainty about our daughter's future would remove the need for a council vote.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.source_text:
“So, if we could only know for sure,” Edward suggested, “exactly what she will
become… then there would be no need for a council at all?”

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.description: I heard Edward ask Aro courteously to have Jane stop attacking my wife during the discussion.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.source_text: “Aro, would you ask Jane to stop attacking my wife?” Edward asked courteously.

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.description: I perceived Edward's sudden exultant confidence that his argument could avert immediate destruction.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.source_text: Edward chuckled exultantly. “Then I do have something more to offer.”

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.description: I saw Edward confront the Volturi with a mix of restraint and controlled triumph that changed the council's mood.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc2.source_text:
Aro hesitated for a second, assessing this new mood warily before he answered. “Yes,
Edward? You have something further… ?”

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.description: I observed Aro look at Edward during his assessment of the situation.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.source_text: "Aro stared at Carlisle, and then Edward, and at last his eyes rested on me."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.description: I learned that Aro considered Edward among those he measured before concluding there was no threat.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.source_text: "There appears to be no danger. This is an unusual development, but I see no threat. These half-vampire children are much like us, it appears."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.description: I sensed that Aro's attention to Edward indicated Edward's presence mattered to the Volturi's judgment.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.source_text: "Aro stared at Carlisle, and then Edward, and at last his eyes rested on me."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.description: I learned that Edward believed the Volturi had given up and would not return.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.source_text: "Yes. They’ve given up. Like all bullies, they’re cowards underneath the swagger."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.description: I observed Edward physically reaffirm our family bond by embracing Nessie and me immediately after the threat ended.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.source_text: "Edward’s arms were around us in the same second."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.description: I recognized that Edward felt confident and triumphant, expressing relief and derision toward the Volturi’s posturing.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.source_text: "His smile was huge. 'Yes. They’ve given up. Like all bullies, they’re cowards underneath the swagger.' He chuckled."

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.description: I heard Edward explain that the outcome really boiled down to Bella.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.source_text: "So it was a combination of things there at the end, but what it really boiled down to was… Bella," Edward was explaining.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.description: I heard Edward say that the Volturi had been seriously shaken and that he imagined they would try to pick us off separately.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.source_text: "They’ve been seriously shaken; their confidence is shattered. But, yes, I’m sure they’ll recover from the blow someday. And then . . ." His eyes tightened. "I imagine they’ll try to pick us off separately."

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.description: I felt reassured by Edward's command of the story when I listened to him recount the conflict to the assembled group.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.source_text: Nahuel sat close beside her, listening while Edward told the rest of us the story of the conflict as only he knew it.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward needed to believe we had no remaining options in order to make Aro commit to his course of action.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc3.source_text: I know Edward had to think we were at a dead end for Aro's sake.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc3.description: I understood that Edward accepted and trusted Alice's plan enough to play along with her seeming abandonment for the greater strategy.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc3.source_text: that her defection was only a ruse because Edward had to believe that she’d abandoned us,

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.description: I observed Edward analyzing every shift of intention and control from the meadow encounter and attributing the Volturi's retreat to my shield.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.source_text: I read 'Edward went back to analyzing every shift of intention and control that had happened in the meadow today, declaring that it was my shield that had made the Volturi run away with their tails between their legs.'

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward joined the group in looking impressed at me, which changed my perception of how he viewed my role in the confrontation.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.source_text: I read 'The way everyone looked at me made me uncomfortable. Even Edward. It was like I had grown a hundred feet during the course of the morning.'

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.description: I observed Edward agree quickly that taking Nessie was probably a good idea because he believed she had not slept soundly.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.source_text: “That’s probably a good idea,” he agreed quickly. “I’m sure she didn’t sleep soundly last night, what with all the snoring.”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.description: I noticed Edward grinned at Jacob, showing a familiar, teasing rapport between them.
I heard Edward express that he fervently hoped things would be boring, indicating his desire for peace and normalcy.
I experienced crossing the river with Edward while we walked barely faster than human speed in no hurry and held hands.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.source_text: Once we were across the river, we walked barely faster than human speed, in no hurry, holding hands.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.description: I observed Edward expressing that he was thoroughly impressed with Jacob and that the wolves made a strong impact.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.source_text: “I have to say, I’m thoroughly impressed with Jacob right now,” Edward told me. “The wolves make quite an impact, don’t they?”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.description: I understood that Edward believes Nahuel looks at him as what his father should have been and looks at me as the life his mother should have had.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.source_text: “He looks at me and sees… what his father should have been.” “He looks at you and sees the life his mother should have had.”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc7.description: I felt Edward's affection when he murmured about celebrations and he put his hand under my chin to lift my lips to his.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc7.source_text: “A night for celebrations,” he murmured, and he put his hand under my chin to lift my lips to his.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc7.description: I heard Edward whisper my name in shock as my actions surprised him.
I experienced Edward's passion directly when his lips suddenly became fierce against mine and he broke my concentration.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc7.source_text: His lips, suddenly fierce against mine, broke my concentration.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.description: I watched Edward hear me and ask how I had done that.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.source_text: “I heard you,” he breathed. “How? How did you do that?”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.description: I noticed Edward tell me I was almost right and that he knew of just one exception.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.source_text: “You’re almost right.” He smiled, his eyes still a little wider than usual. “I know of just one exception.”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.description: I observed Edward promise to be good and to wait while I attempted the shield again.
I felt Edward’s eagerness and hunger when he kissed me and growled in frustration.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.source_text: “Damn it,” he growled, kissing hungrily down the edge of my jaw.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.description: I heard Edward murmur the repetition of 'forever' as an affirmation of our time together.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc8.source_text: “Forever and forever and forever,” he murmured.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward openly introduced Bella as his wife and took visible pride in doing so.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: “Let me introduce you to my wife.”

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I noticed Edward’s intense satisfaction at being able to call Bella his wife.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: It was the first time Edward had said that word since it was officially true; he seemed like he would explode with satisfaction saying it now.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I observed Edward expressing gratitude to Seth, Sue, and Billy for allowing Seth to come and for supporting Bella.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: “Thank you, as well. For letting Seth come. For supporting Bella today.”

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that Edward engaged politely with the Denali family and reconnected with Tanya.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.description: I saw Edward intervene by removing my attacker and moving me several feet away with sudden, cold hands.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Before I could register more than that, cold hands replaced the hot ones, and the air was suddenly whooshing past me."

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.description: I noticed Edward whisper that Jacob is right and I perceived a moment of conflict or doubt in him.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Jacob is right," he whispered.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.description: I observed Edward agree to prioritize our relationship in the moment and I received his promise to try to let the confrontation go.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.description: I experienced Edward being protective and affectionate as he waited, took my hand, pulled me through the guests, kissed me, and shielded me from the rice.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: Edward was waiting at the bottom of the stairs. I took his outstretched hand... Edward shielded me from the rice while I climbed in...

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.description: I felt Edward accelerate onto the black highway and drive quickly after we left.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: As we turned onto the black highway and Edward really hit the accelerator, I heard a noise over the purr of the engine...

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.description: I realized that if I could hear the distant noise from the forest then Edward certainly could hear it too.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: If I could hear it, then he certainly could.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.description: I noticed that most of the thrown rice missed but that someone, probably Emmett, threw with uncanny precision, causing ricochets off Edward's back.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: Most of it went wide, but someone, probably Emmett, threw with uncanny precision, and I caught a lot of the ricochets off Edward’s back.

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.description: I saw Edward standing waist-deep in the midnight water, pale in the moonlight and motionless with his hands on the surface.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: He stood, his back to me, waist deep in the midnight water, staring up at the oval moon. The pallid light of the moon turned his skin a perfect white, like the sand, like the moon itself, and made his wet hair black as the ocean. He was motionless, his hands resting palms down against the water;

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.description: I listened as Edward asked me to tell him immediately if he ever hurt me, showing his caution and care.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: “I promised we would try,” he whispered, suddenly tense. “If… if I do something wrong, if I hurt you, you must tell me at once.”

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.description: I noticed Edward shudder slightly and breathe more roughly when I touched his warm skin, indicating a strong physical reaction to my touch.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: He shuddered the tiniest bit at my warm touch. His breath came rougher now.

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.description: I heard Edward deflect the word beautiful, implying that he found me more striking than the moonlit scene.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc2.source_text: “But I wouldn’t use the word beautiful,” he continued. “Not with you standing here in comparison.”

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward feels intense guilt and believes he has already ruined what we shared.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I’ve already ruined this," he whispered.

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward consulted Carlisle for guidance about the dangers and meaning of physical love and that Carlisle warned him it could be very powerful.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I spoke to Carlisle after you and I made our bargain... Of course he warned me that this would be very dangerous for you."

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward also spoke to his brothers who described physical pleasure as great, and I learned that Edward found my blood uniquely potent.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I spoke to my brothers, too. They told me it was a very great pleasure... But I’ve tasted your blood, and there could be no blood more potent than that."

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.description: I observed Edward move from despair to a resolve to stop letting the past sour my happiness and to try to make me happy now.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "You’re right. The past is past... I’ll do whatever I can to make you happy now."

tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward acknowledged that I had altered him and that he viewed our intimacy as something powerful that affected him deeply.
tw-book4-chapter5_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "...you had already altered me so completely."

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc1.description: I heard Edward refuse to make any deals and to insist that he would not agree to risky compromises about my life.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: I will not make any deals with you.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc1.description: I observed that Edward can be highly controlled and protective, reacting visibly for a moment before regaining composure.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: I had the satisfaction of watching his eyes pop open wide for just a second before he controlled his expression.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward offers verbal reassurance about the Volturi and offers to sing to Bella to keep bad dreams away.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "They aren’t going to bother us anymore. You’ll be immortal soon, and they’ll have no reason." and "Do you want me to sing to you? I’ll sing all night if it will keep the bad dreams away."

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.description: I noticed that Edward is protective, attentive, and becomes anxious and physically comforting when Bella is upset.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "Bella?" Edward whispered, his arms tight around me, shaking me gently. "Are you all right, sweetheart?"

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.description: I observed that Edward initially resists Bella’s sudden, desperate physical advance but then relinquishes control and surrenders to intimacy.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "No, Bella,' he insisted... 'I can’t, Bella, I can’t!' ... But whatever the reason, he pulled my lips back to his, surrendering with a groan."

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.description: I felt that Edward experiences agonized self-control when confronted with Bella’s emotional extremes but chooses to comfort her despite his struggle.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "I can’t, Bella, I can’t!" and "It’s okay, love, you’re fine. I’m here."

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.description: I learned that Edward monitors practical details like school timing while also offering to stay as long as Bella wants on the island.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc2.source_text: "When does the semester start? I wasn’t paying attention before." and "We can stay as long as you want, Bella," he promised me."

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward claims he is not angry and that he can control himself better now.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text:
“I’m not angry.”
“Well . . .” He paused. “I didn’t hurt you, for one thing. It was easier this time, to control myself, to channel the excesses.”

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward bought or secured a house in Dartmouth as an investment and contingency.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text:
“Well, we sort of already have a house there. You know, just in case.”
“Real estate is a good investment.”

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward plans to tutor me in college if I struggle.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text:
“I’ll tutor you.”
“You’re going to love college.”

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I observed that Edward speaks Portuguese fluently while greeting the visitors.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: I could hear Edward’s low, velvet voice as he came back down the hall, conversing fluidly in what I assumed was perfect Portuguese.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I noticed that Edward is affectionate, teasing, protective, and supportive toward me.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text:
He touched my burning cheek and sighed. “I’m really going to miss that.”
“You can give up the college pretense now—you’ve gotten what you wanted.”
“Are you all right?”

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.description: I observed Edward laugh at my convoluted sentence and respond affirmatively.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: He laughed at my convoluted sentence. “Yes.”

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward approvingly called the musical choice very honeymoonish.
I noticed Edward admitted to already mangling the headboard and joked about limiting destruction to one area.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: I don’t know.… I’ve already mangled the headboard in the other room beyond repair—maybe if we limit the destruction to one area of the house, Esme might invite us back someday.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.description: I observed Edward speak Portuguese to Gustavo when the men finished their work.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.source_text: Edward sat up, keeping me cradled against him, and answered Gustavo in flowing Portuguese.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.description: I noticed Edward suggest lunch first when we realized we might be alone.
I recognized Edward's playful and affectionate behavior when he offered ideas to burn calories and then physically swept me up.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc4.source_text:
“Do you want to swim with the dolphins this afternoon—burn off the calories?” he asked.
But I didn’t finish. He’d already swept me up into his arms, and his lips silenced mine as he carried me with inhuman speed to the blue room.

tw-book4-chapter7_Sc1.description: I saw that Edward left a note saying he had gone to the mainland to hunt and would come back soon.
tw-book4-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: I’m hoping you won’t wake and notice my absence, but, if you should, I’ll be back very soon. I’ve just gone to the mainland to hunt. Go back to sleep and I’ll be here when you wake again. I love you.

tw-book4-chapter7_Sc1.description: I observed Edward return and immediately attend to me by wiping my forehead, holding me while I was sick, checking my temperature, and preparing food.
tw-book4-chapter7_Sc1.source_text: "I’m sorry," Edward was murmuring as he wiped a wintry hand across my clammy forehead. He held me anxiously, keeping my hair out of my face.
