tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.source_text: A vampire and a werewolf who were best friends.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.description: I suspected that the image of a vampire and a werewolf being best friends would explain Irina's decision to alert the Volturi.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.source_text: What had she seen? A vampire and a werewolf who were best friends. I’d been focused on that image, one that would obviously explain her reaction.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.description: I realized that the perceived friendship between a vampire and a werewolf could escalate tensions and endanger my family and allies.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc2.source_text: A vampire and a werewolf who were best friends.

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.description: I heard Emmett say that he did not expect Jacob or Sam to ignore an invasion, implying that the Quileute pack would respond to a Volturi attack.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.source_text: "do you think Jacob or Sam is going to ignore an invasion?"

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.description: I recognized that the Cullens' alliance with the pack has political and mortal consequences now that Aro knows about it.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.source_text: "thanks to Irina, Aro knows about our alliance with the pack now, too."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.description: I felt strongly that we should not sentence the Quileute allies to death by forcing them to fight without consent.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc3.source_text: "We don't have to sentence the Quileutes to death, either, Emmett!"

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.description: I watched Jacob arrive, check Renesmee frantically, and learn from the room's tone and words that all the Cullens believed they had been sentenced.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "He glanced down, eyes wide, at the wet spot on the floor, the scattered roses, the fragments of crystal. His fingers quivered." "All of us, Jacob," I whispered. "It’s over. We’ve all been sentenced to die."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.description: I noticed Jacob move from casual visitor to shaken protector as the severity of the situation registered on him.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "Jacob crossed the room in three long strides and dropped to his knees beside Renesmee and me. I could feel the heat shaking off his body as tremors rolled down his arms to his shaking hands."

tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.description: I felt Jacob's bond with Bella and Renesmee affirm as he physically checked Renesmee and demanded honesty and action from Bella.
tw-book4-chapter28_Sc4.source_text: I quote: "Is she okay?" he demanded, touching her forehead, tilting his head as he listened to her heart. "Don't mess with me, Bella, please!"

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.description: I observed Jacob snoring in the corner, a mountain of fur on the floor, twitching anxiously in his sleep.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.source_text: Jacob was snoring in the corner, a mountain of fur on the floor, twitching anxiously in his sleep.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.description: I watched Jacob lurch to his feet with a growl when Emmett cursed and heard his pack echo the sound in the yard.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.source_text: Emmett cussed loud enough that Jacob lurched to his feet with a growl. In the yard, his growl was echoed by his pack.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.description: I realized that Jacob and the wolves were preparing for the coming threat even though I believed that preparation might only get them killed with the rest of my family.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc1.source_text: Sam knew everything—the wolves were readying themselves for what was coming. Not that this preparation would do anything but get them killed with the rest of my family.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.description: I ordered Jacob to stay with Renesmee before I sprinted after the others.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.source_text: “Stay with Renesmee!” I all but shrieked at Jacob as I sprinted through the door.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.description: I smelled the wolf scent on the breeze from the east, indicating nearby wolves as we neared the treaty line.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.source_text: I could smell the hint of wolf in the breeze blowing from the east.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.description: I trusted Jacob enough to instruct him to remain with Renesmee rather than follow our pursuit.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc2.source_text: “Stay with Renesmee!” I all but shrieked at Jacob as I sprinted through the door.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.description: I learned that Alice told Sam it was of the utmost importance not to tell Jacob about seeing her until Sam spoke to Edward.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.source_text: Alice told me it was of the utmost importance that I say nothing to Jacob about seeing her until I spoke to you.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.description: I saw Sam arrive in human form flanked by two big wolves named Paul and Jared.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc3.source_text: Sam came through the trees a few hundred yards away, walking quickly toward us in his human form, flanked by two big wolves—Paul and Jared.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.description: I learned that Jacob could not abandon Renesmee and that the pack claimed they could not abandon him.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.source_text: Renesmee is as much as part of our family now as she is yours. Jacob cannot abandon her, and we cannot abandon him.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.description: I understood that the wolves intended to fight alongside the Cullens for Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.source_text: The wolves, too, would fight with us for Renesmee.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.description: I noted the pack's declared refusal to flee and I believed their pride and resolve made them unlikely to run away.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc4.source_text: Sam smiled grimly. "We don’t run away."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.description: I noticed that Jacob was not present with us at the river and that only the Cullens and I were moving on the trail.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc5.source_text: Carlisle nodded, and the others left.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.description: I learned that there are wolves in the nearby woods close to the Cullens' house and the cottage.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.source_text: the wolves in the nearby woods

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.description: I noticed the trail to the cottage took a circuitous route that stayed far clear of the Cullens' house and the wolves in the nearby woods, implying caution around the pack.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc6.source_text: the trail led back to the cottage by a circuitous route that stayed far clear of the Cullens’ house and the wolves in the nearby woods.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.description: I inferred that Jacob was not present during this exchange and not involved in the immediate decision to leave.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.source_text: Edward took my hand, and we ran.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.description: I realized that Jacob was not considered in Alice's note or in our immediate plan to return home.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc7.source_text: We should go home. There’s no time.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.description: I learned that Jacob had returned to human form and that he was holding Renesmee on his lap watching us with wide eyes.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "In the corner, Jacob was human again, with Renesmee on his lap, both of them watching us with wide eyes."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.description: I heard Jacob murmur to Renesmee that he wasn’t sure Carlisle’s friends would come and that we sounded a little outnumbered, which showed his concern.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "'I don’t know if Carlisle’s friends will come. I hope so. Sounds like we’re a little outnumbered right now,' Jacob murmured to Renesmee."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.description: I noticed Renesmee twist in Jacob’s arms to touch his cheek, which I saw as an intimate and protective bond between them.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc8.source_text: I quote: "Renesmee twisted in Jacob’s arms to touch his cheek."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.description: I noted that Jacob’s imprint on Renesmee drives a possessive desire often summarized as an imprinted werewolf giving the object of his imprint whatever she wants.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "The whole imprinted-werewolf-gives-the-object-of-his-imprinting-whatever-she-wants thing was getting old pretty fast."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.description: I saw Jacob insist he could take care of himself while also agreeing to keep a safe distance from the main house to help Renesmee’s introduction go more smoothly.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "I can take care of myself," Jacob interrupted. "I can do that. Company in the morning, huh?" "Yes. The closest of our friends. ... As long as you keep a safe distance from the main house . . ."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.description: I noticed Jacob’s face register the realization that he might be wrong about being able to defy the suggested distance when he looked at Edward.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc9.source_text: I quote: "Then he looked at Edward, his face stunned by the realization that he might be wrong. 'Do I?' Edward hesitated."

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.description: I learned that Jacob had withheld the worst news from Renesmee about having no hope and dying within a month.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.source_text: Jake had kept the worst from her as far as I could tell. The part about how we had no hope, how we all were going to die in a month’s time.

tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.description: I inferred that Jacob was protecting Renesmee by keeping the worst from her.
tw-book4-chapter29_Sc10.source_text: Jake had kept the worst from her as far as I could tell.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc2.description: I observed that Jacob Black is not present in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc2.source_text: Characters present: Bella Swan, Charlie Swan

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc6.description: I noticed that Jacob is not present or mentioned directly in the scene.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "Alice made me stand so that she could ease the dress over my hair and makeup."

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.description: I learned that my lost werewolf friend was absent and that Seth Clearwater had braved the throng of vampires to stand in for him.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.source_text: One scorching hug stood out from all the others—Seth Clearwater had braved the throng of vampires to stand in for my lost werewolf friend.

tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.description: I perceived that my werewolf connections included supporters like Seth who were willing to step in for absent friends.
tw-book4-chapter3_Sc11.source_text: One scorching hug stood out from all the others—Seth Clearwater had braved the throng of vampires to stand in for my lost werewolf friend.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.description: I saw Jacob more comfortable in his wolf form and observed him running in the woods on guard.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.source_text: Jacob was more comfortable in his wolf form at the moment; the stress was easier dealt with when he felt ready for a fight. He ran in the woods, on guard again.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.description: I noticed Jacob's protective stance and readiness to fight, which contrasted with my own lack of readiness.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.source_text: Jacob was more comfortable in his wolf form at the moment; the stress was easier dealt with when he felt ready for a fight.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.description: I wished that I could feel as ready to fight as Jacob did while he ran and stood guard.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc1.source_text: I wished that I could feel the same, could feel ready. He ran in the woods, on guard again.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.description: I noticed Jacob shadowing my steps with his body heat close behind me as I moved forward.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.source_text: The heat from Jacob’s body flamed close behind me as he shadowed my steps.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.description: I became aware that Jacob was impatient and skeptical during the exchange as he muttered complaints under his breath.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.source_text: “Oh please,” I heard Jacob complain under his breath.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.description: I knew Jacob remained physically protective and emotionally tense as he shifted behind me and questioned what Nessie was showing.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc3.source_text: What’s Nessie showing her?” he grumbled under his breath.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.description: I heard Renesmee say that she loves wolf-people like my Jacob, indicating affection between them.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.source_text: “I love humans. And wolf-people like my Jacob.”

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.description: I watched Renesmee drop Edward's hand to reach back and pat Jacob’s arm, showing a physical bond with Jacob.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.source_text: She dropped Edward’s hand to reach back and pat Jacob’s arm.

tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.description: I began to think that Renesmee’s appeal might win over allies including Jacob and perhaps influence others.
tw-book4-chapter30_Sc4.source_text: For a moment I thought that maybe what we were attempting might be possible. Maybe Renesmee could do the impossible and win over our enemies as she had our friends.

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.description: I learned that Jacob declared the werewolves would stop the Volturi if the Volturi refused to listen about Renesmee, indicating a willingness to take violent action to protect her.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.source_text: I read "If the Volturi won’t stop to listen about Nessie, I mean Renesmee, we will stop them."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.description: I noticed Jacob's longing and emotional connection to Renesmee when his eyes flickered to her in Carmen's arms and the narration described the longing as easy to read.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.source_text: I read "Jacob’s eyes flickered to Renesmee—still in Carmen’s arms with Kate hovering over them—and it was easy to read the longing in them."

tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.description: I observed Jacob correct his casual nickname 'Nessie' to the formal 'Renesmee' in front of Tanya, which showed his awareness of the seriousness of the council and his attempt to be respectful.
tw-book4-chapter31_Sc1.source_text: I read "If the Volturi won’t stop to listen about Nessie, I mean Renesmee," he corrected himself, remembering that Tanya would not understand his stupid nickname.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.description: I observed that Jacob was deeply upset because the werewolves' purpose to prevent human loss made him furious that murder was being condoned near pack borders.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.source_text: I saw Jacob even more upset because the werewolves existed to prevent the loss of human life and here was rampant murder being condoned barely outside the packs' borders.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.description: I understood that Jacob kept his mouth shut and glared at the floor to restrain himself for Renesmee's safety despite his anger.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.source_text: I observed Jacob keep his mouth shut and glare at the floor rather than the vampires in order to protect Renesmee.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.description: I realized that Jacob could not join the running pack because he could not bear to be away from Renesmee while she fascinated Carlisle's guests.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc1.source_text: I saw that Jacob would have happily joined them, except that he couldn't stand to be away from Renesmee, and Renesmee was busy fascinating the strange collection of Carlisle's friends.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.description: I saw Jacob grow more surly with each new addition and I observed him keep his distance whenever possible.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Of course, Jacob got more surly with each new addition. He kept his distance when he could..."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.description: I found myself thinking Jacob was increasingly resistant to the gathering after I heard him grumble to Renesmee about needing an index to remember all the new names.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.source_text: I read: "...and when he couldn’t he grumbled to Renesmee that someone was going to have to provide an index if anyone expected him to keep all the new bloodsuckers’ names straight."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.description: I noticed Jacob's attitude hardened toward the assembled vampires as more nomads arrived, indicating growing tension between him and the newcomers.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc6.source_text: I read: "Of course, Jacob got more surly with each new addition. He kept his distance when he could..."

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.description: I note that Jacob Black was not present at this meeting.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc7.source_text: I quote: 'Characters present: Bella Swan, Carlisle Cullen, Zafrina, Senna, Kachiri, Alice Cullen, Renesmee'

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.description: I saw Jacob holding Renesmee while I fought with Zafrina, which showed Jacob's presence and care during the training.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc9.source_text: I even fought once with Zafrina while Renesmee watched from Jacob’s arms.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.description: I noticed that Jacob was not listed among the present spectators and therefore was not involved in this practice session.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc10.source_text: Characters present: Bella Swan, Kate, Edward Cullen, Renesmee, Eleazar, Carmen, Tanya, Garrett, Benjamin, Tia, Siobhan, Maggie, Alistair, Zafrina, Senna

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.description: I shadowed the group from a few feet behind while staying present during the confrontation.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.source_text: Jacob shadowed them from a few feet behind.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.description: I remained nearby as a silent protector rather than directly intervening in Bella's confrontation with Kate.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc11.source_text: Jacob shadowed them from a few feet behind.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.description: I noticed that Jacob was not mentioned among the people moving into the front room to see the new visitors, implying he was not present in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc13.source_text: the front room was crowded—almost everyone had gone in to see the newest visitors—but there was barely any noise.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.description: I learned that we had an active alliance with the werewolves which other vampires noticed with interest.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.source_text: They seemed mysteriously delighted by our alliance with the werewolves.

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.description: I felt increased confidence in our position because the combination of Renesmee's influence and the werewolf alliance made our case stronger.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.source_text: Renesmee had won over so many in such a brief time. The Volturi only had to listen for just the tiniest second. . . .

tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.description: I recognized that the presence of the werewolves shifted others' perceptions and created unexpected goodwill among otherwise distant covens.
tw-book4-chapter32_Sc14.source_text: They seemed mysteriously delighted by our alliance with the werewolves.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc1.description: I expect Jacob will probably come with us to visit Charlie and Renesmee.
I noted that Jacob's attachment to Renesmee is strong and apparent to others.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc1.source_text: Though Charlie didn’t know anything about werewolf imprinting, no one could be oblivious to the attachment between Jacob and Renesmee.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc1.description: I believed Jacob would not voluntarily miss an afternoon with Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc1.source_text: There was no way Jacob would voluntarily miss an afternoon with Renesmee sans bloodsuckers.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.description: I heard Jacob complain 'Why can't we take your Ferrari?' when he met me in the garage.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.source_text: "Why can’t we take your Ferrari?" Jacob complained when he met me in the garage.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.description: I heard Jacob state that he was 'sick of all these reeking bloodsuckers' and call the Romanians 'Dracula One and Dracula Two,' showing his continued distrust and contempt.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.source_text: "I’m sick of all these reeking bloodsuckers." "Say what you want, I still think Dracula One and Dracula Two are creep-tacular."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.description: I noticed Jacob visibly relax as we pulled away from the house and I felt pleased that he still regarded me as Bella rather than as a vampire.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc2.source_text: He was visibly relaxing as we pulled away from the house and all its new inmates. It made me happy that I didn’t really count as a vampire to him. I was still just Bella.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.description: I watched Jacob raise one thick black brow in response to my question about controlling thoughts around Edward.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.source_text: He raised one thick black brow. "Yeah?"

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.description: I observed Jacob wait for me to add more and push out his lower lip while he thought about what little I'd said.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.source_text: Jacob waited for me to add something else, and then his lower lip pushed out while he thought about what little I’d said.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.description: I noticed Jacob was still chewing over our truncated conversation when we arrived at Charlie's.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc3.source_text: Jacob was still chewing over our truncated conversation when we got to Charlie’s.

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.description: I heard Jacob say I was "entertaining friends" and then snort while teasing Charlie about being out of the loop.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: "Entertaining friends," Jacob said, and then snorted. "You’re so lucky you’re out of the loop, Charlie."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.description: I perceived Jacob as playful and teasing toward Charlie while also being somewhat informed about certain things.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: "You’re so lucky you’re out of the loop, Charlie. That’s all I’m going to say."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.description: I believed that Jacob could not share much because he truly did not know the specifics of my plans despite his teasing.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc4.source_text: I quoted: "Even if he couldn’t help but think about this near Edward, at least there wasn’t much for him to share. He had no idea what I was up to."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.description: I decided to assign the forged identities Jacob Wolfe and Vanessa Wolfe to conceal Renesmee's identity.
I chose ages that would let Jacob plausibly be a twenty-seven-year-old stepfather for the girl.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.source_text: "Twenty-seven for the man, five for the girl."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.description: I believed Jacob could pull off the identity and serve as a protector because he was physically formidable.
tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.source_text: "Jacob could pull it off. He was a beast."

tw-book4-chapter33_Sc7.description: I planned for Jacob to act as the girl's stepfather and guardian under the assumed identity.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I noticed Jacob’s stance change and guessed that he was in Alpha mode to gather information for his pack.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: Jacob’s stance changed; his face turned serious and careful. I guessed that he was in Alpha mode now. Obviously, something had happened, and he was going to get the information he and Sam would need.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I imagined what I would say to Jacob and planned to give him the documents and instructions about taking Renesmee to Charlie if it was ever safe.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: I watched her and imagined the things I would say to Jacob right now if I didn’t have to keep my words out of Edward’s head. If it’s ever safe again, take her to Charlie. Tell him the whole story someday. I would have to give Jacob the documents before it was too late.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.description: I trusted Jacob to take Renesmee to Charlie and to carry my message about how much I loved him and how I couldn’t bear to leave him.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc2.source_text: If it’s ever safe again, take her to Charlie. Tell him the whole story someday. Tell him how much I loved him, how I couldn’t bear to leave him even when my human life was over.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.description: I heard Jacob declare that the packs would fight with the Cullens and that they were not afraid of vampires.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.source_text: "The packs will fight with the Cullens," Jacob said suddenly. "We're not afraid of vampires," he added with a smirk.

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.description: I noticed Jacob's mocking contempt for some vampires and his confidence that the younger members would protect the older ones.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.source_text: "Stupid leeches," he muttered. "They'll be shocked when the infants save their superior lives, won't they?" Jake smiled and punched his shoulder. "Hell yeah, they will."

tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.description: I observed Jacob accompany us on the hunt and tease Edward physically, which signaled camaraderie and alliance with the Cullens.
tw-book4-chapter34_Sc3.source_text: Jacob tagged along. Jake smiled and punched his shoulder. "Hell yeah, they will."

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob's passport and driver's license were part of the forged documents J produced and that the photo had been altered to disguise that they were the same.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.source_text: J had flipped Jacob’s picture and changed the coloring so that it wasn’t immediately evident that it was the same picture on both his passport and driver’s license.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.description: I noticed that Vanessa Wolfe's passport was among the items and that seeing it caused an immediate emotional reaction.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.source_text: I glanced at the picture on Vanessa Wolfe’s passport for a fraction of a second, and then looked away quickly, a lump rising in my throat.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.description: I understood that Jacob's identity documents are being handled as part of clandestine assistance provided to the Cullens.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc3.source_text: I can assure you every piece is perfect. All will pass the most rigorous scrutiny by experts.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.description: I inferred that Jacob was in the woods close by the cottage and therefore nearby.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.source_text: Jacob, no doubt, was in the woods close by the cottage.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.description: I believed Jacob remained close and watchful because I assumed he was in the woods near the cottage.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc4.source_text: Jacob, no doubt, was in the woods close by the cottage.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.description: I concluded that Rio de Janeiro was chosen as the likely escape destination for Jacob and Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.source_text: Rio seemed the best place to send them: It was far away from here, Alice and Jasper were already in South America at last report, and it wasn’t like our old problems had ceased to exist just because we had worse problems now.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.description: I expected Jacob to find the hidden note in the duffel bag.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.source_text: I took a deep breath and put the note at the bottom of the duffel bag, where Jacob would find it soon enough.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.description: I hoped Jacob had taken Spanish because Portuguese was unlikely to be offered at his high school.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.source_text: I crossed my fingers that—since it was unlikely that his high school offered Portuguese —Jake had at least taken Spanish as his language elective.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.description: I believed that if Jacob and Renesmee were reunited, Renesmee would have the best protection imaginable.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc5.source_text: If they were reunited, Renesmee would have the best protection imaginable.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I observed Jacob camping with us and snoring loudly while Renesmee slept nearby.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: It started to snow again the night before New Year’s Eve... While Renesmee and Jacob slept—Jacob snoring so loudly I wondered how Renesmee didn’t wake—

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I watched Jacob emerge from the tent to join the wolves as they moved in the woods before the confrontation.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: Soon after we all were together, we could hear the wolves moving in the woods. Jacob emerged from the tent, leaving Renesmee still sleeping, to join them.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I realized that the triangular relationship between Jacob, Edward, and me had shifted into a balanced cooperation rather than the earlier heartbreaks.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: Seven months ago, our triangular relationship seemed impossible... Now everything was in perfect balance.

tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.description: I pictured Jacob’s face when I asked Renesmee to withhold news of our escape plan until I told her to run.
tw-book4-chapter35_Sc6.source_text: In my head, I saw Jacob’s face.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.description: I learned that Jacob would not be able to outrun the approaching danger even if a key Volturi like Demetri were killed.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.source_text: Even if we killed Demetri, Jacob would not be able to outrun this.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.description: I felt less confident in Jacob’s capacity to save us after understanding the scale of the threat and the limits of his speed against a crowd.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.source_text: Even if we killed Demetri, Jacob would not be able to outrun this.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.description: I updated my view of Jacob to include the painful recognition that his abilities had practical limits in the face of overwhelming numbers.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc2.source_text: Even if we killed Demetri, Jacob would not be able to outrun this.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.description: I heard Jacob give a strange little huff during the tense moments before the wolves joined us.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.source_text: Jacob gave a strange little huff.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.description: I counted Jacob among the seventeen wolves who formed a defensive ring around us.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.source_text: There were sixteen of them spaced evenly around us—seventeen total, counting Jacob.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.description: I saw Jacob as part of a young pack willing to stand with us despite the mortal risk to their entire species.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc3.source_text: The wolves had joined us. If any of the wolves stood with us, the Volturi would be sure to search out the rest. They had gambled their entire species on this stand.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.description: I realized the Volturi were explicitly worried about the wolves’ presence, which implied Jacob and his pack were considered a significant factor.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.source_text: They’re worried about the faces they don’t recognize—Zafrina and Senna in particular—and the wolves, naturally.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.description: I understood that the Volturi’s hesitation was partly due to being outnumbered, a situation the wolves helped create.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc4.source_text: They’ve never been outnumbered before. That’s what stopped them.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.description: I heard a growl rumble through Jacob's chest when Caius pointed at Renesmee.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.source_text: A growl rumbled through Jacob’s chest.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.description: I observed Jacob physically connected to Renesmee through her fingers tangled in his fur.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.source_text: where she clung to my back, her fingers still tangled in Jacob’s fur.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.description: I recognized Jacob as fiercely protective and prepared to respond aggressively to threats against the child.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc5.source_text: A growl rumbled through Jacob’s chest.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc6.description: I observed that Jacob is not mentioned or present in this scene, so I learned no new information about him here.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc6.source_text: I quote: "I heard a low whimper from behind me—Esme’s terror breaking through."

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.description: I saw Jacob glance at me and roll his eye down to stare at me during my sudden display of power.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.source_text: I felt the others glancing at me and saw Jacob’s big black eye roll down to stare at me like I’d lost my mind.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.description: I felt that Jacob's look communicated disbelief or concern about my actions, which updated my sense of how he viewed my control of the situation.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc7.source_text: I felt the others glancing at me and saw Jacob’s big black eye roll down to stare at me like I’d lost my mind.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.description: I learned that Jacob was not listed among those present in this scene and I therefore had no direct information about him here.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc8.source_text: Characters present: Aro, Edward Cullen, Bella Swan, Zafrina, Renata, Jane, Alec, Caius, Felix, Demetri

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.description: I noticed Jacob was present among those protecting us at the meeting with the Volturi.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.source_text: I saw Jacob present among the group on our side.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.description: I felt reassured by Jacob's presence as part of our defenders even though he did not speak during this exchange.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc9.source_text: I watched Jacob remain with our side while Aro and Edward crossed back toward us.

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.description: I selected Jacob because I believed he could not bear being left behind and would insist on accompanying us.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.source_text: I said 'Jacob, because he wouldn’t be able to bear being left behind.'

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.description: I heard the Volturi guard rumble in mistrust at my choice of Jacob and observed Aro waving their protest away.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.source_text: I heard 'Another rumble came from the guard as they saw my choices and Aro lifted his hand, waving away their protest again.'

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.description: I noticed Jacob's low growl at Demetri's comment and felt reinforced in my belief that Jacob would protect Renesmee fiercely.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc10.source_text: I noticed 'Edward didn’t respond, but a low growl slipped through Jacob’s teeth.'

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.description: I learned that the wolves are committed to protecting human life, which enables coexistence with the Cullens but makes them incompatible with Volturi control.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.source_text: “They’re committed to protecting human life, Aro. That makes them able to coexist with us, but hardly with you.”

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.description: I observed that the pack openly chose the Cullens' side, responding with furious snarls that were called off by command and then peaceful obedience.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.source_text: There was one second of dead silence, and then the sound of the furious snarls ripping from the entire pack filled the giant clearing. There was a sharp bark of command... and the complaint broke off into ominous quiet. “I suppose that answers that question,” Aro said, laughing again. “This lot has picked its side.”

tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.description: I saw Aro look at Jacob with an unexpected longing and curiosity, which shifted how Aro regarded the wolves from disgust to interest.
tw-book4-chapter36_Sc11.source_text: His eyes moved unexpectedly to Jacob, and instead of the disgust the other Volturi viewed the giant wolf with, Aro’s eyes were filled with a longing that I did not comprehend.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.description: I watched Jacob retreat slowest with the fur on his shoulders standing straight up as he bared his fangs at Aro.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.source_text: Jacob retreated slowest, the fur on his shoulders standing straight up as he bared his fangs at Aro.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.description: I noticed Renesmee restrained Jacob by grabbing his tail, which showed she could control him in tense moments.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.source_text: Renesmee grabbed the end of his tail as we retreated; she held it like a leash, forcing him to stay with us.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.description: I felt that Jacob remained aggressive toward Aro despite being held by Renesmee, which changed my view of how restrained he truly was.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc1.source_text: Jacob retreated slowest, the fur on his shoulders standing straight up as he bared his fangs at Aro. Renesmee grabbed the end of his tail as we retreated; she held it like a leash, forcing him to stay with us.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.description: I learned that most of the werewolves were unprotected unless their Alpha was inside my shield.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.source_text: With sudden panic, I realized that most of the werewolves were unprotected. I was about to reach out to them when I realize that, strangely, I could still feel their sparks. Curious, I drew the shield tighter in, until Amun and Kebi—the farthest edge of our group—were outside with the wolves. Once they were on the other side, their lights vanished. They no longer existed to that new sense.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.description: I changed my belief about the wolves’ mental cohesion when I realized their minds were more interconnected than I had imagined.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.source_text: Their minds must have been more interconnected than I’d imagined.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.description: I updated my view to see the wolves as a linked group whose protection depended on whether their Alpha was covered by my shield.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc2.source_text: If the Alpha was inside my shield, the rest of their minds were every bit as protected as his.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.description: I understood that Jacob is among the creatures described by Aro, who stated they inherit their shape-shifting genetically and do not spread by infection like true werewolves.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.source_text: “It’s genetic—they do not continue their species by infecting others the way true werewolves do.”

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.description: I noticed that Jacob appeared uncertain about Edward's claim, as shown by his shrugged reaction when Bella looked at him.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc3.source_text: “Not werewolves? I shot a mystified look at Jacob. He lifted his huge shoulders and let them drop—a shrug. He didn’t know what Edward was talking about, either.”

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.description: I knew that Demetri would hunt the Volturi witnesses until they were extinct.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.source_text: Demetri would hunt them until they were extinct, too.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.description: I concluded that Demetri had to die to protect Jacob and Renesmee and to safeguard others involved.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.source_text: For Jacob and Renesmee, for Alice and Jasper, for Alistair, and for these strangers who had not known what today would cost them, Demetri had to die.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.description: I asserted that I prioritized Jacob and Renesmee's safety highly enough to accept extreme measures against threats like Demetri.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc6.source_text: For Jacob and Renesmee, for Alice and Jasper, for Alistair, and for these strangers who had not known what today would cost them, Demetri had to die.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.description: I learned that Jacob Black is not present in the list of attendees for this scene.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.source_text: Characters present: Garrett, Kate, Aro, Makenna, Charles, Eleazar, Bella Swan, Carlisle

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.description: I observed that Garrett appealed specifically to nomads and wanderers, which does not directly involve Jacob but frames the broader political stakes Jacob's allies might face.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc9.source_text: I stayed to witness something else. You." He jabbed his finger toward the wary vampires. "Two of you I know—Makenna, Charles—and I can see that many of you others are also wanderers, roamers like myself.

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc10.description: I noticed Jacob Black was not listed among the present characters in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc10.source_text: I quote: "Characters present: Aro, Makenna, Charles, Marcus, Caius, Renata, Felix, Demetri, Bella Swan, Garrett"

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.description: I watched Jacob accept Renesmee and physically prepare to carry her as she climbed onto his back and settled between his shoulder blades.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.source_text: "Edward kissed Renesmee's forehead and both her cheeks, then he lifted her to Jacob’s shoulder. She scrambled agilely onto his back, pulling herself into place with handfuls of his fur, and fit herself easily into the dip between his massive shoulder blades."

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.description: I experienced Jacob's deep devotion through his actions and Bella's reciprocal affection when she told him she loved him and called him her best man.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.source_text: "He whined again, and dipped his head to butt it against my shoulder." "I love you, too, Jake. You’ll always be my best man."

tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.description: I observed Jacob's emotional turmoil transform into fierce protectiveness as shown by his low growl, stiff hackles, exposed teeth, and the large tear in his fur.
tw-book4-chapter37_Sc11.source_text: "Jacob was growling quietly, a low rasp that was as even and unbroken as a purr. His hackles were stiff and his teeth exposed." "A tear the size of a baseball rolled into the russet fur beneath his eye."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.description: I observed that Jacob is not present in this described confrontation and that he is not listed among the characters actively engaging the Volturi in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc1.source_text: I read the character list indicating the present participants and noted that Jacob Black was not listed among Edward, Bella, Carlisle, Jane, Tanya, Vladimir, Stefan, Alec, Benjamin, Zafrina, and Kate.

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.description: I noticed Jacob shuddered visibly when Nahuel spoke about his age and nature.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.source_text: "I felt a shudder tremble through Jacob’s body."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.description: I decided not to dwell on Jacob's reaction in the moment and to wait until the danger had passed before I considered it.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.source_text: "I didn’t want to think about this yet. I would wait till the danger was past and I could concentrate."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.description: I recognized Jacob's visceral response to Nahuel as evidence of how strongly he is affected by other supernatural presences.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc4.source_text: "I felt a shudder tremble through Jacob’s body."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.description: I learned that Jacob had been carrying Nessie on his back as a giant russet wolf prior to handing her to me.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.source_text: "I half-climbed the giant russet wolf to rip my daughter off his back and then crushed her to my chest."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.description: I noticed Jacob’s playful, familial affection in the moment when he laughed and poked the back of my head with his nose.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.source_text: "Jacob laughed his big, barky laugh and poked the back of my head with his nose."

tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.description: I realized that Jacob remained a close, protective presence rather than an antagonist in this scene.
tw-book4-chapter38_Sc5.source_text: "Jacob laughed his big, barky laugh and poked the back of my head with his nose."

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.description: I saw Jacob listed among the characters present in the gathering at the Cullens' house.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc1.source_text: Characters present: Edward, Bella, Vladimir, Stefan, Benjamin, Tia, Amun, Kebi, Peter, Charlotte, Jasper, Zafrina, Nessie, Siobhan, Carlisle, Maggie, Liam, Alistair, Tanya, Kate, Garrett, Huilen, Nahuel, Emmett, Jacob, Alice, Esme

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.description: I saw that Jacob kept an unchanged expression while I focused on Nessie, indicating no outward surprise from him.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.source_text: I read 'I tried to ignore the impressed looks, mostly keeping my eyes on Nessie’s sleeping face and Jacob’s unchanged expression.'

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.description: I felt reassured that Jacob would still see me as just Bella, which updated my sense of safety in our relationship.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.source_text: I read 'I would always be just Bella to him, and that was a relief.'

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.description: I hoped Jacob would not soon realize the implications of Nahuel noticing Nessie because I wanted to avoid more conflict.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc4.source_text: I read 'I didn’t think this idea had occurred to Jacob yet. I kind of hoped it wouldn’t soon.'

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.description: I heard Jacob admit it had been a while since he slept in a bed and I learned he thought his dad would get a kick out of having him under his roof again.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.source_text: “It’s been a while since I slept in a bed. I bet my dad would get a kick out of having me under his roof again.”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.description: I noticed Jacob show affection by kissing the top of Nessie’s head and then the top of mine and by punching Edward’s shoulder before leaving.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.source_text: He got up, stretched, kissed the top of Nessie’s head, and then the top of mine. Finally, he punched Edward’s shoulder.

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.description: I heard Jacob suggest that things were going to be kind of boring now, revealing his expectation of quieter days ahead.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc5.source_text: “See you guys tomorrow. I guess things are going to be kind of boring now, aren’t they?”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.description: I noticed that Jacob does not view Nessie as someone he wants to hurry into adulthood and that he prioritizes her happiness over her rapid maturation.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.source_text: “He doesn’t see her that way. He’s not in a hurry for her to grow up. He just wants her to be happy.”

tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.description: I heard Edward suggest that Jacob will face competition when Nessie matures, indicating a potential future rivalry.
tw-book4-chapter39_Sc6.source_text: “Of course, it looks like he’ll have some competition to worry about when the time comes.”

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that Jacob is described as the heir to the Quileute magic who has turned his back on it.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: It flowed straight through him. It flowed to his son, the heir to the magic, who had turned his back on it.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I understood that the Quileute wolves anticipated a breach of the treaty with the Cullens and were concerned about how they would react.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: The wolves knew a breach was coming, but the Cullens had no idea how they would react.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.description: I learned that Sam Uley was acting as the chief of legends and magic in place of Jacob.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc1.source_text: That left Sam Uley to act as the chief of legends and magic now. . . .

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob confronted me angrily and spoke harshly, accusing me and shaking me while demanding answers.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Bella! Have you lost your mind? You can't be that stupid! Tell me you're joking!"

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.description: I observed that Jacob threatened to kill Edward in a whisper and that his rage was intense.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "I'll kill you," Jacob said, his voice so choked with rage that it was low as a whisper.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.description: I saw Jacob being physically restrained and led away by Seth and Sam to prevent a fight.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Seth—the gangly, fifteen-year-old Seth—had his long arms around Jacob's shaking body, and he was tugging him away."

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.description: I heard a piercing, heartbroken howling from the forest that grew fainter and then disappeared entirely.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: The piercing, heartbroken howling grew fainter and then disappeared entirely.

tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.description: I understood that the distant howling could be heard by us from the car as we left and that it faded as we drove away.
tw-book4-chapter4_Sc4.source_text: As we turned onto the black highway and Edward really hit the accelerator, I heard a noise over the purr of the engine, coming from the forest behind us... The piercing, heartbroken howling grew fainter and then disappeared entirely.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc1.description: I noticed that Jacob Black is not mentioned or present in this island scene.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc1.source_text: My entertainment became the number-one priority on Isle Esme.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I noticed a physical reminder labeled as the Jacob-drawer that rattled and brought him to mind.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: The Jacob-drawer, all but forgotten, rattled, and I amended the thought—for almost everyone.

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I realized that thoughts of Jacob complicate my feelings and decisions about staying human or becoming something else.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text:
The Jacob-drawer, all but forgotten, rattled, and I amended the thought—for almost everyone.
“This wasn’t getting any easier. Now that I’d discovered exactly how good being human could be, it was tempting to let my plans drift.”

tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.description: I recognized that my relationship or feelings toward Jacob remain unresolved and continue to influence my choices.
tw-book4-chapter6_Sc3.source_text: The Jacob-drawer, all but forgotten, rattled, and I amended the thought—for almost everyone.

tw-book4-chapter7_Sc2.description: I remembered that Jacob had told me, less than twenty-four hours earlier, that Edward was a vampire.
tw-book4-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: It had been less than twenty-four hours since Jacob Black, trying to entertain me with the Quileute legends he didn’t believe in yet, had told me that Edward was a vampire.

tw-book4-chapter7_Sc2.description: I began to take Jacob’s stories and the vampire legends I skimmed online more seriously as I connected them to the signs I was witnessing.
tw-book4-chapter7_Sc2.source_text: I’d scanned anxiously through the first entries on the site, which was dedicated to vampire myths around the world.

tw-book4-chapter7_Sc4.description: I noticed the narrative heading shift explicitly to Jacob with the label indicating the next section.

tw-book1-chapter12_Sc1.description: I learned that Jacob has not finished fixing his car and that he still needs parts like a master cylinder.
tw-book1-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: "No." He frowned. "I still need parts. We borrowed that one." "Master cylinder." He grinned.

tw-book1-chapter12_Sc1.description: I observed that Jacob is close to and protective of his father and that he cares about seeing me, displaying both pride and embarrassment.
tw-book1-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: Jacob grinned. "I think that's the plan — our TV broke last week." Jacob scowled and ducked his head while I fought back a surge of remorse. "And, of course, Jacob was anxious to see Bella again," he added.

tw-book1-chapter12_Sc1.description: I noticed that Jacob physically helps his father into the house and assists with the wheelchair.
tw-book1-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: Are you and your friends coming back to the beach soon?" Jacob asked as he pushed his father over the lip of the threshold.

tw-book1-chapter12_Sc2.description: I learned that Jacob was involved in a tense evening with Bella and Billy earlier in the week.
tw-book1-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: The tense evening with Billy and Jacob seemed harmless enough now; I decided to forget it completely.

tw-book1-chapter12_Sc2.description: I noticed that Bella's attitude toward the earlier tension with Jacob had softened by the next morning.
tw-book1-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: The tense evening with Billy and Jacob seemed harmless enough now; I decided to forget it completely.

tw-book1-chapter17_Sc1.description: I saw Jacob stand behind his father's wheelchair and stare down with a mortified expression.
tw-book1-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: Leaning away from the rain under the shallow front porch, Jacob Black stood behind his father's wheelchair. Jacob stared down, his expression mortified.

tw-book1-chapter17_Sc1.description: I learned that Jacob went back out into the rain to look for a new picture of Rebecca in the trunk.
tw-book1-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: "Why don't you go get that new picture of Rebecca out of the car? I'll leave that for Charlie, too." "Jacob slouched back out into the rain."

tw-book1-chapter17_Sc1.description: I defended Jacob when Edward called him a child by insisting that Jacob is not that much younger than I am.
tw-book1-chapter17_Sc1.source_text: "The child has no idea." "Jacob is not that much younger than I am," I reminded him.

tw-book1-chapter22_Sc2.description: I noticed that Jacob Black is not mentioned in this scene and I concluded he is not involved here.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.description: I learned that Jacob attended the prom because his father paid him twenty dollars to be there as a 'safe' place to talk.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: I heard Jacob admit that his dad paid him twenty bucks to come to the prom and I listened as he called the gym a 'safe' place to talk to me.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.description: I noticed that Jacob had grown significantly and that he reported his height as six-two after a recent growth spurt.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: I heard Jacob say he was six-two and I watched him look gangly and uncoordinated following a recent growth spurt.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.description: I sensed that Jacob still had affectionate feelings for me when he awkwardly told me I looked really pretty and acted apologetic.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc2.source_text: I watched Jacob approach with embarrassment and I heard him tell me I looked really pretty while he stood apologetic beside me.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob came to convey a warning and that his verbal message included the phrase "We'll be watching."
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: "We'll be watching." He watched warily for my reaction.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.description: I observed Jacob grin in relief after delivering the message and appraise my dress with his eyes raking over me.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: "I don't mind that much." He grinned in relief. His eyes were appraising as they raked quickly over my dress.

tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.description: I noticed Jacob offered to tell Billy that I said to "butt the hell out" and showed a willingness to intervene on my behalf.
tw-book1-chapter25_Sc3.source_text: So, should I tell him you said to butt the hell out?" he asked hopefully.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I found Jacob surprised and overjoyed to see me, smiling like the sun breaking free of the clouds.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: Bella! he yelled back, and the smile I’d been waiting for stretched across his face like the sun breaking free of the clouds.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I experienced Jacob grabbing me in a bear hug so tight I couldn’t breathe.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: Jacob grabbed me up in a bear hug too tight to breathe and swung me around in a circle.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I watched the face of my friend harden into a bitter mask when we discussed the reasons behind our separation.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: the face of my friend hardened into the bitter mask that was already too familiar.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.description: I noticed Jacob’s face relax and his voice become calmer after I began to explain what had happened.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc2.source_text: His face relaxed, and his voice was calmer when he spoke.

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I learned from Jacob that Sam and the pack prioritized Victoria and that the pack was restricted from crossing the treaty line.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "So Sam and the head vamp agreed that Victoria was the priority, and we started after her again. Carlisle gave us the line, so that we could follow the scent properly, but then she hit the cliffs just north of Makah country, right where the line hugs the coast for a few miles."

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob believes Sam is angry at Bella because Sam felt betrayed when she allowed the Cullens back into her life.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Did you know Sam is mad at you?" and "Sam feels sort of . . . betrayed that you would just let them back into your life like they never hurt you."

tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.description: I noticed Jacob's frustration and jealousy regarding Bella's relationship with Edward and I sensed that Jacob struggled to accept her choices.
tw-book3-chapter4_Sc3.source_text: I quote: "Is that what it comes down to?" and "Is it the money, then?"

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.description: I learned that Jacob treasures Bella's humanity intensely and is acutely aware that her life is finite.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: Jacob was even more obsessed with my humanity than Edward. He treasured every one of my heartbeats, knowing that they were numbered.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.description: I observed that Jacob physically shook Bella in a panic when he believed she would give up her human life.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: He shook me. “Bella! Have you lost your mind? Tell me you’re joking!” He shook me again.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.description: I noticed that Jacob views Bella's choice of Edward as equivalent to a fate worse than death.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: Because—in Jacob’s eyes—by choosing Edward, I was choosing a fate that was worse than death, or at least equivalent to it.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.description: I saw that Jacob chose to be Bella's friend, presenting himself as her best friend one last time despite his inner turmoil.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc3.source_text: “I’m just here to be your friend. Your best friend, one last time.”

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.description: I noticed that Jacob Black is not present or mentioned in this scene and that the interaction focuses solely on my relationship with Edward.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc4.source_text: I grabbed his chin and leaned forward so that our faces were inches apart.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.description: I decided to act alone against the Cullens despite the pack's decision not to attack anyone today.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: Nope, the pack wasn’t attacking anyone today. But I was.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.description: I felt overruled by Sam when his voice of the Alpha took over and the pack accepted his ruling.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: Enough, Jacob. You’re overruled. Sam’s mental voice changed, took on that strange double timbre that we could not disobey. The voice of the Alpha.

tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.description: I declared that I was not afraid to die and accepted the personal risk of opposing the Cullens alone.
I was accused of having a sick hero worship for the Cullens, which influenced how other wolves judged my motives.
tw-book4-chapter8_Sc6.source_text: Just ’cause you’ve got some kind of sick hero worship thing going on with that bloodsucker, it doesn’t change the law.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.description: I admitted that I followed Edward out the front door despite not promising to behave and despite the danger.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: I wasn’t making any promises today. I looked away and then followed Edward out the front door.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.description: I realized that I felt no sympathetic fire when Edward crumpled and that I was cold and ready for violence rather than moved by his pain.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: But I felt cold as snow—there was no fire in me.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.description: I growled and admitted that patience is not my specialty when Edward asked for time.
I understood that my desire for a fight with Edward intensified when I saw him vulnerable and that my view of him shifted from a confident predator to a wounded, pitiable figure.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc2.source_text: His broken helplessness irritated me. I wanted a fight, not an execution. Where was his smug superiority now?

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I learned that Edward asked me to talk some sense into Bella, even though I rarely succeed at making her listen.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "Did he ask you to yell at me?" "Sort of. Though I can’t figure why he thinks you’d listen to me. You never have before."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I realized that every second I spend with Bella will add to the pain I will endure later, like a junkie using a limited supply.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "I did know this—every second I spent with her was only going to add to the pain I would have to suffer later. Like a junkie with a limited supply, the day of reckoning was coming for me."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I came to doubt that the idea of imprinting or future love could justify the immediate pain of Bella's choice and I questioned the point of our suffering.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "If you think that imprinting could ever make sense of this insanity . . . Do you really think that just because I might someday imprint on some stranger it would make this right?"

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I acknowledged that I needed Bella to stay alive in some form and that I pleaded with her not to wait until it was too late to be changed.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "I realized I needed her to stay alive, in some form. In any form. I took a deep breath. 'Don’t wait until it’s too late, Bella. Not that way.'"

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.description: I remembered that I once listened to Carlisle's instructions because Bella asked me to, and I cited that as precedent for listening to reason.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc3.source_text: "Remember when I got mangled up by those newborns? What did you tell me?" "You told me to be good and listen to Carlisle," I reminded her. "And what did I do? I listened to the vampire. For you."

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.description: I learned that the pack can synchronize thoughts and actions and that most were moving in unison.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: The pack was pacing in synchronization now, thinking in synchronization, all but myself and one other.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.description: I changed from expecting the pack to punish me for breaking orders to understanding that their priority was killing the threat to protect the tribe.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: At first their anger was undefined, and I thought I was in for it. They could do whatever they wanted to me for circumventing orders. If they won’t kill it, we have to.

tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.description: I recognized Sam and others taking leadership roles and heard their strategic thoughts about needing surprise and readiness to fight.
tw-book4-chapter9_Sc4.source_text: Sam’s hackles were sticking straight up, and he was growling in an unbroken stream as he paced back and forth around the top of the ring. We’ll need surprise on our side, Sam thought.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.description: I learned that I agreed to speak to Bella at Edward's request to try to 'talk some sense into' her.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: "Did he really ask you to talk to me?" I nodded. "To talk some sense into you."

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.description: I realized that spending time with Bella will increase my future pain because of my feelings for her.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: every second I spent with her was only going to add to the pain I would have to suffer later.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.description: I judged Bella as a martyr who beats herself up and expressed frustration at her self-blame.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc1.source_text: Sickening. He was right—she was beating herself up about hurting his feelings. The girl was a classic martyr.

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.description: I confirmed my place in the pack structure and I observed that Sam, Paul, Jared, Embry, Seth, Leah, and others were all present and mentally unified in concern.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: "Paul found them when I did, so the pack was complete."

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.description: I shifted from stunned confusion to active defense of Bella, howling in protest when the idea of killing her or shortening her life was entertained.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: "I howled. She’s human, too! Doesn’t our protection apply to her?"

tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.description: I recognized Sam's leadership and authoritative control over the pack and I accepted his command to restrain the pack despite my personal anger.
tw-book4-chapter10_Sc3.source_text: "Stop! he ordered in the double timbre of the Alpha."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I noticed that Sam started moving the others into formation while I was still on the ground.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "Sam started moving the others into formation while I was still on the ground."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I embraced my birthright and I felt the bonds fall off my body as I accepted Alpha power.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "The bonds fell off my body the second that I embraced my birthright."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I understood that an Alpha's authority binds the pack to move and think together and that this authority could be broken by me.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "There was a good reason for the Alpha’s authority. Even a pack as strong as ours wasn’t much of a force without a leader."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I felt that Alpha power is hollow without a pack and I experienced a sudden loneliness because I had no pack in that moment.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "Hollow because an Alpha’s power came from his pack, and I had no pack. For a second, loneliness overwhelmed me. I had no pack now."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.description: I refused to follow Sam's command and I declared that his decision did not bind me anymore.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc1.source_text: "I won’t follow you, Sam. Not for something so wrong."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I confirmed that Jacob and Seth disbanded from the pack to warn the Cullens.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Jacob and Seth disbanded from the pack to warn us."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I learned that Carlisle and Esme were on their way and would arrive in about twenty minutes.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Carlisle and Esme are on their way," Emmett said. "Twenty minutes, tops."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I felt that I hadn't done any good earlier and that Bella would not listen to my warnings.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Sorry I didn’t do any good today. Told you she wouldn’t listen to me."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I recognized that I needed to stay linked to Seth and to take responsibility for his perimeter patrols.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "He needs to stay linked to Seth." "I’ll run perimeter with Seth." "I’ll take half the circle."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.description: I noticed that Seth is young and prone to mistakes after his false alarm.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Seth is young. He forgets things." "False alarm."

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I know that Leah insists she belongs to our pack and refuses to go wherever Sam is, stating, "I belong to your pack, Jacob. The end."
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: I belong to your pack, Jacob. The end.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I realized that I was beginning to feel some sympathy for Sam despite what he had done to me and Seth.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: I was beginning to feel some sympathy for Sam, despite what he had done to me, to Seth.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I learned that Leah had gone human and left a note for her mother and expected Sam to find out about it.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: I left a note for my mom. I expect we’ll hear it when Sam finds out.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I learned that the immediate plan for the pack was to keep an eye out for now rather than attack.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: I guess we just keep an eye out for now. That’s all we can do.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I realized that Leah’s love for Sam was stronger than her hatred of the Cullens and that this would keep her from leaving him.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: She loved Sam. Still. And having him wish she would disappear was more pain than she was willing to live with, now that she had a choice.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.description: I learned that I planned to check in with the Cullens while Leah offered to run the border and stay alert.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text: I’m going to go check in with the Cullens.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc3.source_text_alt: I’ll run the border, Jake. I’m not tired at all.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.description: I learned that Jacob had proposed an idea intended to help Bella or the baby.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Jacob had an idea that might help you,

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.description: I noticed that Carlisle and the others were willing to consider Jacob's idea as part of their plan for Bella.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: Jacob had an idea that might help you," Carlisle said.

tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.description: I felt sidelined and wanted to leave the credit to someone else even though a suggestion had circulated, which changed my view of whose ideas were being adopted.
tw-book4-chapter11_Sc4.source_text: I wished he would leave me out of it. I hadn't suggested anything. Give the credit to her bloodsucking husband, where it belonged.

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.description: I realized that my group does not feel like a real pack and that I feel like I am acting alone rather than leading a true pack.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: This isn't your pack! This isn't even a pack. This is just me, going off on my own!

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.description: I felt unexpected empathy for Leah when I sensed the pain in her brief words and realized her despair ran deeper than I had assumed.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.source_text:
Ugh, Leah, you ruin everything!
Yeah, I know, she told him, and the thought was loaded with the heaviness of her despair.
I felt the pain in the three little words, and it was more than I would’ve guessed.

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.description: I decided that I want Leah and Seth gone if they come as a package deal and that I prefer to keep control over who is in my circle.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc1.source_text: if you and Leah are a package deal—if the only way to get rid of her is for you to go home.… Well, can you blame me for wanting you gone?

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I learned that Leah left a note for her mother and chose not to return to Sam's pack.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “I left a note for my mom. I expect we’ll hear it when Sam finds out.…”

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I learned that Sam planned to consult the other Elders and that an immediate attack seemed unlikely, with the pack warning that it was 'open season on vamps' for the moment.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “Sam was planning to talk to the other Elders first thing this morning. ... I’m not sure what they’ll do, but I wouldn’t be wandering the forest alone if I was a leech. It’s open season on vamps now.”

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I felt unexpected sympathy for Sam despite his earlier actions against Jacob and Seth.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “I was beginning to feel some sympathy for Sam, despite what he had done to me, to Seth.”

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I felt that Leah was particularly annoying and that I would trade her for almost anyone if a three-person group were required.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “But if there had to be three of us, it was hard to think of anyone that I wouldn’t trade her for.”

tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.description: I recognized that Carlisle and the Cullens were grateful to me and publicly thanked me for helping ensure their family's safety.
tw-book4-chapter12_Sc2.source_text: “I didn’t get a chance to thank you last night, Jacob. You don’t know how much I appreciate your… compassion. I know your goal was to protect Bella, but I owe you the safety of the rest of my family as well.”

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.description: I learned that I have Leah in my pack and that she follows my lead so she was assigned to keep an eye on Seth.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I stated that Leah is in my pack so she follows my lead and that her presence was to keep an eye on Seth.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.description: I admitted that I would never blame Leah again because I understood how unbearable misery could make someone lash out and shift burden onto others.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I confessed that I would never blame her again after I realized how anyone might try to ease their burden by passing some of it on.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.description: I decided to stay with Bella because I had nowhere else to go and because I believed leaving would make her situation harder, showing my protective instinct despite discomfort.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc1.source_text: I explained that I didn't really have anywhere else to go and that leaving would only make it worse for Bella, so I stayed.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I observed that Jacob phased to the clearing, positioned Seth at his right shoulder and Leah at his left, and maintained caution while confronting the approaching party.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: I made the little clearing then, moving immediately to the point. Seth sighed with relief and then straightened up, already in place at my right shoulder. Leah fell in on my left with a little less enthusiasm.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I heard Jared present a white flag and request that Jacob return with them for discussion.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: White flag of truce, Jake. We’re here to talk.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I suspected that the elders might be betting on Bella dying and that Jacob could be manipulated into leading an attack if that happened.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: They’re betting on Bella dying anyway. And then they figure you’ll be so mad...

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I felt Jacob's mistrust of Sam’s leadership decisions increase as Jacob suspected a diversion and questioned sending Collin instead of a more experienced wolf.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: But… it was weird that Sam would send Collin rather than Embry. That wasn’t what I would do if I were sending a diplomacy party into enemy territory.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.description: I noted that Jacob instructed Leah to make a circuit as a precaution while he planned to speak phased, showing his priority on guarding the pack’s backs.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc2.source_text: Leah, make a circuit—just to be sure. I’m going to have to talk to him, and I want to be positive there isn’t anything else going on while I’m phased.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I found a stack of light-colored fabric on the bottom step of the porch that I thought Edward had left for me.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: There was a stack of light-colored fabric on the bottom step of the porch. I loped over to investigate. Someone had laid out clothes. Huh. Edward must have caught my moment of irritation as I’d bolted out the door. Well. That was… nice. And weird.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I carried the clothes into the trees, I dropped the stinking pile and I shifted back to human before shaking them out.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: In the cover of the trees, I dropped the stinking pile and shifted back to human. I shook the clothes out, snapping them against a tree to beat some of the smell from them.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I noticed the vampire smell stuck to the fabric and I concluded the clothes were definitely guy’s clothes that looked like Emmett’s.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: Holding my breath, because the vampire smell stuck to the fabric like you wouldn’t believe... They were definitely guy’s clothes—tan pants and a white button-down shirt. Neither of them long enough, but they looked like they’d fit around me. Must be Emmett’s.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I acknowledged that I had no place to go back to and that I lacked possessions.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: The homeless thing again—not having anyplace to go back to. No possessions, either, which wasn’t bothering me too bad now, but would probably get annoying soon.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.description: I felt conflicted and hurt that Bella, though married and pregnant, was pleased to see me which made staying away feel harder.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc3.source_text: What was with her? For crying out loud, she was married! ... And hugely pregnant, to top it off. So why did she have to be so damn thrilled to see me? ... If she would just not care… Or more than that—really not want me around. It would be so much easier to stay away.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I learned that Jacob had slept through the rest of the day and the whole night and apologized to Seth for missing his duties.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: Well, damn. I’d slept through the rest of the day and the whole night—dropped the ball. “Crap. Sorry about that, Seth. Really. You shoulda kicked me awake.”

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I learned that Jacob had been on extended patrols before and had not taken a break for 'like forty hours? Fifty?' as noted by Seth.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: You haven’t taken a break since when? Night before your last patrol for Sam? Like forty hours? Fifty? You’re not a machine,

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I learned that Seth ran a twelve-hour shift and that Leah was on patrol after they traded off around midnight.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: “She’s on it. No worries. She’ll howl if there’s anything. We traded off around midnight. I ran twelve hours.”

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I believed that Bella did not belong to Jacob as he thought 'She didn’t belong to me' and stepped back from claiming her.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: Right. None of my business, anyway. She didn’t belong to me.

tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.description: I decided that Jacob was attentive and possessive toward Bella because he watched her color, asked about her rib, and appraised her reaction.
tw-book4-chapter13_Sc4.source_text: Nothing at all? I glanced quickly at Bella. Her color was back to the way I remembered it. How’s the rib? I asked.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc1.description: I found that Jacob Black is not mentioned or present in this excerpt.

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I saw Jacob appear from the darkness, hug me tightly, and press his cheek to the top of my head.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.source_text: I read: "Hey there, Bells." "He made no effort to dance; he just hugged me while I buried my face in his chest. He leaned down to press his cheek to the top of my head."

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I felt Jacob's heart beating under my palm while he held my hand to his chest.
tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.source_text: I read: "He cradled our hands to his chest; I could feel his heart beat under my palm."

tw-book4-chapter14_Sc2.description: I learned that Jacob had been wandering and only really started running back that morning because he didn’t know if he could make it in time.
